//// src/cloud/gzip.js
let codec = null;
async function pipe(u8, stream) {
    const rs = new Blob([u8]).stream().pipeThrough(stream);
    return new Uint8Array(await new Response(rs).arrayBuffer());
}
export function compression() {
    if (codec) return codec;
    if (typeof CompressionStream !== "undefined" && typeof Blob !== "undefined" && typeof Response !== "undefined") {
        codec = {
            name: "gz1",
            gzip: (u8) => pipe(u8, new CompressionStream("gzip")),
            gunzip: (u8) => pipe(u8, new DecompressionStream("gzip")),
        };
    } else {
        codec = { name: "raw", gzip: async (u8) => u8, gunzip: async (u8) => u8 };
    }
    return codec;
}
export async function gunzipAs(name, u8) {
    if (name === "raw" || name == null) return u8;
    const c = compression();
    if (c.name !== name) throw new Error(`this drawing's chunks are ${name}-compressed and this browser cannot read them`);
    return c.gunzip(u8);
}
//// src/cloud/lzWorker.js
import LZString from "lz-string";
let worker = null;
let broken = false;
let seq = 0;
const pending = new Map();
function workerUrl() {
    const base = (typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env && process.env.PUBLIC_URL) || "";
    return base + "/lz-worker.js";
}
function getWorker() {
    if (broken) return null;
    if (worker) return worker;
    if (typeof Worker === "undefined") { broken = true; return null; }
    try {
        worker = new Worker(workerUrl());
    } catch (err) {
        broken = true;
        return null;
    }
    worker.onmessage = (e) => {
        const { id, ok, out, err } = e.data || {};
        const p = pending.get(id);
        if (!p) return;
        pending.delete(id);
        if (ok) p.resolve(out); else p.reject(new Error(err || "lz worker failed"));
    };
    worker.onerror = (e) => {
        broken = true;
        const failed = [...pending.values()];
        pending.clear();
        try { worker.terminate(); } catch (err2) {  }
        worker = null;
        for (const p of failed) p.reject(new Error("lz worker unavailable"));
        if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
    };
    return worker;
}
function run(op, data, transfer) {
    const w = getWorker();
    if (!w) return null;
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const id = ++seq;
        pending.set(id, { resolve, reject });
        try { w.postMessage({ id, op, data }, transfer || []); }
        catch (err) { pending.delete(id); reject(err); }
    });
}
const unavailable = (err) => /lz worker unavailable/.test(String((err && err.message) || err));
export async function compressToUint8Array(json) {
    const job = run("compress", json);
    if (job) {
        try { return await job; } catch (err) { if (!unavailable(err)) throw err; }
    }
    return LZString.compressToUint8Array(json);
}
export async function decompressFromUint8Array(u8) {
    const job = run("decompress", u8.slice(), null);
    if (job) {
        try {
            const out = await job;
            return out == null ? "" : out;
        } catch (err) { if (!unavailable(err)) throw err; }
    }
    return LZString.decompressFromUint8Array(u8) ?? "";
}
//// src/cloud/storageLocks.js
const abortError = () => Object.assign(new Error("The lock request was aborted"), { name: "AbortError" });
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
export function makeStorageLocks({ storage = typeof localStorage !== "undefined" ? localStorage : null, heartbeatMs = 1000, staleMs = 10000, pollMs = 250, settleMs = 60, now = () => Date.now(), target = typeof window !== "undefined" ? window : null } = {}) {
    const key = (name) => `boundless.lock.${name}`;
    const read = (name) => { try { return JSON.parse(storage.getItem(key(name)) || "null"); } catch (err) { return null; } };
    const write = (name, owner) => { try { storage.setItem(key(name), JSON.stringify({ owner, at: now() })); } catch (err) {  } };
    const isFree = (v) => !v || !(now() - v.at <= staleMs);
    const held = new Map();
    if (target && target.addEventListener) {
        target.addEventListener("pagehide", () => {
            for (const [owner, name] of held) { const v = read(name); if (v && v.owner === owner) { try { storage.removeItem(key(name)); } catch (err) {  } } }
        });
    }
    return {
        request(name, opts, cb) {
            if (typeof opts === "function") { cb = opts; opts = {}; }
            opts = opts || {};
            const owner = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + now().toString(36);
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                let beat = null;
                let over = false;
                const end = (fn, v) => { if (over) return; over = true; clearInterval(beat); held.delete(owner); fn(v); };
                const letGo = () => { const v = read(name); if (v && v.owner === owner) { try { storage.removeItem(key(name)); } catch (err) {  } } };
                const granted = () => {
                    held.set(owner, name);
                    beat = setInterval(() => {
                        const v = read(name);
                        if (!v || v.owner !== owner) { end(reject, abortError()); return; }
                        write(name, owner);
                    }, heartbeatMs);
                    Promise.resolve()
                        .then(() => cb({ name, mode: "exclusive" }))
                        .then((v) => { if (!over) letGo(); end(resolve, v); }, (e) => { if (!over) letGo(); end(reject, e); });
                };
                const attempt = async () => {
                    if (over) return;
                    if (opts.signal && opts.signal.aborted) { end(reject, abortError()); return; }
                    if (opts.steal || isFree(read(name))) {
                        write(name, owner);
                        await sleep(settleMs);
                        if (opts.signal && opts.signal.aborted) { letGo(); end(reject, abortError()); return; }
                        const v = read(name);
                        if (v && v.owner === owner) { granted(); return; }
                    }
                    if (opts.ifAvailable) {
                        over = true;
                        Promise.resolve().then(() => cb(null)).then(resolve, reject);
                        return;
                    }
                    setTimeout(attempt, pollMs);
                };
                if (opts.signal) opts.signal.addEventListener("abort", () => { if (!beat) end(reject, abortError()); });
                attempt();
            });
        },
    };
}
//// src/cloud/store2.js
import { packChunk, unpackChunk, CHUNK_FRAME, CHUNK_LOG } from "../engine/format2";
export const PART_BYTES = 700 * 1024;
export function packFrameChunk({ frameId, seq, objects, geo }) {
    return packChunk(CHUNK_FRAME, { frame: String(frameId), seq: seq || 0, objects }, geo);
}
export function unpackFrameChunk(u8) {
    const { kind, header, geo } = unpackChunk(u8);
    if (kind !== CHUNK_FRAME) throw new Error("not a frame chunk");
    return { frameId: header.frame, seq: header.seq || 0, objects: header.objects || [], geo };
}
export function packLogChunk(entries) {
    let total = 0;
    for (const e of entries) total += e.geo ? e.geo.length : 0;
    const geo = new Float64Array(total);
    let off = 0;
    const list = entries.map((e) => {
        const n = e.geo ? e.geo.length : 0;
        if (n) geo.set(e.geo, off);
        const h = { seq: e.seq, t: e.t, op: e.op, touches: e.touches || [], g: [off, n] };
        off += n;
        return h;
    });
    return packChunk(CHUNK_LOG, { entries: list }, geo);
}
export function unpackLogChunk(u8) {
    const { kind, header, geo } = unpackChunk(u8);
    if (kind !== CHUNK_LOG) throw new Error("not a log chunk");
    return (header.entries || []).map((h) => {
        const [off, n] = h.g || [0, 0];
        if (off < 0 || off + n > geo.length) throw new Error(`bad log chunk: entry ${h.seq} outside its array`);
        return { seq: h.seq, t: h.t, op: h.op, touches: h.touches || [], geo: geo.subarray(off, off + n) };
    });
}
export function splitParts(u8, size = PART_BYTES) {
    const parts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < u8.length; i += size) parts.push(u8.subarray(i, i + size));
    if (!parts.length) parts.push(new Uint8Array(0));
    return parts;
}
export function joinParts(parts) {
    let total = 0;
    for (const p of parts) total += p.length;
    const out = new Uint8Array(total);
    let off = 0;
    for (const p of parts) { out.set(p, off); off += p.length; }
    return out;
}
//// src/cloud/syncCore.js
export const LEASE_TTL_MS = 90 * 1000;
export const LEASE_BEAT_MS = 20 * 1000;
export const LEASE_SKEW_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
export function newEpoch() {
    return Date.now().toString(36).slice(-5) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7);
}
export function headOf(manifest) {
    if (!manifest) return null;
    const h = manifest.head;
    if (h && h.seq != null) return { epoch: h.epoch == null ? 0 : h.epoch, seq: h.seq || 0 };
    return { epoch: 0, seq: manifest.seq || 0 };
}
export function sameHead(a, b) {
    return !!a && !!b && String(a.epoch) === String(b.epoch) && (a.seq || 0) === (b.seq || 0);
}
export function leaseState(lease, { device, now = Date.now(), skewMs = LEASE_SKEW_MS }) {
    if (!lease || !lease.device) return { free: true, mine: false, holder: null };
    if (!(lease.until > 0)) return lease.to && lease.to !== device ? { free: false, mine: false, holder: lease, reserved: true } : { free: true, mine: lease.device === device, holder: null };
    if (lease.device === device) return { free: true, mine: true, holder: lease };
    if (now > lease.until + skewMs) return { free: true, mine: false, holder: null };
    return { free: false, mine: false, holder: lease };
}
function chunkNames(m) {
    const out = new Set();
    for (const f of Object.values((m && m.frames) || {})) out.add(f.chunk);
    for (const c of (m && m.log) || []) out.add(c.chunk);
    return out;
}
export function intentLanded(intent, manifest, col) {
    if (!intent || intent.col !== col || !manifest) return false;
    if (sameHead(intent, headOf(manifest))) return true;
    const named = chunkNames(manifest);
    return (intent.chunks || []).some((c) => named.has(c));
}
export function decideOpen({ local, cloud, deviceId, col }) {
    if (!cloud) return { action: "none", base: local && local.base && local.base.col === col ? local.base : null, why: "no cloud copy" };
    if (cloud.format !== "kobin-2") return { action: "legacy", base: null, why: "an lz1 cloud copy" };
    const head = { ...headOf(cloud), col };
    if (!local) return { action: "pull", full: true, base: null, why: "no local copy" };
    const kobin2 = local.store === "kobin-2";
    let base = kobin2 && local.base && local.base.col === col ? local.base : null;
    if (kobin2 && intentLanded(local.intent, cloud, col)) base = { epoch: local.intent.epoch, seq: local.intent.seq || 0, col };
    const seq = kobin2 ? local.seq || 0 : 0;
    if (!base) {
        if (!(local.strokes > 0)) return { action: "pull", full: true, base: null, why: "the local copy is empty" };
        if (!cloud.head && cloud.device && cloud.device === deviceId) base = { epoch: 0, seq: cloud.seq || 0, col };
        else if (kobin2 && sameFrames(local, cloud) && seq === head.seq) base = head;
        else {
            const cloudAt = String(cloud.savedAt || ""), localAt = String(local.savedAt || "");
            if (cloudAt > localAt || !kobin2) return { action: "stash", full: true, base: null, why: "unknown ancestry, the cloud copy is newer" };
            return { action: "conflict", base: null, why: "unknown ancestry, this copy is newer" };
        }
    }
    const ahead = seq > (base.seq || 0);
    const moved = !sameHead(head, base);
    if (!ahead && !moved) return { action: "sync", base, why: "in step" };
    if (ahead && !moved) return { action: "push", base, why: "this device is ahead" };
    if (!ahead && moved) return { action: "pull", full: false, base, why: "the cloud moved" };
    return { action: "conflict", base, why: "both moved" };
}
function sameFrames(local, cloud) {
    const lf = local.frameSeq || {}, cf = cloud.frames || {};
    const lk = Object.keys(lf), ck = Object.keys(cf);
    if (lk.length !== ck.length) return false;
    for (const k of lk) if (!cf[k] || (cf[k].seq || 0) !== (lf[k] || 0)) return false;
    return true;
}
export function conflictName(name, deviceName, at = new Date()) {
    let day = "";
    try { day = at.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: "short", day: "numeric" }); } catch (err) { day = at.toISOString().slice(0, 10); }
    return `${name || "Untitled canvas"} — edits from ${deviceName || "another device"}, ${day}`;
}
export function defaultDeviceName(ua = typeof navigator !== "undefined" ? navigator.userAgent : "") {
    const s = String(ua || "");
    const browser = /Edg\//.test(s) ? "Edge" : /OPR\//.test(s) ? "Opera" : /Firefox\//.test(s) ? "Firefox"
        : /CriOS|Chrome\//.test(s) ? "Chrome" : /Safari\//.test(s) ? "Safari" : "Browser";
    const os = /iPhone/.test(s) ? "iPhone" : /iPad/.test(s) ? "iPad" : /Android/.test(s) ? "Android"
        : /Windows/.test(s) ? "Windows" : /Mac OS X|Macintosh/.test(s) ? "Mac" : /CrOS/.test(s) ? "ChromeOS" : /Linux/.test(s) ? "Linux" : "";
    return os ? `${browser} on ${os}` : browser;
}
//// src/cloud/useUser.js
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import {
    GoogleAuthProvider, signInWithPopup, signInWithRedirect, signOut, onAuthStateChanged,
} from "firebase/auth";
import { getFirebaseAuth } from "./firebaseApp";
export default function useUser() {
    const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
    const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
    useEffect(() => onAuthStateChanged(getFirebaseAuth(), (u) => { setUser(u); setReady(true); }), []);
    return { user, ready };
}
export async function signInWithGoogle() {
    const provider = new GoogleAuthProvider();
    const auth = getFirebaseAuth();
    try {
        const cred = await signInWithPopup(auth, provider);
        return cred.user;
    } catch (err) {
        if (err && (err.code === "auth/popup-blocked"
            || err.code === "auth/operation-not-supported-in-this-environment")) {
            await signInWithRedirect(auth, provider);
            return null;
        }
        throw err;
    }
}
export function signOutUser() {
    return signOut(getFirebaseAuth());
}
//// src/engine/Camera.js
import { W, HALF_W } from "./frameLattice";
export default class Camera {
    constructor(levelMap, cfg, hooks = {}) {
        this.lm = levelMap;
        this.cfg = cfg;
        this.frame = "0";
        this.inScale = 1; this.inPanX = 0; this.inPanY = 0;
        this.hooks = hooks;
    }
    get activeLevel() { const d = this.lm.depthOf(this.frame); return d == null ? 0 : d; }
    set activeLevel(v) { this.frame = this.lm.ensureSpine(v); }
    set(camera) {
        if (camera.frame != null && this.lm.frame(camera.frame)) this.frame = camera.frame;
        else this.frame = this.lm.ensureSpine(camera.activeLevel || 0);
        this.inScale = camera.inScale; this.inPanX = camera.inPanX; this.inPanY = camera.inPanY;
    }
    state() { return { activeLevel: this.activeLevel, frame: this.frame, inScale: this.inScale, inPanX: this.inPanX, inPanY: this.inPanY }; }
    screenToFrame(sx, sy) { return [(sx - this.inPanX) / this.inScale, (sy - this.inPanY) / this.inScale]; }
    frameWindow(margin = 0) {
        const inv = 1 / this.inScale;
        return {
            left: (0 - this.inPanX) * inv - margin, top: (0 - this.inPanY) * inv - margin,
            right: (this.lm.width - this.inPanX) * inv + margin, bottom: (this.lm.height - this.inPanY) * inv + margin,
        };
    }
    centre() { return [(this.lm.width / 2 - this.inPanX) / this.inScale, (this.lm.height / 2 - this.inPanY) / this.inScale]; }
    panBy(dx, dy) { this.inPanX += dx; this.inPanY += dy; return this._settle(); }
    zoomFactorAt(sx, sy, factor) {
        if (!(factor > 0) || !Number.isFinite(factor)) return false;
        if (this.hooks.finalizeLiveStroke) this.hooks.finalizeLiveStroke();
        const ns = this.inScale * factor;
        this.inPanX = sx - ((sx - this.inPanX) / this.inScale) * ns;
        this.inPanY = sy - ((sy - this.inPanY) / this.inScale) * ns;
        this.inScale = ns;
        return this._maybeCross();
    }
    zoomAt(sx, sy, deltaY) { return this.zoomFactorAt(sx, sy, Math.pow(2, -deltaY / 1000)); }
    pinchUpdate(mx, my, factor, dx, dy) { this.inPanX += dx; this.inPanY += dy; return this.zoomFactorAt(mx, my, factor); }
    _maybeShift() {
        if (this.hooks.holdFrame && this.hooks.holdFrame()) return false;
        const [cx, cy] = this.centre();
        if (cx >= -HALF_W && cx < HALF_W && cy >= -HALF_W && cy < HALF_W) return false;
        const di = Math.floor((cx + HALF_W) / W), dj = Math.floor((cy + HALF_W) / W);
        const to = this.lm.neighbour(this.frame, di, dj);
        if (!to || to.id === this.frame) return false;
        this.frame = to.id;
        this.inPanX += di * W * this.inScale;
        this.inPanY += dj * W * this.inScale;
        return true;
    }
    settle() { return this._settle(); }
    _maybeCross() { return this._settle(); }
    _settle() {
        const from = this.activeLevel;
        const was = this.frame;
        let guard = 0;
        for (;;) {
            let did = this._maybeShift();
            if (this.inScale > this.cfg.enter) { this._crossUp(); did = true; }
            else if (this.inScale < this.cfg.exit) { this._crossDown(); did = true; }
            if (!did) break;
            if (++guard > 64) break;
        }
        const changed = this.frame !== was;
        if (changed && this.hooks.onCross) this.hooks.onCross(from, this.activeLevel);
        return changed;
    }
    _crossUp() {
        const base = this.cfg.base;
        const child = this.lm.ensureChild(this.frame, this.inScale, this.inPanX, this.inPanY);
        if (child.parent != null && child.parent !== this.frame) {
            const o = this.lm.mapPointF([0, 0], child.parent, this.frame);
            if (o) {
                this.inPanX += o[0] * this.inScale;
                this.inPanY += o[1] * this.inScale;
                this.frame = child.parent;
            }
        }
        const { s, t } = child.edge;
        const nis = this.inScale * base / s;
        this.inPanX = this.inPanX - t.x * nis / base;
        this.inPanY = this.inPanY - t.y * nis / base;
        this.inScale = nis;
        this.frame = child.id;
    }
    _crossDown() {
        const base = this.cfg.base;
        const edge = this.lm.ensureParentEdge(this.frame);
        const { s, t } = edge;
        const cur = this.inScale, px = this.inPanX, py = this.inPanY;
        this.frame = this.lm.parentOf(this.frame);
        this.inScale = (s / base) * cur;
        this.inPanX = (t.x / base) * cur + px;
        this.inPanY = (t.y / base) * cur + py;
    }
    effectiveZoom() { return this.lm.effectiveZoom(this.frame, this.inScale); }
    levelPointToScreen(key, x, y) {
        return this.lm.framePointToScreen(key, x, y, this.frame, this.inScale, this.inPanX, this.inPanY);
    }
}

import {
    loopsBBox, translateLoops, transformLoopsAbout, encodeLoops, decodeLoops, shapeFromRings, normalizeLoops,
    subtractShape, rectLoop, shapeComponents, dropDust, repairLoops, validEncodedLoops,
} from "./geometry/arcShape";
import { tilePhase, childTilePhase } from "./frameLattice";
import { cloneBelow, shiftDown, shiftUp, hasOffsets, decodeBelow, addOffset, sameShift } from "./geometry/offsets";
import { objectHeader, extraFields } from "./format2";
import { Loop } from "./geometry/loop";
function flattenLoops(o) {
    if (o && o.type === "shape" && o.loops) {
        for (let i = 0; i < o.loops.length; i++) if (!(o.loops[i] instanceof Loop)) o.loops[i] = Loop.from(o.loops[i]);
    }
    return o;
}
const CELL = 2048;
const BIG = CELL * 4;
const WALK_MAX = 2 ** 40;
const OFF_LOG_MAX = 100000;
class LevelIndex {
    constructor() { this.cells = new Map(); this.big = new Set(); this.boxes = new Map(); this.objs = new Map(); this.ext = null; this.maxSize = 0; this.maxZ = -Infinity; }
    _key(cx, cy) { return cx + "," + cy; }
    _cellsOf(b, fn) {
        const x0 = Math.floor(b.x0 / CELL), x1 = Math.floor(b.x1 / CELL);
        const y0 = Math.floor(b.y0 / CELL), y1 = Math.floor(b.y1 / CELL);
        for (let cx = x0; cx <= x1; cx++) for (let cy = y0; cy <= y1; cy++) fn(this._key(cx, cy));
    }
    add(o) {
        const m = (o.type === "fill" || o.type === "shape") ? 0 : (o.lwFrame || 0) / 2;
        let x0 = Infinity, y0 = Infinity, x1 = -Infinity, y1 = -Infinity;
        const scan = (pts) => { for (const p of pts) { if (p[0] < x0) x0 = p[0]; if (p[0] > x1) x1 = p[0]; if (p[1] < y0) y0 = p[1]; if (p[1] > y1) y1 = p[1]; } };
        if (o.type === "shape") {
            const bb = loopsBBox(o.loops);
            if (bb) { x0 = bb.x0; y0 = bb.y0; x1 = bb.x1; y1 = bb.y1; }
        } else if (o.type === "fill") { for (const poly of o.polys) scan(poly); } else scan(o.pts);
        const b = { x0: x0 - m, y0: y0 - m, x1: x1 + m, y1: y1 + m };
        const lw = o.lwFrame || 0;
        if (!this.ext) this.ext = { x0: x0 - lw, y0: y0 - lw, x1: x1 + lw, y1: y1 + lw };
        else { const e = this.ext; if (x0 - lw < e.x0) e.x0 = x0 - lw; if (y0 - lw < e.y0) e.y0 = y0 - lw; if (x1 + lw > e.x1) e.x1 = x1 + lw; if (y1 + lw > e.y1) e.y1 = y1 + lw; }
        const size = Math.hypot(x1 - x0, y1 - y0) + lw;
        if (size > this.maxSize) this.maxSize = size;
        const z = o.z != null ? o.z : o.id;
        if (z > this.maxZ) this.maxZ = z;
        this.boxes.set(o.id, b);
        this.objs.set(o.id, o);
        if (b.x1 - b.x0 > BIG || b.y1 - b.y0 > BIG) { this.big.add(o); return; }
        this._cellsOf(b, (k) => {
            let s = this.cells.get(k);
            if (!s) { s = new Set(); this.cells.set(k, s); }
            s.add(o);
        });
    }
    remove(o) {
        const b = this.boxes.get(o.id);
        if (!b) return;
        this.boxes.delete(o.id);
        this.objs.delete(o.id);
        if (this.big.delete(o)) return;
        this._cellsOf(b, (k) => {
            const s = this.cells.get(k);
            if (s) { s.delete(o); if (!s.size) this.cells.delete(k); }
        });
    }
    query(rect, out) {
        const seen = new Set();
        const q = { x0: rect.left, y0: rect.top, x1: rect.right, y1: rect.bottom };
        const e = this.ext;
        if (!e || !(q.x1 >= e.x0 && q.x0 <= e.x1 && q.y1 >= e.y0 && q.y0 <= e.y1)) return out;
        const nx = Math.floor(q.x1 / CELL) - Math.floor(q.x0 / CELL) + 1;
        const ny = Math.floor(q.y1 / CELL) - Math.floor(q.y0 / CELL) + 1;
        const far = !(Math.abs(q.x0) < WALK_MAX && Math.abs(q.x1) < WALK_MAX && Math.abs(q.y0) < WALK_MAX && Math.abs(q.y1) < WALK_MAX);
        if (far || nx * ny > 4096 || nx * ny > this.objs.size) {
            for (const [, o] of this.objs) {
                const b = this.boxes.get(o.id);
                if (b.x1 >= q.x0 && b.x0 <= q.x1 && b.y1 >= q.y0 && b.y0 <= q.y1) out.push(o);
            }
            return out;
        }
        this._cellsOf(q, (k) => {
            const s = this.cells.get(k);
            if (s) for (const o of s) {
                if (seen.has(o.id)) continue;
                seen.add(o.id);
                const b = this.boxes.get(o.id);
                if (b.x1 >= q.x0 && b.x0 <= q.x1 && b.y1 >= q.y0 && b.y0 <= q.y1) out.push(o);
            }
        });
        for (const o of this.big) {
            const b = this.boxes.get(o.id);
            if (b.x1 >= q.x0 && b.x0 <= q.x1 && b.y1 >= q.y0 && b.y0 <= q.y1) out.push(o);
        }
        return out;
    }
}
export function nativeFromRecord(o) {
    const { windows, srcId, paths, ...keep } = o;
    if (keep.below != null) {
        try { keep.below = decodeBelow(keep.below); } catch (err) { delete keep.below; }
        if (!keep.below) delete keep.below;
    }
    const extra = extraFields(o);
    let out;
    if (keep.type === "shape" && keep.loops) {
        out = { ...keep };
        out.loops = validEncodedLoops(keep.loops)
            ? keep.loops.map((l) => (l instanceof Loop ? l : Loop.wrap(l)))
            : repairLoops(decodeLoops(keep.loops), keep.w).map(Loop.from);
    } else out = { ...keep };
    if (extra) out._extra = extra;
    return out;
}
export const UNDO_CAP = 200;
export function opFrames(op, out = new Set()) {
    const add = (k) => { if (k != null) out.add(String(k)); };
    if (!op) return out;
    switch (op.op) {
        case "absent": case "erase": add(op.level); break;
        case "move": add(op.from); add(op.to); break;
        case "moveMany": for (const m of op.moves) { add(m.from); add(m.to); } break;
        case "eraseMany": case "removeMany": for (const r of op.records) add(r.level); break;
        case "removeFrames": case "eraseFrames": for (const r of op.records) add(r.frame); break;
        case "deleteMany": for (const p of op.parts) opFrames(p, out); break;
        case "moveFrames":
            for (const e of op.frames) {
                add(e.id); if (e.from) add(e.from.parent); if (e.to) add(e.to.parent);
                for (const m of e.merged || []) { add(m.id); add(m.into); add(m.parent); for (const kd of m.kids || []) add(kd.shadowOf); }
                if (e.settled) for (const c of e.settled.carries || []) add(c[1]);
            }
            for (const m of op.moves || []) { add(m.from); add(m.to); }
            break;
        case "eraseCommit": case "eraseRevert":
            if (op.strokeRec) add(op.strokeRec.level);
            for (const st of op.baked || []) {
                if (st.removed) add(st.removed.level);
                for (const p of st.pieces || []) add(p.level);
                for (const r of st.frames || []) add(r.frame);
            }
            break;
        default: break;
    }
    return out;
}
export default class Document {
    constructor() {
        this.nativesByLevel = { 0: [] };
        this._nextId = 1;
        this._stepSeq = 0;
        this._undo = []; this._redo = [];
        this._subs = new Set(); this._opSubs = new Set(); this._inUndo = false;
        this._index = {};
        this._pending = new Set();
        this._byId = new Map();
        this._groups = null;
        this.rev = 0;
        this.offRev = 0;
        this._offLog = [];
        this._offWide = 0;
        this._offsetIds = new Set();
        this.lm = null;
        this._frameOwner = new Map();
        this.holdMerges = false;
        this._detached = new Set();
        this._detachedLists = new Map();
        this._reused = new Set();
        this._keyedIn = new Map();
        this._detachedKeyed = new Map();
    }
    _noteBelow(o) {
        if (hasOffsets(o.below)) this._offsetIds.add(o.id);
        else { if (o.below !== undefined) delete o.below; this._offsetIds.delete(o.id); }
    }
    hasOffsets() { return this._offsetIds.size > 0; }
    offsetIds() { return this._offsetIds; }
    subscribe(fn) { this._subs.add(fn); return () => this._subs.delete(fn); }
    _emit(ev) {
        if (!(ev && ev.offsetsOnly)) this._groups = null;
        this.rev++;
        if (!(ev && ev.obj && !ev.offsetsOnly && ev.obj.below === undefined && !this._offsetIds.has(ev.id))) {
            this.offRev++;
            if (ev && ev.obj && ev.id != null) {
                this._offLog.push(this.offRev, ev.id);
                if (this._offLog.length > OFF_LOG_MAX * 2) { this._offLog.splice(0, OFF_LOG_MAX); }
            } else this._offWide = this.offRev;
        }
        for (const fn of this._subs) fn(ev);
    }
    offTouchedSince(rev) {
        if (this._offWide > rev) return null;
        const L = this._offLog;
        if (L.length && L[0] > rev + 1) return null;
        const out = new Set();
        for (let i = L.length - 2; i >= 0 && L[i] > rev; i -= 2) out.add(L[i + 1]);
        return out;
    }
    subscribeOps(fn) { this._opSubs.add(fn); return () => this._opSubs.delete(fn); }
    _notifyOps(ev) { for (const fn of this._opSubs) fn(ev); }
    recordBake(op, step) { step._seq = ++this._stepSeq; op.baked.push(step); this._notifyOps({ kind: "bake", op, step }); }
    noteId(id) { if (Number.isInteger(id) && id >= this._nextId) this._nextId = id + 1; }
    noteRefile(frameId, from, to) { this._emit({ kind: "refile", frame: String(frameId), from, to }); }
    keysChanged() { this._groups = null; this.rev++; }
    allocId() { return this._nextId++; }
    levels() { return Object.keys(this.nativesByLevel); }
    _forgetIfEmpty(k) {
        const arr = this.nativesByLevel[k];
        if (!arr || arr.length) return false;
        delete this.nativesByLevel[k];
        delete this._index[k];
        return true;
    }
    at(level) {
        const k = String(level);
        const f = this.lm ? this.lm.frame(k) : null;
        if (f && f._shadows && f._shadows.size && !this.holdMerges) this._mergeShadows(f);
        const arr = this.nativesByLevel[k];
        if (!arr) return [];
        if (f && f.shift) this._settleIfPending(k, arr);
        return arr;
    }
    count(level) { const arr = this.nativesByLevel[level]; return arr ? arr.length : 0; }
    list(level) { return this.nativesByLevel[level] || []; }
    _settleIfPending(level, arr) {
        if (!this.lm) return;
        const k = String(level);
        const f = this.lm.frame(k);
        if (!f || !f.shift) return;
        const [dx, dy] = f.shift;
        f.shift = null;
        const list = arr || this.nativesByLevel[k] || [];
        if (!list.length) return;
        const tables = [], carried = [];
        for (const o of list) {
            const r = addOffset(o.below, 0, dx, dy);
            o.below = r.below; this._noteBelow(o); o._ver = (o._ver || 0) + 1;
            tables.push([o.id, r.below || null]);
            if (r.cellX || r.cellY) carried.push([o, r.cellX, r.cellY]);
            this._emit({ kind: "change", id: o.id, level: k, obj: o, offsetsOnly: true });
        }
        const carries = [];
        for (const [o, cx, cy] of carried) {
            const n = this.lm.neighbour(k, cx, cy);
            if (n) { this.rehomeById(o.id, n.id); carries.push([o.id, n.id]); }
        }
        const rec = { dx, dy, tables, carries };
        const owner = this._frameOwner.get(k) || null;
        if (owner) owner.settled = rec;
        this._notifyOps({ kind: "settle", frame: k, rec, owner });
    }
    setFrameShift(frameId, shift) {
        const f = this.lm && this.lm.frame(String(frameId));
        if (!f) return false;
        f.shift = shift && (shift[0] || shift[1]) ? [shift[0], shift[1]] : null;
        return true;
    }
    noteFrameOwner(frameId, entry) {
        const k = String(frameId);
        if (entry) this._frameOwner.set(k, entry); else this._frameOwner.delete(k);
    }
    unsettle(frameId, settled) {
        const k = String(frameId);
        const tables = [], back = [];
        for (const [id, after] of settled.tables) {
            const o = this._byId.get(id);
            if (!o) continue;
            const r = addOffset(after, 0, -settled.dx, -settled.dy);
            o.below = r.below; this._noteBelow(o); o._ver = (o._ver || 0) + 1;
            tables.push([id, r.below || null]);
            this._emit({ kind: "change", id, level: o._home, obj: o, offsetsOnly: true });
            if (o._home !== k) back.push(id);
        }
        for (const id of back) this.rehomeById(id, k);
        if (!this._inUndo && tables.length) {
            this._notifyOps({ kind: "settle", frame: k, rec: { dx: -settled.dx, dy: -settled.dy, tables, carries: back.map((id) => [id, k]) }, owner: null });
        }
    }
    applySettle(frameId, rec) {
        const homes = new Map(rec.carries || []);
        for (const [id, after] of rec.tables) {
            const o = this._byId.get(id);
            if (!o) continue;
            const to = homes.get(id);
            if (to != null && o._home !== String(to)) this.rehomeById(id, to);
            this.setOffsetsById(id, after || undefined);
        }
    }
    _mergeShadows(E) {
        for (const mid of [...E._shadows]) {
            const M = this.lm.frame(mid);
            if (!M || this._detached.has(mid)) continue;
            this._settleIfPending(mid);
            this._settleIfPending(E.id);
            const src = this.nativesByLevel[mid] || [];
            const ids = src.map((o) => o.id);
            if (src.length) {
                this._reuseDetached(E.id);
                const dst = this.nativesByLevel[E.id] || (this.nativesByLevel[E.id] = []);
                for (const o of src) { dst.push(o); this._keyOut(mid, o); this._keyIn(E.id, o); o._home = E.id; if (!this._pending.has(o)) this._idx(E.id).add(o); o._ver = (o._ver || 0) + 1; }
            }
            delete this.nativesByLevel[mid]; delete this._index[mid];
            const rec = this.lm.adoptShadow(M, E);
            rec.ids = ids;
            const owner = this._frameOwner.get(mid) || this._frameOwner.get(E.id) || null;
            this._frameOwner.delete(mid);
            if (owner) (owner.merged || (owner.merged = [])).push(rec);
            this._emit({ kind: "mergeFrame", frame: mid, into: E.id, at: { parent: E.parent, i: E.cell.i, j: E.cell.j }, ids, kids: rec.kids.map((kd) => kd.id) });
            this._notifyOps({ kind: "mergeFrame", rec, owner });
        }
    }
    _setKeyedAside(k) {
        const set = this._keyedIn.get(k);
        this._keyedIn.delete(k);
        if (set) this._detachedKeyed.set(k, set); else this._detachedKeyed.delete(k);
    }
    detachFrame(frame, rec = null) {
        const k = String(frame);
        const arr = this.nativesByLevel[k];
        if (arr && rec && rec.kept && arr.some((o) => rec.kept.has(o))) {
            const aside = [];
            let w = 0;
            for (let r = 0; r < arr.length; r++) {
                const o = arr[r];
                if (rec.kept.has(o)) { arr[w++] = o; continue; }
                aside.push(o);
                o._gone = true;
                if (!this._pending.has(o)) this._idx(k).remove(o);
                this._keyOut(k, o);
            }
            arr.length = w;
            this._reused.add(k);
            this._detachedLists.set(k, aside);
            this._detachedKeyed.delete(k);
            rec.natives = aside; rec.index = null;
            this._emit({ kind: "removeFrame", frame: k, count: aside.length, partial: true });
            return;
        }
        const index = this._index[k] || null;
        delete this.nativesByLevel[k]; delete this._index[k];
        this._setKeyedAside(k);
        this._detached.add(k);
        if (arr) {
            this._detachedLists.set(k, arr);
            if (rec) { rec.natives = arr; rec.index = index; }
        }
        this._emit({ kind: "removeFrame", frame: k, count: arr ? arr.length : 0 });
    }
    _reuseDetached(k) {
        if (!this._detached.has(k)) return;
        for (const o of this._detachedLists.get(k) || []) if (o._home === k) o._gone = true;
        this._detached.delete(k);
        this._reused.add(k);
    }
    mergeReplay(rec) { this.rehomeManyById(rec.ids, rec.into); this._forgetIfEmpty(rec.id); }
    unmergeReplay(rec) { this.rehomeManyById(rec.ids, rec.id); this._forgetIfEmpty(rec.into); }
    unmerge(rec) {
        const M = this.lm.unadoptShadow(rec);
        const set = new Set(rec.ids);
        const src = this.nativesByLevel[rec.into] || [];
        const mine = [];
        let w = 0;
        for (let r = 0; r < src.length; r++) { const o = src[r]; if (set.has(o.id)) mine.push(o); else src[w++] = o; }
        src.length = w;
        if (mine.length) {
            this.nativesByLevel[M.id] = mine;
            for (const o of mine) {
                if (!this._pending.has(o)) { this._idx(rec.into).remove(o); this._idx(M.id).add(o); }
                this._keyOut(rec.into, o); this._keyIn(M.id, o);
                o._home = M.id; o._ver = (o._ver || 0) + 1;
            }
        }
        this._forgetIfEmpty(rec.into);
        this._emit({ kind: "splitFrame", frame: M.id, from: rec.into, at: { parent: M.parent, i: M.cell.i, j: M.cell.j }, ids: rec.ids, kids: rec.kids.map((kd) => kd.id) });
        return M;
    }
    _idx(level) { const k = String(level); return this._index[k] || (this._index[k] = new LevelIndex()); }
    _keyIn(k, o) {
        if (o.editId == null) return;
        let set = this._keyedIn.get(k);
        if (!set) this._keyedIn.set(k, (set = new Set()));
        set.add(o);
    }
    _keyOut(k, o) { const set = this._keyedIn.get(k); if (set && set.delete(o) && !set.size) this._keyedIn.delete(k); }
    keyedIn(frame) { return this._keyedIn.get(String(frame)) || null; }
    keyedFrames() { return this._keyedIn.keys(); }
    add(o, level, { live = false } = {}) {
        const k = String(level);
        this._settleIfPending(k);
        this._reuseDetached(k);
        flattenLoops(o);
        if (!this.nativesByLevel[k]) this.nativesByLevel[k] = [];
        this.nativesByLevel[k].push(o);
        o._home = k; delete o._gone;
        this._keyIn(k, o);
        this._byId.set(o.id, o);
        this._noteBelow(o);
        if (live) this._pending.add(o);
        else this._idx(k).add(o);
        this._emit({ kind: "add", id: o.id, level: k, obj: o, live });
        return o;
    }
    finalize(o) {
        if (!this._pending.delete(o)) return;
        this._idx(o._home).add(o);
        this._emit({ kind: "finalize", id: o.id, level: o._home, obj: o });
    }
    getById(id) {
        const o = this._byId.get(id);
        if (o && (o._gone || this._detached.has(o._home))) return null;
        return o ? { obj: o, level: o._home } : null;
    }
    editKey(o) { return o && o.editId != null ? o.editId : o && o.id; }
    editGroup(idOrObj) {
        const rec = typeof idOrObj === "object" ? { obj: idOrObj } : this.getById(idOrObj);
        const key = rec ? this.editKey(rec.obj) : idOrObj;
        if (key == null) return [];
        if (!this._groups) {
            const g = new Map();
            for (const level of Object.keys(this.nativesByLevel)) {
                for (const obj of this.nativesByLevel[level] || []) {
                    const k = this.editKey(obj);
                    let a = g.get(k);
                    if (!a) { a = []; g.set(k, a); }
                    a.push({ obj, level });
                }
            }
            this._groups = g;
        }
        const a = this._groups.get(key);
        return a ? a.slice() : [];
    }
    removeById(id) {
        const obj = this._byId.get(id);
        if (!obj) return null;
        this._settleIfPending(obj._home);
        const Ls = obj._home;
        const arr = this.nativesByLevel[Ls];
        const i = arr ? arr.indexOf(obj) : -1;
        if (i < 0) return null;
        arr.splice(i, 1);
        this._keyOut(Ls, obj);
        this._byId.delete(id);
        this._offsetIds.delete(id);
        this._pending.delete(obj);
        this._idx(Ls).remove(obj);
        this._forgetIfEmpty(Ls);
        this._emit({ kind: "remove", id, level: Ls, obj });
        return { obj, level: Ls, index: i };
    }
    insertAt(obj, level, index) {
        const k = String(level);
        this._settleIfPending(k);
        this._reuseDetached(k);
        flattenLoops(obj);
        if (!this.nativesByLevel[k]) this.nativesByLevel[k] = [];
        const arr = this.nativesByLevel[k];
        arr.splice(Math.min(index, arr.length), 0, obj);
        obj._home = k; delete obj._gone;
        this._keyIn(k, obj);
        this._byId.set(obj.id, obj);
        this._noteBelow(obj);
        this._idx(k).add(obj);
        this._emit({ kind: "add", id: obj.id, level: k, obj });
    }
    moveById(id, dx, dy) {
        const rec = this.getById(id);
        if (!rec || (dx === 0 && dy === 0)) return rec;
        const o = rec.obj;
        const oldBbox = this._bboxNow(o);
        const shift = (pts) => { for (const p of pts) { p[0] += dx; p[1] += dy; } };
        if (o.type === "shape") {
            o.loops = translateLoops(o.loops, dx, dy); flattenLoops(o);
        } else if (o.type === "fill") { for (const poly of o.polys) shift(poly); } else shift(o.pts);
        const shiftRect = (r) => { r.x0 += dx; r.x1 += dx; r.y0 += dy; r.y1 += dy; };
        if (o.attachRect) shiftRect(o.attachRect);
        this._afterEdit(o, rec.level, oldBbox, o.lwFrame);
        return rec;
    }
    setGeometryById(id, geom) {
        const rec = this.getById(id);
        if (!rec) return null;
        const o = rec.obj;
        const oldBbox = this._bboxNow(o);
        if (o.type === "shape") { o.loops = geom.loops.slice(); flattenLoops(o); }
        else if (o.type === "fill") o.polys = geom.polys;
        else o.pts = geom.pts;
        if (geom.attachRect) o.attachRect = { ...geom.attachRect };
        else if ("attachRect" in geom) delete o.attachRect;
        if (geom.tile) o.tile = [geom.tile[0], geom.tile[1]];
        else if ("tile" in geom) delete o.tile;
        if ("below" in geom) { o.below = cloneBelow(geom.below); this._noteBelow(o); }
        this._afterEdit(o, rec.level, oldBbox, o.lwFrame);
        return rec;
    }
    maxZUnder(rootId) {
        let m = -Infinity;
        const frames = new Set();
        this.lm.walk(rootId, (f) => { frames.add(f.id); const ix = this._index[f.id]; if (ix && ix.maxZ > m) m = ix.maxZ; });
        for (const o of this._pending) if (frames.has(o._home)) { const z = o.z != null ? o.z : o.id; if (z > m) m = z; }
        return m;
    }
    setZById(id, z) {
        const rec = this.getById(id);
        if (!rec) return null;
        const o = rec.obj, before = o.z;
        o.z = z;
        const ix = this._index[rec.level];
        if (ix && z > ix.maxZ) ix.maxZ = z;
        this._emit({ kind: "change", id: o.id, level: rec.level, obj: o, attrOnly: true });
        return before;
    }
    setOffsetsById(id, below) {
        const rec = this.getById(id);
        if (!rec) return null;
        const o = rec.obj;
        o.below = cloneBelow(below);
        this._noteBelow(o);
        o._ver = (o._ver || 0) + 1;
        this._emit({ kind: "change", id: o.id, level: rec.level, obj: o, offsetsOnly: true });
        return rec;
    }
    static snapGeometry(o) {
        const tile = o.tile ? [o.tile[0], o.tile[1]] : null;
        const below = cloneBelow(o.below);
        if (o.type === "shape") return { loops: o.loops, tile, attachRect: o.attachRect ? { ...o.attachRect } : null, below };
        if (o.type === "fill") return { polys: o.polys.map((p) => p.map((q) => [q[0], q[1]])), tile, attachRect: o.attachRect ? { ...o.attachRect } : null, below };
        return { pts: o.pts.map((q) => [q[0], q[1]]), tile, attachRect: o.attachRect ? { ...o.attachRect } : null, below };
    }
    static scaleGeometry(g, f, cx, cy) {
        const pt = ([x, y]) => [(x - cx) * f, (y - cy) * f];
        const out = {};
        out.tile = [childTilePhase(g.tile ? g.tile[0] : 0, cx, f),
            childTilePhase(g.tile ? g.tile[1] : 0, cy, f)];
        if (g.loops) out.loops = transformLoopsAbout(g.loops, cx, cy, f);
        if (g.polys) out.polys = g.polys.map((poly) => poly.map(pt));
        if (g.pts) out.pts = g.pts.map(pt);
        if (g.attachRect) {
            const a = pt([g.attachRect.x0, g.attachRect.y0]), b = pt([g.attachRect.x1, g.attachRect.y1]);
            out.attachRect = { x0: a[0], y0: a[1], x1: b[0], y1: b[1] };
        }
        out.below = f < 1 ? shiftUp(g.below) : f > 1 ? shiftDown(g.below, 1) : cloneBelow(g.below);
        return out;
    }
    static translateGeometry(g, dx, dy) {
        const out = {};
        out.tile = [tilePhase((g.tile ? g.tile[0] : 0) + dx), tilePhase((g.tile ? g.tile[1] : 0) + dy)];
        if (g.loops) out.loops = translateLoops(g.loops, dx, dy);
        if (g.polys) out.polys = g.polys.map((p) => p.map((q) => [q[0] + dx, q[1] + dy]));
        if (g.pts) out.pts = g.pts.map((q) => [q[0] + dx, q[1] + dy]);
        if (g.attachRect) out.attachRect = { x0: g.attachRect.x0 + dx, x1: g.attachRect.x1 + dx, y0: g.attachRect.y0 + dy, y1: g.attachRect.y1 + dy };
        out.below = cloneBelow(g.below);
        return out;
    }
    rehomeById(id, toLevel) {
        const k = String(toLevel);
        const o0 = this._byId.get(id);
        if (o0) this._settleIfPending(o0._home);
        this._settleIfPending(k);
        const rec = this.getById(id);
        if (!rec || rec.level === k) return rec;
        const o = rec.obj;
        const wasPending = this._pending.has(o);
        const arr = this.nativesByLevel[rec.level];
        arr.splice(arr.indexOf(o), 1);
        this._idx(rec.level).remove(o);
        this._keyOut(rec.level, o);
        this._forgetIfEmpty(rec.level);
        this._emit({ kind: "remove", id, level: rec.level, obj: o, rehome: k });
        this._reuseDetached(k);
        if (!this.nativesByLevel[k]) this.nativesByLevel[k] = [];
        this.nativesByLevel[k].push(o);
        o._home = k;
        this._keyIn(k, o);
        if (!wasPending) this._idx(k).add(o);
        o._ver = (o._ver || 0) + 1;
        this._emit({ kind: "add", id, level: k, obj: o, live: wasPending, rehome: rec.level });
        return { obj: o, level: k };
    }
    rehomeManyById(ids, toLevel) {
        const k = String(toLevel);
        this._settleIfPending(k);
        for (const id of ids) { const o = this._byId.get(id); if (o) this._settleIfPending(o._home); }
        const groups = new Map();
        for (const id of ids) {
            const rec = this.getById(id);
            if (!rec || rec.level === k) continue;
            let g = groups.get(rec.level);
            if (!g) { g = []; groups.set(rec.level, g); }
            g.push(rec.obj);
        }
        let n = 0;
        for (const [from, objs] of groups) {
            const set = new Set(objs);
            const arr = this.nativesByLevel[from];
            let w = 0;
            for (let r = 0; r < arr.length; r++) if (!set.has(arr[r])) arr[w++] = arr[r];
            arr.length = w;
            for (const o of objs) { if (!this._pending.has(o)) this._idx(from).remove(o); this._keyOut(from, o); }
            this._forgetIfEmpty(from);
            for (const o of objs) this._emit({ kind: "remove", id: o.id, level: from, obj: o, rehome: k });
            this._reuseDetached(k);
            if (!this.nativesByLevel[k]) this.nativesByLevel[k] = [];
            for (const o of objs) {
                const wasPending = this._pending.has(o);
                this.nativesByLevel[k].push(o);
                o._home = k;
                this._keyIn(k, o);
                if (!wasPending) this._idx(k).add(o);
                o._ver = (o._ver || 0) + 1;
                this._emit({ kind: "add", id: o.id, level: k, obj: o, live: wasPending, rehome: from });
                n++;
            }
        }
        return n;
    }
    removeFrameSubtree(rootId) {
        const frames = [];
        this.lm.walk(rootId, (f) => frames.push(f.id));
        const records = [];
        for (const k of frames) {
            const arr = this.nativesByLevel[k];
            if (!arr) continue;
            records.push({ frame: k, natives: arr, index: this._index[k] || null });
            delete this.nativesByLevel[k]; delete this._index[k];
            this._setKeyedAside(k);
            this._detached.add(k);
            this._detachedLists.set(k, arr);
            this._emit({ kind: "removeFrame", frame: k, count: arr.length });
        }
        return records.length ? records : null;
    }
    insertFrameSubtree(records) {
        for (const r of records) {
            const k = r.frame, cur = this.nativesByLevel[k];
            if (this._reused.delete(k)) for (const o of r.natives) delete o._gone;
            if (cur && cur !== r.natives && cur.length) {
                r.kept = new Set(cur);
                const all = r.natives.slice();
                for (const o of r.natives) {
                    flattenLoops(o); o._home = k; this._byId.set(o.id, o); this._noteBelow(o); this._keyIn(k, o);
                    if (!this._pending.has(o)) this._idx(k).add(o);
                }
                for (const o of cur) all.push(o);
                this.nativesByLevel[k] = all;
            } else {
                r.kept = null;
                this.nativesByLevel[k] = r.natives;
                const aside = this._detachedKeyed.get(k);
                if (r.index) {
                    this._index[k] = r.index;
                    for (const o of aside || r.natives) this._keyIn(k, o);
                } else {
                    delete this._index[k];
                    for (const o of r.natives) { flattenLoops(o); o._home = k; this._byId.set(o.id, o); this._noteBelow(o); this._idx(k).add(o); this._keyIn(k, o); }
                }
            }
            this._detachedKeyed.delete(k);
            this._detached.delete(k);
            this._detachedLists.delete(k);
            this._emit({ kind: "addFrame", frame: k, count: r.natives.length });
        }
    }
    eraseReplaceById(id, regions) {
        const rec = this.removeById(id);
        if (!rec) return null;
        const src = rec.obj;
        const z = src.z != null ? src.z : src.id;
        const editKey = this.editKey(src);
        const pieces = regions.map((loops) => {
            const obj = {
                type: "shape", origin: src.origin, id: this.allocId(), z, loops,
                color: src.color, opacity: src.opacity,
            };
            if (src.tile) obj.tile = [src.tile[0], src.tile[1]];
            if (src.w > 0) obj.w = src.w;
            const below = cloneBelow(src.below);
            if (below) obj.below = below;
            if (regions.length === 1 || src.editId != null) {
                obj.editId = editKey;
                if (src.attachRect) obj.attachRect = { ...src.attachRect };
            }
            return this.add(obj, rec.level);
        });
        return { removed: rec, pieces };
    }
    cedeTileById(id, level, regions, holeInParent, attachRect, kidTile, kidBelow, boolOpts, dustBar) {
        const rec = this.getById(id);
        if (!rec) return null;
        const src = rec.obj;
        if (src.type === "fill") this.fillToShapeById(id);
        if (src.type !== "shape") return null;
        const R = { left: holeInParent.x0, top: holeInParent.y0, right: holeInParent.x1, bottom: holeInParent.y1 };
        const cut = subtractShape(src.loops, rectLoop(R), boolOpts).loops;
        const groups = dropDust(shapeComponents(cut), src.w, dustBar);
        const removed = this.removeById(id);
        if (!removed) return null;
        const z = src.z != null ? src.z : src.id;
        const editKey = this.editKey(src);
        const mk = (loops, lvl, attach, tile, below) => {
            const obj = {
                type: "shape", origin: src.origin, id: this.allocId(), z, loops,
                color: src.color, opacity: src.opacity, editId: editKey,
            };
            if (src.w > 0) obj.w = src.w;
            if (attach) obj.attachRect = { ...attach };
            if (below) obj.below = below;
            if (tile) obj.tile = [tile[0], tile[1]];
            return { obj: this.add(obj, lvl), level: String(lvl) };
        };
        const parents = groups.map((loops) => mk(loops, removed.level, src.attachRect, src.tile, cloneBelow(src.below)));
        const below1 = kidBelow !== undefined ? cloneBelow(kidBelow) : shiftDown(src.below, 1);
        const kids = regions.map((r) => mk(r.loops || r, level, attachRect, kidTile, cloneBelow(below1)));
        return { removed, parents, kids, pieces: parents.concat(kids) };
    }
    bakeShapeById(id, loops, w) {
        const rec = this.getById(id);
        if (!rec || rec.obj.type !== "stroke") return null;
        const o = rec.obj;
        const oldBbox = this._bboxNow(o);
        const oldLw = o.lwFrame;
        o.type = "shape";
        o.loops = loops; flattenLoops(o);
        if (w > 0) o.w = w;
        delete o.pts; delete o.lwFrame; delete o._pen; delete o._tol;
        this._afterEdit(o, rec.level, oldBbox, oldLw);
        return rec;
    }
    fillToShapeById(id) {
        const rec = this.getById(id);
        if (!rec || rec.obj.type !== "fill") return null;
        const o = rec.obj;
        const loops = normalizeLoops(shapeFromRings(o.polys));
        if (!loops.length) return null;
        const oldBbox = this._bboxNow(o);
        o.type = "shape";
        o.loops = loops; flattenLoops(o);
        delete o.polys; delete o.covers;
        this._afterEdit(o, rec.level, oldBbox, 0);
        return rec;
    }
    _bboxNow(o) {
        if (o.type === "shape") return loopsBBox(o.loops) || { x0: 0, y0: 0, x1: 0, y1: 0 };
        let x0 = Infinity, y0 = Infinity, x1 = -Infinity, y1 = -Infinity;
        const scan = (pts) => { for (const p of pts) { if (p[0] < x0) x0 = p[0]; if (p[0] > x1) x1 = p[0]; if (p[1] < y0) y0 = p[1]; if (p[1] > y1) y1 = p[1]; } };
        if (o.type === "fill") { for (const poly of o.polys) scan(poly); } else scan(o.pts);
        return { x0, y0, x1, y1 };
    }
    _afterEdit(o, level, oldBbox, oldLw) {
        delete o._bbox; delete o._dispFlat; delete o._flat; delete o._outline;
        o._ver = (o._ver || 0) + 1;
        if (!this._pending.has(o)) { this._idx(level).remove(o); this._idx(level).add(o); }
        this._emit({ kind: "change", id: o.id, level, obj: o, oldBbox, oldLw });
    }
    queryRect(level, rect) {
        const k = String(level);
        const out = [];
        if (this._index[k]) this._index[k].query(rect, out);
        for (const o of this._pending) if (o._home === k) out.push(o);
        return out;
    }
    frameExtent(level) {
        const k = String(level);
        const ix = this._index[k];
        let e = ix && ix.ext ? { ...ix.ext } : null, size = ix ? ix.maxSize : 0;
        for (const o of this._pending) {
            if (o._home !== k) continue;
            const b = this._bboxNow(o), lw = o.lwFrame || 0;
            if (!e) e = { x0: b.x0 - lw, y0: b.y0 - lw, x1: b.x1 + lw, y1: b.y1 + lw };
            else { e.x0 = Math.min(e.x0, b.x0 - lw); e.y0 = Math.min(e.y0, b.y0 - lw); e.x1 = Math.max(e.x1, b.x1 + lw); e.y1 = Math.max(e.y1, b.y1 + lw); }
            size = Math.max(size, Math.hypot(b.x1 - b.x0, b.y1 - b.y0) + lw);
        }
        return e ? { box: e, maxSize: size } : null;
    }
    _undoMove(moves) {
        for (const m of moves) {
            if (m.from != null) this.rehomeById(m.id, m.from);
            if (m.base) this.setGeometryById(m.id, m.base);
            if ("belowBefore" in m) this.setOffsetsById(m.id, m.belowBefore);
            else if (!m.base) this.moveById(m.id, -m.dx, -m.dy);
        }
        return true;
    }
    _invertMove(m) {
        const inv = { id: m.id, dx: -m.dx, dy: -m.dy, from: m.to, to: m.from };
        if ("belowBefore" in m) { inv.belowBefore = m.belowAfter; inv.belowAfter = m.belowBefore; }
        if (m.base || m.after) { inv.base = m.after || null; inv.after = m.base || null; }
        return inv;
    }
    pushUndo(op) {
        this._undo.push(op);
        const gone = this._undo.length > UNDO_CAP ? [this._undo.shift()] : [];
        for (const r of this._redo) gone.push(r);
        this._redo = [];
        if (gone.length && this.onOpsDropped) this.onOpsDropped(gone);
        this._notifyOps({ kind: "op", op });
    }
    namedFrames() {
        const out = new Set();
        for (const op of this._undo) opFrames(op, out);
        for (const op of this._redo) opFrames(op, out);
        return out;
    }
    forgetFrame(frame) {
        const k = String(frame);
        const arr = this.nativesByLevel[k];
        if (arr && arr.length) return false;
        delete this.nativesByLevel[k]; delete this._index[k];
        for (const o of this._detachedLists.get(k) || []) {
            if (o._home !== k || this._byId.get(o.id) !== o) continue;
            this._byId.delete(o.id); this._offsetIds.delete(o.id); this._pending.delete(o);
        }
        this._detachedLists.delete(k);
        this._detached.delete(k); this._reused.delete(k); this._frameOwner.delete(k);
        this._keyedIn.delete(k); this._detachedKeyed.delete(k);
        return true;
    }
    noteForgotten(frames) { if (frames.length) this._notifyOps({ kind: "forget", frames }); }
    canUndo() { return this._undo.length > 0; }
    canRedo() { return this._redo.length > 0; }
    undo() {
        const op = this._undo.pop();
        if (!op) return false;
        this._inUndo = true;
        try { this._redo.push(this._carrySeq(op, this._invert(op))); } finally { this._inUndo = false; }
        this._notifyOps({ kind: "undo", op });
        return true;
    }
    redo() {
        const op = this._redo.pop();
        if (!op) return false;
        this._inUndo = true;
        try { this._undo.push(this._carrySeq(op, this._invert(op))); } finally { this._inUndo = false; }
        this._notifyOps({ kind: "redo", op });
        return true;
    }
    _carrySeq(op, inv) { if (inv !== op && op._seq != null && inv._seq == null) inv._seq = op._seq; return inv; }
    _invert(op) {
        switch (op.op) {
            case "add": {
                const rec = this.removeById(op.id);
                return rec ? { op: "absent", obj: rec.obj, level: rec.level, index: rec.index } : op;
            }
            case "erase": {
                this.insertAt(op.obj, op.level, op.index);
                return { op: "present", id: op.obj.id };
            }
            case "absent": {
                this.insertAt(op.obj, op.level, op.index);
                return { op: "add", id: op.obj.id };
            }
            case "present": {
                const rec = this.removeById(op.id);
                return rec ? { op: "erase", obj: rec.obj, level: rec.level, index: rec.index } : op;
            }
            case "move": return this._undoMove([op]) && { op: "move", ...this._invertMove(op) };
            case "moveMany": {
                this._undoMove(op.moves);
                return { op: "moveMany", moves: op.moves.map((m) => this._invertMove(m)) };
            }
            case "eraseMany": {
                for (let i = op.records.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    const rec = op.records[i];
                    if (!this.getById(rec.obj.id)) this.insertAt(rec.obj, rec.level, rec.index);
                }
                return { op: "removeMany", records: op.records };
            }
            case "removeMany": {
                for (const rec of op.records) this.removeById(rec.obj.id);
                return { op: "eraseMany", records: op.records };
            }
            case "moveFrames": {
                for (const e of op.frames) {
                    const pf = this.lm.frame(e.id);
                    if (pf && pf.shift && !sameShift(pf.shift, e.shiftAfter)) this._settleIfPending(e.id);
                    if (e.merged) { for (let i = e.merged.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) this.unmerge(e.merged[i]); e.merged = null; }
                    if (e.settled) { this.unsettle(e.id, e.settled); e.settled = null; }
                }
                const was = new Map(op.frames.map((e) => { const f = this.lm.frame(e.id); return [e.id, f ? { parent: f.parent, i: f.cell.i, j: f.cell.j } : null]; }));
                this.lm.readdressMany(op.frames.map((e) => ({ id: e.id, depth: e.depth, parent: e.from.parent, i: e.from.i, j: e.from.j })),
                    { empty: (id) => this.count(id) === 0 });
                const inv = {
                    op: "moveFrames",
                    frames: op.frames.map((e) => ({ ...e, from: e.to, to: e.from, shiftBefore: e.shiftAfter, shiftAfter: e.shiftBefore, settled: null, merged: null })),
                    moves: (op.moves || []).map((m) => this._invertMove(m)),
                };
                for (const e of inv.frames) {
                    this.setFrameShift(e.id, e.shiftAfter);
                    this.noteFrameOwner(e.id, e);
                    const w = was.get(e.id), f = this.lm.frame(e.id);
                    if (w && f) this._emit({ kind: "refile", frame: e.id, from: w, to: { parent: f.parent, i: f.cell.i, j: f.cell.j } });
                }
                if (op.moves && op.moves.length) this._undoMove(op.moves);
                return inv;
            }
            case "removeFrames": {
                this.insertFrameSubtree(op.records);
                return { op: "eraseFrames", records: op.records };
            }
            case "eraseFrames": {
                for (const r of op.records) this.detachFrame(r.frame, r);
                return { op: "removeFrames", records: op.records };
            }
            case "deleteMany": {
                const inverted = [];
                for (let i = op.parts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) inverted.push(this._invert(op.parts[i]));
                return { op: "deleteMany", parts: inverted.reverse() };
            }
            case "eraseCommit": {
                this._stepsUndo(op);
                op.strokeRec = this.removeById(op.strokeId);
                op.op = "eraseRevert";
                return op;
            }
            case "eraseRevert": {
                if (op.strokeRec && !this.getById(op.strokeRec.obj.id)) {
                    this.insertAt(op.strokeRec.obj, op.strokeRec.level, op.strokeRec.index);
                }
                this._stepsRedo(op);
                op.op = "eraseCommit";
                return op;
            }
            case "clear": {
                const curNatives = this.nativesByLevel;
                const curExternal = op.onExternal ? op.onExternal() : undefined;
                this._replace(op.natives);
                if (op.restoreExternal) op.restoreExternal(op.external);
                return { ...op, natives: curNatives, external: curExternal };
            }
            default: return op;
        }
    }
    _stepIndex(extra) {
        const consumed = new Map(), minted = new Map(), opOf = new Map(), steps = [], applied = new Set();
        const add = (op, on) => {
            if (op.op !== "eraseCommit" && op.op !== "eraseRevert") return;
            if (on) applied.add(op);
            for (const st of op.baked || []) {
                if (st._seq == null) st._seq = ++this._stepSeq;
                opOf.set(st, op); steps.push(st);
                if (!st.removed || !st.pieces) continue;
                consumed.set(st.removed.obj.id, st);
                for (const pc of st.pieces) minted.set(pc.obj.id, st);
            }
        };
        for (const op of this._undo) add(op, true);
        for (const op of this._redo) add(op, false);
        if (extra && !opOf.has((extra.baked || [])[0])) add(extra, extra.op === "eraseCommit");
        for (const st of steps.filter((x) => x._on === undefined).sort((x, y) => x._seq - y._seq)) {
            if (!applied.has(opOf.get(st))) { st._on = false; continue; }
            if (!st.removed || !st.pieces) { st._on = true; continue; }
            const m = minted.get(st.removed.obj.id);
            st._on = !this.getById(st.removed.obj.id) && (!m || m._on !== false);
        }
        return { consumed, opOf, steps, applied };
    }
    _revertStep(st) {
        st._on = false;
        if (st.frames) { this.insertFrameSubtree(st.frames); return; }
        if (st.rekey) { for (const r of st.rekey) { const o = this.getById(r.id); if (o) Object.assign(o.obj, r.before); } this.keysChanged(); return; }
        let took = st.pieces.length === 0;
        for (const pc of st.pieces) if (this.removeById(pc.obj.id)) took = true;
        if (took && !this.getById(st.removed.obj.id)) this.insertAt(st.removed.obj, st.removed.level, st.removed.index);
    }
    _applyStep(st) {
        if (st.frames) { for (const r of st.frames) this.detachFrame(r.frame, r); st._on = true; return true; }
        if (st.rekey) { for (const r of st.rekey) { const o = this.getById(r.id); if (o) Object.assign(o.obj, r.after); } this.keysChanged(); st._on = true; return true; }
        const r = this.removeById(st.removed.obj.id);
        if (!r) return false;
        st.removed = r;
        for (const pc of st.pieces) if (!this.getById(pc.obj.id)) this.insertAt(pc.obj, pc.level, 1e9);
        st._on = true;
        return true;
    }
    _stepsUndo(op) {
        const ix = this._stepIndex(op);
        const S = new Set(op.baked.filter((st) => st._on !== false));
        const stack = [...S];
        while (stack.length) {
            const t = stack.pop();
            for (const pc of t.pieces || []) {
                const c = ix.consumed.get(pc.obj.id);
                if (c && c._on !== false && !S.has(c)) { S.add(c); stack.push(c); }
            }
        }
        for (const st of [...S].sort((a, b) => b._seq - a._seq)) this._revertStep(st);
    }
    _stepsRedo(op) {
        const ix = this._stepIndex(op);
        for (const st of [...op.baked].sort((a, b) => a._seq - b._seq)) this._applyStep(st);
        const waiting = ix.steps.filter((st) => st._on === false && ix.opOf.get(st) !== op && ix.applied.has(ix.opOf.get(st))).sort((x, y) => x._seq - y._seq);
        for (let changed = true; changed;) {
            changed = false;
            for (const st of waiting) if (st._on === false && this._applyStep(st)) changed = true;
        }
    }
    clear(external, onExternal, restoreExternal) {
        this.pushUndo({ op: "clear", natives: this.nativesByLevel, external, onExternal, restoreExternal });
        this._replace({ 0: [] });
    }
    _replace(natives, load = false) {
        this.nativesByLevel = natives;
        this._index = {};
        this._pending = new Set();
        this._byId = new Map();
        this._offsetIds = new Set();
        this._frameOwner = new Map();
        this.holdMerges = false;
        this._detached = new Set();
        this._detachedLists = new Map();
        this._reused = new Set();
        this._keyedIn = new Map();
        this._detachedKeyed = new Map();
        for (const Ls of Object.keys(natives)) {
            for (const o of natives[Ls] || []) { o._home = Ls; this._byId.set(o.id, o); this._noteBelow(o); this._idx(Ls).add(o); this._keyIn(Ls, o); }
        }
        this._emit(load ? { kind: "reset", load: true } : { kind: "reset" });
    }
    serializeNatives(only = null) {
        const natives = {};
        const keys = only == null
            ? Object.keys(this.nativesByLevel)
            : only.map(String).filter((l) => this.nativesByLevel[l]);
        for (const l of keys) {
            natives[l] = (this.nativesByLevel[l] || []).map((o) => objectHeader(o,
                o.type === "shape" ? { loops: encodeLoops(o.loops) }
                    : o.type === "fill" ? { polys: o.polys } : { pts: o.pts }));
        }
        return natives;
    }
    loadNatives(snapNatives) {
        if (!snapNatives) return false;
        const natives = {};
        let maxId = 0;
        for (const l of Object.keys(snapNatives)) {
            natives[l] = snapNatives[l].map(nativeFromRecord);
            for (const o of natives[l]) {
                if (o.id >= maxId) maxId = o.id;
                if (o.editId != null && o.editId >= maxId) maxId = o.editId;
            }
        }
        this._nextId = Math.max(this._nextId, maxId + 1);
        for (const l of Object.keys(natives)) if (!natives[l].length) delete natives[l];
        this._undo = []; this._redo = [];
        this._replace(natives, true);
        return true;
    }
}

export default class KobinEngine {
    constructor(container, { width, height, onStatus, raster = false, scenes = true } = {}) {
        this.cfg = { ...DEFAULTS };
        this.onStatus = onStatus || (() => {});
        this.width = width || window.innerWidth;
        this.height = height || window.innerHeight;
        this.lm = new LevelMap(this.cfg, this.width, this.height);
        this.doc = new Document();
        this.doc.lm = this.lm;
        initFrameGc(this);
        this.doc.subscribe((ev) => noteFrameEvent(this, ev));
        this.doc.subscribe((ev) => {
            if (ev.kind !== "mergeFrame" || !this.cam || String(this.cam.frame) !== String(ev.frame)) return;
            this.cam.frame = ev.into;
            Promise.resolve().then(() => { if (!this._destroyed) this._render(); });
        });
        this.doc.frameFactor = (from, to) => this.lm.frameFactor(from, to);
        this.cam = new Camera(this.lm, this.cfg, {
            finalizeLiveStroke: () => { if (this._drawing) this.pointerUp(); },
            holdFrame: () => !!this._drawing || !!this._erasing,
            onCross: () => {  },
        });
        this.store = new TileStore(this.lm, this.doc, this.cfg);
        this.raster = !!raster;
        this.plates = null;
        this._frameSeq = 0;
        this._plateEvents = this.raster ? [] : null;
        this._footBelow = this.raster ? new Map() : null;
        this._holdMove = null;
        if (this.raster) {
            this.plates = new PlateStore({});
            this.renderer = new RasterRenderer(container, this.cam, this.cfg, {
                width: this.width, height: this.height, store: this.plates,
                frameSeq: () => ++this._frameSeq,
                drain: () => this._drainPlates(),
                notePerf: (op, t0, extra) => this.notePerf(op, t0, extra),
            });
            this.doc.subscribe((ev) => {
                if (ev.kind === "reset" && this._footBelow) this._footBelow.clear();
                if (ev.kind === "reset") this.renderer.dropCarry();
                if (this._uncut && (ev.kind === "reset" || (ev.kind === "remove" && ev.obj && ev.obj.erase))) {
                    if (ev.kind === "reset") this._uncut.clear(); else this._uncut.delete(ev.id);
                }
                let neutral = this._pictureNeutral;
                const whole = neutral && ev.kind === "change" && ev.obj && ev.obj.erase && this._uncut ? this._uncut.get(ev.id) : null;
                if (whole && whole.size) {
                    const zm = this._zOf(ev.obj);
                    for (const id of whole) {
                        const r = this.doc.getById(id);
                        if (!r) whole.delete(id);
                        else if (this._zOf(r.obj) > zm) { neutral = false; whole.delete(id); }
                    }
                }
                this._plateEvents.push(neutral ? { ...ev, neutral: true } : ev);
            });
        }
        this.tool = "pen"; this.penType = "freehand"; this.color = "rgb(0,0,0)"; this.penWidth = 13; this.opacity = 1;
        this.opacityGroups = true; this.debug = false; this.tileDebug = false;
        this.trace = false;
        this.preBake = true;
        this.lazyOutlines = true;
        this.retainScenes = true;
        this._idleFitScheduled = false;
        this._drawing = null; this._panLast = null; this._erasing = false; this._drawStartT = 0;
        this._lasso = null;
        this._eraserPx = 16;
        this._eraseCommits = new Map();
        this._bakeDone = new Map();
        this._bakeTimer = null;
        this._bakeDelay = Infinity;
        this._bakeJobs = [];
        this._bakeQueued = new Set();
        this._lastList = []; this._lastRange = null;
        this.perfLog = [];
        this.perfLong = [];
        this.frameMeter = new FrameMeter();
        this.frameMeter.onPoke = () => { try { this.growth.maybeSample(); } catch (err) {  } };
        this.growth = new GrowthLog(this);
        this.longFrames = new LongFrames();
        this.eventLatency = new EventLatency();
        this.eventLatency.start();
        this.longFrames.start();
        this._zoomStat = null;
        this.journal = [];
        this._journalCur = null;
        this.selection = null;
        this._dragSel = null;
        this.docMeta = { name: null, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), scaleDef: null, scenes: [], sceneIndex: null };
        this._initScenes(scenes);
        this.renderer.setSelectionAnts(() => this._selectionAnts());
        this.renderer.setLasso(() => (this._lasso ? this._lasso.pts : null));
        this.renderer.setDragState(() => this._dragState());
        this.renderer.setPlaneState(() => this._planeState());
        this.renderer.onPlaneLost = () => this._planeLost();
        this.renderer.markDone = (id) => {
            const done = this._bakeDone.get(id), whole = this._uncut && this._uncut.get(id);
            return !done || !whole || !whole.size ? done || null : { has: (x) => done.has(x) && !whole.has(x) };
        };
        this.renderer.onPlaneAimed = () => this._maybeLadder();
        this.renderer.listForPlane = (frame, rect, budgetMs) => this.listFor(frame, rect, false, budgetMs);
        this.doc.subscribeOps((ev) => { if (ev.kind === "settle" && ev.rec && ev.rec.carries && ev.rec.carries.length) this._followCarries(ev.frame, ev.rec.carries); });
        this.renderer.onShown = () => { if (this._destroyed) return; this._ladderAt = null; this._render(); };
        this._moveHoldOn = !!this.renderer.supportsDragPlane;
        this.doc.subscribe((ev) => {
            if (!this.selection) return;
            if (ev.kind === "reset") { this.selection = null; this._dropHold("reset"); return; }
            if (ev.kind === "mergeFrame") {
                const s = this.selection;
                if (!s.frames.includes(ev.frame)) return;
                const inked = this._inkedFrames();
                const frames = s.frames.filter((f) => f !== ev.frame).concat(ev.kids.filter((k) => inked.has(k) && !s.frames.includes(k)));
                this._setSelection(s.ids.concat(ev.ids), frames);
                return;
            }
            if (this._moving) {
                const s = this.selection;
                if (ev.kind === "remove" && ev.rehome != null && (s.ids.includes(ev.id) || this._underFrames(ev.level, s.frames))) this._moving.ids.add(ev.id);
                if (ev.kind === "refile" && ev.from && this._underFrames(ev.from.parent, s.frames)) this._moving.frames.add(ev.frame);
            }
            if (ev.kind !== "remove") return;
            if (ev.rehome) return;
            const ids = this.selection.ids.filter((id) => this.doc.getById(id));
            const frames = this.selection.frames || [];
            if (ev.id === this.selection.id && !ids.length) {
                const family = this.doc.editGroup(this.selection.editId);
                if (family.length) { this._setSelection([family[0].obj.id], frames); return; }
                if (frames.length) { this._setSelection([], frames); return; }
            }
            if (!ids.length && !frames.length) { this.selection = null; this._dropHold("removed"); return; }
            if (ids.length !== this.selection.ids.length || ev.id === this.selection.id) this._setSelection(ids, frames);
        });
        this._render();
    }
    get nativesByLevel() { return this.doc.nativesByLevel; }
    setTool(t) {
        if (t !== this.tool && t !== "select") this.deselect();
        this.tool = t;
    }
    setPenType(t) { this.penType = t; }
    setColor(c) { this.color = c; }
    setWidth(w) { this.penWidth = w; }
    setOpacity(o) { this.opacity = o; }
    setScaleDef(def) {
        this.docMeta.scaleDef = def ? validateScaleDef(def) : null;
    }
    resize(w, h) {
        if (this._destroyed || (w === this.width && h === this.height)) return;
        const t0 = perfNow();
        this.width = w; this.height = h;
        this.lm.resize(w, h); this.renderer.setSize(w, h);
        this._render();
        this._perf("resize", t0, true, { w, h });
    }
    destroy() {
        this._destroyed = true;
        if (this._bakeTimer != null) { clearTimeout(this._bakeTimer); this._bakeTimer = null; }
        if (this._ladderTimer != null) { clearTimeout(this._ladderTimer); this._ladderTimer = null; }
        this.frameMeter.stop();
        this.longFrames.stop();
        this.eventLatency.stop();
        if (this._sceneClient) this._sceneClient.destroy();
        this.store.destroy(); this.renderer.destroy();
        if (this.plates) this.plates.destroy();
    }
    notePerf(op, t0, extra) { this._perf(op, t0, true, extra); }
    _noteFast(kind, ms) {
        const all = this._zoomStat || (this._zoomStat = {});
        const z = all[kind] || (all[kind] = { n: 0, total: 0, max: 0, over8: 0, over16: 0, over50: 0, recent: [] });
        z.n++; z.total += ms;
        if (ms > z.max) z.max = +ms.toFixed(1);
        if (ms > 8) z.over8++;
        if (ms > 16) z.over16++;
        if (ms > 50) z.over50++;
        z.recent.push(+ms.toFixed(2));
        if (z.recent.length > 200) z.recent.shift();
    }
    _perf(op, t0, always, extra) {
        const ms = perfNow() - t0;
        if (ms < 8 && !always && !this.trace) return;
        const e = { op, ms: +ms.toFixed(1), level: this.cam.activeLevel, inScale: +this.cam.inScale.toFixed(3), t: Date.now() };
        if (extra) Object.assign(e, extra);
        this.perfLog.push(e);
        const cap = this.trace ? 4000 : 300;
        while (this.perfLog.length > cap) this.perfLog.shift();
        if (ms >= PERF_LONG_MS) {
            this.perfLong.push(e);
            if (this.perfLong.length > PERF_LONG_CAP) this.perfLong.shift();
        }
    }
    _note(entry) {
        const e = { t: Date.now(), frame: this.cam.frame, level: this.cam.activeLevel,
            inScale: +this.cam.inScale.toFixed(4), ...entry };
        this.journal.push(e);
        if (this.journal.length > 40) this.journal.shift();
        return e;
    }
    static _thin(pts, cap = 120) {
        if (!pts || pts.length <= cap) return (pts || []).map((p) => [+p[0].toFixed(3), +p[1].toFixed(3)]);
        const step = Math.ceil(pts.length / cap), out = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i += step) out.push([+pts[i][0].toFixed(3), +pts[i][1].toFixed(3)]);
        const last = pts[pts.length - 1];
        out.push([+last[0].toFixed(3), +last[1].toFixed(3)]);
        return out;
    }
    _buildList() {
        const win = this._listWin();
        const F = this.cam.frame;
        const list = this.listFor(F, win, true);
        if (F !== this._tileFrame) { this.store.framesLeft(F); this._tileFrame = F; }
        this._lastRange = this.lm.tileRange(F, win);
        return list;
    }
    listFor(frameKey, rect, forCamera = false, budgetMs = 0) {
        const t0 = perfNow();
        const cf = this.lm.frameFor(frameKey);
        if (!cf) return [];
        const F = cf.id;
        const derived = forCamera ? this.store.content(F, rect) : this.store.contentOffCamera(F, rect, budgetMs);
        if (!derived) return null;
        const own = this.store.ownContent(F);
        const list = derived.concat(own);
        const hasOff = this.doc.hasOffsets();
        const d = this.lm.depthOf(F);
        const D = d == null ? 0 : d;
        const resById = hasOff ? new Map() : null;
        const seed = forCamera ? this._footBelow : null;
        let marks = null;
        for (const o of list) {
            const rec = this.doc.getById(o.id);
            if (rec && rec.obj.editId != null) o.editId = rec.obj.editId;
            if (rec && rec.obj.erase && o !== rec.obj) { o.erase = true; if (rec.obj.z != null) o.z = rec.obj.z; }
            if (rec && rec.obj.erase && !(marks && marks.has(o.id))) (marks || (marks = new Map())).set(o.id, this._markNow(rec.obj));
            if (seed && rec && !seed.has(o.id)) {
                seed.set(o.id, rec.obj.below || null);
            }
            let res = null;
            if (hasOff && rec && rec.obj.below) {
                res = resById.get(o.id);
                if (res === undefined) { res = residual(rec.obj.below, D - this.lm.depthOf(rec.level)); resById.set(o.id, res); }
            }
            if (res) o.res = res; else if (o.res) delete o.res;
        }
