        list.sort((a, b) => ((a.z != null ? a.z : a.id) - (b.z != null ? b.z : b.id)) || (a.id - b.id));
        if (marks && this.renderer.noteListMarks) {
            for (const [id, m] of marks) {
                const d = this.renderer.markDone && this.renderer.markDone(id);
                if (!d) continue;
                const done = new Set();
                for (const o of list) if (d.has(o.id)) done.add(o.id);
                m.done = done;
            }
            this.renderer.noteListMarks(list, marks);
        }
        if (!forCamera) this._perf("listFor", t0, false, { frame: F, n: list.length, tiles: this.store.size() });
        return list;
    }
    _markNow(m) { return { z: m.z != null ? m.z : m.id, done: null }; }
    _drainPlates() {
        const q = this._plateEvents;
        if (!q || !this.plates) return 0;
        let n = 0;
        for (let k = 0; k < q.length; k++) {
            const ev = q[k];
            if (this._holdMove && this._heldByMove(ev)) continue;
            if (ev.neutral) {
                if (ev.obj && ev.id != null && this._footBelow) this._footBelow.set(ev.id, ev.obj.below || null);
                this.plates.s.neutralEvents++;
                n++;
                continue;
            }
            if (ev.kind === "refile" && ev.frame != null && ev.from && ev.to) { this._refilePlates(ev); n++; continue; }
            if ((ev.kind === "mergeFrame" || ev.kind === "splitFrame") && ev.frame != null) {
                if (ev.kind === "mergeFrame") this.plates.dropFrames((G) => G === ev.frame);
                n++;
                continue;
            }
            if ((ev.kind === "removeFrame" || ev.kind === "addFrame") && ev.frame != null && this._frameListPlates(ev)) { n++; continue; }
            const prev = ev.id != null && this._footBelow ? this._footBelow.get(ev.id) : undefined;
            this.plates.onDocEvent(ev, (frameId) => this._drawnRectIn(ev, prev, frameId));
            if (ev.obj && ev.id != null && this._footBelow) this._footBelow.set(ev.id, ev.obj.below || null);
            n++;
        }
        q.length = 0;
        if (this._footBelow && this._footBelow.size > 1024) this._footBelow.clear();
        this.plates.noteDrain(n);
        return n;
    }
    _refilePlates(ev) {
        let n = this.plates.dropFrames((G) => this.lm.isUnder(ev.frame, G));
        const at = [ev.from, ev.to].filter((a) => a && a.parent != null && this.lm.frame(String(a.parent)));
        n += this.plates.dropRectPerFrame((G) => this._cellFootIn(at, G));
        return n;
    }
    _cellFootIn(at, G) {
        const h = REACH / R, out = [];
        for (const a of at) {
            const c = cellCentre(a.i, a.j);
            const m = this.lm.mapRectF({ left: c.x - h, top: c.y - h, right: c.x + h, bottom: c.y + h }, String(a.parent), G);
            if (m) out.push(m);
        }
        return out.length ? out : null;
    }
    _frameListPlates(ev) {
        if (!ev.count) return true;
        const f = this.lm.frame(String(ev.frame));
        if (!f || f.parent == null || !f.cell) return false;
        const at = [{ parent: f.parent, i: f.cell.i, j: f.cell.j }];
        this.plates.dropRectPerFrame((G) => (this.lm.isUnder(ev.frame, G) ? EVERYWHERE : this._cellFootIn(at, G)));
        return true;
    }
    _beginHold() {
        this._holdMove = null;
        if (!this._moveHoldOn || !this.raster || !this.selection) return;
        if (this.renderer.planeAccepts && !this.renderer.planeAccepts()) return;
        const ids = new Set(), startBelow = new Map(), startLevel = new Map();
        for (const rec of this._selectionMembers()) {
            ids.add(rec.obj.id);
            startLevel.set(rec.obj.id, rec.level);
            startBelow.set(rec.obj.id, rec.obj.below || null);
        }
        const frames = (this.selection.frames || []).slice();
        this._holdMove = { ids, frames, startBelow, startLevel, at: null, frameStart: this._framesFootIn(frames) };
    }
    _framesFootIn(frames) {
        const out = new Map();
        if (!frames.length || !this.plates) return out;
        const ext = { left: -REACH, top: -REACH, right: REACH, bottom: REACH };
        const seen = new Set();
        for (const e of this.plates.cache.values()) seen.add(e.frameId);
        for (const f of this.plates.inflight.values()) seen.add(f.frameId);
        for (const G of seen) {
            const rs = [];
            for (const root of frames) { const r = this.lm.frame(root) ? this.lm.mapRectF(ext, root, G) : null; if (r) rs.push(r); }
            if (rs.length) out.set(G, rs);
        }
        return out;
    }
    _planeLost() {
        if (!this._holdMove) return 0;
        const n = this._releaseMove();
        if (this._dragSel) this._dragSel.listAt = null;
        return n;
    }
    _heldByMove(ev) {
        const h = this._holdMove;
        if (ev.id != null && h.ids.has(ev.id)) return true;
        if (!h.frames.length) return false;
        if (ev.kind === "refile" && ev.frame != null) return this._underHeldFrames(ev.frame);
        return ev.level != null && this._underHeldFrames(ev.level);
    }
    _underHeldFrames(level) {
        const h = this._holdMove; if (!h) return false;
        for (const root of h.frames) if (root === level || this.lm.isUnder(root, level)) return true;
        return false;
    }
    _planeState() {
        const s = this.selection;
        if (!s || !this.raster) return null;
        const list = this._lastList, m = this._planeMemo;
        if (m && m.sel === s && m.list === list) return m.state;
        const members = this._selTable(s).ids;
        const frames = s.frames || [];
        const ids = new Set();
        for (const o of list) {
            if (members.has(o.id)) { ids.add(o.id); continue; }
            if (!frames.length) continue;
            const rec = this.doc.getById(o.id);
            if (rec && this._underFrames(rec.level, frames)) ids.add(o.id);
        }
        const state = ids.size ? { key: s, ids } : null;
        this._planeMemo = { sel: s, list, state };
        return state;
    }
    _dragState() {
        const d = this._dragSel, h = this._holdMove;
        if (!d || !h) return null;
        if (!h.at) h.at = d.last ? [d.last[0], d.last[1]] : [d.start[0], d.start[1]];
        return { drag: d, ids: h.ids, frames: h.frames, at: h.at };
    }
    _endMove(why) {
        const d = this._dragSel, carried = this._carried || new Set();
        this._dropHold(why);
        this._dropping = d ? { d, ids: carried } : null;
        try { this._render(); } finally { this._dropping = null; }
        if (d && this.selection && (why === "drop" || carried.size)) this._reselect([...carried], why === "drop" && d.frames ? this._outsideSelection(d.frames.keys()) : []);
        collectFrames(this);
    }
    _dropHold(why) {
        const live = this._dragSel || this._holdMove;
        this._dragSel = null;
        this._carried = null;
        this.store.setBatch(false);
        this.doc.holdMerges = false;
        const n = this._releaseMove();
        if (live && this.renderer.endMove) this.renderer.endMove(why, n);
    }
    _releaseMove() {
        const h = this._holdMove; this._holdMove = null;
        if (!h || !this.plates) return 0;
        let n = this.plates.dropById(h.ids);
        n += this.plates.dropRectPerFrame((frameId) => this._movedRectsIn(h, frameId));
        if (h.frames.length) {
            n += this.plates.dropFrames((G) => h.frames.some((root) => this.lm.isUnder(root, G)));
            const end = this._framesFootIn(h.frames);
            n += this.plates.dropRectPerFrame((G) => {
                const rs = (h.frameStart.get(G) || []).concat(end.get(G) || []);
                return rs.length ? rs : null;
            });
        }
        return n;
    }
    _movedRectsIn(h, frameId) {
        const F = String(frameId);
        const out = [];
        let union = null;
        const add = (rect, H, below) => {
            const m = this.lm.mapRectObj(rect, H, F, below, H, false);
            if (!m) return;
            if (h.ids.size <= MOVE_RECTS_MAX) out.push(m);
            else union = union ? { left: Math.min(union.left, m.left), top: Math.min(union.top, m.top), right: Math.max(union.right, m.right), bottom: Math.max(union.bottom, m.bottom) } : m;
        };
        for (const id of h.ids) {
            const rec = this.doc.getById(id);
            if (!rec) continue;
            const o = rec.obj;
            const b = bboxOf(o, this._drawing);
            const half = (o.type === "fill" ? 0 : (o.lwFrame || 0)) / 2;
            const r = { left: b.x0 - half, top: b.y0 - half, right: b.x1 + half, bottom: b.y1 + half };
            add(r, rec.level, o.below);
            const L0 = h.startLevel.get(id), b0 = h.startBelow.get(id);
            if (L0 !== rec.level || b0 !== (o.below || null)) add(r, L0, b0);
        }
        if (union) out.push(union);
        return out.length ? out : null;
    }
    _drawnRectIn(ev, prev, frameId) {
        const o = ev.obj;
        if (!o || ev.level == null) return null;
        const H = String(ev.level), F = String(frameId);
        const b = bboxOf(o, this._drawing);
        const lw = o.type === "fill" ? 0 : (o.lwFrame || 0);
        const half = Math.max(lw, ev.oldLw || 0) / 2;
        const box = (bb) => ({ left: bb.x0 - half, top: bb.y0 - half, right: bb.x1 + half, bottom: bb.y1 + half });
        const r = box(b);
        const movedTable = prev !== undefined && prev !== (o.below || null);
        const ob = ev.oldBbox;
        const movedGeom = !!ob && (ob.x0 !== b.x0 || ob.y0 !== b.y0 || ob.x1 !== b.x1 || ob.y1 !== b.y1);
        const out = [];
        const add = (rect, below) => { const m = this.lm.mapRectObj(rect, H, F, below, H, false); if (m) out.push(m); };
        add(r, o.below);
        if (movedGeom) add(box(ob), o.below);
        if (movedTable) add(r, prev);
        if (movedTable && movedGeom) add(box(ob), prev);
        if (!out.length) return null;
        return out.length === 1 ? out[0] : out;
    }
    _render() {
        if (this._destroyed) return;
        const t0 = perfNow();
        this._renderPending = false;
        this._eraseListStale = false;
        if (noteCameraFrame(this)) collectFrames(this, true);
        const ras = this.raster ? this.renderer : null;
        if (ras) ras.beginRender();
        const tList = perfNow();
        this._lastList = this._buildList();
        if (ras) ras.noteList(perfNow() - tList);
        this._drainPlates();
        this.renderer.render(this._lastList, this.cam.frame);
        this.renderer.update();
        this._emit();
        this._perf("render", t0, false, { n: this._lastList.length, fat: this.renderer._hasFat });
        if (this._carriedLater) this._flushCarried();
        this.frameMeter.poke();
        this._maybeLadder();
    }
    _listWin() {
        const win = this.cam.frameWindow(0);
        if (!this.raster || !this.renderer.listMargin) return win;
        const m = this.renderer.listMargin(this.cam.inScale);
        return { left: win.left - m, top: win.top - m, right: win.right + m, bottom: win.bottom + m };
    }
    _visibleChanged() {
        const r = this.lm.tileRange(this.cam.frame, this._listWin());
        const p = this._lastRange;
        return !p || r.i0 !== p.i0 || r.i1 !== p.i1 || r.j0 !== p.j0 || r.j1 !== p.j1;
    }
    panBy(dx, dy) {
        if (this._destroyed) return;
        const t0 = perfNow();
        this._lastCamMove = t0;
        this.frameMeter.poke();
        const crossed = this.cam.panBy(dx, dy);
        if (crossed || this._eraseListStale || this._visibleChanged() || this.renderer.needsReorigin()
            || this.renderer.needsWindowChop()) this._render();
        else { this.renderer.syncCameraOnly(); this.renderer.update(); this._emit(); }
        this._perf("pan", t0);
        this._noteFast("panStep", perfNow() - t0);
        this._maybeLadder();
    }
    zoomAt(sx, sy, deltaY) { this.zoomFactorAt(sx, sy, Math.pow(2, -deltaY / 1000)); }
    pinchUpdate(mx, my, factor, dx, dy) { this.cam.panBy(dx, dy); this.zoomFactorAt(mx, my, factor); }
    zoomFactorAt(sx, sy, factor) {
        if (this._destroyed) return;
        const t0 = perfNow();
        this._lastCamMove = t0;
        this.frameMeter.poke();
        const crossed = this.cam.zoomFactorAt(sx, sy, factor);
        if (crossed || this._eraseListStale || this._visibleChanged() || this.renderer.needsFatFlip()
            || this.renderer.needsFadeFlip() || this.renderer.needsReorigin() || this.renderer.needsWindowChop()) this._render();
        else { this.renderer.syncCameraOnly(); this.renderer.update(); this._emit(); }
        this._perf(crossed ? "cross" : "zoom", t0, crossed);
        this._noteFast(crossed ? "crossStep" : "zoomStep", perfNow() - t0);
        this._maybePrebake();
        this._maybeLadder();
        if (crossed || this.renderer.hasPendingNearFat()) this._queueIdleFits();
    }
    _crossTarget() {
        const cam = this.cam, base = this.cfg.base;
        if (cam.inScale > this.cfg.enter * 0.8) {
            let child = this.lm.findChild(cam.frame, cam.inScale, cam.inPanX, cam.inPanY);
            if (!child && this.preBake) child = this.lm.ensureChild(cam.frame, cam.inScale, cam.inPanX, cam.inPanY);
            if (!child || !child.edge) return null;
            return { id: child.id, dir: "up", inScale: cam.inScale * base / child.edge.s };
        }
        if (cam.inScale < this.cfg.exit * 1.25) {
            const f = this.lm.frame(cam.frame);
            if (!f || f.parent == null || !f.edge) return null;
            return { id: f.parent, dir: "down", inScale: (f.edge.s / base) * cam.inScale };
        }
        return null;
    }
    _maybeLadder() {
        if (!this.raster || !this.plates || !this.renderer.ladderPlates || this._destroyed) return;
        if (this._ladderTimer != null) clearTimeout(this._ladderTimer);
        this._ladderTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            this._ladderTimer = null;
            ladderIdle(() => { if (!this._destroyed) this._buildLadder(); });
        }, LADDER_QUIET_MS);
    }
    _buildLadder() {
        if (this._drawing || this._dragSel || this._lasso) return 0;
        if (perfNow() - (this._lastCamMove || 0) < LADDER_QUIET_MS) { this._maybeLadder(); return 0; }
        const key = this._ladderKey();
        const ev = this.plates.s.ladderEvictions;
        if (key === this._ladderAt && (ev === this._ladderEv || key === this._ladderRebuilt)) return 0;
        if (key === this._ladderAt) this._ladderRebuilt = key;
        this._ladderAt = key;
        this._ladderEv = ev;
        this.store.clearWarm();
        const n = this.plates.phone ? LADDER_PHONE_RUNGS : (this.ladderFar ? LADDER_FACTORS.length : LADDER_NEAR);
        const steps = LADDER_FACTORS.slice(0, n).map((factor) => ({ factor, cross: false }));
        for (const factor of this._ladderCrossings(LADDER_FACTORS[Math.min(n, LADDER_NEAR) - 1])) steps.push({ factor, cross: true });
        this._ladderSteps = steps;
        return this._ladderRung(0, key);
    }
    _ladderCrossings(maxFactor) {
        const out = [], base = this.cfg.base, exit = this.cfg.exit;
        let f = this.lm.frame(this.cam.frame), s = this.cam.inScale, total = 1;
        while (f && f.parent != null && f.edge) {
            total *= s / exit;
            if (total * 1.02 > maxFactor) break;
            out.push(total * 1.02);
            s = (f.edge.s / base) * exit;
            f = this.lm.frame(f.parent);
        }
        return out;
    }
    _ladderKey() { const c = this.cam; return c.frame + "|" + c.inScale + "|" + c.inPanX + "|" + c.inPanY + "|" + this.width + "x" + this.height; }
    _ladderRung(k, key) {
        const steps = this._ladderSteps || [];
        const rungs = steps.length;
        this._ladderBusy = false;
        if (this._destroyed || k >= rungs || key !== this._ladderKey() || this._drawing || this._dragSel || this._lasso) return 0;
        if (this._ladderCap && this._ladderCap.key === key && k > this._ladderCap.k) return 0;
        if (this._reportBusy) {
            this._ladderBusy = true;
            setTimeout(() => this._ladderRung(k, key), LADDER_REPORT_WAIT_MS);
            return 0;
        }
        const step = steps[k];
        const aim = this._zoomedOut(step.factor);
        if (!aim) return 0;
        const t = { id: aim.frame, inScale: aim.inScale, first: k === 0 };
        let posted = 0;
        if (this.renderer.ladderMisses(t, aim.win) > 0 || step.cross) {
            const tL = perfNow();
            const budget = this.ladderRungBudgetMs != null ? this.ladderRungBudgetMs : (this.plates.phone ? LADDER_RUNG_BUDGET_PHONE_MS : LADDER_RUNG_BUDGET_MS);
            this.store.warmReads = true;
            let list;
            const slice = this.ladderSliceMs != null ? this.ladderSliceMs : (this.plates.phone ? LADDER_SLICE_PHONE_MS : LADDER_SLICE_MS);
            try { list = this.listFor(aim.frame, this.renderer.plateCover(t, aim.win, LADDER_DQ), false, slice); } finally { this.store.warmReads = false; }
            this._perf("ladder", tL, false, { frame: aim.frame, k, n: list ? list.length : -1, cross: step.cross });
            if (!list) {
                const tries = (this._ladderTries && this._ladderTries.key === key && this._ladderTries.k === k) ? this._ladderTries.n + 1 : 1;
                this._ladderTries = { key, k, n: tries };
                if (tries >= LADDER_RUNG_TRIES) { this._ladderCap = { key, k: k - 1 }; return 0; }
                this._ladderBusy = true;
                ladderIdle(() => this._ladderRung(k, key));
                return 0;
            }
            if (perfNow() - tL > budget) this._ladderCap = { key, k };
            const tP = perfNow();
            posted = this.renderer.ladderPlates(t, aim.win, list);
            this._perf("ladderPost", tP, false, { k, n: list.length, posted });
        }
        if (k + 1 < rungs && !(this._ladderCap && this._ladderCap.key === key)) {
            this._ladderBusy = true;
            ladderIdle(() => this._ladderRung(k + 1, key));
        }
        return posted;
    }
    _zoomedOut(factor) {
        const base = this.cfg.base, exit = this.cfg.exit;
        let f = this.lm.frame(this.cam.frame);
        if (!f) return null;
        const W2 = this.width / 2, H2 = this.height / 2;
        let s = this.cam.inScale;
        let p = [(W2 - this.cam.inPanX) / s, (H2 - this.cam.inPanY) / s];
        s /= factor;
        while (s < exit) {
            if (f.parent == null || !f.edge) return null;
            const q = this.lm.mapPointF(p, f.id, f.parent);
            if (!q) return null;
            s = (f.edge.s / base) * s;
            p = q;
            f = this.lm.frame(f.parent);
            if (!f) return null;
        }
        const hw = (W2 / s) * LADDER_MARGIN, hh = (H2 / s) * LADDER_MARGIN;
        return { frame: f.id, inScale: s, win: { left: p[0] - hw, top: p[1] - hh, right: p[0] + hw, bottom: p[1] + hh } };
    }
    _maybePrebake() {
        if (this._prebakeQueued) return;
        const aim = this._crossTarget();
        if (!aim) return;
        this._prebakeQueued = true;
        const idle = typeof requestIdleCallback === "function" ? requestIdleCallback : (fn) => setTimeout(fn, 30);
        idle(() => {
            this._prebakeQueued = false;
            if (this._destroyed) return;
            const t = this._crossTarget();
            if (!t || t.id !== aim.id || !this.lm.frame(t.id)) return;
            const win = this.lm.mapRectF(this.cam.frameWindow(0), this.cam.frame, t.id);
            if (!win) return;
            const tP = perfNow();
            this.store.warmReads = true;
            let list;
            try { list = this.listFor(t.id, this.raster && this.renderer.plateCover ? this.renderer.plateCover(t, win, PREVIEW_QUANTA) : win); } finally { this.store.warmReads = false; }
            this._perf("prebake", tP, false, { frame: t.id, dir: t.dir, n: list.length });
            if (this.raster && this.plates && this.renderer.prebakePlates) {
                const tQ = perfNow();
                this.renderer.prebakePlates(t, win, list);
                this._perf("prebakePost", tQ, false, { n: list.length });
            }
        });
    }
    _queueIdleFits() {
        if (!this.lazyOutlines || this._idleFitScheduled || this._destroyed) return;
        const gate = this.cfg.fatWidthPx != null ? this.cfg.fatWidthPx : 500;
        this._idleFitScheduled = true;
        const idle = typeof requestIdleCallback === "function" ? requestIdleCallback : (fn) => setTimeout(fn, 50);
        idle(() => {
            this._idleFitScheduled = false;
            if (this._destroyed) return;
            const t0 = perfNow();
            let more = false, fitted = 0;
            for (const o of this.doc.at(this.cam.frame)) {
                if (o.type !== "stroke" || o === this._drawing) continue;
                if (o._outline) continue;
                if (o.lwFrame * this.cfg.enter <= gate) continue;
                if (perfNow() - t0 > 8) { more = true; break; }
                this.renderer.ensureOutline(o, o.origin === "native");
                if (this.plates) this.plates.dropById(o.id);
                fitted++;
            }
            this._perf("idleFit", t0, false, { fitted, more });
            if (more) this._queueIdleFits();
            else if (fitted) this._render();
        });
    }
    screenToFrame(sx, sy) { return this.cam.screenToFrame(sx, sy); }
    pointerDown(sx, sy, ctrl = false) {
        const t0 = perfNow();
        this.frameMeter.poke();
        try { return this._pointerDown(sx, sy, ctrl); }
        finally { const ms = perfNow() - t0; this._perf("ptrDown", t0, false, { tool: this.tool }); this._noteFast("ptrDown", ms); }
    }
    pointerMove(sx, sy) {
        const t0 = perfNow();
        this.frameMeter.poke();
        try { return this._pointerMove(sx, sy); }
        finally { const ms = perfNow() - t0; this._perf("ptrMove", t0, false, { tool: this.tool }); this._noteFast("ptrMove", ms); }
    }
    pointerUp() {
        const t0 = perfNow();
        this.frameMeter.poke();
        try { return this._pointerUp(); }
        finally { const ms = perfNow() - t0; this._perf("ptrUp", t0, false, { tool: this.tool }); this._noteFast("ptrUp", ms); }
    }
    _pointerDown(sx, sy, ctrl = false) {
        if (this._drawing) this._pointerUp();
        if (this.tool !== "select") {
            this._selPress = null;
            if (this._lasso) { this._lasso = null; this.renderer.refreshSelection(); }
        }
        if (this.tool === "pan" || this.readOnly) { this._panLast = [sx, sy]; return; }
        if (this.tool === "erase") { this._erasing = true; this.eraseAt(sx, sy); return; }
        if (this.tool === "erasePartial") {
            this._erasing = true;
            const p = this.cam.screenToFrame(sx, sy);
            const o = {
                type: "stroke", origin: "native", erase: true, bakePx: this.cam.inScale,
                id: this.doc.allocId(), pts: [p],
                lwFrame: (2 * this._eraserPx) / this.cam.inScale,
                color: ERASE_COLOR, opacity: 1,
            };
            this._startPen(o);
            this.store.live = o;
            this.doc.add(o, this.cam.frame, { live: true });
            this.renderer.addLive(o);
            this.renderer.setLiveArcs(o._pen.gaps);
            this.renderer.update();
            this._drawing = o; this._drawStartT = Date.now();
            return;
        }
        if (this.tool === "select") {
            this._selPress = { sx, sy, hit: this._hitTest(sx, sy), ctrl: !!ctrl, moved: false, t: Date.now() };
            return;
        }
        const p = this.cam.screenToFrame(sx, sy);
        const highlight = this.penType === "highlight";
        const straight = this.penType === "straight";
        const lw = (highlight ? this.penWidth * 2.5 : this.penWidth) / this.cam.inScale;
        const op = highlight ? Math.min(this.opacity, 0.45) : this.opacity;
        const o = { type: "stroke", origin: "native", id: this.doc.allocId(), pts: [p], lwFrame: lw, color: this.color, opacity: op };
        if (straight) o._straight = true;
        this._startPen(o);
        this.store.live = o;
        this.doc.add(o, this.cam.frame, { live: true });
        this.renderer.addLive(o);
        this.renderer.setLiveArcs(o._pen.gaps);
        this.renderer.update();
        this._drawing = o; this._drawStartT = Date.now();
        this._emit();
    }
    _pointerMove(sx, sy) {
        if ((this.tool === "pan" || this.readOnly) && this._panLast) {
            const dx = sx - this._panLast[0], dy = sy - this._panLast[1];
            this._panLast = [sx, sy]; this.panBy(dx, dy); return;
        }
        if (this.tool === "erase") { if (this._erasing) this.eraseAt(sx, sy); return; }
        if (this.tool === "select") {
            if (this._lasso) {
                const last = this._lasso.pts[this._lasso.pts.length - 1];
                if (Math.abs(sx - last[0]) > 1 || Math.abs(sy - last[1]) > 1) {
                    this._lasso.pts.push([sx, sy]);
                    this._lasso.moved = true;
                    this.renderer.refreshSelection();
                }
                return;
            }
            const P = this._selPress;
            if (P && !P.moved) {
                if (Math.hypot(sx - P.sx, sy - P.sy) < SELECT_DRAG_PX) return;
                P.moved = true;
                this._beginSelectDrag(P, sx, sy);
                return;
            }
            if (this._dragSel && this.selection) this._dragSelection(sx, sy);
            return;
        }
        if (this._drawing) {
            const p = this.cam.screenToFrame(sx, sy);
            const o = this._drawing;
            if (o._straight && o.pts.length >= 2) {
                o.pts[1] = p;
                o._pen = new BiarcPen({ tol: o._tol });
                o._pen.addSample(o.pts[0]);
                o._pen.addSample(p);
            } else {
                o.pts.push(p);
                o._pen.addSample(p);
            }
            this.renderer.setLiveArcs(o._pen.gaps);
            this.renderer.update();
        }
    }
    _startPen(o) {
        o._tol = (this.cfg.arcTolerancePx * 0.5) / this.cam.inScale;
        o._pen = new BiarcPen({ tol: o._tol });
        o._pen.addSample(o.pts[0]);
    }
    _pointerUp() {
        if (this._selPress) {
            const P = this._selPress; this._selPress = null;
            if (!P.moved) { this._selectTap(P); return; }
        }
        if (this._lasso) {
            const L = this._lasso; this._lasso = null;
            if (L.moved && L.pts.length >= 3) this._applyLasso(L);
            this.renderer.refreshSelection();
            this._emit();
            return;
        }
        if (this._dragSel) {
            const d = this._dragSel;
            if (d.moved && this.selection) {
                for (const [id, st] of d.moves) {
                    if (!this._homeShift(id)) continue;
                    const rec = this.doc.getById(id);
                    st.base = Document.snapGeometry(rec.obj);
                    const n = this._normalizeHome(id);
                    st.after = Document.snapGeometry(rec.obj);
                    st.to = n.level; st.dx += n.dx; st.dy += n.dy;
                }
                const moves = [...d.moves].map(([id, v]) => {
                    const m = { id, dx: v.dx, dy: v.dy, from: v.from, to: v.to };
                    if (v.base) { m.base = v.base; m.after = v.after; }
                    m.belowBefore = v.baseBelow; m.belowAfter = cloneBelow(v.below);
                    return m;
                });
                const frames = d.frames ? [...d.frames.values()].filter((e) => e.to && (e.to.parent !== e.from.parent
                    || e.to.i !== e.from.i || e.to.j !== e.from.j || !sameShift(e.shiftBefore, e.shiftAfter))) : [];
                this._note({
                    kind: "move",
                    moves: moves.map((m) => {
                        const rec = this.doc.getById(m.id);
                        const b = rec && rec.obj.loops ? loopsBBox(rec.obj.loops) : null;
                        return { id: m.id, level: rec ? rec.level : null,
                            from: m.from, to: m.to,
                            dx: +m.dx.toPrecision(8), dy: +m.dy.toPrecision(8),
                            reach: b ? +Math.max(Math.abs(b.x0), Math.abs(b.y0), Math.abs(b.x1), Math.abs(b.y1)).toPrecision(6) : null,
                            below: rec ? encodeBelow(rec.obj.below) : undefined };
                    }),
                    skipped: d.skipped && d.skipped.length ? d.skipped.slice(0, 12) : undefined,
                    frames: frames.length || undefined,
                    frameShadowed: d.frameShadowed && d.frameShadowed.length ? d.frameShadowed.slice(0, 12) : undefined,
                });
                if (frames.length) this.doc.pushUndo({ op: "moveFrames", frames, moves });
                else this.doc.pushUndo(moves.length === 1 ? { op: "move", ...moves[0] } : { op: "moveMany", moves });
            }
            this._endMove("drop");
        }
        if (this._drawing) {
            const o = this._drawing; this._drawing = null;
            this._note({
                kind: o.erase ? "erase" : "draw", id: o.id,
                px: o.erase ? this._eraserPx : this.penWidth,
                lwFrame: +(o.lwFrame || 0).toFixed(4),
                pts: KobinEngine._thin(o.pts),
                cuts: [],
            });
            this.renderer.endLive();
            this.store.live = null;
            this.doc.finalize(o);
            this._queueBake(o);
            this._scheduleBake(0);
            if (o.erase) {
                const op = { op: "eraseCommit", strokeId: o.id, strokeRec: null, baked: [] };
                this.doc.pushUndo(op);
                this._eraseCommits.set(o.id, op);
                this._scheduleBake();
            } else {
                this.doc.pushUndo({ op: "add", id: o.id });
            }
            this._render();
            this._queueIdleFits();
        }
        this._panLast = null; this._erasing = false;
    }
    cancelStroke() {
        const o = this._drawing; if (!o) return;
        this._drawing = null; this.renderer.endLive(); this.store.live = null;
        this.doc.removeById(o.id);
        this._render();
    }
    undo() { if (this.readOnly) return false; if (this._dragSel) this.cancelSelectGesture(false); if (!this._keepingSelection(() => this.doc.undo())) return false; this._scheduleBake(); this._render(); collectFrames(this); return true; }
    redo() { if (this.readOnly) return false; if (this._dragSel) this.cancelSelectGesture(false); if (!this._keepingSelection(() => this.doc.redo())) return false; this._scheduleBake(); this._render(); collectFrames(this); return true; }
    sweepFrames() { return this.readOnly ? 0 : sweepFrames(this); }
    clear() {
        if (this.readOnly) return;
        const capture = () => ({ crossings: this.lm.serialize(), camera: this.cam.state() });
        const restore = (ext) => { this.lm.load(ext.crossings); this.cam.set(ext.camera); };
        this._bakeJobs = []; this._bakeQueued.clear();
        this.doc.clear(capture(), capture, restore);
        this.lm.reset();
        this.cam.set({ frame: "0", activeLevel: 0, inScale: 1, inPanX: 0, inPanY: 0 });
        this.renderer.clear();
        this._render();
    }
    _emit() {
        this.onStatus({
            level: this.cam.activeLevel, inScale: this.cam.inScale, effectiveZoom: this.cam.effectiveZoom(),
            nearCross: this.cam.inScale > this.cfg.enter * 0.8, objects: this._lastList.length,
            lines: false,
            selection: this._selectionStatus(),
            canUndo: this.doc.canUndo(), canRedo: this.doc.canRedo(),
        });
    }
}
mixin(KobinEngine.prototype, overlays, erasePipeline, selection, files, sceneOps);
//// src/engine/LevelMap.js
import { transformLoops, transformLoopsAbout } from "./geometry/arcShape";
import { hasOffsets, shiftAt, hasDigits, addOffset } from "./geometry/offsets";
import {
    R, TILE, TileGrid, cellEdge, cellCentre, cellOf, carryDigit, inDigit,
    displacementDigits, applyDigits, tilePhase, childTilePhase,
} from "./frameLattice";
export { TILE };
const cellKey = (i, j) => i + "," + j;
function phaseThrough(tile, path, frames) {
    let px = tile[0], py = tile[1];
    for (const id of path.up) {
        const c = frames.get(id).centre;
        px = tilePhase(px / R + c.x); py = tilePhase(py / R + c.y);
    }
    for (const id of path.down) {
        const c = frames.get(id).centre;
        px = childTilePhase(px, c.x, R); py = childTilePhase(py, c.y, R);
    }
    return [px, py];
}
const EMPTY_PATH = { up: [], down: [] };
export default class LevelMap {
    constructor(cfg, width, height) {
        this.cfg = cfg;
        this.width = width; this.height = height;
        this.frames = new Map();
        this._spine = new Map();
        this._paths = new Map();
        this._rootId = null;
        this.addrEpoch = 0;
        this.minted = null;
        this._retired = null;
        this._addFrame("0", null, { i: 0, j: 0 }, 0);
    }
    _addFrame(id, parent, cell, depth) {
        this._paths.clear();
        if (this.minted) this.minted.add(id);
        const f = {
            id, parent, depth, cell, _kids: null,
            shift: null, addrSeq: 0,
            shadowOf: null, _shadows: null,
            edge: parent == null ? null : cellEdge(cell.i, cell.j),
            centre: parent == null ? null : cellCentre(cell.i, cell.j),
        };
        this.frames.set(id, f);
        if (parent == null && (this._rootId == null || depth < this.frames.get(this._rootId).depth)) this._rootId = id;
        if (this._isSpine(parent, cell.i, cell.j)) this._spine.set(depth, id);
        if (parent != null) {
            const p = this.frames.get(parent);
            if (p) { if (!p._kids) p._kids = new Map(); p._kids.set(cellKey(cell.i, cell.j), id); }
        }
        return f;
    }
    frame(id) { return this.frames.get(id); }
    depthOf(key) { const f = this._frameFor(key); return f ? f.depth : null; }
    parentOf(key) { const f = this._frameFor(key); return f ? f.parent : null; }
    childrenOf(id) {
        const p = this.frames.get(id);
        const out = [];
        if (p && p._kids) for (const cid of p._kids.values()) {
            const c = this.frames.get(cid);
            out.push(c);
            if (c && c._shadows) for (const sid of c._shadows) out.push(this.frames.get(sid));
        }
        return out;
    }
    walk(rootId, fn) {
        const stack = [this.frames.get(rootId)];
        while (stack.length) {
            const f = stack.pop();
            if (!f) continue;
            fn(f);
            if (f._shadows) for (const sid of f._shadows) stack.push(this.frames.get(sid));
            if (f._kids) for (const cid of f._kids.values()) stack.push(this.frames.get(cid));
        }
    }
    spineAt(depth) { return this._spine.get(depth) || null; }
    pathFrameAt(fromId, depth) {
        let f = this.frames.get(fromId);
        while (f && f.depth > depth) f = this.frames.get(f.parent);
        if (f && f.depth === depth) return f.id;
        return this.spineAt(depth);
    }
    _isSpine(parentId, i, j) {
        if (i !== 0 || j !== 0) return false;
        if (parentId == null) return true;
        const p = this.frames.get(parentId);
        return !!p && this._spine.get(p.depth) === p.id;
    }
    _childId(parentId, i, j) {
        const p = this.frames.get(parentId);
        const depth = p.depth + 1;
        let id = this._isSpine(parentId, i, j) ? String(depth) : parentId + "/" + i + "," + j;
        const taken = (x) => this.frames.has(x) || (this._retired != null && this._retired.has(x));
        if (taken(id)) {
            let n = 2;
            while (taken(id + "#" + n)) n++;
            id = id + "#" + n;
        }
        return id;
    }
    forget(id) {
        const f = this.frames.get(id);
        if (!f || f.parent == null || (f._kids && f._kids.size) || (f._shadows && f._shadows.size)) return false;
        if (f.shadowOf != null) {
            const r = this.frames.get(f.shadowOf);
            if (r && r._shadows) { r._shadows.delete(id); if (!r._shadows.size) r._shadows = null; }
        } else {
            const p = this.frames.get(f.parent), key = cellKey(f.cell.i, f.cell.j);
            if (p && p._kids && p._kids.get(key) === id) p._kids.delete(key);
        }
        if (f.addrSeq) (this._retired || (this._retired = new Set())).add(id);
        this.frames.delete(id);
        this._paths.clear();
        if (this._spine.get(f.depth) === id) this._rebuildSpine();
        return true;
    }
    cellChild(parentId, i, j) {
        const p = this.frames.get(parentId);
        if (!p) return null;
        if (!inDigit(i) || !inDigit(j)) {
            const ci = carryDigit(i), cj = carryDigit(j);
            const sib = this.neighbour(parentId, ci.carry, cj.carry);
            if (!sib) return null;
            return this.cellChild(sib.id, ci.digit, cj.digit);
        }
        if (p._kids) { const hit = p._kids.get(cellKey(i, j)); if (hit) return this.frames.get(hit); }
        return this._addFrame(this._childId(parentId, i, j), parentId, { i, j }, p.depth + 1);
    }
    findCellChild(parentId, i, j) {
        if (!inDigit(i) || !inDigit(j)) return null;
        const p = this.frames.get(parentId);
        const hit = p && p._kids && p._kids.get(cellKey(i, j));
        return hit ? this.frames.get(hit) : null;
    }
    neighbour(id, di, dj) {
        const f = this.frames.get(id);
        if (!f) return null;
        if (!di && !dj) return f;
        const ci = carryDigit(f.cell.i + di), cj = carryDigit(f.cell.j + dj);
        let parentId = f.parent;
        if (ci.carry || cj.carry) {
            if (parentId == null) parentId = this._growRoot(f);
            const pn = this.neighbour(parentId, ci.carry, cj.carry);
            if (!pn) return null;
            parentId = pn.id;
        } else if (parentId == null) {
            parentId = this._growRoot(f);
            const ci2 = carryDigit(f.cell.i + di), cj2 = carryDigit(f.cell.j + dj);
            if (ci2.carry || cj2.carry) {
                const pn = this.neighbour(parentId, ci2.carry, cj2.carry);
                if (!pn) return null;
                parentId = pn.id;
            }
            return this.cellChild(parentId, ci2.digit, cj2.digit);
        }
        return this.cellChild(parentId, ci.digit, cj.digit);
    }
    _growRoot(f) {
        const depth = f.depth - 1;
        const id = String(depth);
        const p = this.frames.get(id) || this._addFrame(id, null, { i: 0, j: 0 }, depth);
        this._adopt(f, p, { i: 0, j: 0 });
        return p.id;
    }
    _adopt(f, p, cell) {
        f.parent = p.id;
        f.cell = { i: cell.i, j: cell.j };
        f.edge = cellEdge(cell.i, cell.j);
        f.centre = cellCentre(cell.i, cell.j);
        this._paths.clear();
        if (!p._kids) p._kids = new Map();
        p._kids.set(cellKey(cell.i, cell.j), f.id);
    }
    _leave(f) {
        if (f.shadowOf != null) {
            const res = this.frames.get(f.shadowOf);
            if (res && res._shadows) res._shadows.delete(f.id);
            f.shadowOf = null;
            return;
        }
        const old = f.parent != null ? this.frames.get(f.parent) : null;
        const key = cellKey(f.cell.i, f.cell.j);
        if (!old || !old._kids || old._kids.get(key) !== f.id) return;
        old._kids.delete(key);
        if (!f._shadows || !f._shadows.size) return;
        const sid = f._shadows.values().next().value;
        const s = this.frames.get(sid);
        f._shadows.delete(sid);
        s.shadowOf = null;
        s._shadows = f._shadows.size ? f._shadows : null;
        if (s._shadows) for (const t of s._shadows) this.frames.get(t).shadowOf = sid;
        f._shadows = null;
        old._kids.set(key, sid);
    }
    _take(f, p, i, j, empty) {
        f.parent = p.id; f.cell = { i, j }; f.edge = cellEdge(i, j); f.centre = cellCentre(i, j);
        f.addrSeq = (f.addrSeq || 0) + 1; f._rec = undefined;
        if (!p._kids) p._kids = new Map();
        const key = cellKey(i, j);
        const taken = p._kids.get(key);
        if (!taken || taken === f.id) { p._kids.set(key, f.id); return null; }
        const E = this.frames.get(taken);
        if (!(E._kids && E._kids.size) && empty(E.id)) {
            E.shadowOf = f.id;
            if (!f._shadows) f._shadows = new Set();
            f._shadows.add(E.id);
            if (E._shadows) { for (const sid of E._shadows) { this.frames.get(sid).shadowOf = f.id; f._shadows.add(sid); } E._shadows = null; }
            p._kids.set(key, f.id);
            return [E.id, f.id];
        }
        f.shadowOf = E.id;
        (E._shadows || (E._shadows = new Set())).add(f.id);
        return [f.id, E.id];
    }
    adoptShadow(M, E) {
        const rec = { id: M.id, into: E.id, parent: M.parent, i: M.cell.i, j: M.cell.j, depth: M.depth, addrSeq: M.addrSeq || 0,
            shift: M.shift ? [M.shift[0], M.shift[1]] : null, shadows: [], kids: [] };
        if (E._shadows) E._shadows.delete(M.id);
        if (M._shadows) {
            for (const sid of M._shadows) { this.frames.get(sid).shadowOf = E.id; (E._shadows || (E._shadows = new Set())).add(sid); rec.shadows.push(sid); }
            M._shadows = null;
        }
        if (!E._kids) E._kids = new Map();
        if (M._kids) for (const cid of M._kids.values()) {
            const c = this.frames.get(cid);
            const key = cellKey(c.cell.i, c.cell.j);
            const taken = E._kids.get(key);
            const kd = { id: c.id, shadowOf: null, shadows: [] };
            c.parent = E.id; c.addrSeq = (c.addrSeq || 0) + 1; c._rec = undefined;
            if (!taken) {
                E._kids.set(key, c.id);
                if (c._shadows) for (const sid of c._shadows) { const s = this.frames.get(sid); s.parent = E.id; s.addrSeq = (s.addrSeq || 0) + 1; s._rec = undefined; }
            } else {
                const d = this.frames.get(taken);
                c.shadowOf = d.id; (d._shadows || (d._shadows = new Set())).add(c.id); kd.shadowOf = d.id;
                if (c._shadows) {
                    for (const sid of c._shadows) { const s = this.frames.get(sid); s.shadowOf = d.id; s.parent = E.id; s.addrSeq = (s.addrSeq || 0) + 1; s._rec = undefined; d._shadows.add(sid); kd.shadows.push(sid); }
                    c._shadows = null;
                }
            }
            rec.kids.push(kd);
        }
        M._kids = null;
        this.frames.delete(M.id);
        this._paths.clear(); this.addrEpoch++; this._rebuildSpine();
        return rec;
    }
    unadoptShadow(rec) {
        const E = this.frames.get(rec.into);
        const M = { id: rec.id, parent: rec.parent, depth: rec.depth, cell: { i: rec.i, j: rec.j }, _kids: null,
            shift: rec.shift ? [rec.shift[0], rec.shift[1]] : null, addrSeq: (rec.addrSeq || 0) + 1,
            edge: cellEdge(rec.i, rec.j), centre: cellCentre(rec.i, rec.j), shadowOf: rec.into, _shadows: null };
        this.frames.set(M.id, M);
        (E._shadows || (E._shadows = new Set())).add(M.id);
        for (const sid of rec.shadows) {
            const s = this.frames.get(sid);
            if (!s) continue;
            E._shadows.delete(sid); s.shadowOf = M.id; (M._shadows || (M._shadows = new Set())).add(sid);
        }
        for (let n = rec.kids.length - 1; n >= 0; n--) {
            const kd = rec.kids[n];
            const c = this.frames.get(kd.id);
            if (!c) continue;
            const key = cellKey(c.cell.i, c.cell.j);
            if (kd.shadowOf != null) {
                const d = this.frames.get(kd.shadowOf);
                if (d && d._shadows) { d._shadows.delete(c.id); for (const sid of kd.shadows) d._shadows.delete(sid); }
                c.shadowOf = null;
                for (const sid of kd.shadows) {
                    const s = this.frames.get(sid);
                    if (!s) continue;
                    s.shadowOf = c.id; s.parent = M.id; s.addrSeq = (s.addrSeq || 0) + 1; s._rec = undefined;
                    (c._shadows || (c._shadows = new Set())).add(sid);
                }
            } else {
                if (E._kids && E._kids.get(key) === c.id) E._kids.delete(key);
                if (c._shadows) for (const sid of c._shadows) { const s = this.frames.get(sid); if (s) { s.parent = M.id; s.addrSeq = (s.addrSeq || 0) + 1; s._rec = undefined; } }
            }
            c.parent = M.id; c.addrSeq = (c.addrSeq || 0) + 1; c._rec = undefined;
            if (!M._kids) M._kids = new Map();
            M._kids.set(key, c.id);
        }
        this._paths.clear(); this.addrEpoch++; this._rebuildSpine();
        return M;
    }
    _rebuildSpine() {
        let f = this._rootId != null ? this.frames.get(this._rootId) : null;
        while (f && f.parent != null) f = this.frames.get(f.parent);
        if (f) this._rootId = f.id;
        this._spine = new Map();
        while (f) { this._spine.set(f.depth, f.id); f = this.findCellChild(f.id, 0, 0); }
    }
    subtreeStart(rootId, atDepth) {
        const out = new Map();
        const last = atDepth + 3;
        const stack = [this.frames.get(rootId)];
        while (stack.length) {
            const f = stack.pop();
            if (!f) continue;
            out.set(f.id, { parent: f.parent, i: f.cell.i, j: f.cell.j, depth: f.depth });
            if (f._shadows) for (const sid of f._shadows) stack.push(this.frames.get(sid));
            if (f.depth >= last) continue;
            if (f._kids) for (const cid of f._kids.values()) stack.push(this.frames.get(cid));
        }
        return out;
    }
    moveSubtreeTargets(rootId, atDepth, dx, dy, start, shiftOf = null) {
        const ids = [...start.keys()].sort((a, b) => start.get(a).depth - start.get(b).depth);
        const at = new Map();
        const out = [];
        for (const id of ids) {
            const e = start.get(id);
            const chain = [];
            let s = e;
            for (;;) {
                chain.push({ i: s.i, j: s.j });
                const up = s.parent != null ? start.get(s.parent) : null;
                if (!up) break;
                s = up;
            }
            let a = s.parent != null ? this.frames.get(s.parent) : null;
            while (a && a.depth > atDepth) {
                chain.push({ i: a.cell.i, j: a.cell.j });
                a = a.parent != null ? this.frames.get(a.parent) : null;
            }
            if (!a || a.depth !== atDepth) { out.push({ id, why: "no frame at the camera depth above the start chain" }); continue; }
            chain.reverse();
            const k = chain.length;
            const X = displacementDigits(dx, k), Y = displacementDigits(dy, k);
            let shift = null;
            if (shiftOf) {
                const had = shiftOf(id);
                const s = addOffset(had ? [[had[0], had[1]]] : null, 0, X.rest, Y.rest);
                X.digits[k - 1] += s.cellX; Y.digits[k - 1] += s.cellY;
                shift = s.below && s.below[0] ? [s.below[0][0], s.below[0][1]] : null;
            }
            const ax = applyDigits(chain.map((c) => c.i), 0, X.digits);
            const ay = applyDigits(chain.map((c) => c.j), 0, Y.digits);
            let from = a.id;
            if (ax.carry || ay.carry) {
                const n = this.neighbour(a.id, ax.carry, ay.carry);
                if (!n) { out.push({ id, why: "no neighbour cell for the carry" }); continue; }
                from = n.id;
            }
            const cells = ax.chain.map((i, n) => ({ i, j: ay.chain[n] }));
            let parent = from, ok = true;
            for (let n = 0; n < cells.length - 1; n++) {
                const c = cells[n];
                const mover = at.get(parent + "|" + c.i + "," + c.j);
                if (mover) { parent = mover; continue; }
                const f = this.findCellChild(parent, c.i, c.j) || this.cellChild(parent, c.i, c.j);
                if (!f) { ok = false; break; }
                parent = f.id;
            }
            if (!ok) { out.push({ id, why: "the target chain cannot be reached" }); continue; }
            const cell = cells[cells.length - 1];
            at.set(parent + "|" + cell.i + "," + cell.j, id);
            out.push({ id, depth: e.depth, parent, i: cell.i, j: cell.j, rest: [X.rest, Y.rest], shift });
        }
        out.sort((p, q) => start.get(q.id).depth - start.get(p.id).depth);
        return out;
    }
    readdressMany(targets, opts = {}) {
        const empty = opts.empty || (() => false);
        const list = (targets || []).filter((t) => t && t.parent != null && this.frames.has(t.id) && this.frames.has(t.parent));
        for (const t of list) this._leave(this.frames.get(t.id));
        const order = list.slice().sort((p, q) => (p.depth || 0) - (q.depth || 0));
        const moved = [], shadowed = [];
        for (const t of order) {
            const sh = this._take(this.frames.get(t.id), this.frames.get(t.parent), t.i, t.j, empty);
            if (sh) shadowed.push({ id: sh[0], of: sh[1] });
            moved.push(t.id);
        }
        this._paths.clear();
        this.addrEpoch++;
        this._rebuildSpine();
        return { moved, shadowed };
    }
    merge(data) {
        const list = ((data && data.frames) || []).slice().sort((a, b) => (a.depth - b.depth) || (a.id < b.id ? -1 : a.id > b.id ? 1 : 0));
        let added = 0;
        for (const f of list) {
            const cur = this.frames.get(f.id);
            let p = f.parent != null ? this.frames.get(f.parent) : null;
            if (cur) { if (cur.parent == null && p) this._adopt(cur, p, { i: f.i, j: f.j }); continue; }
            if (f.parent != null && !p) p = this.ensureId(f.parent);
            if (f.parent != null && !p) continue;
            this._addFrame(f.id, f.parent, { i: f.i, j: f.j }, f.depth);
            added++;
        }
        return added;
    }
    ensureId(id) {
        const hit = this.frames.get(id);
        if (hit) return hit;
        const segs = String(id).split("/");
        const depth = Number(segs[0]);
        if (!Number.isInteger(depth) || segs[0] !== String(depth)) return null;
        const cells = [];
        for (let n = 1; n < segs.length; n++) {
            const m = /^(-?\d+),(-?\d+)(#\d+)?$/.exec(segs[n]);
            if (!m || !inDigit(+m[1]) || !inDigit(+m[2])) return null;
            cells.push({ i: +m[1], j: +m[2] });
        }
        let k = segs.length - 1;
        while (k > 1 && !this.frames.has(segs.slice(0, k).join("/"))) k--;
        if (k === 1 && !this.frames.has(segs[0])) this.ensureSpine(depth);
        let cur = this.frames.get(segs.slice(0, k).join("/"));
        for (let n = k; n < segs.length && cur; n++) {
            const exact = segs.slice(0, n + 1).join("/"), { i, j } = cells[n - 1];
            const resident = this.findCellChild(cur.id, i, j);
            const f = this._addFrame(exact, cur.id, { i, j }, cur.depth + 1);
            if (resident) {
                cur._kids.set(cellKey(i, j), resident.id);
                f.shadowOf = resident.id;
                (resident._shadows || (resident._shadows = new Set())).add(f.id);
            }
            cur = f;
        }
        return cur && cur.id === id ? cur : null;
    }
    peekNeighbour(id, di, dj) {
        const f = this.frames.get(id);
        if (!f) return null;
        if (!di && !dj) return f;
        const ci = carryDigit(f.cell.i + di), cj = carryDigit(f.cell.j + dj);
        if (f.parent == null) return null;
        let parentId = f.parent;
        if (ci.carry || cj.carry) {
            const pn = this.peekNeighbour(parentId, ci.carry, cj.carry);
            if (!pn) return null;
            parentId = pn.id;
        }
        return this.findCellChild(parentId, ci.digit, cj.digit);
    }
    peekRing(id) {
        const out = [];
        for (let di = -1; di <= 1; di++) {
            for (let dj = -1; dj <= 1; dj++) {
                if (!di && !dj) continue;
                const n = this.peekNeighbour(id, di, dj);
                if (n) out.push(n);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }
    ensureParent(id) {
        const f = this.frames.get(id);
        if (!f) return null;
        if (f.parent != null) return f.parent;
        return this._growRoot(f);
    }
    _viewCell(inScale, inPanX, inPanY) {
        const cx = (this.width / 2 - inPanX) / inScale, cy = (this.height / 2 - inPanY) / inScale;
        return cellOf(cx, cy);
    }
    findChild(parentId, inScale, inPanX, inPanY) {
        const c = this._viewCell(inScale, inPanX, inPanY);
        return this.findCellChild(parentId, c.i, c.j);
    }
    ensureChild(parentId, inScale, inPanX, inPanY) {
        const c = this._viewCell(inScale, inPanX, inPanY);
        return this.cellChild(parentId, c.i, c.j);
    }
    ensureParentEdge(childId) {
        const child = this.frames.get(childId);
        if (!child) return null;
        if (child.parent == null) this._growRoot(child);
        return child.edge;
    }
    _recOf(f) {
        if (!f || !f.edge) return undefined;
        if (!f._rec) f._rec = { s: f.edge.s, t: f.edge.t, grid: this.makeGrid() };
        return f._rec;
    }
    get records() {
        const out = {};
        for (const [depth, id] of this._spine) {
            const r = this._recOf(this.frames.get(id));
            if (r) out[depth] = r;
        }
        return out;
    }
    makeGrid() { return { w: TILE, h: TILE, ox: -TILE / 2, oy: -TILE / 2 }; }
    grid() { return this.makeGrid(); }
    _frameFor(key) {
        const s = String(key);
        if (this.frames.has(s)) return this.frames.get(s);
        const id = this.spineAt(typeof key === "number" ? key : +key);
        return id ? this.frames.get(id) : null;
    }
    frameFor(key) { return this._frameFor(key); }
    tileRect(key, i, j) { return TileGrid.CACHE.rect(i, j); }
    tileRange(key, rect) { return TileGrid.CACHE.touching(rect); }
    _centre(key) { const f = this._frameFor(key); return f ? f.centre : null; }
    rectToParent(rect, key) {
        const c = this._centre(key);
        return { left: rect.left / R + c.x, top: rect.top / R + c.y,
            right: rect.right / R + c.x, bottom: rect.bottom / R + c.y };
    }
    _ancestors(id) {
        const out = [];
        let f = this.frames.get(id);
        while (f) { out.push(f.id); f = f.parent ? this.frames.get(f.parent) : null; }
        return out;
    }
    isAncestor(aId, bId) {
        if (aId === bId) return false;
        let f = this.frames.get(bId);
        f = f && f.parent ? this.frames.get(f.parent) : null;
        while (f) { if (f.id === aId) return true; f = f.parent ? this.frames.get(f.parent) : null; }
        return false;
    }
    isUnder(aId, bId) {
        let f = this.frames.get(bId);
        while (f) {
            if (f.id === aId || f.shadowOf === aId) return true;
            f = f.parent != null ? this.frames.get(f.parent) : null;
        }
        return false;
    }
    chainFrom(rootId, id) {
        const out = [];
        let f = this.frames.get(id);
        while (f && f.id !== rootId) { out.push(f.cell); f = f.parent ? this.frames.get(f.parent) : null; }
        if (!f) return null;
        out.reverse();
        return out;
    }
    frameAtChain(rootId, chain) {
        let cur = this.frames.get(rootId);
        for (const c of chain) {
            if (!cur) return null;
            cur = this.cellChild(cur.id, c.i, c.j);
        }
        return cur;
    }
    displaceFrame(id, atDepth, dx, dy) {
        const f = this.frames.get(id);
        if (!f || atDepth > f.depth) return null;
        const anchor = this.pathFrameAt(id, atDepth);
        if (anchor == null) return null;
        const chain = this.chainFrom(anchor, id);
        if (!chain) return null;
        const k = chain.length;
        const X = displacementDigits(dx, k), Y = displacementDigits(dy, k);
        if (!k) return { frame: f, rest: [X.rest, Y.rest] };
        const ax = applyDigits(chain.map((c) => c.i), 0, X.digits);
        const ay = applyDigits(chain.map((c) => c.j), 0, Y.digits);
        let root = anchor;
        if (ax.carry || ay.carry) {
            const n = this.neighbour(anchor, ax.carry, ay.carry);
            if (!n) return null;
            root = n.id;
        }
        const cells = ax.chain.map((i, n) => ({ i, j: ay.chain[n] }));
        const frame = this.frameAtChain(root, cells);
        return frame ? { frame, rest: [X.rest, Y.rest] } : null;
    }
    framePath(fromKey, toKey) {
        const from = this._frameFor(fromKey), to = this._frameFor(toKey);
        if (!from || !to) return null;
        const fromId = from.id, toId = to.id;
        if (fromId === toId) return EMPTY_PATH;
        const ck = fromId + "|" + toId;
        const hit = this._paths.get(ck);
        if (hit !== undefined) return hit;
        const built = this._buildPath(fromId, toId);
        this._paths.set(ck, built);
        return built;
    }
    _buildPath(fromId, toId) {
        const fa = this._ancestors(fromId), ta = new Map();
        let f = this.frames.get(toId);
        while (f) { ta.set(f.id, f); f = f.parent ? this.frames.get(f.parent) : null; }
        const upIds = [];
        let common = null;
        for (const a of fa) { if (ta.has(a)) { common = a; break; } upIds.push(a); }
        if (!common) return null;
        const downIds = [];
        f = this.frames.get(toId);
        while (f && f.id !== common) { downIds.push(f.id); f = this.frames.get(f.parent); }
        downIds.reverse();
        return { up: upIds, down: downIds };
    }
    frameFactor(fromId, toId) {
        const path = this.framePath(fromId, toId);
        if (!path) return null;
        const base = this.cfg.base;
        let f = 1;
        for (const id of path.up) { const e = this.frames.get(id).edge; if (!e) return null; f *= base / e.s; }
        for (const id of path.down) { const e = this.frames.get(id).edge; if (!e) return null; f *= e.s / base; }
        return f;
    }
    mapPointF(p, fromId, toId) {
        const path = this.framePath(fromId, toId);
        if (!path) return null;
        let x = p[0], y = p[1];
        for (const id of path.up) { const c = this.frames.get(id).centre; if (!c) return null; x = x / R + c.x; y = y / R + c.y; }
        for (const id of path.down) { const c = this.frames.get(id).centre; if (!c) return null; x = (x - c.x) * R; y = (y - c.y) * R; }
        return [x, y];
    }
    mapRectF(rect, fromId, toId) {
        const a = this.mapPointF([rect.left, rect.top], fromId, toId);
        const b = this.mapPointF([rect.right, rect.bottom], fromId, toId);
        if (!a || !b) return null;
        return { left: Math.min(a[0], b[0]), top: Math.min(a[1], b[1]), right: Math.max(a[0], b[0]), bottom: Math.max(a[1], b[1]) };
    }
    objShift(below, homeId, F) {
        const hd = this.depthOf(homeId), D = this.depthOf(F);
        if (hd == null || D == null) return null;
        const k0 = D - hd;
        const sh = shiftAt(below, k0);
        if (k0 <= 0 || !hasDigits(sh)) return { F0: F, rem: sh.rem, sh };
        const A = this.pathFrameAt(F, hd);
        const chain = A != null ? this.chainFrom(A, F) : null;
        if (!chain || chain.length !== k0) return null;
        const negX = [], negY = [];
        for (let m = 1; m <= k0; m++) { const d = sh.digits[m] || [0, 0]; negX.push(-d[0]); negY.push(-d[1]); }
        const ax = applyDigits(chain.map((c) => c.i), 0, negX);
        const ay = applyDigits(chain.map((c) => c.j), 0, negY);
        const A0 = this.neighbour(A, ax.carry - sh.carry[0], ay.carry - sh.carry[1]);
        if (!A0) return null;
        const F0 = this.frameAtChain(A0.id, ax.chain.map((i, n) => ({ i, j: ay.chain[n] })));
        return F0 ? { F0: F0.id, rem: sh.rem, sh } : null;
    }
    _homeToX(fromId, toId, homeId, toHome) {
        const f = String(fromId) === String(homeId), t = String(toId) === String(homeId);
        return f && !(t && toHome);
    }
    mapPointObj(p, fromId, toId, below, homeId, toHome) {
        if (!hasOffsets(below)) return this.mapPointF(p, fromId, toId);
        if (this._homeToX(fromId, toId, homeId, toHome)) {
            const s = this.objShift(below, fromId, toId);
            if (!s) return null;
            const q = this.mapPointF(p, fromId, s.F0);
            return q ? [q[0] + s.rem[0], q[1] + s.rem[1]] : null;
        }
        const s = this.objShift(below, toId, fromId);
        if (!s) return null;
        return this.mapPointF([p[0] - s.rem[0], p[1] - s.rem[1]], s.F0, toId);
    }
    mapRectObj(rect, fromId, toId, below, homeId, toHome) {
        const a = this.mapPointObj([rect.left, rect.top], fromId, toId, below, homeId, toHome);
        const b = this.mapPointObj([rect.right, rect.bottom], fromId, toId, below, homeId, toHome);
        if (!a || !b) return null;
        return { left: Math.min(a[0], b[0]), top: Math.min(a[1], b[1]), right: Math.max(a[0], b[0]), bottom: Math.max(a[1], b[1]) };
    }
    projectLoops(loops, fromId, toId) {
        const path = this.framePath(fromId, toId);
        if (!path) return null;
        for (const id of path.up) {
            const c = this.frames.get(id).centre;
            loops = transformLoops(loops, 1 / R, c.x, c.y);
        }
        for (const id of path.down) {
            const c = this.frames.get(id).centre;
            loops = transformLoopsAbout(loops, c.x, c.y, R);
        }
        return loops;
    }
    projectLoopsObj(loops, fromId, toId, below, homeId, toHome) {
        if (!hasOffsets(below)) return this.projectLoops(loops, fromId, toId);
        if (this._homeToX(fromId, toId, homeId, toHome)) {
            const s = this.objShift(below, fromId, toId);
            if (!s) return null;
            const out = this.projectLoops(loops, fromId, s.F0);
            return out && (s.rem[0] || s.rem[1]) ? transformLoops(out, 1, s.rem[0], s.rem[1]) : out;
        }
        const s = this.objShift(below, toId, fromId);
        if (!s) return null;
        const moved = (s.rem[0] || s.rem[1]) ? transformLoops(loops, 1, -s.rem[0], -s.rem[1]) : loops;
        return this.projectLoops(moved, s.F0, toId);
    }
    projectF(o, homeId, toId) {
        const f = this.frameFactor(homeId, toId);
        if (f == null) return null;
        const path = this.framePath(homeId, toId);
        const mapAll = (src) => {
            let pts = src;
            for (const id of path.up) { const c = this.frames.get(id).centre; pts = pts.map(([x, y]) => [x / R + c.x, y / R + c.y]); }
            for (const id of path.down) { const c = this.frames.get(id).centre; pts = pts.map(([x, y]) => [(x - c.x) * R, (y - c.y) * R]); }
            return pts;
        };
        if (o.type === "shape") {
            let loops = o.loops;
            for (const id of path.up) {
                const c = this.frames.get(id).centre;
                loops = transformLoops(loops, 1 / R, c.x, c.y);
            }
            for (const id of path.down) {
                const c = this.frames.get(id).centre;
                loops = transformLoopsAbout(loops, c.x, c.y, R);
            }
            const out = { type: "shape", origin: "derived", id: o.id, z: o.z, loops,
                color: o.color, opacity: o.opacity };
            if (o.tile) out.tile = phaseThrough(o.tile, path, this.frames);
            return out;
        }
        if (o.type === "fill") {
            return { type: "fill", origin: "derived", id: o.id, z: o.z, polys: o.polys.map(mapAll),
                color: o.color, opacity: o.opacity };
        }
        return { type: "stroke", origin: "derived", id: o.id, z: o.z, pts: mapAll(o.pts),
            lwFrame: o.lwFrame * f, color: o.color, opacity: o.opacity };
    }
    framePointToScreen(fromKey, x, y, activeKey, inScale, inPanX, inPanY) {
        const from = this._frameFor(fromKey), active = this._frameFor(activeKey);
        if (!from || !active) return null;
        const p = this.mapPointF([x, y], from.id, active.id);
        if (!p) return null;
        return [p[0] * inScale + inPanX, p[1] * inScale + inPanY];
    }
    effectiveZoom(activeKey, inScale) {
        const anchor = this.spineAt(0);
        const active = this._frameFor(activeKey);
        if (!anchor || !active) return inScale;
        const f = this.frameFactor(anchor, active.id);
        return f == null ? inScale : inScale * f;
    }
    serialize() {
        return {
            __lattice: 1,
            frames: [...this.frames.values()].sort((a, b) => (a.depth - b.depth) || (a.id < b.id ? -1 : a.id > b.id ? 1 : 0)).map((f) => ({
                id: f.id, parent: f.parent, depth: f.depth, i: f.cell.i, j: f.cell.j,
                ...(f.shift ? { shift: [f.shift[0], f.shift[1]] } : {}),
                ...(f.shadowOf != null ? { shadowOf: f.shadowOf } : {}),
            })),
        };
    }
    load(data) {
        this._paths.clear();
        this._retired = null;
        if (data && !data.__lattice && Object.keys(data).length) {
            const e = new Error("This drawing was saved in the pre-lattice format and cannot be opened.");
            e.code = "LEGACY_FORMAT";
            throw e;
        }
        this.frames = new Map();
        this._spine = new Map();
        this._rootId = null;
        const minted = this.minted;
        this.minted = null;
        try { this._loadFrames(data); } finally { this.minted = minted; }
    }
    _loadFrames(data) {
        const list = (data && data.frames) || [];
        const byId = new Map(list.map((f) => [f.id, f]));
        const done = new Set();
        const put = (f) => {
            if (!f || done.has(f.id)) return;
            done.add(f.id);
            if (f.parent != null && byId.has(f.parent)) put(byId.get(f.parent));
            else if (f.parent != null && !this.frames.has(f.parent)) this.ensureId(f.parent);
            this._addFrame(f.id, f.parent, { i: f.i, j: f.j }, f.depth);
            if (f.shift) this.frames.get(f.id).shift = [f.shift[0], f.shift[1]];
        };
        for (const f of list) put(f);
        if (!this.frames.has("0")) this._addFrame("0", null, { i: 0, j: 0 }, 0);
        for (const f of list) {
            if (f.shadowOf == null) continue;
            const s = this.frames.get(f.id), r = this.frames.get(f.shadowOf);
            if (!s || !r || r.parent !== s.parent || r.cell.i !== s.cell.i || r.cell.j !== s.cell.j) continue;
            s.shadowOf = r.id;
            (r._shadows || (r._shadows = new Set())).add(s.id);
            const p = this.frames.get(s.parent);
            if (p && p._kids) p._kids.set(cellKey(s.cell.i, s.cell.j), r.id);
        }
        this._rebuildSpine();
    }
    ensureSpine(depth) {
        if (this.spineAt(depth) != null) return this.spineAt(depth);
        let [lo, hi] = [Infinity, -Infinity];
        for (const d of this._spine.keys()) { if (d < lo) lo = d; if (d > hi) hi = d; }
        if (lo === Infinity) { this._addFrame("0", null, { i: 0, j: 0 }, 0); lo = hi = 0; }
        while (depth < lo) {
            lo--;
            const f = this.frames.get(String(lo)) || this._addFrame(String(lo), null, { i: 0, j: 0 }, lo);
            const child = this.frames.get(this._spine.get(lo + 1));
            if (child && child.parent == null) this._adopt(child, f, { i: 0, j: 0 });
        }
        while (depth > hi) { hi++; this.cellChild(this._spine.get(hi - 1), 0, 0); }
        return this.spineAt(depth);
    }
    reset() {
        this._paths.clear();
        this._retired = null;
        this.frames = new Map();
        this._spine = new Map();
        this._rootId = null;
        this._addFrame("0", null, { i: 0, j: 0 }, 0);
    }
    resize(width, height) {
        this.width = width; this.height = height;
    }
}

import Two from "two.js";
import { strokeLoops } from "./geometry/curveOutline";
import { chordCubic, chordArcMid, planArc } from "./geometry/arcShape";
import { onRectEdge } from "./geometry/antRuns";
const LIVE_CHUNK = 128;
function pushMove(verts, pt, og) {
    verts.push(new Two.Anchor(pt[0] - og.x, pt[1] - og.y, undefined, undefined, undefined, undefined, Two.Commands.move));
}
function pushLine(verts, A, B, og, ctx) {
    const len = Math.hypot(B[0] - A[0], B[1] - A[1]);
    let n = 1;
    if (ctx && ctx.segMax > 0 && len > ctx.segMax && !(ctx.clip && onRectEdge({ line: true, A, B }, ctx.clip.rect, ctx.clip.eps))) {
        n = Math.ceil(len / ctx.segMax - 1e-9);
    }
    for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        const t = i / n;
        const x = i === n ? B[0] : A[0] + (B[0] - A[0]) * t, y = i === n ? B[1] : A[1] + (B[1] - A[1]) * t;
        verts.push(new Two.Anchor(x - og.x, y - og.y, undefined, undefined, undefined, undefined, Two.Commands.line));
    }
}
function pushArcPiece(verts, p, og, ctx) {
    const r = Math.abs(p.r);
    if (p.line || !isFinite(r) || !(r > 0)) { pushLine(verts, p.A, p.B, og, ctx); return; }
    const plan = planArc(p, ctx);
    const sweepFlag = p.sweep > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    for (const q of plan.parts) {
        const m = chordArcMid(q);
        let a;
        if (plan.command === "A") {
            a = new Two.Anchor(q.B[0] - og.x, q.B[1] - og.y, undefined, undefined, undefined, undefined, Two.Commands.arc);
            a.rx = r; a.ry = r; a.xAxisRotation = 0; a.largeArcFlag = 0; a.sweepFlag = sweepFlag;
        } else {
            const c = chordCubic(q);
            const prev = verts[verts.length - 1];
            if (prev) {
                if (!prev.controls) Two.Anchor.AppendCurveProperties(prev);
                prev.controls.right.x = c[1][0] - (prev.x + og.x);
                prev.controls.right.y = c[1][1] - (prev.y + og.y);
            }
            a = new Two.Anchor(c[3][0] - og.x, c[3][1] - og.y, c[2][0] - c[3][0], c[2][1] - c[3][1], 0, 0, Two.Commands.curve);
        }
        a._mid = [m[0] - og.x, m[1] - og.y];
        verts.push(a);
    }
}
function pushGapAnchors(verts, gap, og, ctx) {
    for (const a of gap) {
        if (!verts.length) pushMove(verts, a.A, og);
        pushArcPiece(verts, a, og, ctx);
    }
}

    setSize(w, h) { this.width = w; this.height = h; this.two.renderer.setSize(w, h); }

    _gatePx() { return this.cfg.fatWidthPx != null ? this.cfg.fatWidthPx : FAT_WIDTH_PX; }
    _fatEver(o) { return o.type === "stroke" && o.lwFrame * this.cfg.enter > this._gatePx(); }
    _strokeMode(o) {
        if (o.type !== "stroke" || o === this._liveModel || !this._fatEver(o)) return "raw";
        if (!this.lazyOutlines || o._outline) return "outline";

    }
    needsFatFlip() {

    }
    syncCameraOnly(view) {
        this.syncWorld(view);
        for (const entry of this._groups.values()) if (entry.fadeTag != null) this._applyOpacity(entry, entry.pieces[0]);
    }
    syncWorld(view) {
        this._syncWorldTransform(view);
        this._renderOverlays(view);
    }
    _renderOverlays(view) {
        this._renderSelection();

    }
    _syncWorldTransform() {
        const o = this._origin();
        this.world.scale = this.cam.inScale;
        this.world.translation.x = this.cam.inPanX + this.cam.inScale * o.x;
        this.world.translation.y = this.cam.inPanY + this.cam.inScale * o.y;
    }
    _origin() {
        if (this._ovOrigin) return this._ovOrigin;
        const sc = this._scenes.get(this._level);
        return (sc && sc.origin) || Renderer._ZERO;
    }
    _viewCenter() {
        const w = this.cam.frameWindow(0);
        return { x: Math.round((w.left + w.right) / 2), y: Math.round((w.top + w.bottom) / 2) };
    }
    _applyOpacity(entry, o) {
        const fade = entry.family ? 1 : this._fade(o);
        entry.group.opacity = (o.opacity == null ? 1 : o.opacity) * fade;
    }
    _fade(o) {
        if (o.fadeTag == null) return 1;
        const px = o.fadeTag * this.cam.inScale / this.cfg.enter;
        const lo = this.cfg.fadeLoPx != null ? this.cfg.fadeLoPx : 0.15;
        const hi = this.cfg.cullPx != null ? this.cfg.cullPx : 0.3;
        return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (px - lo) / (hi - lo)));
    }
    ensureOutline(o, curved) {
        return strokeLoops(o, this.cfg, { curved, live: this._liveModel });
    }
    addLive(o) {
        if (this._live) this.endLive();
        const root = new Two.Group();
        root.opacity = o.opacity == null ? 1 : o.opacity;
        const live = this._livePath(o.color, o.lwFrame, []);
        root.add(live);
        (this._activeRoot || this.world).add(root);
        this._liveRoot = root; this._live = live; this._liveModel = o;
        this._liveStable = 0; this._liveGap = 0;
        return live;
    }
    _livePath(color, lw, verts) {
        const p = new Two.Path(verts, false, false, true);
        p.noFill(); p.stroke = color; p.linewidth = lw; p.cap = "round"; p.join = "round"; p.opacity = 1;
        return p;
    }
    _freezeLive() {
        const path = this._live, v = path.vertices, k = this._liveStable;
        const j = v[k - 1];
        const chunk = this._livePath(path.stroke, path.linewidth, v.slice(0, k));
        const r = j.controls ? j.controls.right : null;
        const mv = new Two.Anchor(j.x, j.y, 0, 0, r ? r.x : 0, r ? r.y : 0, Two.Commands.move);
        v.splice(0, k, mv);
        this._liveRoot.add(chunk);
        this._liveStable = 1;
    }
    setLiveArcs(gaps) {
        const path = this._live;
        if (!path) return;
        const og = this._origin();
        const v = path.vertices;
        if (v.length > this._liveStable) v.splice(this._liveStable, v.length - this._liveStable);
        const n = gaps.length;
        if (!n) {
            const m = this._liveModel;
            if (m && m.pts.length) {
                const p = m.pts[0];
                v.push(new Two.Anchor(p[0] - og.x, p[1] - og.y, 0, 0, 0, 0, Two.Commands.move));
                v.push(new Two.Anchor(p[0] - og.x, p[1] - og.y, 0, 0, 0, 0, Two.Commands.line));
            }
            return;
        }
        const finalTo = Math.max(0, n - 2);
        let stable = this._liveStable;
        for (let g = this._liveGap; g < n; g++) {
            pushGapAnchors(v, gaps[g], og, this._arcPlan);
            if (g + 1 <= finalTo) stable = v.length;
        }
        this._liveStable = stable;
        this._liveGap = finalTo;
        if (this._liveStable > this.liveChunk) this._freezeLive();
    }
    endLive() {
        if (this._live && this._live.parent) this._live.parent.remove(this._live);
        if (this._liveRoot && this._liveRoot.parent) this._liveRoot.parent.remove(this._liveRoot);
        this._live = null; this._liveRoot = null; this._liveModel = null;
    }
    setLasso(fn) { this._lassoFn = fn; }

    _renderSelection() {

        const loop = this._lassoFn && this._lassoFn();

            const lp = new Two.Path(loop.map(([x, y]) => new Two.Anchor(x, y)), true, false);
            lp.noFill(); lp.stroke = SEL_INK; lp.linewidth = 1.5; lp.opacity = 0.9;

            this.selGroup.add(lp);
        }
    }
    setSelectionAnts(fn) { this._selAntsFn = fn; }
    _renderSelChevrons(edges, kt, W, H) {
        const els = this._selEls;
        if (!els || typeof document === "undefined") return 0;
        const inset = (SEL_ANT_W * kt) / 2;
        const DIR = { left: 180, right: 0, top: -90, bottom: 90 };
        const withChevron = edges.filter((e) => e.chevron);
        Renderer._poolTo(els.screen, els.arrowPool, withChevron.length, null, () => {
            const q = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "path");
            const half = SEL_ARROW_SPAN / 2, d = SEL_ARROW_DEPTH / 2;
            q.setAttribute("d", "M" + (-d) + "," + (-half)
                + " L" + d + ",0 L" + (-d) + "," + half);
            q.setAttribute("fill", "none");
            q.setAttribute("stroke", SEL_INK);
            q.setAttribute("stroke-width", "2.2");
            q.setAttribute("stroke-linecap", "round");
            q.setAttribute("stroke-linejoin", "round");
            q.setAttribute("class", "bl-sel-arrow");
            return q;
        });
        for (let i = 0; i < withChevron.length; i++) {
            const e = withChevron[i];
            const mid = (e.from + e.to) / 2;
            const x = e.side === "left" ? inset + SEL_ARROW_GAP
                : e.side === "right" ? W - inset - SEL_ARROW_GAP
                    : mid;
            const y = e.side === "top" ? inset + SEL_ARROW_GAP
                : e.side === "bottom" ? H - inset - SEL_ARROW_GAP
                    : mid;
            els.arrowPool[i].setAttribute("transform",
                "translate(" + x.toFixed(2) + "," + y.toFixed(2) + ") rotate(" + DIR[e.side] + ")");
        }
        return withChevron.length;
    }
    _mkSelLayer(svg, host, cls) {
        const l = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, "svg");
        l.setAttribute("class", cls);
        l.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        l.style.cssText = "position:absolute;left:0;top:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:visible;will-change:transform;transform-origin:0 0;";
        try {
            const a = svg.getBoundingClientRect(), b = host.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (a.left - b.left || a.top - b.top) { l.style.left = (a.left - b.left) + "px"; l.style.top = (a.top - b.top) + "px"; }
        } catch (e) {  }
        return l;
    }
    _dropSelOverlay() {
        if (this._selEls && this._selEls.resume) clearTimeout(this._selEls.resume);
        for (const g of this._selOv || []) if (g && g.parentNode) g.parentNode.removeChild(g);
        this._selOv = null;
        this._selEls = null;
    }
    static _poolTo(parent, pool, n, before, make) {
        while (pool.length < n) {
            const el = make();
            if (before) parent.insertBefore(el, before); else parent.appendChild(el);
            pool.push(el);
        }
        while (pool.length > n) {
            const el = pool.pop();
            if (el.parentNode) el.parentNode.removeChild(el);
        }
    }
    static _ensureSelStyle() {
        if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
        const css = Renderer._selCss();
        let st = document.getElementById("bl-sel-style");
        if (st) {
            if (st.textContent !== css) st.textContent = css;
            return;
        }
        st = document.createElement("style");
        st.id = "bl-sel-style";
        st.textContent = css;
        (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(st);
    }
    static _selCss() {
        return [
            "@keyframes bl-sel-ants{to{stroke-dashoffset:var(--ao,-18px)}}",
            "@keyframes bl-sel-faint{0%,100%{opacity:.5}50%{opacity:.8}}",
            ".bl-sel-ants{animation:bl-sel-ants .8s steps(16,end) infinite}",
            ".bl-sel-still .bl-sel-ants{animation-play-state:paused}",
            ".bl-sel-arrow{animation:bl-sel-faint 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}",
            "@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){",
            ".bl-sel-ants{animation:none}",
            ".bl-sel-arrow{animation:none;opacity:.65}}",
        ].join("");
    }
}

function flattenAll(objs) {
    for (const o of objs) if (o && o.loops) for (let i = 0; i < o.loops.length; i++) if (!(o.loops[i] instanceof Loop)) o.loops[i] = Loop.from(o.loops[i]);
    return objs;
}
const PER_LEVEL_CAP = 64;

export default class TileStore {
    constructor(levelMap, doc, cfg) {

    _depth(frameId) { const d = this.lm.depthOf(frameId); return d == null ? 0 : d; }
    _minContentDepth() {
        let m = Infinity;
        for (const k of this.doc.levels()) if (this.doc.count(k)) { const d = this._depth(k); if (d < m) m = d; }
        return m;
    }
    content(F, windowRect) {
        const cf = this.lm.frameFor(F);
