        if (!cf) return [];
        F = cf.id;
        let out = [];
        const range = this.lm.tileRange(F, windowRect);
        const nowVisible = new Set();
        for (let i = range.i0; i <= range.i1; i++) {
            for (let j = range.j0; j <= range.j1; j++) {
                for (const dir of ["up", "down"]) {
                    const key = F + "|" + dir + "|" + i + "," + j;
                    nowVisible.add(key);
                    this._pins.add(key);
                    const tile = dir === "up" ? this._ensureUp(F, i, j) : this._ensureDown(F, i, j);
                    for (const o of tile.objs) out.push(o);
                }
            }
        }
        if (this.doc.hasOffsets()) out = this._reroute(F, windowRect, out, nowVisible);
        this._pins = nowVisible;
        this._evict();
        return out;
    }
    contentOffCamera(F, rect, budgetMs = 0) {
        const pins = new Set(this._pins);
        this._holdEvict = true;
        this._deadline = budgetMs > 0 ? perfNow() + budgetMs : null;
        this._readBakes = 0;
        try {
            const out = this.content(F, rect);
            if (this.warmReads) for (const k of this._pins) this._warm.add(k);
            return out;
        } catch (e) {
            if (e === OVER_BUDGET) { this.overBudget = (this.overBudget || 0) + 1; return null; }
            throw e;
        } finally { this._deadline = null; this._pins = pins; this._holdEvict = false; this._evict(); }
    }
    clearWarm() { this._warm.clear(); }
    _reroute(F, win, out, pins) {
        const { moved, groups } = this._rerouteGroups(F);
        if (!moved.size) return out;
        const kept = out.filter((p) => !moved.has(p.id));
        for (const g of groups.values()) {
            const w = { left: win.left - g.rem[0], right: win.right - g.rem[0], top: win.top - g.rem[1], bottom: win.bottom - g.rem[1] };
            const range = this.lm.tileRange(g.F0, w);
            for (let i = range.i0; i <= range.i1; i++) {
                for (let j = range.j0; j <= range.j1; j++) {
                    for (const dir of ["up", "down"]) {
                        const key = g.F0 + "|" + dir + "|" + i + "," + j;
                        pins.add(key);
                        this._pins.add(key);
                        const tile = dir === "up" ? this._ensureUp(g.F0, i, j) : this._ensureDown(g.F0, i, j);
                        for (const p of tile.objs) if (g.ids.has(p.id)) kept.push(p);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return kept;
    }
    _rerouteGroups(F) {
        const memo = this._rrMemo || (this._rrMemo = new Map());
        const m = memo.get(F);
        const lat = () => this.lm.addrEpoch + "|" + this.lm.frames.size;
        const key = () => F + "|" + this.doc.offRev + "|" + lat();
        const k0 = key();
        if (m && m.key === k0) { this._rrHits = (this._rrHits || 0) + 1; return m; }
        const D = this._depth(F);
        const place = (out, id) => {
            const rec = this.doc.getById(id);
            if (!rec || rec.level === F) return;
            if (D < this._depth(rec.level)) return;
            const s = this.lm.objShift(rec.obj.below, rec.level, F);
            if (!s) return;
            out.moved.add(id);
            const k = s.F0 + "|" + s.rem[0] + "|" + s.rem[1];
            let g = out.groups.get(k);
            if (!g) out.groups.set(k, (g = { F0: s.F0, rem: s.rem, ids: new Set() }));
            g.ids.add(id);
            out.gk.set(id, k);
        };
        const since = m && m.lat === lat() ? this.doc.offTouchedSince(m.rev) : null;
        let out;
        if (since && since.size < this.doc.offsetIds().size / 2) {
            out = m;
            for (const id of since) {
                const k = out.gk.get(id);
                if (k !== undefined) {
                    const g = out.groups.get(k);
                    g.ids.delete(id);
                    if (!g.ids.size) out.groups.delete(k);
                    out.moved.delete(id); out.gk.delete(id);
                }
                if (this.doc.offsetIds().has(id)) place(out, id);
            }
            this._rrPatches = (this._rrPatches || 0) + 1;
        } else {
            out = { moved: new Set(), groups: new Map(), gk: new Map() };
            for (const id of this.doc.offsetIds()) place(out, id);
        }
        out.key = k0; out.rev = this.doc.offRev; out.lat = lat();
        memo.delete(F);
        if (key() === k0) { memo.set(F, out); if (memo.size > 4) memo.delete(memo.keys().next().value); }
        return out;
    }
    ownContent(F) {
        const cf = this.lm.frameFor(F);
        if (!cf) return [];
        return this.doc.at(cf.id);
    }
    _ensureUp(F, i, j) {
        const cf = this.lm.frameFor(F); if (!cf) return { level: F, dir: "up", i, j, objs: [], epoch: this._epoch, lru: this._clock };
        F = cf.id;
        const key = F + "|up|" + i + "," + j;
        const hit = this.cache.get(key);
        const seq = this.chainSeq(F);
        if (hit && hit.epoch === this._epoch && hit.seq === seq) { hit.lru = ++this._clock; return hit; }
        if (this._deadline != null && !this._nest && this._readBakes > 0 && perfNow() > this._deadline) throw OVER_BUDGET;
        this._pins.add(key);
        let objs;
        this._nest++;
        try { objs = this._bakeSettled(() => this._bakeUp(F, i, j)); } finally { this._nest--; }
        const tile = { level: F, dir: "up", i, j, objs, epoch: this._epoch, seq: this.chainSeq(F), lru: ++this._clock };
        this.cache.set(key, tile);
        this._readBakes++;
        return tile;
    }
    _bakeSettled(bake) {
        let objs;
        for (let n = 0; n < 3; n++) {
            const rev = this.doc.rev;
            objs = bake();
            if (this.doc.rev === rev) return objs;
            this._rebakes++;
        }
        return objs;
    }
    _bakeUp(F, i, j) {
        const frame = this.lm.frame(F);
        const parentId = frame && frame.parent;
        const rec = frame && frame.edge;
        if (!parentId || !rec) return [];
        const rect = this.lm.tileRect(F, i, j);
        if (this._depth(parentId) < this._minContentDepth()) return [];
        const pr = this.lm.rectToParent(rect, F);
        const parentObjs = this._upPiecesOver(parentId, pr, null);
        for (const o of this.doc.at(parentId)) parentObjs.push(o);
        for (const o of this._ringNatives(parentId, pr)) parentObjs.push(o);
        const objs = [];
        const edges = [];
        for (const o of parentObjs) {
            const tier = classifyUp(o, rec.s, rec.t, rect, this.cfg, this.live, null);
            if (tier === "empty") continue;
            if (tier === "solid") objs.push(this._solid(o, rec, rect));
            else edges.push(o);
        }
        deriveStep(edges, rec.s, rec.t, rect, F, {
            cfg: this.cfg, width: this.lm.width, opacityGroups: this.opacityGroups, live: this.live,
            addrSeq: frame.addrSeq || 0,
            parentCurved: (o) => o.origin === "native",
            childCurved: () => false,
        }, objs);
        return flattenAll(objs);
    }
    _upPiecesOver(parentId, pr, only) {
        const parentObjs = [];
        const take = (o) => { if (only == null || o.id === only) parentObjs.push(o); };
        const prange = this.lm.tileRange(parentId, pr);
        if (prange.i0 === prange.i1 && prange.j0 === prange.j1) {
            for (const o of this._ensureUp(parentId, prange.i0, prange.j0).objs) take(o);
        } else {
            const cx = (pr.left + pr.right) / 2, cy = (pr.top + pr.bottom) / 2;
            const pc = this.lm.tileRange(parentId, { left: cx, right: cx, top: cy, bottom: cy });
            const covered = new Set();
            for (const o of this._ensureUp(parentId, pc.i0, pc.j0).objs) {
                if (only != null && o.id !== only) continue;
                parentObjs.push(o);
                const c = o.clip;
                if (c && c.left <= pr.left && c.right >= pr.right && c.top <= pr.top && c.bottom >= pr.bottom) covered.add(o.id);
            }
            for (let pi = prange.i0; pi <= prange.i1; pi++) {
                for (let pj = prange.j0; pj <= prange.j1; pj++) {
                    if (pi === pc.i0 && pj === pc.j0) continue;
                    for (const o of this._ensureUp(parentId, pi, pj).objs) if (!covered.has(o.id)) take(o);
                }
            }
        }
        return parentObjs;
    }
    _ringNatives(parentId, rect) {
        const out = [];
        for (const G of this.lm.peekRing(parentId)) {
            if (!this.doc.at(G.id).length) continue;
            const inG = this.lm.mapRectF(rect, parentId, G.id);
            if (!inG) continue;
            for (const o of this.doc.queryRect(G.id, inG)) {
                const d = this.lm.projectF(o, G.id, parentId);
                if (!d) continue;
                d.origin = o.origin;
                out.push(d);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }
    _solid(o, rec, rect) {
        return solidQuad(o, rect, { pad: seamPad(o, this.cfg, this.opacityGroups) });
    }
    _ensureDown(F, i, j) {
        const cf = this.lm.frameFor(F); if (!cf) return { level: F, dir: "down", i, j, objs: [], epoch: this._epoch, lru: this._clock };
        F = cf.id;
        const key = F + "|down|" + i + "," + j;
        const hit = this.cache.get(key);
        const seq = this.chainSeq(F);
        if (hit && hit.epoch === this._epoch && hit.seq === seq) { hit.lru = ++this._clock; return hit; }
        if (this._deadline != null && !this._nest && this._readBakes > 0 && perfNow() > this._deadline) throw OVER_BUDGET;
        const objs = this._bakeSettled(() => this._bakeDown(F, i, j));
        const tile = { level: F, dir: "down", i, j, objs, epoch: this._epoch, seq: this.chainSeq(F), lru: ++this._clock };
        this.cache.set(key, tile);
        this._readBakes++;
        return tile;
    }
    _bakeDown(F, i, j) {
        const rect = this.lm.tileRect(F, i, j);
        const objs = [];
        const enter = this.cfg.enter;
        const cands = this._downSources(F, rect);
        for (const G of cands) {
            const f = this.lm.frameFactor(G, F);
            if (f == null) continue;
            if (DOWN_MAX_SIZE * f * enter < this.fadeLoPx) continue;
            const ext = this.doc.frameExtent(G);
            if (!ext || ext.maxSize * f * enter < this.fadeLoPx) continue;
            const eAtF = this.lm.mapRectF({ left: ext.box.x0, top: ext.box.y0, right: ext.box.x1, bottom: ext.box.y1 }, G, F);
            if (eAtF) {
                const tol = 1e-9 * (rect.right - rect.left);
                if (eAtF.right + tol < rect.left || eAtF.left - tol > rect.right ||
                    eAtF.bottom + tol < rect.top || eAtF.top - tol > rect.bottom) continue;
            }
            for (const o of this.doc.at(G)) {
                const tag = projectedSizePx(o, f, this.cfg, this.live);
                if (tag < this.fadeLoPx) continue;
                const b = bboxOf(o, this.live);
                const bAtF = this.lm.mapRectF({ left: b.x0, top: b.y0, right: b.x1, bottom: b.y1 }, G, F);
                const lwF = (o.lwFrame || 0) * f;
                if (!bAtF || bAtF.right + lwF < rect.left || bAtF.left - lwF > rect.right ||
                    bAtF.bottom + lwF < rect.top || bAtF.top - lwF > rect.bottom) continue;
                const d = this.lm.projectF(o, G, F);
                if (!d) continue;
                this._downPieces(o, d, rect, tag, objs);
            }
        }
        return flattenAll(objs);
    }
    _downSources(F, rect) {
        const Fd = this._depth(F);
        const out = [];
        const visit = (id, s, tx, ty) => {
            const reach = REACH * s * (1 + 1e-9);
            if (tx + reach < rect.left || tx - reach > rect.right || ty + reach < rect.top || ty - reach > rect.bottom) return;
            const f = this.lm.frame(id);
            if (id !== F && f.depth >= Fd && this.doc.count(id)) out.push(id);
            for (const c of this.lm.childrenOf(id)) if (c.centre) visit(c.id, s / R, c.centre.x * s + tx, c.centre.y * s + ty);
        };
        visit(F, 1, 0, 0);
        let child = this.lm.frame(F), s = 1, tx = 0, ty = 0;
        while (child && child.parent != null) {
            const c = child.centre;
            if (!c) break;
            s *= R; tx -= c.x * s; ty -= c.y * s;
            for (const sib of this.lm.childrenOf(child.parent)) if (sib.id !== child.id && sib.centre) visit(sib.id, s / R, sib.centre.x * s + tx, sib.centre.y * s + ty);
            child = this.lm.frame(child.parent);
        }
        out.sort((a, b) => this._depth(a) - this._depth(b));
        return out;
    }
    _downPieces(o, d, rect, tag, out) {
        const pad = seamPad(o, this.cfg, this.opacityGroups);
        if (d.type === "shape") {
            const crect = padRect(rect, pad);
            const { rings, covered } = shapeRingsInRect(d.loops, crect, shapeTol(this.cfg), { freezeR: freezeR(this.cfg) });
            if (rings.length) {
                const piece = { type: "fill", origin: "derived", id: o.id, z: o.z, color: o.color,
                    opacity: o.opacity, polys: rings, fadeTag: tag, clip: crect };
                if (covered) piece.covers = true;
                out.push(piece);
            }
            return out;
        }
        if (d.type === "fill") {
            const crect = padRect(rect, pad);
            const tp = clipRingsToRect(d.polys, crect);
            if (tp.length) out.push({ type: "fill", origin: "derived", id: o.id, z: o.z, color: o.color,
                opacity: o.opacity, polys: tp, fadeTag: tag, clip: crect });
            return out;
        }
        const pts = (o.origin === "native" && d.pts.length > 2)
            ? flattenCurve(d.pts, (this.cfg.arcTolerancePx * 0.5) / this.cfg.base) : d.pts;
        const lw = d.lwFrame;
        const ew = padRect(rect, pad + lw);
        for (const run of clipPolylineToRect(pts, ew)) {
            if (run.length) out.push({ type: "stroke", origin: "derived", id: o.id, z: o.z, color: o.color,
                opacity: o.opacity, pts: run, lwFrame: lw, fadeTag: tag });
        }
        return out;
    }
    chainSeq(F) {
        if (this._chainSeqEpoch !== this.lm.addrEpoch) { this._chainSeq.clear(); this._chainSeqEpoch = this.lm.addrEpoch; }
        const hit = this._chainSeq.get(F);
        if (hit !== undefined) return hit;
        let n = 0;
        for (let id = F; id != null; id = this.lm.parentOf(id)) { const f = this.lm.frame(id); if (f && f.addrSeq) n += f.addrSeq; }
        this._chainSeq.set(F, n);
        return n;
    }
    _onFrameEvent(ev) {
        const foot = [];
        const cur = this.lm.frame(ev.frame);
        if (cur && cur.parent != null) foot.push([cur.parent, cur.cell.i, cur.cell.j]);
        else if (ev.at && ev.at.parent != null) foot.push([ev.at.parent, ev.at.i, ev.at.j]);
        if (ev.kind === "refile" && ev.from && ev.from.parent != null) foot.push([ev.from.parent, ev.from.i, ev.from.j]);
        if (ev.kind === "mergeFrame") for (const [key, tile] of this.cache) if (tile.level === ev.frame) this.cache.delete(key);
        if (!foot.length) return;
        const reach = REACH / R;
        const pad = seamPadFor(this.cfg);
        const memo = new Map();
        for (const [key, tile] of this.cache) {
            let rects = memo.get(tile.level);
            if (rects === undefined) {
                rects = [];
                for (const [parent, i, j] of foot) {
                    const r = this.lm.mapRectF({ left: i * G - reach, top: j * G - reach, right: i * G + reach, bottom: j * G + reach }, parent, tile.level);
                    if (r) rects.push(r);
                }
                memo.set(tile.level, rects);
            }
            if (!rects.length) continue;
            const t = padRect(this.lm.tileRect(tile.level, tile.i, tile.j), pad);
            for (const r of rects) {
                if (r.right < t.left || r.left > t.right || r.bottom < t.top || r.top > t.bottom) continue;
                this.cache.delete(key);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    _onDoc(ev) {
        if (ev.kind === "reset") { this.cache.clear(); return; }
        if (ev.kind === "refile" || ev.kind === "removeFrame" || ev.kind === "addFrame" || ev.kind === "mergeFrame" || ev.kind === "splitFrame") { this._onFrameEvent(ev); return; }
        if (!ev.obj) return;
        if (ev.kind === "remove") { this._removeObject(ev.id); return; }
        if (ev.kind === "add" && ev.live) return;
        if (ev.kind === "add" || ev.kind === "finalize") { this._addObject(ev.obj, ev.level); return; }
        if (ev.kind === "change" && (ev.offsetsOnly || ev.attrOnly)) return;
        if (ev.kind === "change") { this._removeObject(ev.id); this._addObject(ev.obj, ev.level); }
    }
    forgetFrame(frame) {
        const F = String(frame);
        for (const [key, tile] of this.cache) {
            if (String(tile.level) !== F) continue;
            this.cache.delete(key); this._pins.delete(key); this._warm.delete(key);
        }
        if (this._rrMemo) this._rrMemo.delete(F);
        this._chainSeq.delete(F);
    }
    _tileLive(key, tile) {
        if (this._batch && !this._pins.has(key)) { this.cache.delete(key); return false; }
        if (!this.lm.frame(tile.level)) { this.cache.delete(key); return false; }
        return true;
    }
    _removeObject(id) {
        for (const [key, tile] of this.cache) {
            if (!this._tileLive(key, tile) || !tile.objs.length) continue;
            let has = false;
            for (const p of tile.objs) if (p.id === id) { has = true; break; }
            if (has) tile.objs = tile.objs.filter((p) => p.id !== id);
        }
    }
    _addObject(o, H) {
        H = String(H);
        const chained = [];
        const via = new Map();
        for (const [key, tile] of this.cache) {
            if (!this._tileLive(key, tile)) continue;
            const F = tile.level;
            if (F === H) continue;
            if (tile.dir === "down") {
                if (!this.lm.isAncestor(H, F) && this._depth(H) >= this._depth(F)) this._appendDown(tile, o, H);
                continue;
            }
            let A = via.get(F);
            if (A === undefined) { A = this._upVia(H, F); via.set(F, A); }
            if (A == null) continue;
            if (this.lm.parentOf(F) === A) {
                const d = A === H ? o : this._ringCopy(o, H, A, this.lm.rectToParent(this.lm.tileRect(F, tile.i, tile.j), F));
                if (d) this._appendUp(tile, [d]);
            } else if (this._reaches(o, H, tile)) chained.push([key, tile]);
        }
        chained.sort((a, b) => this._depth(a[1].level) - this._depth(b[1].level));
        for (const [key, tile] of chained) if (this.cache.get(key) === tile) this._appendChained(key, tile, o);
    }
    _upVia(H, F) {
        const dH = this._depth(H);
        if (dH >= this._depth(F)) return null;
        let A = F;
        while (A != null && this._depth(A) > dH) A = this.lm.parentOf(A);
        if (A == null) return null;
        A = String(A);
        if (A === H) return H;
        for (const G of this.lm.peekRing(A)) if (String(G.id) === H) return A;
        return null;
    }
    _ringCopy(o, H, A, pr) {
        const inH = this.lm.mapRectF(pr, A, H);
        if (!inH || !this.doc.queryRect(H, inH).includes(o)) return null;
        const d = this.lm.projectF(o, H, A);
        if (!d) return null;
        d.origin = o.origin;
        return d;
    }
    _reaches(o, H, tile) {
        const r = this.lm.mapRectF(padRect(this.lm.tileRect(tile.level, tile.i, tile.j), seamPadFor(this.cfg)), tile.level, H);
        const half = o.type === "fill" ? 0 : (o.lwFrame || 0) / 2;
        return !r || this._overlaps(r, bboxOf(o, this.live), half);
    }
    _appendChained(key, tile, o) {
        const F = tile.level;
        const frame = this.lm.frame(F);
        const P = frame && frame.parent != null ? this.lm.frameFor(frame.parent) : null;
        if (!P || !frame.edge) return;
        const pr = this.lm.rectToParent(this.lm.tileRect(F, tile.i, tile.j), F);
        const r = this.lm.tileRange(P.id, pr);
        const seq = this.chainSeq(P.id);
        for (let i = r.i0; i <= r.i1; i++) {
            for (let j = r.j0; j <= r.j1; j++) {
                const p = this.cache.get(P.id + "|up|" + i + "," + j);
                if (!p || p.epoch !== this._epoch || p.seq !== seq) { this.cache.delete(key); return; }
            }
        }
        const from = this._upPiecesOver(P.id, pr, o.id);
        if (from.length) this._appendUp(tile, from);
    }
    _appendUp(tile, objs) {
        const F = tile.level;
        const frame = this.lm.frame(F);
        const rec = frame && frame.edge;
        if (!rec) return;
        const rect = this.lm.tileRect(F, tile.i, tile.j);
        const edges = [];
        for (const o of objs) {
            const tier = classifyUp(o, rec.s, rec.t, rect, this.cfg, this.live, null);
            if (tier === "empty") continue;
            if (tier === "solid") tile.objs.push(this._solid(o, rec, rect));
            else edges.push(o);
        }
        if (!edges.length) return;
        deriveStep(edges, rec.s, rec.t, rect, F, {
            cfg: this.cfg, width: this.lm.width, opacityGroups: this.opacityGroups, live: this.live,
            addrSeq: frame.addrSeq || 0,
            parentCurved: (p) => p.origin === "native",
            childCurved: () => false,
        }, tile.objs);
        flattenAll(tile.objs);
    }
    _appendDown(tile, o, H) {
        const F = tile.level;
        const f = this.lm.frameFactor(H, F);
        if (f == null) return;
        const tag = projectedSizePx(o, f, this.cfg, this.live);
        if (tag < this.fadeLoPx) return;
        const rect = this.lm.tileRect(F, tile.i, tile.j);
        const b = bboxOf(o, this.live);
        const bAtF = this.lm.mapRectF({ left: b.x0, top: b.y0, right: b.x1, bottom: b.y1 }, H, F);
        const lwF = (o.lwFrame || 0) * f;
        if (!bAtF || bAtF.right + lwF < rect.left || bAtF.left - lwF > rect.right ||
            bAtF.bottom + lwF < rect.top || bAtF.top - lwF > rect.bottom) return;
        const d = this.lm.projectF(o, H, F);
        if (!d) return;
        this._downPieces(o, d, rect, tag, tile.objs);
        flattenAll(tile.objs);
    }
    _overlaps(rect, b, margin) {
        return b.x1 + margin >= rect.left && b.x0 - margin <= rect.right &&
               b.y1 + margin >= rect.top && b.y0 - margin <= rect.bottom;
    }
    framesLeft(F) {
        const keep = new Set();
        for (let id = F; id != null; id = this.lm.parentOf(id)) keep.add(String(id));
        let n = 0;
        for (const [key, tile] of this.cache) {
            if (keep.has(String(tile.level)) || this._pins.has(key) || this._warm.has(key)) continue;
            this.cache.delete(key); n++;
        }
        return n;
    }
    _evict() {
        if (this._holdEvict) return;
        if (this.cache.size <= GLOBAL_CAP) { this._evictPerLevel(); return; }
        const evictable = [];
        for (const [key, tile] of this.cache) if (!this._pins.has(key)) evictable.push([key, tile.lru]);
        evictable.sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
        let n = this.cache.size - GLOBAL_CAP;
        for (const [key] of evictable) { if (n-- <= 0) break; this.cache.delete(key); }
        this._evictPerLevel();
    }
    _evictPerLevel() {
        const byLevel = new Map();
        for (const [key, tile] of this.cache) {
            if (!byLevel.has(tile.level)) byLevel.set(tile.level, []);
            byLevel.get(tile.level).push([key, tile.lru]);
        }
        for (const arr of byLevel.values()) {
            if (arr.length <= PER_LEVEL_CAP) continue;
            arr.sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]);
            let n = arr.length - PER_LEVEL_CAP;
            for (const [key] of arr) { if (n-- <= 0) break; if (!this._pins.has(key)) this.cache.delete(key); }
        }
    }
    size() { return this.cache.size; }
}
//// src/engine/eraseDescent.js
import LevelMap from "./LevelMap";
import { R as CROSS_RATIO, W as FRAME_W, childTilePhase } from "./frameLattice";
import { classifyUp, deriveStep, solidQuad, seamPad, bboxOf } from "./geometry/derive";
import { loopsBBox, translateLoops, shapeComponents, dropDust, subtractShape, rectLoop } from "./geometry/arcShape";
import { shiftDown, cloneBelow } from "./geometry/offsets";
import { Loop } from "./geometry/loop";
import { cutJob, dustBarFor } from "./eraseJob";
const asLTRB = (r) => ("x0" in r ? { left: r.x0, top: r.y0, right: r.x1, bottom: r.y1 } : r);
export class VirtualDoc {
    constructor(seed) {
        this.map = new Map();
        this.next = -1;
        for (const rec of seed || []) this.map.set(rec.obj.id, { obj: rec.obj, level: String(rec.level) });
    }
    allocId() { return this.next--; }
    getById(id) { return this.map.get(id) || null; }
    add(obj, level) { this.map.set(obj.id, { obj, level: String(level) }); return obj; }
    removeById(id) { const rec = this.map.get(id); if (rec) this.map.delete(id); return rec || null; }
    editKey(o) { return o && o.editId != null ? o.editId : o && o.id; }
}
export function squareInkOf(world, vdoc, id, F, i, j) {
    const { lm, cfg, opacityGroups } = world;
    const cf = lm.frameFor(F);
    if (!cf) return null;
    F = cf.id;
    const frame = lm.frame(F);
    const parentId = frame && frame.parent;
    const rec = frame && frame.edge;
    if (!parentId || !rec) return null;
    const rect = lm.tileRect(F, i, j);
    const v = vdoc.getById(id);
    if (!v) return null;
    let o = v.obj;
    if (String(v.level) !== String(parentId)) {
        const pr = lm.rectToParent(rect, F);
        const inG = lm.mapRectF(pr, parentId, v.level);
        if (!inG) return null;
        const b = bboxOf(o, null);
        if (b.x1 < inG.left || b.x0 > inG.right || b.y1 < inG.top || b.y0 > inG.bottom) return null;
        const d = lm.projectF(o, v.level, parentId);
        if (!d) return null;
        d.origin = o.origin;
        o = d;
    }
    const tier = classifyUp(o, rec.s, rec.t, rect, cfg, null, null);
    if (tier === "empty") return null;
    const objs = [];
    if (tier === "solid") objs.push(solidQuad(o, rect, { pad: seamPad(o, cfg, opacityGroups) }));
    else {
        deriveStep([o], rec.s, rec.t, rect, F, {
            cfg, width: world.width, opacityGroups, live: null,
            addrSeq: frame.addrSeq || 0,
            parentCurved: (p) => p.origin === "native",
            childCurved: () => false,
        }, objs);
    }
    let loops = null, clip = null, tile = null;
    for (const p of objs) {
        if (p.id !== id) continue;
        if (p.type === "shape" && p.loops && p.loops.length) {
            loops = loops ? loops.concat(p.loops) : p.loops;
            clip = clip || p.clip; tile = tile || p.tile;
        } else if (p.type === "fill" && p.covers && p.clip) {
            const r = asLTRB(p.clip);
            loops = (loops || []).concat(rectLoop(r));
            clip = clip || p.clip;
        }
    }
    if (!loops || !loops.length || !clip) return null;
    return { loops, clip: asLTRB(clip), tile };
}
function cedeVirtual(vdoc, id, level, regions, holeInParent, attachRect, kidTile, kidBelow, boolOpts, dustBar) {
    const rec = vdoc.getById(id);
    if (!rec) return null;
    const src = rec.obj;
    if (src.type !== "shape") return null;
    const R = { left: holeInParent.x0, top: holeInParent.y0, right: holeInParent.x1, bottom: holeInParent.y1 };
    const cut = subtractShape(src.loops, rectLoop(R), boolOpts).loops;
    const groups = dropDust(shapeComponents(cut), src.w, dustBar);
    const removed = vdoc.removeById(id);
    if (!removed) return null;
    const z = src.z != null ? src.z : src.id;
    const editKey = vdoc.editKey(src);
    const mk = (loops, lvl, attach, tile, below) => {
        const obj = {
            type: "shape", origin: src.origin, id: vdoc.allocId(), z, loops,
            color: src.color, opacity: src.opacity, editId: editKey,
        };
        if (src.w > 0) obj.w = src.w;
        if (attach) obj.attachRect = { ...attach };
        if (below) obj.below = below;
        if (tile) obj.tile = [tile[0], tile[1]];
        return { obj: vdoc.add(obj, lvl), level: String(lvl) };
    };
    const parents = groups.map((loops) => mk(loops, removed.level, src.attachRect, src.tile, cloneBelow(src.below)));
    const below1 = kidBelow !== undefined ? cloneBelow(kidBelow) : shiftDown(src.below, 1);
    const kids = regions.map((r) => mk(r.loops || r, level, attachRect, kidTile, cloneBelow(below1)));
    return { removed, parents, kids, pieces: parents.concat(kids) };
}
export function descentJob(world, input) {
    const { lm } = world;
    const had = new Map();
    for (const f of lm.frames.values()) had.set(f.id, f.parent);
    const boolOpts = { freezeR: input.freezeR };
    const E = input.E, HE = input.HE;
    const o = input.target.obj, HO = String(input.target.level);
    const stats = { openChains: 0, dust: 0, seals: [] };
    const squareInk = world.squareInk || squareInkOf;
    const vdoc = new VirtualDoc([{ obj: o, level: HO }]);
    const path0 = lm.framePath(HO, HE), dHO = lm.depthOf(HO);
    const ringA = path0 && path0.up.length ? path0.down.find((f) => lm.depthOf(f) === dHO) : null;
    let near = false;
    if (ringA) for (let di = -1; di <= 1; di++) for (let dj = -1; dj <= 1; dj++) { const n = (di || dj) ? lm.peekNeighbour(HO, di, dj) : null; if (n && String(n.id) === String(ringA)) near = true; }
    const path = near ? { up: [], down: path0.down.filter((f) => lm.depthOf(f) > dHO) } : path0;
    if (!path || path.up.length || !path.down.length) return { refused: "not a pure descent", stats };
    if (!E.loops || !E.loops.length) return { refused: "eraser has no perimeter", stats };
    const clipAtHE = E.loops;
    const eb = loopsBBox(clipAtHE);
    if (!eb) return { refused: "eraser has no bbox", stats };
    const rE = Math.max(eb.x1 - eb.x0, eb.y1 - eb.y0) / 2;
    const eraseAtHE = { left: eb.x0 - rE, top: eb.y0 - rE, right: eb.x1 + rE, bottom: eb.y1 + rE };
    if (o.type !== "shape") return { refused: "target is a " + o.type, stats };
    const steps = [];
    let why = null;
    let curIds = new Set([o.id]);
    let lastCeded = false;
    let inked = false, unread = false;
    for (let k = 0; k < path.down.length && curIds.size; k++) {
        const F = path.down[k];
        const last = k === path.down.length - 1;
        inked = false;
        const eraseAtF = lm.mapRectF(eraseAtHE, HE, F);
        if (!eraseAtF) { why = "the eraser maps to nothing in " + F; unread = true; break; }
        const next = k + 1 < path.down.length ? lm.frame(path.down[k + 1]) : null;
        const cf = lm.frame(F);
        const kidIds = new Set();
        for (const cid0 of [...curIds]) {
            curIds.delete(cid0);
            let ids = [cid0];
            let only = false;
            const c0rec = vdoc.getById(cid0);
            const c0 = c0rec && c0rec.obj;
            const shift = c0 && c0.below ? lm.objShift(c0.below, c0rec.level, F) : null;
            if (c0 && c0.below && !shift) { why = "the picture's frame cannot be found in " + F; unread = true; continue; }
            const F0 = shift ? shift.F0 : F;
            const rem = shift ? shift.rem : [0, 0];
            const kdep = c0rec ? lm.depthOf(F) - lm.depthOf(c0rec.level) : 1;
            const kidBelow = c0 && c0.below ? shiftDown(c0.below, kdep) : undefined;
            let need = { left: eraseAtF.left - rem[0], right: eraseAtF.right - rem[0],
                top: eraseAtF.top - rem[1], bottom: eraseAtF.bottom - rem[1] };
            if (next && next.centre) {
                const n0 = shift ? lm.objShift(c0.below, c0rec.level, next.id) : null;
                const nc = n0 && n0.F0 !== next.id ? lm.mapPointF([0, 0], n0.F0, F0) : [next.centre.x, next.centre.y];
                const h = FRAME_W / CROSS_RATIO / 2;
                if (nc) {
                    need = {
                        left: Math.min(need.left, nc[0] - h), right: Math.max(need.right, nc[0] + h),
                        top: Math.min(need.top, nc[1] - h), bottom: Math.max(need.bottom, nc[1] + h),
                    };
                }
            }
            const rg = lm.tileRange(F0, need);
            const i1 = Math.min(rg.i1, rg.i0 + 1), j1 = Math.min(rg.j1, rg.j0 + 1);
            if (i1 < rg.i1 || j1 < rg.j1) unread = true;
            const ncx = (need.left + need.right) / 2, ncy = (need.top + need.bottom) / 2;
            const pref = lm.tileRange(F0, { left: ncx, right: ncx, top: ncy, bottom: ncy });
            const order = [[pref.i0, pref.j0]];
            for (let i = rg.i0; i <= i1; i++) for (let j = rg.j0; j <= j1; j++) if (i !== pref.i0 || j !== pref.j0) order.push([i, j]);
            const covers = (c, n = need) => c.left <= n.left && c.right >= n.right && c.top <= n.top && c.bottom >= n.bottom;
            for (const [i, j] of order) {
                if (only) break;
                const own0 = (i || j) ? lm.neighbour(F0, i, j) : null;
                const ownF = (i || j) ? lm.neighbour(F, i, j) : null;
                if ((i || j) && (!own0 || !ownF)) { why = "the square's frame cannot be found"; unread = true; continue; }
                const F0n = own0 ? own0.id : F0, Fn = ownF ? ownF.id : F;
                const needIn = (i || j) ? { left: need.left - i * FRAME_W, right: need.right - i * FRAME_W, top: need.top - j * FRAME_W, bottom: need.bottom - j * FRAME_W } : need;
                for (const cid of [...ids]) {
                    const crec = vdoc.getById(cid);
                    if (!crec || crec.obj.type !== "shape") continue;
                    const cur = crec.obj;
                    const ink = squareInk(world, vdoc, cid, F0n, 0, 0);
                    if (!ink) { why = "tile holds none of its ink"; continue; }
                    if (i === pref.i0 && j === pref.j0 && covers(ink.clip, needIn)) only = true;
                    const groups = shapeComponents(ink.loops);
                    const solid = dropDust(groups, cur.w, dustBarFor(E.bakePx, lm.frameFactor(HE, F0n)));
                    stats.dust += groups.length - solid.length;
                    if (!solid.length) { why = "the tile's ink is degenerate"; continue; }
                    let specs;
                    if (last) {
                        const whole = [].concat(...solid);
                        const tx = -rem[0] - i * FRAME_W, ty = -rem[1] - j * FRAME_W;
                        const clipHere = (tx || ty) ? translateLoops(clipAtHE, tx, ty) : clipAtHE;
                        const r = cutJob({ subject: whole, clip: clipHere, w: cur.w, dustBar: dustBarFor(E.bakePx), freezeR: boolOpts.freezeR, graze: "cede" });
                        if (r.stats && r.stats.openChains) stats.seals.push({ id: cur.id, open: r.stats.openChains, area: r.stats.sealedArea, weld: r.stats.weld, retriedAt: r.stats.retriedAt || 0 });
                        stats.dust += r.dust || 0;
                        if (r.kind === "grazed") { why = "grazing: nothing removed"; continue; }
                        specs = r.kind === "cut" ? r.regions.map((g) => ({ loops: g })) : [];
                        if (!specs.length) { why = "nothing survives the cut"; }
                    } else {
                        specs = solid.map((g) => ({ loops: g }));
                    }
                    inked = true;
                    const Rc = ink.clip;
                    const wParent = lm.mapRectF(Rc, F0n, crec.level);
                    if (!wParent || !(wParent.right > wParent.left) || !(wParent.bottom > wParent.top)) { why = "the tile maps to nothing in the parent"; continue; }
                    const pcur = cur.tile || [0, 0];
                    const cfo = ownF || cf;
                    const ph = ink.tile || (cfo && cfo.centre
                        ? [childTilePhase(pcur[0], cfo.centre.x, CROSS_RATIO), childTilePhase(pcur[1], cfo.centre.y, CROSS_RATIO)]
                        : [0, 0]);
                    const step = cedeVirtual(vdoc, cid, Fn, specs,
                        { x0: wParent.left, y0: wParent.top, x1: wParent.right, y1: wParent.bottom },
                        { x0: Rc.left, y0: Rc.top, x1: Rc.right, y1: Rc.bottom }, ph, kidBelow, boolOpts,
                        dustBarFor(E.bakePx, lm.frameFactor(HE, crec.level)));
                    if (!step) { why = "cedeTileById refused"; continue; }
                    const spec = (p) => ({ vid: p.obj.id, level: p.level, obj: p.obj });
                    steps.push({ removedId: step.removed.obj.id, parents: step.parents.map(spec), kids: step.kids.map(spec) });
                    if (last) lastCeded = true;
                    ids = ids.filter((x) => x !== cid).concat(step.parents.map((p) => p.obj.id));
                    for (const kd of step.kids) kidIds.add(kd.obj.id);
                }
            }
        }
        curIds = kidIds;
    }
    const inkless = !inked && !unread;
    if (!steps.length) return { refused: "no tile ceded: " + (why || "?"), stats, inkless };
    if (!lastCeded) return { refused: "last link refused: " + (why || "?"), stats, inkless };
    const minted = [];
    for (const f of lm.frames.values()) if (!had.has(f.id) || had.get(f.id) !== f.parent) minted.push({ id: f.id, parent: f.parent, depth: f.depth, i: f.cell.i, j: f.cell.j });
    return { steps, stats, minted };
}
const own = (l) => { const x = Loop.from(l); return { buf: x.buf.slice(), idx: x.idx.slice() }; };
const wrap = (x) => new Loop(x.buf, x.idx);
const objOut = (o, transfer) => {
    const out = { ...o };
    delete out._bbox; delete out._home; delete out._ver; delete out._zScan;
    if (o.loops) { out.loops = o.loops.map(own); for (const x of out.loops) transfer.push(x.buf.buffer, x.idx.buffer); }
    return out;
};
const objIn = (o) => (o.loops ? { ...o, loops: o.loops.map(wrap) } : o);
export function wireDescent(world, input) {
    const transfer = [];
    const msg = {
        lattice: world.lm.serialize(), retired: world.lm._retired ? [...world.lm._retired] : null,
        width: world.width, height: world.lm.height, cfg: world.cfg, opacityGroups: world.opacityGroups,
        freezeR: input.freezeR, HE: input.HE,
        target: { level: String(input.target.level), obj: objOut(input.target.obj, transfer) },
        E: { id: input.E.id, w: input.E.w, bakePx: input.E.bakePx, loops: input.E.loops.map(own) },
    };
    for (const x of msg.E.loops) transfer.push(x.buf.buffer, x.idx.buffer);
    return { msg, transfer };
}
export function unwireDescent(m) {
    const lm = new LevelMap(m.cfg, m.width, m.height);
    lm.load(m.lattice);
    if (m.retired && m.retired.length) lm._retired = new Set(m.retired);
    const world = { lm, cfg: m.cfg, width: m.width, opacityGroups: m.opacityGroups };
    const input = { freezeR: m.freezeR, HE: m.HE, target: { level: m.target.level, obj: objIn(m.target.obj) }, E: { id: m.E.id, w: m.E.w, bakePx: m.E.bakePx, loops: m.E.loops.map(wrap) } };
    return { world, input };
}
export function wireDescentResult(r) {
    if (!r.steps) return { msg: r, transfer: [] };
    const transfer = [];
    const spec = (s) => ({ vid: s.vid, level: s.level, obj: objOut(s.obj, transfer) });
    return { msg: { stats: r.stats, minted: r.minted, steps: r.steps.map((st) => ({ removedId: st.removedId, parents: st.parents.map(spec), kids: st.kids.map(spec) })) }, transfer };
}
export function unwireDescentResult(m) {
    if (!m.steps) return m;
    const spec = (s) => ({ vid: s.vid, level: s.level, obj: objIn(s.obj) });
    return { stats: m.stats, minted: m.minted, steps: m.steps.map((st) => ({ removedId: st.removedId, parents: st.parents.map(spec), kids: st.kids.map(spec) })) };
}
//// src/engine/eraseJob.js
import { shapeBoolean, shapeComponents, dropDust, loopsArea, loopsBBox } from "./geometry/arcShape";
import { Loop } from "./geometry/loop";
export const DUST_PX = 0.25;
export function dustBarFor(bakePx, f = 1) {
    return bakePx > 0 && f > 0 ? (DUST_PX / bakePx) * f : undefined;
}
export function cutJob(j) {
    const opts = { freezeR: j.freezeR };
    const eb = loopsBBox(j.clip);
    const rE = eb ? Math.max(eb.x1 - eb.x0, eb.y1 - eb.y0) / 2 : 0;
    const both = shapeBoolean(j.subject, j.clip, "both", opts);
    const res = both.difference;
    const stats = res.stats || null;
    const removed = Math.abs(loopsArea(both.intersection.loops));
    let graze = 1e-4 * rE * rE, grazed;
    if (j.graze === "cede") grazed = removed < graze;
    else { graze = Math.min(graze, 1e-6 * Math.max(loopsArea(j.subject), 0)); grazed = removed <= graze; }
    if (grazed) return { kind: "grazed", stats, removed, dust: 0 };
    const groups = shapeComponents(res.loops);
    const keep = dropDust(groups, j.w, j.dustBar);
    const dust = groups.length - keep.length;
    if (!keep.length) return { kind: "removed", stats, removed, dust };
    return { kind: "cut", regions: keep.map((g) => g.map((l) => Loop.from(l))), stats, removed, dust };
}
const own = (l) => { const x = Loop.from(l); return { buf: x.buf.slice(), idx: x.idx.slice() }; };
const wrap = (x) => new Loop(x.buf, x.idx);
export function wireJob(j) {
    const subject = j.subject.map(own), clip = j.clip.map(own);
    const transfer = [];
    for (const x of subject) transfer.push(x.buf.buffer, x.idx.buffer);
    for (const x of clip) transfer.push(x.buf.buffer, x.idx.buffer);
    return { msg: { subject, clip, w: j.w, dustBar: j.dustBar, freezeR: j.freezeR, graze: j.graze }, transfer };
}
export function unwireJob(m) {
    return { subject: m.subject.map(wrap), clip: m.clip.map(wrap), w: m.w, dustBar: m.dustBar, freezeR: m.freezeR, graze: m.graze };
}
export function wireResult(r) {
    if (r.kind !== "cut") return { msg: r, transfer: [] };
    const regions = r.regions.map((g) => g.map((l) => ({ buf: l.buf, idx: l.idx })));
    const transfer = [];
    for (const g of regions) for (const x of g) transfer.push(x.buf.buffer, x.idx.buffer);
    return { msg: { ...r, regions }, transfer };
}
export function unwireResult(m) {
    if (m.kind !== "cut") return m;
    return { ...m, regions: m.regions.map((g) => g.map(wrap)) };
}
//// src/engine/erasePipeline.js
import { perfNow } from "./now";
import { ArcBakeJob, bakeArcPerimeter } from "./geometry/arcPerimeter";
import {
    R as CROSS_RATIO,
    W as FRAME_W,
    REACH,
} from "./frameLattice";
import Document from "./Document";
import { Groups, arcsTouch, contactArcs } from "./geometry/connect";
import { bboxOf, freezeR } from "./geometry/derive";
import { encodeBelow } from "./geometry/offsets";
import {
    flattenShape,
    insideShape,
    loopsArea,
    loopsBBox,
    repairLoops,
} from "./geometry/arcShape";
import { polygonMissesRect } from "./geometry/lasso";
import { flattenLoops, strokeLoops } from "./geometry/curveOutline";
import { cutJob, dustBarFor } from "./eraseJob";
import { runCutAsync, runDescentAsync } from "./eraseWorkerClient";
import { descentJob } from "./eraseDescent";
import { rectSpan, rectTol } from "./rectMath";
const ERASE_FRAME_TOL = 1;
const ERASE_SLICE_MS = 8;
const ERASE_RENDER_MS = 100;
const CAM_IDLE_MS = 120;
const BAKE_STARVE_MS = 1500;
class ErasePipeline {
    eraseAt(sx, sy) {
        const id = this._hitTest(sx, sy);
        if (id == null) return false;
        if (!this._eraseWhole(id)) return false;
        this._render();
        return true;
    }
    _eraseWhole(id) {
        const family = this.doc.editGroup(id);
        if (!family.length) return false;
        if (family.length === 1 && family[0].obj.editId == null) {
            const rec = this.doc.removeById(id);
            if (!rec) return false;
            this.doc.pushUndo({ op: "erase", obj: rec.obj, level: rec.level, index: rec.index });
            return true;
        }
        const records = [];
        for (const member of family) {
            const rec = this.doc.removeById(member.obj.id);
            if (rec) records.push(rec);
        }
        if (!records.length) return false;
        this.doc.pushUndo({ op: "eraseMany", records });
        return true;
    }
    setEraserSize(px) { this._eraserPx = Math.min(200, Math.max(2, +px || 16)); }
    _zOf(o) { return o.z != null ? o.z : o.id; }
    _eraseStrokes() {
        const out = [];
        for (const k of this.doc.levels()) {
            for (const o of this.doc.list(k)) if (o.erase && o.type === "shape") out.push({ obj: o, level: k });
        }
        out.sort((a, b) => this._zOf(a.obj) - this._zOf(b.obj));
        return out;
    }
    flushBakes() {
        let guard = 0;
        for (;;) {
            this._ensureShapeBakes();
            if (!this._bakeJobs.length) break;
            while (this._stepShapeBakes(Infinity)) { if (guard++ > 100000) return; }
            if (guard++ > 100000) return;
        }
        if (this._renderPending) this._render();
    }
    _forceBake(o) {
        if (o.type !== "stroke") return;
        const tol = o._tol > 0 ? o._tol : (this.cfg.arcTolerancePx * 0.5) / this.cfg.enter;
        const res = bakeArcPerimeter(o.pts, o.lwFrame, { tol, centre: o._pen ? o._pen.arcs() : undefined });
        this._bakeQueued.delete(o.id);
        this._bakeJobs = this._bakeJobs.filter((j) => j.id !== o.id);
        this.doc.bakeShapeById(o.id, this._sealed(res, o.lwFrame), o.lwFrame);
    }
    _sealed(res, w) {
        const open = res && res.stats ? res.stats.openChains : 0;
        if (!open) return res.loops;
        this._bakeRepairs = (this._bakeRepairs || 0) + 1;
        const st = { open, loops: res.loops.length };
        const out = repairLoops(res.loops, w, st);
        this._lastBakeRepair = st;
        return out;
    }
    _doneSet(eid) {
        let s = this._bakeDone.get(eid);
        if (!s) { s = new Set(); this._bakeDone.set(eid, s); }
        return s;
    }
    _scheduleBake(delay = 400) {
        if (this._bakeTimer != null) {
            if (delay >= this._bakeDelay) return;
            clearTimeout(this._bakeTimer);
        }
        this._bakeDelay = delay;
        this._bakeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            this._bakeTimer = null; this._bakeDelay = Infinity; this._bakeTick();
        }, delay);
    }
    _queueBake(o) {
        if (this._bakeQueued.has(o.id)) return;
        const tol = o._tol > 0 ? o._tol : (this.cfg.arcTolerancePx * 0.5) / this.cfg.enter;
        const job = new ArcBakeJob(o.pts, o.lwFrame, {
            tol,
            centre: o._pen ? (o._pen.closeLoop(), o._pen.arcs()) : undefined,
        });
        this._bakeQueued.add(o.id);
        this._bakeJobs.push({ id: o.id, job, w: o.lwFrame });
    }
    _promoteOversize(id) {
        for (let guard = 0; guard < 8; guard++) {
            const rec = this.doc.getById(id);
            if (!rec) return false;
            const b = bboxOf(rec.obj, this.store.live);
            if (!b) return false;
            if (Math.max(b.x1 - b.x0, b.y1 - b.y0) <= FRAME_W) return guard > 0;
            const pid = this.lm.ensureParent(rec.level);
            const f = this.lm.frame(rec.level);
            if (pid == null || !f || !f.centre) return guard > 0;
            const g = Document.scaleGeometry(Document.snapGeometry(rec.obj), 1 / CROSS_RATIO, 0, 0);
            const moved = Document.translateGeometry(g, f.centre.x, f.centre.y);
            const lw = rec.obj.lwFrame, w = rec.obj.w;
            this.doc.rehomeById(id, pid);
            this.doc.setGeometryById(id, moved);
            const cur = this.doc.getById(id);
            if (cur) {
                if (lw != null) cur.obj.lwFrame = lw / CROSS_RATIO;
                if (w != null) cur.obj.w = w / CROSS_RATIO;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    _ensureShapeBakes() {
        for (const k of this.doc.levels()) {
            for (const o of this.doc.list(k)) {
                if (o.type !== "stroke" || o === this._drawing) continue;
                this._queueBake(o);
            }
        }
    }
    _stepShapeBakes(budgetMs = 8) {
        const t0 = perfNow();
        let changed = false, promoted = false, away = false;
        while (this._bakeJobs.length) {
            const left = budgetMs - (perfNow() - t0);
            if (left <= 0) break;
            const entry = this._bakeJobs[0];
            const rec = this.doc.getById(entry.id);
            if (!rec || rec.obj.type !== "stroke") {
                this._bakeJobs.shift(); this._bakeQueued.delete(entry.id); continue;
            }
            if (!entry.job.step(left)) break;
            this._bakeJobs.shift();
            this._bakeQueued.delete(entry.id);
            this.doc.bakeShapeById(entry.id, this._sealed(entry.job.result, entry.w), entry.w);
            if (this._promoteOversize(entry.id)) promoted = true;
            else if (this.raster && rec.level !== this.cam.frame) away = true;
            changed = true;
        }
        if (changed) {
            if (promoted || away) this._render();
            else {
                this._renderPending = true;
                if (this.raster) { this.renderer.syncCameraOnly(); this.renderer.update(); }
            }
        }
        return this._bakeJobs.length > 0;
    }
    _camBusy() {
        if (this._lastCamMove == null) return false;
        return perfNow() - this._lastCamMove < CAM_IDLE_MS;
    }
    _bakeTick() {
        const tB = perfNow();
        try { this._bakeTickInner(); } finally { this._perf("bake", tB, false, { jobs: this._bakeJobs.length }); }
    }
    _bakeTickInner() {
        if (this._drawing || this._erasing || this._dragSel || this._panLast) { this._bakeHeldSince = this._bakeHeldSince || perfNow(); this._scheduleBake(120); return; }
        if (this._camBusy()) {
            const held = this._bakeHeldSince || (this._bakeHeldSince = perfNow());
            if (perfNow() - held < BAKE_STARVE_MS) { this._scheduleBake(CAM_IDLE_MS); return; }
        }
        this._bakeHeldSince = null;
        if (!this._bakeJobs.length) this._ensureShapeBakes();
        if (this._stepShapeBakes()) { this._scheduleBake(0); return; }
        if (this.readOnly) { if (this._eraseStrokes().length) this._scheduleBake(500); return; }
        if (this._cutInflight) return;
        const t0 = perfNow();
        let changed = false, more = false, baked = 0, pending = false, spent = false;
        for (const Erec of this._eraseStrokes()) {
            let guard = 0;
            let target = this._nextEraseTarget(Erec);
            while (target && guard++ < 10000) {
                if (baked > 0 && (perfNow() - t0) + (this._eraseItemMs || 0) > ERASE_SLICE_MS) { more = true; break; }
                const it0 = perfNow();
                const outcome = this._bakeOne(Erec, target);
                if (outcome === "pending") { pending = true; break; }
                if (outcome) changed = true;
                this._eraseItemMs = perfNow() - it0;
                baked++;
                target = this._lowerMark(Erec, target);
                changed = true;
                if (perfNow() - t0 >= ERASE_SLICE_MS) { more = true; break; }
            }
            if (more || pending) break;
            this._noteSpent(Erec.obj);
            this.doc.removeById(Erec.obj.id);
            this._eraseCommits.delete(Erec.obj.id);
            this._bakeDone.delete(Erec.obj.id);
            changed = true; spent = true;
            if (perfNow() - t0 >= ERASE_SLICE_MS) { more = true; break; }
        }
        if (spent) this._render(); else if (changed) this._renderSoon();
        if (!pending && (more || this._eraseStrokes().length)) this._scheduleBake(0);
    }
    _candidatesUnder(Erec) {
        const E = Erec.obj, HE = Erec.level;
        const zE = this._zOf(E);
        let scan = E._zScan;
        if (scan && scan.rev === this.doc.rev) return scan;
        this._scanBuilds = (this._scanBuilds || 0) + 1;
        const done = this._doneSet(E.id);
        const list = [];
        const box = E.type === "shape" && E.loops ? loopsBBox(E.loops) : null;
        if (box) {
            const rectE = { left: box.x0, top: box.y0, right: box.x1, bottom: box.y1 };
            const seen = new Set();
            const consider = (o, k) => {
                if (o.erase || seen.has(o.id) || done.has(o.id)) return;
                if (this._zOf(o) >= zE) return;
                seen.add(o.id);
                list.push({ id: o.id, z: this._zOf(o), level: k });
            };
            for (const k of this.doc.levels()) {
                if (this.lm.frameFactor(k, HE) == null) continue;
                const r = this.lm.mapRectF(rectE, HE, k);
                if (r) for (const o of this.doc.queryRect(k, r)) consider(o, k);
            }
            const rectIn = new Map();
            for (const id of this.doc._offsetIds) {
                const rec = this.doc.getById(id);
                if (!rec || rec.obj.erase || done.has(id) || this._zOf(rec.obj) >= zE || this.lm.frameFactor(rec.level, HE) == null) continue;
                const key = rec.level + "|" + (encodeBelow(rec.obj.below) || []).join(";");
                let r = rectIn.get(key);
                if (r === undefined) { r = this._eraserRectInto(rectE, HE, rec.obj, rec.level); rectIn.set(key, r); }
                if (!r || !this._rectMayTouch(r, rec.obj)) { done.add(id); continue; }
                consider(rec.obj, rec.level);
            }
            list.sort((a, b) => (b.z - a.z) || (b.id - a.id));
        }
        scan = { rev: this.doc.rev, z: zE, list, pos: 0 };
        E._zScan = scan;
        return scan;
    }
    _eraseFramesPass(Erec) {
        const E = Erec.obj, HE = Erec.level;
        if (E._framesPassed || E.type !== "shape" || !E.loops) return 0;
        E._framesPassed = true;
        const zE = this._zOf(E);
        const box = loopsBBox(E.loops);
        if (!box) return 0;
        const tol = ERASE_FRAME_TOL;
        const polys = flattenShape(E.loops, tol);
        if (!polys.length) return 0;
        const inside = (rect) => insideShape(E.loops, [rect.left, rect.top]) && polys.every((p) => polygonMissesRect(p, rect));
        const covered = [];
        const visit = (id, s, tx, ty, skip) => {
            const own = { left: -REACH * s + tx - tol, top: -REACH * s + ty - tol, right: REACH * s + tx + tol, bottom: REACH * s + ty + tol };
            if (own.right < box.x0 || own.left > box.x1 || own.bottom < box.y0 || own.top > box.y1) return;
            if (id !== HE && inside(own) && this.doc.maxZUnder(id) < zE) { covered.push(id); return; }
            for (const c of this.lm.childrenOf(id)) {
                if (!c || c.id === skip || !c.centre) continue;
                visit(c.id, s / CROSS_RATIO, c.centre.x * s + tx, c.centre.y * s + ty, null);
            }
        };
        visit(HE, 1, 0, 0, null);
        let child = this.lm.frame(HE), s = 1, tx = 0, ty = 0;
        while (child && child.parent != null) {
            const c = child.centre;
            if (!c) break;
            s *= CROSS_RATIO; tx -= c.x * s; ty -= c.y * s;
            visit(child.parent, s, tx, ty, child.id);
            child = this.lm.frame(child.parent);
        }
        let n = 0;
        if (!covered.length) return 0;
        const op = this._eraseOp(E);
        const note = this.journal.find((j) => j.kind === "erase" && j.id === E.id);
        for (const F of covered) {
            const recs = this.doc.removeFrameSubtree(F);
            if (!recs) continue;
            this.doc.recordBake(op, { frames: recs });
            if (note) note.cuts.push({ frame: F, mode: "frame", natives: recs.reduce((a, r) => a + r.natives.length, 0) });
            n++;
        }
        return n;
    }
    _nextEraseTarget(Erec) {
        this._eraseFramesPass(Erec);
        const E = Erec.obj, HE = Erec.level;
        const done = this._doneSet(E.id);
        const scan = this._candidatesUnder(Erec);
        for (; scan.pos < scan.list.length; scan.pos++) {
            const c = scan.list[scan.pos];
            if (done.has(c.id)) continue;
            const rec = this.doc.getById(c.id);
            if (!rec || rec.obj.erase) continue;
            const o = rec.obj;
            if (this._zOf(o) >= this._zOf(E)) continue;
            if (this.lm.frameFactor(rec.level, HE) == null) { done.add(o.id); continue; }
            if (!this._eraseMayTouch(E, HE, o, rec.level)) { done.add(o.id); continue; }
            return { obj: o, level: rec.level };
        }
        return null;
    }
    _lowerMark(Erec, target) {
        const E = Erec.obj, zo = this._zOf(target.obj);
        const next = this._nextEraseTarget(Erec);
        if (next && this._zOf(next.obj) >= zo) return next;
        if (zo - 0.5 < this._zOf(E)) this._neutral(() => this._ownChange(E, () => this.doc.setZById(E.id, zo - 0.5)));
        return next;
    }
    _ownChange(E, fn) {
        const scan = E._zScan, rev = this.doc.rev;
        const out = fn();
        if (scan && scan.rev === rev && E._zScan === scan) scan.rev = this.doc.rev;
        return out;
    }
    _neutral(fn) {
        const was = this._pictureNeutral;
        this._pictureNeutral = true;
        try { return fn(); } finally { this._pictureNeutral = was; }
    }
    _neutralUnder(E, o, fn) { return this._zOf(E) > this._zOf(o) ? this._neutral(fn) : fn(); }
    _uncutOf(markId) {
        const m = this._uncut || (this._uncut = new Map());
        let s = m.get(markId);
        if (!s) m.set(markId, (s = new Set()));
        return s;
    }
    _eraseMayTouch(E, HE, o, HO) {
        if (E.type !== "shape" || !E.loops) return false;
        if (E._eraseBox == null || E._eraseBoxVer !== (E._ver || 0)) {
            E._eraseBox = loopsBBox(E.loops);
            E._eraseBoxVer = E._ver || 0;
        }
        if (!E._eraseBox) return false;
        const eb = E._eraseBox;
        const r = this._eraserRectInto({ left: eb.x0, top: eb.y0, right: eb.x1, bottom: eb.y1 }, HE, o, HO);
        return !!r && this._rectMayTouch(r, o);
    }
    _rectMayTouch(r, o) {
        const m = o.type === "stroke" ? (o.lwFrame || 0) / 2 : 0;
        const hits = (a) => r.right >= a.x0 - m && r.left <= a.x1 + m && r.bottom >= a.y0 - m && r.top <= a.y1 + m;
        if (!hits(bboxOf(o, this.store.live))) return false;
        if (o.type !== "shape") return true;
        for (const loop of o.loops) {
            const lb = loopsBBox([loop]);
            if (lb && hits(lb)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    _eraserRectInto(rect, HE, o, HO) {
        if (!o.below) return this.lm.mapRectF(rect, HE, HO);
        return this.lm.mapRectObj(rect, HE, HO, o.below, HO, true);
    }
    _eraserLoopsInto(loops, HE, o, HO) {
        return this.lm.projectLoopsObj(loops, HE, HO, o.below, HO, true);
    }
    _eraseOp(E) {
        let op = this._eraseCommits.get(E.id);
        if (!op || op.op !== "eraseCommit") {
            const u = this.doc._undo;
            op = null;
            for (let i = u.length - 1; i >= 0 && !op; i--) if (u[i].op === "eraseCommit" && u[i].strokeId === E.id) op = u[i];
            if (!op) {
                op = { op: "eraseCommit", strokeId: E.id, strokeRec: null, baked: [] };
                this.doc.pushUndo(op);
            }
            this._eraseCommits.set(E.id, op);
        }
        return op;
    }
    _bakeOne(Erec, target, { sync = false } = {}) {
        const E = Erec.obj, HE = Erec.level;
        const { obj: o, level: HO } = target;
        if (!this.doc.getById(o.id)) return false;
        this._uncutOf(E.id).add(o.id);
        if (E.type === "stroke") this._forceBake(E);
        if (E.type !== "shape") return false;
        if (o.type === "stroke") this._forceBake(o);
        if (o.type === "fill") this.doc.fillToShapeById(o.id);
        const done = this._doneSet(E.id);
        done.add(o.id);
        if (o.type !== "shape") return this._rehomeBail(E, o, HO, "target is a " + o.type + " with no perimeter");
        const op = this._eraseOp(E);
        const note = this.journal.find((j) => j.kind === "erase" && j.id === E.id);
        const areaBefore = o.loops ? loopsArea(o.loops) : 0;
        const desc = this.lm.framePath(HO, HE);
        const pureDescent = !!desc && !desc.up.length && desc.down.length > 0;
        const dHO = this.lm.depthOf(HO);
        const ringA = desc && desc.up.length ? desc.down.find((f) => this.lm.depthOf(f) === dHO) : null;
        const ring = !!ringA && !!this._cellOffset(HO, ringA) && desc.down.some((f) => this.lm.depthOf(f) > dHO);
        if (this.lm.depthOf(HO) < this.lm.depthOf(HE) && (pureDescent || ring)) {
            return this._bakeRehome(op, Erec, target, done, sync);
        }
        const EpLoops = this._eraserLoopsInto(E.loops, HE, o, HO);
        const Ep = EpLoops ? { loops: EpLoops } : null;
        if (!Ep || !Ep.loops || !Ep.loops.length) return false;
        const job = { subject: o.loops, clip: Ep.loops, w: o.w, dustBar: dustBarFor(E.bakePx, this.lm.frameFactor(HE, HO)), freezeR: this._boolOpts().freezeR, graze: "cut" };
        if (!sync && !this._cutInflight) {
            const p = runCutAsync(job);
            if (p) {
                const inflight = { id: o.id, ver: o._ver || 0, Erec, target, job, ctx: { op, note, areaBefore, done }, t0: perfNow() };
                this._cutInflight = inflight;
                p.then((r) => this._onCutResult(inflight, r, null), (err) => this._onCutResult(inflight, null, err));
                return "pending";
            }
        }
        const r = cutJob(job);
        return this._ownChange(E, () => this._applyCut(Erec, target, r, { op, note, areaBefore, done }));
    }
    _onCutResult(inflight, r, err) {
        if (this._cutInflight !== inflight) return;
        if (this._destroyed) return;
        this._cutInflight = null;
        const { Erec, target, ctx, job } = inflight;
        const cur = this.doc.getById(inflight.id);
        const markAlive = !!this.doc.getById(Erec.obj.id);
        const same = !!cur && cur.obj === target.obj;
        const changedMeanwhile = same && (cur.obj._ver || 0) !== inflight.ver;
        if (!markAlive || !same || changedMeanwhile) {
            if (changedMeanwhile || !markAlive) ctx.done.delete(inflight.id);
            this._cutStale = (this._cutStale || 0) + 1;
            this._scheduleBake(0);
            return;
        }
        const descent = inflight.kind === "descent";
        if (err || !r) { this._cutFailures = (this._cutFailures || 0) + 1; r = descent ? descentJob(inflight.world, inflight.input) : cutJob(job); }
        const tA = perfNow();
        try { this._ownChange(Erec.obj, () => (descent ? this._applyDescent(Erec, target, r, ctx) : this._applyCut(Erec, target, r, ctx))); }
        finally { this._perf(descent ? "descentApply" : "cutApply", tA, true, { kind: descent ? (r.refused ? "refused" : "steps:" + r.steps.length) : r.kind, workerMs: Math.round(tA - inflight.t0) }); }
        this._lowerMark(Erec, target);
        this._renderSoon();
        this._scheduleBake(0);
    }
    _renderSoon() {
        if (this._renderSoonTimer != null) return;
        this._renderSoonTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            this._renderSoonTimer = null;
            if (this._destroyed) return;
            if (this.raster && this._plateEvents.every((ev) => ev.neutral)) { this._renderPending = true; this._eraseListStale = true; return; }
            this._render();
        }, ERASE_RENDER_MS);
    }
    _settleInflight() {
        const f = this._cutInflight;
        if (!f) return false;
        this._onCutResult(f, f.kind === "descent" ? descentJob(f.world, f.input) : cutJob(f.job), null);
        return true;
    }
    _applyCut(Erec, target, r, { op, note, areaBefore, done }) {
        const E = Erec.obj;
        const { obj: o, level: HO } = target;
        if (!this.doc.getById(E.id) || !this.doc.getById(o.id)) return false;
        this._noteSeal({ stats: r.stats }, o);
        this._dustCulled = (this._dustCulled || 0) + (r.dust || 0);
        if (r.kind === "grazed") { this._uncutOf(E.id).delete(o.id); return false; }
        let bakedStep;
        if (r.kind === "cut") {
            const regions = r.regions;
            const wasKey = this.doc.editKey(o);
            const inFamily = o.editId != null;
            const cut = this._neutralUnder(E, o, () => this.doc.eraseReplaceById(o.id, regions));
            if (!cut) return false;
            this._uncutOf(E.id).delete(o.id);
            if (note) {
                note.cuts.push({ target: o.id, level: HO, mode: "cut",
                    areaBefore: +areaBefore.toFixed(2),
                    into: cut.pieces.map((x) => ({ id: x.id, area: +loopsArea(x.loops).toFixed(2) })),
                    sealed: (r.stats && r.stats.sealed) || 0 });
            }
            bakedStep = { removed: cut.removed, pieces: cut.pieces.map((obj) => ({ obj, level: cut.removed.level })) };
            for (const pc of bakedStep.pieces) done.add(pc.obj.id);
            if (regions.length > 1 && inFamily) { this.doc.recordBake(op, bakedStep); this._resplitFamily(op, wasKey); return true; }
        } else {
            const rec = this._neutralUnder(E, o, () => this.doc.removeById(o.id));
            if (!rec) return false;
            this._uncutOf(E.id).delete(o.id);
            if (note) note.cuts.push({ target: o.id, level: HO, mode: "removed", areaBefore: +areaBefore.toFixed(2) });
            bakedStep = { removed: rec, pieces: [] };
        }
        this.doc.recordBake(op, bakedStep);
        return true;
    }
    _noteSeal(res, subject) {
        const open = res && res.stats ? res.stats.openChains : 0;
        if (!open) return;
        this._boolFailures = (this._boolFailures || 0) + 1;
        this._lastBoolFailure = { id: subject && subject.id, open, area: res.stats.sealedArea,
            weld: res.stats.weld, retriedAt: res.stats.retriedAt || 0 };
    }
    _inkOutline(o, tol) {
        if (o.type === "shape") return flattenShape(o.loops, tol);
        if (o.type === "fill") return o.polys;
        return flattenLoops(strokeLoops(o, this.cfg, { curved: o.origin === "native", live: this.store.live }), tol);
    }
    _familyMembers(key) {
        const out = [];
        for (const L of this.doc.levels()) {
            for (const o of this.doc.list(L)) {
                if (!o.erase && this.doc.editKey(o) === key) out.push({ obj: o, level: L });
            }
        }
        return out;
    }
    _familyComponents(key) {
        const members = this._familyMembers(key);
        const G = new Groups(members.length);
        for (let i = 0; i < members.length; i++) {
            const kid = members[i], R = kid.obj.attachRect;
            if (!R) continue;
            const kidDepth = this.lm.depthOf(kid.level);
            if (kidDepth == null) continue;
            const kidArcs = contactArcs(this._inkOutline(kid.obj, rectTol(R)), R, rectTol(R));
            if (!kidArcs.length) continue;
            for (let j = 0; j < members.length; j++) {
                const up = members[j];
                if (j === i) continue;
                if (up.obj.type !== "shape" && up.obj.type !== "fill") continue;
                const upDepth = this.lm.depthOf(up.level);
                if (upDepth === kidDepth) {
                    if (!up.obj.attachRect) continue;
                    const d = this._cellOffset(kid.level, up.level);
                    if (!d) continue;
                    const r = up.obj.attachRect, Rj = { x0: r.x0 + d[0], y0: r.y0 + d[1], x1: r.x1 + d[0], y1: r.y1 + d[1] };
                    if (Rj.x1 < R.x0 - rectTol(R) || Rj.x0 > R.x1 + rectTol(R) || Rj.y1 < R.y0 - rectTol(R) || Rj.y0 > R.y1 + rectTol(R)) continue;
                    let rings = this._inkOutline(up.obj, rectTol(R));
                    if (d[0] || d[1]) rings = rings.map((ring) => ring.map((p) => [p[0] + d[0], p[1] + d[1]]));
                    if (arcsTouch(kidArcs, contactArcs(rings, R, rectTol(R)), rectTol(R) / rectSpan(R))) G.union(i, j);
                    continue;
                }
                if (upDepth !== kidDepth - 1) continue;
                const Rk = { left: R.x0, top: R.y0, right: R.x1, bottom: R.y1 };
                const upF0 = up.obj.below ? this.lm.objShift(up.obj.below, up.level, kid.level) : null;
                const Rp = upF0 ? this.lm.mapRectF(Rk, upF0.F0, up.level) : this.lm.mapRectF(Rk, kid.level, up.level);
                if (!Rp) continue;
                const at = Math.max(rectTol(R) / rectSpan(R), rectTol(Rp) / rectSpan(Rp));
                if (arcsTouch(kidArcs, contactArcs(this._inkOutline(up.obj, rectTol(Rp)), Rp, rectTol(Rp)), at)) G.union(i, j);
            }
        }
        const ids = members.map((_, i) => i);
        const unresolved = ids.filter((i) => this.lm.depthOf(members[i].level) == null);
        return { members, classes: G.classes(ids), unresolved };
    }
    _cellOffset(A, B) {
        if (String(A) === String(B)) return [0, 0];
        for (let di = -1; di <= 1; di++) {
            for (let dj = -1; dj <= 1; dj++) {
                const n = (di || dj) ? this.lm.peekNeighbour(A, di, dj) : null;
                if (n && String(n.id) === String(B)) return [di * FRAME_W, dj * FRAME_W];
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    _resplitFamily(op, key) {
        const comp = this._familyComponents(key);
        const { members, unresolved } = comp;
        let classes = comp.classes;
        if (unresolved.length && classes.length > 1) {
            const lost = new Set(unresolved);
            const keep = (c) => c.some((i) => lost.has(i)) || c.every((i) => members[i].obj.attachRect);
            classes = [classes[0].concat(...classes.slice(1).filter(keep))].concat(classes.slice(1).filter((c) => !keep(c)));
        }
        const note = this.journal[this.journal.length - 1];
        if (note && note.kind === "erase") {
            note.split = { key, components: classes.map((c) => c.map((i) => `${members[i].level}#${members[i].obj.id}`)) };
        }
        if (classes.length < 2) return false;
        const rekeys = [];
        classes.forEach((cls, n) => {
            const k = n === 0 ? key : this.doc.allocId();
            for (const i of cls) {
                const o = members[i].obj;
                if (this.doc.editKey(o) === k) continue;
                rekeys.push({ id: o.id, before: { editId: o.editId }, after: { editId: k } });
                o.editId = k;
            }
        });
        if (rekeys.length) { this.doc.keysChanged(); this.doc.recordBake(op, { rekey: rekeys }); }
        return true;
    }
    _bakeRehome(op, Erec, target, done, sync) {
        const tRH = perfNow();
        try { return this._bakeRehomeInner(op, Erec, target, done, sync); }
        finally { this._perf("rehome", tRH, false, { id: target && target.obj && target.obj.id }); }
    }
    _descentWorld() { return { lm: this.lm, cfg: this.cfg, width: this.lm.width, opacityGroups: this.store.opacityGroups }; }
    _bakeRehomeInner(op, Erec, target, done, sync) {
        const E = Erec.obj, HE = Erec.level;
        const { obj: o, level: HO } = target;
        if (o.type === "stroke") { this._forceBake(o); done.add(o.id); }
        if (o.type === "fill") this.doc.fillToShapeById(o.id);
        if (o.type !== "shape") return this._rehomeBail(E, o, HO, "target is a " + o.type);
        const input = { freezeR: this._boolOpts().freezeR, HE, target: { obj: o, level: HO }, E: { id: E.id, w: E.w, bakePx: E.bakePx, loops: E.loops } };
        const world = this._descentWorld();
        if (!sync && !this._cutInflight) {
            const p = runDescentAsync(world, input);
            if (p) {
                const inflight = { kind: "descent", id: o.id, ver: o._ver || 0, Erec, target, world, input, ctx: { op, done }, t0: perfNow() };
                this._cutInflight = inflight;
                p.then((r) => this._onCutResult(inflight, r, null), (err) => this._onCutResult(inflight, null, err));
                return "pending";
            }
        }
        return this._ownChange(Erec.obj, () => this._applyDescent(Erec, target, descentJob(world, input), { op, done }));
    }
    _applyDescent(Erec, target, r, { op, done }) {
        const E = Erec.obj;
        const { obj: o, level: HO } = target;
        for (const sl of r.stats.seals) { this._boolFailures = (this._boolFailures || 0) + 1; this._lastBoolFailure = { ...sl }; }
        this._dustCulled = (this._dustCulled || 0) + (r.stats.dust || 0);
        if (r.refused) {
            if (r.inkless) this._uncutOf(E.id).delete(o.id);
            return this._rehomeBail(E, o, HO, r.refused);
        }
        const cur = this.doc.getById(o.id);
        if (!cur || cur.obj !== o || !this.doc.getById(E.id)) return false;
        if (r.minted && r.minted.length) this.lm.merge({ frames: r.minted });
        for (const st of r.steps) for (const sp of st.parents.concat(st.kids)) if (!this.lm.frame(sp.level)) return this._rehomeBail(E, o, HO, "a piece's frame is missing");
        const idMap = new Map();
        const real = (vid) => (vid < 0 ? idMap.get(vid) : vid);
        const steps = [];
        const apply = () => {
            for (const st of r.steps) {
                const removed = this.doc.removeById(real(st.removedId));
                if (!removed) return false;
                const mint = (sp) => { const obj = { ...sp.obj, id: this.doc.allocId() }; this.doc.add(obj, sp.level); idMap.set(sp.vid, obj.id); return { obj, level: String(sp.level) }; };
                const pieces = st.parents.map(mint).concat(st.kids.map(mint));
                for (const pc of pieces) done.add(pc.obj.id);
                steps.push({ removed, pieces });
            }
            return true;
        };
        if (!this._neutralUnder(E, o, apply)) return false;
        for (const st of steps) this.doc.recordBake(op, st);
        this._uncutOf(E.id).delete(o.id);
        const note = this.journal.find((j) => j.kind === "erase" && j.id === E.id);
        if (note) {
            note.cuts.push({ target: o.id, level: HO, mode: "cede",
                through: steps.map((st) => st.pieces.map((pc) => `${pc.level}#${pc.obj.id}`)) });
        }
        this._resplitFamily(op, this.doc.editKey(o));
        return true;
    }
    _boolOpts() { return { freezeR: freezeR(this.cfg) }; }
    _rehomeBail(E, o, HO, why) {
        const note = this.journal.find((j) => j.kind === "erase" && j.id === E.id);
        if (note) {
            note.refused = note.refused || [];
            if (note.refused.length < 12) note.refused.push({ target: o.id, level: HO, why });
        }
        this._rehomeWhy = null;
        return false;
    }
    _noteSpent(E) {
        const note = this.journal.find((j) => j.kind === "erase" && j.id === E.id);
        if (!note || (note.cuts && note.cuts.length)) return;
        const done = this._bakeDone.get(E.id);
        note.spent = {
            considered: done ? [...done].slice(0, 24) : [],
            nConsidered: done ? done.size : 0,
            refused: (note.refused || []).length,
            pending: this._eraseStrokes().length,
        };
    }
    _flushErasesFor(id, marks = null) {
        if (!marks) this.flushBakes();
        const rec = this.doc.getById(id);
        if (!rec || rec.obj.erase) return false;
        for (const Erec of marks || this._eraseStrokes()) {
            const E = Erec.obj;
            if (marks && !this.doc.getById(E.id)) continue;
            if (this._zOf(E) <= this._zOf(rec.obj)) continue;
            const inflight = this._cutInflight && this._cutInflight.id === id && this._cutInflight.Erec.obj === E;
            if (!inflight && this._doneSet(E.id).has(id)) continue;
            if (!this._eraseMayTouch(E, Erec.level, rec.obj, rec.level)) { this._doneSet(E.id).add(id); continue; }
            if (this._cutInflight && this._cutInflight.Erec.obj === E && !inflight) {
                this._settleInflight();
                const cur = this.doc.getById(id);
                if (!cur || cur.obj !== rec.obj) return true;
            }
            const next = this._nextEraseTarget(Erec);
            const inOrder = !next || next.obj === rec.obj || this._zOf(next.obj) <= this._zOf(rec.obj);
            const target = { obj: rec.obj, level: rec.level };
            const changed = this._bakeOne(Erec, target, { sync: true });
            if (inOrder) this._lowerMark(Erec, target);
            if (changed) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    _settleSelectionErases() {
        this.flushBakes();
        let marks = this._eraseStrokes();
        if (!marks.length) return false;
        const frames = this.selection ? this.selection.frames || [] : [];
        if (frames.length) { this.flushErases(); marks = this._eraseStrokes(); }
        const live = new Set(this._selectionMembers().map((m) => m.obj.id));
        const added = [], removed = [];
        const unsub = this.doc.subscribe((ev) => {
            if (ev.kind === "add" && ev.obj && !ev.obj.erase) added.push(ev.id);
            else if (ev.kind === "remove" && !ev.rehome) removed.push(ev.id);
        });
        let replaced = false, changed = false;
        try {
            for (let guard = 0; guard < 200 && marks.length; guard++) {
                added.length = 0; removed.length = 0;
                let baked = false;
                for (const id of [...live]) {
                    if (this.doc.getById(id) && this._flushErasesFor(id, marks)) { baked = true; break; }
                }
                if (!baked) break;
                for (const id of added) live.add(id);
                for (const id of removed) live.delete(id);
                replaced = true; changed = true;
                marks = this._eraseStrokes();
            }
        } finally { unsub(); }
        for (const Erec of this._eraseStrokes()) {
            if (this._nextEraseTarget(Erec) || (this._cutInflight && this._cutInflight.Erec.obj === Erec.obj)) continue;
            this._noteSpent(Erec.obj);
            this.doc.removeById(Erec.obj.id);
            this._eraseCommits.delete(Erec.obj.id);
            this._bakeDone.delete(Erec.obj.id);
            changed = true;
        }
        if (replaced) {
            const ids = [...live].filter((id) => this.doc.getById(id));
            if (ids.length || frames.length) this._setSelection(ids, frames); else this.deselect();
        }
        if (changed) this._render();
        return changed;
    }
    _settleLassoErases(poly) {
        let any = false, raw = false;
        for (const k of this.doc.levels()) for (const o of this.doc.list(k)) if (o.erase) { any = true; if (o.type !== "shape") raw = true; }
        if (!any || !poly.length) return false;
        if (raw) this.flushBakes();
        const marks = this._eraseStrokes();
        let x0 = Infinity, y0 = Infinity, x1 = -Infinity, y1 = -Infinity;
        for (const [x, y] of poly) { if (x < x0) x0 = x; if (x > x1) x1 = x; if (y < y0) y0 = y; if (y > y1) y1 = y; }
        const ids = new Set();
        for (const Erec of marks) {
            const b = Erec.obj.loops ? loopsBBox(Erec.obj.loops) : null;
            const r = b ? this.lm.mapRectF({ left: b.x0, top: b.y0, right: b.x1, bottom: b.y1 }, Erec.level, this.cam.frame) : null;
            if (r && r.right >= x0 && r.left <= x1 && r.bottom >= y0 && r.top <= y1) ids.add(Erec.obj.id);
        }
        if (!ids.size) return false;
        this.flushErases(ids);
        return true;
    }
    flushErases(only = null) {
        this.flushBakes();
        const f = this._cutInflight;
        if (f && (!only || only.has(f.Erec.obj.id))) this._settleInflight();
        let guard = 0;
        while (guard++ < 10000) {
