    const segmentCrosses = (p, q) => {
        if (Math.max(p[0], q[0]) < l || Math.min(p[0], q[0]) > r ||
            Math.max(p[1], q[1]) < t || Math.min(p[1], q[1]) > b) return false;
        tick++;
        const x0 = cx(Math.min(p[0], q[0])), x1 = cx(Math.max(p[0], q[0]));
        const y0 = cy(Math.min(p[1], q[1])), y1 = cy(Math.max(p[1], q[1]));
        for (let y = y0; y <= y1; y++) for (let x = x0; x <= x1; x++) {
            const list = cells[y * G + x];
            if (!list) continue;
            for (const i of list) {
                if (stamp[i] === tick) continue;
                stamp[i] = tick;
                if (segsCross(poly[i], poly[(i + 1) % n], p, q)) return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    };
    return {
        inside: insideRow,
        ringInside: (ring) => {
            const m = ring ? ring.length : 0;
            if (m < 1) return false;
            if (!insideRow(ring[0])) return false;
            for (let k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                if (segmentCrosses(ring[k], ring[(k + 1) % m])) return false;
            }
            return true;
        },
    };
}
export function rectInsidePolygon(poly, rect) {
    if (!poly || poly.length < 3) return false;
    if (!(rect.right >= rect.left && rect.bottom >= rect.top)) return false;
    if (!pointInPolygon(poly, [rect.left, rect.top])) return false;
    return polygonMissesRect(poly, rect);
}
export function polygonMissesRect(poly, rect) {
    const corners = [
        [rect.left, rect.top], [rect.right, rect.top],
        [rect.right, rect.bottom], [rect.left, rect.bottom],
    ];
    for (let i = 0; i < poly.length; i++) {
        const a = poly[i], b = poly[(i + 1) % poly.length];
        if (Math.max(a[0], b[0]) < rect.left || Math.min(a[0], b[0]) > rect.right ||
            Math.max(a[1], b[1]) < rect.top || Math.min(a[1], b[1]) > rect.bottom) continue;
        for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            if (segsCross(a, b, corners[k], corners[(k + 1) % 4])) return false;
        }
        if (a[0] >= rect.left && a[0] <= rect.right && a[1] >= rect.top && a[1] <= rect.bottom) return false;
    }
    return true;
}
//// src/engine/geometry/loop.js
const WIDTH = { 0: 3, 1: 8, 2: 9, 3: 16 };
const widthOf = (code) => WIDTH[code] || 8;
export function indexLoop(buf) {
    const n = buf.length;
    if (n < 5) return new Uint32Array(0);
    let count = 0;
    for (let i = 2; i < n; i += widthOf(buf[i])) count++;
    const idx = new Uint32Array(count);
    let k = 0;
    for (let i = 2; i < n; i += widthOf(buf[i])) idx[k++] = i;
    return idx;
}
export function decodePiece(a, o, A) {
    const code = a[o];
    if (code === 0) return { line: true, A, B: [a[o + 1], a[o + 2]] };
    if (code === 2) return { line: true, A, B: [a[o + 7], a[o + 8]], P: [a[o + 1], a[o + 2]], Q: [a[o + 3], a[o + 4]], sa: a[o + 5], sb: a[o + 6] };
    if (code === 3) {
        return { line: false, C: [a[o + 1], a[o + 2]], r: a[o + 3], a0: a[o + 4], sweep: a[o + 5], A, B: [a[o + 14], a[o + 15]],
            K: { a0: a[o + 6], sweep: a[o + 7], A: [a[o + 8], a[o + 9]], B: [a[o + 10], a[o + 11]] }, ua: a[o + 12], ub: a[o + 13] };
    }
    return { line: false, C: [a[o + 1], a[o + 2]], r: a[o + 3], a0: a[o + 4], sweep: a[o + 5], A, B: [a[o + 6], a[o + 7]] };
}
export function encodeLoopInto(loop, out) {
    if (loop instanceof Loop) { const b = loop.buf; for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i++) out.push(b[i]); return out; }
    out.push(loop[0].A[0], loop[0].A[1]);
    for (const p of loop) {
        if (p.line && p.P) out.push(2, p.P[0], p.P[1], p.Q[0], p.Q[1], p.sa, p.sb, p.B[0], p.B[1]);
        else if (p.line || !isFinite(p.r)) out.push(0, p.B[0], p.B[1]);
        else if (p.K) out.push(3, p.C[0], p.C[1], p.r, p.a0, p.sweep, p.K.a0, p.K.sweep, p.K.A[0], p.K.A[1], p.K.B[0], p.K.B[1], p.ua, p.ub, p.B[0], p.B[1]);
        else out.push(1, p.C[0], p.C[1], p.r, p.a0, p.sweep, p.B[0], p.B[1]);
    }
    return out;
}
export function shiftLoopNumbers(a, dx, dy) {
    a[0] += dx; a[1] += dy;
    for (let o = 2; o < a.length; o += widthOf(a[o])) {
        const code = a[o];
        if (code === 0) { a[o + 1] += dx; a[o + 2] += dy; }
        else if (code === 2) { a[o + 1] += dx; a[o + 2] += dy; a[o + 3] += dx; a[o + 4] += dy; a[o + 7] += dx; a[o + 8] += dy; }
        else if (code === 3) { a[o + 1] += dx; a[o + 2] += dy; a[o + 8] += dx; a[o + 9] += dy; a[o + 10] += dx; a[o + 11] += dy; a[o + 14] += dx; a[o + 15] += dy; }
        else { a[o + 1] += dx; a[o + 2] += dy; a[o + 6] += dx; a[o + 7] += dy; }
    }
    return a;
}
export class Loop {
    constructor(buf, idx) { this.buf = buf; this.idx = idx || indexLoop(buf); }
    static is(x) { return x instanceof Loop; }
    static wrap(enc) { return new Loop(enc instanceof Float64Array ? enc : Float64Array.from(enc)); }
    static from(pieces) {
        if (pieces instanceof Loop) return pieces;
        const n = pieces.length;
        if (!n) return new Loop(new Float64Array(0), new Uint32Array(0));
        let len = 2;
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const p = pieces[i]; len += p.line ? (p.P ? 9 : 3) : !isFinite(p.r) ? 3 : p.K ? 16 : 8; }
        const buf = new Float64Array(len), idx = new Uint32Array(n);
        buf[0] = pieces[0].A[0]; buf[1] = pieces[0].A[1];
        let o = 2;
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const p = pieces[i];
            idx[i] = o;
            if (p.line && p.P) { buf[o] = 2; buf[o + 1] = p.P[0]; buf[o + 2] = p.P[1]; buf[o + 3] = p.Q[0]; buf[o + 4] = p.Q[1]; buf[o + 5] = p.sa; buf[o + 6] = p.sb; buf[o + 7] = p.B[0]; buf[o + 8] = p.B[1]; o += 9; }
            else if (p.line || !isFinite(p.r)) { buf[o] = 0; buf[o + 1] = p.B[0]; buf[o + 2] = p.B[1]; o += 3; }
            else if (p.K) {
                buf[o] = 3; buf[o + 1] = p.C[0]; buf[o + 2] = p.C[1]; buf[o + 3] = p.r; buf[o + 4] = p.a0; buf[o + 5] = p.sweep;
                buf[o + 6] = p.K.a0; buf[o + 7] = p.K.sweep; buf[o + 8] = p.K.A[0]; buf[o + 9] = p.K.A[1]; buf[o + 10] = p.K.B[0]; buf[o + 11] = p.K.B[1];
                buf[o + 12] = p.ua; buf[o + 13] = p.ub; buf[o + 14] = p.B[0]; buf[o + 15] = p.B[1]; o += 16;
            } else { buf[o] = 1; buf[o + 1] = p.C[0]; buf[o + 2] = p.C[1]; buf[o + 3] = p.r; buf[o + 4] = p.a0; buf[o + 5] = p.sweep; buf[o + 6] = p.B[0]; buf[o + 7] = p.B[1]; o += 8; }
        }
        return new Loop(buf, idx);
    }
    get length() { return this.idx.length; }
    at(i) {
        const n = this.idx.length;
        if (i < 0) i += n;
        if (!(i >= 0 && i < n)) return undefined;
        const o = this.idx[i], b = this.buf;
        return decodePiece(b, o, i === 0 ? [b[0], b[1]] : [b[o - 2], b[o - 1]]);
    }
    *[Symbol.iterator]() {
        const b = this.buf, idx = this.idx;
        let A = [b[0], b[1]];
        for (let i = 0; i < idx.length; i++) { const p = decodePiece(b, idx[i], A); A = p.B; yield p; }
    }
    toPieces() { return [...this]; }
    map(fn) { const out = new Array(this.idx.length); let i = 0; for (const p of this) { out[i] = fn(p, i, this); i++; } return out; }
    forEach(fn) { let i = 0; for (const p of this) fn(p, i++, this); }
    some(fn) { let i = 0; for (const p of this) if (fn(p, i++, this)) return true; return false; }
    every(fn) { let i = 0; for (const p of this) if (!fn(p, i++, this)) return false; return true; }
    filter(fn) { const out = []; let i = 0; for (const p of this) if (fn(p, i++, this)) out.push(p); return out; }
    reduce(fn, init) { let acc = init, i = 0; for (const p of this) acc = fn(acc, p, i++, this); return acc; }
    slice(a = 0, b = this.idx.length) { return this.toPieces().slice(a, b); }
    translate(dx, dy) { return new Loop(shiftLoopNumbers(this.buf.slice(), dx, dy), this.idx); }
    get byteLength() { return this.buf.byteLength + this.idx.byteLength; }
}
//// src/engine/geometry/offsets.js
import { W, G, R, HALF_W } from "../frameLattice";
import { displacementDigits } from "../frameLattice";
export function snapDisplacement(v) { return Math.round(v * 1024) / 1024; }
export function offsetAt(below, k) {
    if (!below || !(k >= 0)) return null;
    const e = below[k];
    return e && (e[0] !== 0 || e[1] !== 0) ? e : null;
}
export function hasOffsets(below) {
    if (!below) return false;
    for (let k = 0; k < below.length; k++) if (offsetAt(below, k)) return true;
    return false;
}
export function cloneBelow(below) {
    if (!hasOffsets(below)) return undefined;
    const out = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < below.length; k++) { const e = offsetAt(below, k); if (e) out[k] = [e[0], e[1]]; }
    return out;
}
function tidy(out) {
    let any = false;
    for (let k = 0; k < out.length; k++) {
        const e = out[k];
        if (!e) continue;
        if (e[0] === 0 && e[1] === 0) delete out[k]; else any = true;
    }
    return any ? out : undefined;
}
const carryOf = (v) => Math.floor((v + HALF_W) / W);
export function addOffset(below, k, dx, dy) {
    const out = cloneBelow(below) || [];
    if (!(k >= 0)) return { below: tidy(out), cellX: 0, cellY: 0 };
    const e = out[k] || (out[k] = [0, 0]);
    e[0] += dx; e[1] += dy;
    let cellX = 0, cellY = 0;
    for (let m = k; m >= 0; m--) {
        const q = out[m];
        if (!q) break;
        const nx = carryOf(q[0]), ny = carryOf(q[1]);
        if (!nx && !ny) break;
        q[0] -= nx * W; q[1] -= ny * W;
        if (m > 0) {
            const p = out[m - 1] || (out[m - 1] = [0, 0]);
            p[0] += nx * G; p[1] += ny * G;
        } else {
            cellX += nx; cellY += ny;
        }
    }
    return { below: tidy(out), cellX, cellY };
}
export function shiftAt(below, k0) {
    const out = { digits: [], carry: [0, 0], rem: [0, 0] };
    if (!below) return out;
    const n = Math.max(0, k0);
    const dx = new Array(n + 1).fill(0), dy = new Array(n + 1).fill(0);
    let rx = 0, ry = 0, any = false;
    for (let k = 0; k < below.length; k++) {
        const e = offsetAt(below, k);
        if (!e) continue;
        any = true;
        if (k > k0) {
            const f = Math.pow(R, k0 - k);
            rx += e[0] * f; ry += e[1] * f;
            continue;
        }
        const X = displacementDigits(e[0], k0 - k), Y = displacementDigits(e[1], k0 - k);
        for (let i = 0; i < X.digits.length; i++) { dx[k + 1 + i] += X.digits[i]; dy[k + 1 + i] += Y.digits[i]; }
        rx += X.rest; ry += Y.rest;
    }
    if (!any) return out;
    if (k0 < 0) { out.rem = [rx, ry]; return out; }
    const cx = carryOf(rx), cy = carryOf(ry);
    rx -= cx * W; ry -= cy * W;
    if (k0 > 0) { dx[k0] += cx; dy[k0] += cy; } else { out.carry = [cx, cy]; }
    for (let m = n; m >= 1; m--) {
        const ax = Math.floor((dx[m] + R / 2) / R), ay = Math.floor((dy[m] + R / 2) / R);
        if (!ax && !ay) continue;
        dx[m] -= ax * R; dy[m] -= ay * R;
        if (m > 1) { dx[m - 1] += ax; dy[m - 1] += ay; } else { out.carry[0] += ax; out.carry[1] += ay; }
    }
    for (let m = 1; m <= n; m++) out.digits[m] = [dx[m], dy[m]];
    out.rem = [rx, ry];
    return out;
}
export function hasDigits(sh) {
    if (!sh) return false;
    if (sh.carry[0] || sh.carry[1]) return true;
    for (let m = 1; m < sh.digits.length; m++) { const d = sh.digits[m]; if (d && (d[0] || d[1])) return true; }
    return false;
}
export function residual(below, k0) {
    if (!hasOffsets(below)) return null;
    const r = shiftAt(below, k0).rem;
    return r[0] !== 0 || r[1] !== 0 ? r : null;
}
export function shiftDown(below, k) {
    if (!hasOffsets(below)) return undefined;
    const out = [];
    const above = [];
    for (let m = 0; m <= k && m < below.length; m++) { const e = offsetAt(below, m); if (e) above[m] = e; }
    const sh = shiftAt(above, k);
    if (sh.rem[0] !== 0 || sh.rem[1] !== 0) out[0] = [sh.rem[0], sh.rem[1]];
    for (let m = k + 1; m < below.length; m++) { const e = offsetAt(below, m); if (e) out[m - k] = [e[0], e[1]]; }
    return tidy(out);
}
export function shiftUp(below) {
    if (!hasOffsets(below)) return undefined;
    const out = [];
    for (let m = 0; m < below.length; m++) { const e = offsetAt(below, m); if (e) out[m + 1] = [e[0], e[1]]; }
    return tidy(out);
}
export function sameShift(a, b) {
    if (!a && !b) return true;
    if (!a || !b) return false;
    return a[0] === b[0] && a[1] === b[1];
}
export function sameBelow(a, b) {
    const n = Math.max(a ? a.length : 0, b ? b.length : 0);
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        const p = offsetAt(a, k), q = offsetAt(b, k);
        if (!p && !q) continue;
        if (!p || !q || p[0] !== q[0] || p[1] !== q[1]) return false;
    }
    return true;
}
export function encodeBelow(below) {
    if (!hasOffsets(below)) return undefined;
    const out = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < below.length; k++) { const e = offsetAt(below, k); if (e) out.push([k, e[0], e[1]]); }
    return out;
}
export function decodeBelow(raw) {
    if (raw == null) return undefined;
    if (!Array.isArray(raw)) throw new Error("below: expected an array");
    const out = [];
    for (const t of raw) {
        if (!Array.isArray(t) || t.length !== 3 || !Number.isInteger(t[0]) || t[0] < 0
            || !Number.isFinite(t[1]) || !Number.isFinite(t[2])) throw new Error("below: each entry must be [k, ox, oy]");
        out[t[0]] = [t[1], t[2]];
    }
    return tidy(out);
}
//// src/engine/geometry/polyline.js
const HALF_PI = Math.PI / 2;
export function controlsFor(a, b, c) {
    const d1 = Math.hypot(a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1]);
    const d2 = Math.hypot(c[0] - b[0], c[1] - b[1]);
    if (d1 < 0.0001 || d2 < 0.0001) return { left: [b[0], b[1]], right: [b[0], b[1]] };
    const a1 = Math.atan2(a[1] - b[1], a[0] - b[0]);
    const a2 = Math.atan2(c[1] - b[1], c[0] - b[0]);
    const e1 = d1 * 0.33, e2 = d2 * 0.33;
    let mid = (a1 + a2) / 2;
    mid += (a2 < a1) ? HALF_PI : -HALF_PI;
    const left = [Math.cos(mid) * e1 + b[0], Math.sin(mid) * e1 + b[1]];
    mid -= Math.PI;
    const right = [Math.cos(mid) * e2 + b[0], Math.sin(mid) * e2 + b[1]];
    return { left, right };
}
const _mid = (a, b) => [(a[0] + b[0]) / 2, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2];
function flattenCubic(p0, p1, p2, p3, tol2, out, depth) {
    if (depth > 18) { out.push([p3[0], p3[1]]); return; }
    const dx = p3[0] - p0[0], dy = p3[1] - p0[1];
    const chord2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    let flat;
    if (chord2 > tol2) {
        const d1 = Math.abs((p1[0] - p0[0]) * dy - (p1[1] - p0[1]) * dx);
        const d2 = Math.abs((p2[0] - p0[0]) * dy - (p2[1] - p0[1]) * dx);
        const s1 = (p1[0] - p0[0]) * dx + (p1[1] - p0[1]) * dy;
        const s2 = (p2[0] - p0[0]) * dx + (p2[1] - p0[1]) * dy;
        flat = (d1 + d2) * (d1 + d2) <= (16 / 9) * tol2 * chord2
            && s1 >= 0 && s2 >= 0 && s1 <= chord2 && s2 <= chord2;
    } else {
        const h1x = p1[0] - p0[0], h1y = p1[1] - p0[1];
        const h2x = p2[0] - p3[0], h2y = p2[1] - p3[1];
        flat = Math.max(h1x * h1x + h1y * h1y, h2x * h2x + h2y * h2y) <= tol2;
    }
    if (flat) { out.push([p3[0], p3[1]]); return; }
    const p01 = _mid(p0, p1), p12 = _mid(p1, p2), p23 = _mid(p2, p3);
    const p012 = _mid(p01, p12), p123 = _mid(p12, p23), m = _mid(p012, p123);
    flattenCubic(p0, p01, p012, m, tol2, out, depth + 1);
    flattenCubic(m, p123, p23, p3, tol2, out, depth + 1);
}
export function flattenCurve(pts, tol) {
    const n = pts.length;
    if (n < 3) return pts.map((p) => [p[0], p[1]]);
    const last = n - 1, ctrl = new Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        ctrl[i] = controlsFor(pts[Math.max(i - 1, 0)], pts[i], pts[Math.min(i + 1, last)]);
    }
    const tol2 = tol * tol, out = [[pts[0][0], pts[0][1]]];
    for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) flattenCubic(pts[i - 1], ctrl[i - 1].right, ctrl[i].left, pts[i], tol2, out, 0);
    return out;
}
function rectDistMin(bx0, by0, bx1, by1, rect) {
    const dx = Math.max(rect.left - bx1, bx0 - rect.right, 0);
    const dy = Math.max(rect.top - by1, by0 - rect.bottom, 0);
    return Math.hypot(dx, dy);
}
function rectDistMax(bx0, by0, bx1, by1, rect) {
    const dx = Math.max(Math.abs(bx0 - rect.right), Math.abs(bx1 - rect.left));
    const dy = Math.max(Math.abs(by0 - rect.bottom), Math.abs(by1 - rect.top));
    return Math.hypot(dx, dy);
}
function flattenCubicNear(p0, p1, p2, p3, tol2, rect, rIn, rOut, out, depth) {
    const bx0 = Math.min(p0[0], p1[0], p2[0], p3[0]), bx1 = Math.max(p0[0], p1[0], p2[0], p3[0]);
    const by0 = Math.min(p0[1], p1[1], p2[1], p3[1]), by1 = Math.max(p0[1], p1[1], p2[1], p3[1]);
    if (rectDistMax(bx0, by0, bx1, by1, rect) < rIn || rectDistMin(bx0, by0, bx1, by1, rect) > rOut) {
        out.push([p3[0], p3[1]]);
        return;
    }
    if (depth > 40) { out.push([p3[0], p3[1]]); return; }
    const dx = p3[0] - p0[0], dy = p3[1] - p0[1];
    const chord2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    let flat;
    if (chord2 > tol2) {
        const d1 = Math.abs((p1[0] - p0[0]) * dy - (p1[1] - p0[1]) * dx);
        const d2 = Math.abs((p2[0] - p0[0]) * dy - (p2[1] - p0[1]) * dx);
        const s1 = (p1[0] - p0[0]) * dx + (p1[1] - p0[1]) * dy;
        const s2 = (p2[0] - p0[0]) * dx + (p2[1] - p0[1]) * dy;
        flat = (d1 + d2) * (d1 + d2) <= (16 / 9) * tol2 * chord2
            && s1 >= 0 && s2 >= 0 && s1 <= chord2 && s2 <= chord2;
    } else {
        const h1x = p1[0] - p0[0], h1y = p1[1] - p0[1];
        const h2x = p2[0] - p3[0], h2y = p2[1] - p3[1];
        flat = Math.max(h1x * h1x + h1y * h1y, h2x * h2x + h2y * h2y) <= tol2;
    }
    if (flat) { out.push([p3[0], p3[1]]); return; }
    const p01 = _mid(p0, p1), p12 = _mid(p1, p2), p23 = _mid(p2, p3);
    const p012 = _mid(p01, p12), p123 = _mid(p12, p23), m = _mid(p012, p123);
    flattenCubicNear(p0, p01, p012, m, tol2, rect, rIn, rOut, out, depth + 1);
    flattenCubicNear(m, p123, p23, p3, tol2, rect, rIn, rOut, out, depth + 1);
}
export function flattenCurveNear(pts, tol, rect, rIn, rOut) {
    const n = pts.length;
    if (n < 3) return pts.map((p) => [p[0], p[1]]);
    const last = n - 1, ctrl = new Array(n);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        ctrl[i] = controlsFor(pts[Math.max(i - 1, 0)], pts[i], pts[Math.min(i + 1, last)]);
    }
    const tol2 = tol * tol, out = [[pts[0][0], pts[0][1]]];
    for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) flattenCubicNear(pts[i - 1], ctrl[i - 1].right, ctrl[i].left, pts[i], tol2, rect, rIn, rOut, out, 0);
    return out;
}
export function ringSignedArea(ring) {
    let s = 0;
    for (let i = 0, n = ring.length; i < n; i++) {
        const a = ring[i], b = ring[(i + 1) % n];
        s += a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1];
    }
    return s / 2;
}
export function windingAt(rings, p) {
    let w = 0;
    for (const r of rings) {
        for (let i = 0, n = r.length; i < n; i++) {
            const a = r[i], b = r[(i + 1) % n];
            if (a[1] <= p[1]) {
                if (b[1] > p[1] && (b[0] - a[0]) * (p[1] - a[1]) - (b[1] - a[1]) * (p[0] - a[0]) > 0) w++;
            } else if (b[1] <= p[1] && (b[0] - a[0]) * (p[1] - a[1]) - (b[1] - a[1]) * (p[0] - a[0]) < 0) w--;
        }
    }
    return w;
}
export function clipRingsToRect(polys, rect) {
    const out = [];
    if (!polys) return out;
    const probe = [rect.left + (rect.right - rect.left) * 0.500123,
        rect.top + (rect.bottom - rect.top) * 0.500567];
    for (const poly of polys) {
        let ring = poly;
        for (let e = 0; e < 4 && ring.length; e++) {
            const axis = e >> 1, max = (e & 1) === 1;
            const val = axis === 0 ? (max ? rect.right : rect.left) : (max ? rect.bottom : rect.top);
            const next = [];
            for (let i = 0, n = ring.length; i < n; i++) {
                const a = ring[i], b = ring[(i + 1) % n];
                const ain = max ? a[axis] <= val : a[axis] >= val;
                const bin = max ? b[axis] <= val : b[axis] >= val;
                if (ain) next.push(a);
                if (ain !== bin) {
                    const t = (val - a[axis]) / (b[axis] - a[axis]);
                    next.push(axis === 0 ? [val, a[1] + t * (b[1] - a[1])] : [a[0] + t * (b[0] - a[0]), val]);
                }
            }
            ring = next;
        }
        const kept = ring.length >= 3 ? ring : null;
        if (kept) out.push(kept);
        const dw = windingAt([poly], probe) - (kept ? windingAt([kept], probe) : 0);
        if (dw !== 0) {
            let rr = [[rect.left, rect.top], [rect.right, rect.top], [rect.right, rect.bottom], [rect.left, rect.bottom]];
            if (windingAt([rr], probe) * dw < 0) rr = rr.slice().reverse();
            for (let k = Math.abs(dw); k > 0; k--) out.push(rr);
        }
    }
    return out;
}
export function strokeStripNear(pts, width, rect, opts = {}) {
    if (opts.joins === "round") return strokeStripRound(pts, width, opts);
    const half = width / 2;
    const out = [];
    const diagR = Math.hypot(rect.right - rect.left, rect.bottom - rect.top);
    const rcx = (rect.left + rect.right) / 2, rcy = (rect.top + rect.bottom) / 2;
    const capPiece = (p) => {
        const dx = rcx - p[0], dy = rcy - p[1];
        const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
        if (dist - diagR > half) return;
        const phi = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
        const delta = Math.min(Math.PI, 4 * Math.asin(Math.min(1, diagR / Math.max(dist, diagR))));
        const K = 96, ring = [[p[0], p[1]]];
        for (let k = 0; k <= K; k++) {
            const a = phi - delta + (2 * delta * k) / K;
            ring.push([p[0] + Math.cos(a) * half, p[1] + Math.sin(a) * half]);
        }
        out.push(ring);
    };
    if (pts.length === 1) { capPiece(pts[0]); }
    else {
        const n = pts.length, nx = [], ny = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            const dx = pts[i + 1][0] - pts[i][0], dy = pts[i + 1][1] - pts[i][1];
            const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
            nx.push(-dy / len); ny.push(dx / len);
        }
        const L = [], R = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const a = Math.max(0, i - 1), b = Math.min(n - 2, i);
            let mx = (nx[a] + nx[b]) / 2, my = (ny[a] + ny[b]) / 2;
            const ml = Math.hypot(mx, my);
            if (ml < 1e-12) { mx = nx[b]; my = ny[b]; } else { mx /= ml; my /= ml; }
            const dot = mx * nx[b] + my * ny[b];
            const sc = half / Math.max(0.5, dot);
            L.push([pts[i][0] + mx * sc, pts[i][1] + my * sc]);
            R.push([pts[i][0] - mx * sc, pts[i][1] - my * sc]);
        }
        out.push(L.concat(R.reverse()));
        for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            const ox = nx[i] * half, oy = ny[i] * half;
            out.push([
                [pts[i][0] + ox, pts[i][1] + oy], [pts[i + 1][0] + ox, pts[i + 1][1] + oy],
                [pts[i + 1][0] - ox, pts[i + 1][1] - oy], [pts[i][0] - ox, pts[i][1] - oy],
            ]);
        }
        if (opts.startCap) capPiece(pts[0]);
        if (opts.endCap) capPiece(pts[n - 1]);
    }
    for (const ring of out) {
        let area = 0;
        for (let i = 0, m = ring.length; i < m; i++) { const a = ring[i], b = ring[(i + 1) % m]; area += a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1]; }
        if (area > 0) ring.reverse();
    }
    return out;
}
export function strokeStripRound(pts, width, opts = {}) {
    const half = width / 2;
    const tol = opts.tol > 0 ? opts.tol : half / 64;
    const step = half > 0 ? 2 * Math.acos(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, 1 - tol / half))) : Math.PI;
    const w = new RingWriter(opts.out);
    const p = [];
    for (const q of pts) {
        const n = p.length;
        if (!n || q[0] !== p[n - 1][0] || q[1] !== p[n - 1][1]) p.push(q);
    }
    if (!p.length || !(half > 0)) return w.done();
    if (p.length === 1) { disc(w, p[0][0], p[0][1], half, step); return w.done(); }
    const n = p.length, dx = [], dy = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        const ex = p[i + 1][0] - p[i][0], ey = p[i + 1][1] - p[i][1];
        const len = Math.hypot(ex, ey);
        dx.push(ex / len); dy.push(ey / len);
        const ox = (-ey / len) * half, oy = (ex / len) * half;
        w.startRing();
        w.pt(p[i][0] + ox, p[i][1] + oy); w.pt(p[i + 1][0] + ox, p[i + 1][1] + oy);
        w.pt(p[i + 1][0] - ox, p[i + 1][1] - oy); w.pt(p[i][0] - ox, p[i][1] - oy);
        w.close();
    }
    for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i++) {
        const cross = dx[i - 1] * dy[i] - dy[i - 1] * dx[i];
        const dot = dx[i - 1] * dx[i] + dy[i - 1] * dy[i];
        const turn = Math.atan2(cross, dot);
        if (turn === 0) continue;
        if (Math.abs(Math.abs(turn) - Math.PI) < 1e-12) { disc(w, p[i][0], p[i][1], half, step); continue; }
        const s = cross > 0 ? -1 : 1;
        const a0 = Math.atan2(s * dx[i - 1], -s * dy[i - 1]);
        fanAt(w, p[i][0], p[i][1], half, a0, turn, step);
    }
    fanAt(w, p[0][0], p[0][1], half, Math.atan2(dx[0], -dy[0]), Math.PI, step);
    const L = n - 2;
    fanAt(w, p[n - 1][0], p[n - 1][1], half, Math.atan2(-dx[L], dy[L]), Math.PI, step);
    return w.done();
}
function fanAt(w, cx, cy, r, a0, delta, step) {
    w.startRing();
    w.pt(cx, cy);
    const k = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.abs(delta) / step));
    for (let i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
        const a = a0 + (delta * i) / k;
        w.pt(cx + Math.cos(a) * r, cy + Math.sin(a) * r);
    }
    w.close();
}
function disc(w, cx, cy, r, step) {
    w.startRing();
    const k = Math.max(3, Math.ceil((2 * Math.PI) / step));
    for (let i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        const a = (2 * Math.PI * i) / k;
        w.pt(cx + Math.cos(a) * r, cy + Math.sin(a) * r);
    }
    w.close();
}
class RingWriter {
    constructor(out) {
        this.xy = (out && out.xy) || new Float64Array(256);
        this.ring = (out && out.ring) || new Uint32Array(16);
        this.n = 0; this.r = 0; this.start = 0; this.area = 0;
    }
    startRing() {
        if (this.r === this.ring.length) { const g = new Uint32Array(this.r * 2); g.set(this.ring); this.ring = g; }
        this.ring[this.r++] = this.n;
        this.start = this.n;
    }
    pt(x, y) {
        if (this.n * 2 + 2 > this.xy.length) { const g = new Float64Array(this.xy.length * 2); g.set(this.xy); this.xy = g; }
        this.xy[this.n * 2] = x; this.xy[this.n * 2 + 1] = y; this.n++;
    }
    close() {
        let area = 0;
        for (let i = this.start; i < this.n; i++) {
            const j = i + 1 < this.n ? i + 1 : this.start;
            area += this.xy[i * 2] * this.xy[j * 2 + 1] - this.xy[j * 2] * this.xy[i * 2 + 1];
        }
        this.area += (area < 0 ? -area : area) / 2;
        if (area < 0) {
            for (let a = this.start, b = this.n - 1; a < b; a++, b--) {
                const x = this.xy[a * 2], y = this.xy[a * 2 + 1];
                this.xy[a * 2] = this.xy[b * 2]; this.xy[a * 2 + 1] = this.xy[b * 2 + 1];
                this.xy[b * 2] = x; this.xy[b * 2 + 1] = y;
            }
        }
    }
    done() { return { xy: this.xy, ring: this.ring, rings: this.r, pts: this.n, area: this.area }; }
}
export function decimatePolyline(pts, tol) {
    const n = pts.length;
    if (n <= 2) return pts;
    const keep = new Uint8Array(n); keep[0] = 1; keep[n - 1] = 1;
    const t2 = tol * tol;
    const stack = [[0, n - 1]];
    while (stack.length) {
        const [i0, i1] = stack.pop();
        if (i1 - i0 < 2) continue;
        const a = pts[i0], b = pts[i1];
        const dx = b[0] - a[0], dy = b[1] - a[1];
        const L2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
        let worst = -1, wd = 0;
        for (let i = i0 + 1; i < i1; i++) {
            const cx = pts[i][0] - a[0], cy = pts[i][1] - a[1];
            let d2;
            const t = L2 > 0 ? (cx * dx + cy * dy) / L2 : 0;
            if (t <= 0) d2 = cx * cx + cy * cy;
            else if (t >= 1) { const ex = pts[i][0] - b[0], ey = pts[i][1] - b[1]; d2 = ex * ex + ey * ey; }
            else { const cr = cx * dy - cy * dx; d2 = (cr * cr) / L2; }
            if (d2 > wd) { wd = d2; worst = i; }
        }
        if (wd > t2) { keep[worst] = 1; stack.push([i0, worst], [worst, i1]); }
    }
    const out = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) if (keep[i]) out.push(pts[i]);
    return out;
}
function clipSeg(p0, p1, r) {
    let t0 = 0, t1 = 1;
    const dx = p1[0] - p0[0], dy = p1[1] - p0[1];
    const p = [-dx, dx, -dy, dy];
    const q = [p0[0] - r.left, r.right - p0[0], p0[1] - r.top, r.bottom - p0[1]];
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        if (p[i] === 0) { if (q[i] < 0) return null; }
        else {
            const u = q[i] / p[i];
            if (p[i] < 0) { if (u > t1) return null; if (u > t0) t0 = u; }
            else { if (u < t0) return null; if (u < t1) t1 = u; }
        }
    }
    return [[p0[0] + t0 * dx, p0[1] + t0 * dy], [p0[0] + t1 * dx, p0[1] + t1 * dy]];
}
export function clipPolylineToRect(pts, rect) {
    if (!pts || pts.length === 0) return [];
    if (pts.length === 1) {
        const [x, y] = pts[0];
        return (x >= rect.left && x <= rect.right && y >= rect.top && y <= rect.bottom) ? [[pts[0]]] : [];
    }
    const runs = []; let cur = null; const eps = 1e-6;
    const close = (a, b) => Math.abs(a[0] - b[0]) < eps && Math.abs(a[1] - b[1]) < eps;
    for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
        const seg = clipSeg(pts[i], pts[i + 1], rect);
        if (!seg) { cur = null; continue; }
        if (cur && close(cur[cur.length - 1], seg[0])) cur.push(seg[1]);
        else { cur = [seg[0], seg[1]]; runs.push(cur); }
    }
    return runs;
}

const LOAF_KEPT = 25;
export class LongFrames {
    constructor() {
        this.worst = [];
        this.recent = [];
        this.count = 0;
        this.totalMs = 0;
        this.supported = false;
        this._obs = null;
    }
    start() {
        if (typeof PerformanceObserver !== "function") return;
        const types = PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes || [];
        if (types.indexOf("long-animation-frame") < 0) return;
        try {
            this._obs = new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
                for (const e of list.getEntries()) this._take(e);
            });
            this._obs.observe({ type: "long-animation-frame", buffered: true });
            this.supported = true;
        } catch (err) { this._obs = null; }
    }
    _take(e) {
        this.count++;
        this.totalMs += e.duration || 0;
        const end = e.startTime + e.duration;
        const preRender = e.renderStart ? e.renderStart - e.startTime : e.duration;
        const render = e.renderStart ? end - e.renderStart : 0;
        const styleLayout = e.styleAndLayoutStart ? end - e.styleAndLayoutStart : 0;
        const scripts = (e.scripts || []).map((sc) => ({
            ms: +(sc.duration || 0).toFixed(1),
            forcedMs: +(sc.forcedStyleAndLayoutDuration || 0).toFixed(1),
            fn: String(sc.sourceFunctionName || "").slice(0, 60),
            src: String(sc.sourceURL || "").split("/").pop().slice(0, 48),
            invoker: String(sc.invoker || "").slice(0, 60),
        })).sort((a, b) => b.ms - a.ms).slice(0, 4);
        const scriptMs = scripts.reduce((n, x) => n + x.ms, 0);
        const rec = {
            t: Math.round((performance.timeOrigin || 0) + e.startTime),
            ms: +(e.duration || 0).toFixed(1),
            blockingMs: +(e.blockingDuration || 0).toFixed(1),
            preRenderMs: +preRender.toFixed(1),
            renderMs: +render.toFixed(1),
            styleLayoutMs: +styleLayout.toFixed(1),
            paintMs: +Math.max(0, render - styleLayout).toFixed(1),
            scriptMs: +scriptMs.toFixed(1),
            scripts,
        };
        this.worst.push(rec);
        this.worst.sort((a, b) => b.ms - a.ms);
        if (this.worst.length > LOAF_KEPT) this.worst.length = LOAF_KEPT;
        this.recent.push(rec);
        if (this.recent.length > LOAF_KEPT) this.recent.shift();
    }
    stop() { try { if (this._obs) this._obs.disconnect(); } catch (err) {  } this._obs = null; }
}
const EVENT_MIN_MS = 100;
const EVENT_KEPT = 25;
export class EventLatency {
    constructor() { this.worst = []; this.count = 0; this.supported = false; this._obs = null; }
    start() {
        if (typeof PerformanceObserver !== "function") return;
        if ((PerformanceObserver.supportedEntryTypes || []).indexOf("event") < 0) return;
        try {
            this._obs = new PerformanceObserver((list) => {
                for (const e of list.getEntries()) this._take(e);
            });
            this._obs.observe({ type: "event", buffered: true, durationThreshold: EVENT_MIN_MS });
            this.supported = true;
        } catch (err) { this._obs = null; }
    }
    _take(e) {
        this.count++;
        const wait = Math.max(0, (e.processingStart || e.startTime) - e.startTime);
        const handle = Math.max(0, (e.processingEnd || 0) - (e.processingStart || 0));
        const present = Math.max(0, (e.startTime + e.duration) - (e.processingEnd || e.startTime));
        this.worst.push({
            t: Math.round((performance.timeOrigin || 0) + e.startTime),
            name: String(e.name || "").slice(0, 24),
            ms: +(e.duration || 0).toFixed(1),
            waitMs: +wait.toFixed(1),
            handleMs: +handle.toFixed(1),
            presentMs: +present.toFixed(1),
        });
        this.worst.sort((a, b) => b.ms - a.ms);
        if (this.worst.length > EVENT_KEPT) this.worst.length = EVENT_KEPT;
    }
    stop() { try { if (this._obs) this._obs.disconnect(); } catch (err) {  } this._obs = null; }
}
const GROWTH_EVERY_MS = 2000;
const GROWTH_KEPT = 150;
export class GrowthLog {
    constructor(engine) { this.e = engine; this.samples = []; this._last = 0; }
    maybeSample() {
        const now = perfNow();
        if (now - this._last < GROWTH_EVERY_MS) return;
        this._last = now;
        const E = this.e;
        let heapMB = null;
        try {
            if (typeof performance !== "undefined" && performance.memory) {
                heapMB = Math.round(performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize / 1048576);
            }
        } catch (err) {  }
        let svgNodes = null;
        try { if (typeof document !== "undefined") svgNodes = document.querySelectorAll("svg *").length; }
        catch (err) {  }
        const ras = rasterGrowth();
        const s = {
            t: Date.now(),
            heapMB,
            plates: ras ? ras.plates : null,
            plateBytes: ras ? ras.plateBytes : null,
            packedBytes: ras ? ras.packedBytes : null,
            svgNodes,
            frames: E.lm && E.lm.frames ? E.lm.frames.size : null,
            buckets: E.doc ? E.doc.levels().length : null,
            objects: E.doc ? E.doc.levels().reduce((n, k) => n + E.doc.count(k), 0) : null,
            undo: E.doc && E.doc._undo ? E.doc._undo.length : null,
            redo: E.doc && E.doc._redo ? E.doc._redo.length : null,
            tiles: E.store && E.store.cache && E.store.cache.size != null ? E.store.cache.size : null,
            groups: E.renderer && E.renderer._groups ? E.renderer._groups.size : null,
            bakeJobs: E._bakeJobs ? E._bakeJobs.length : null,
        };
        this.samples.push(s);
        if (this.samples.length > GROWTH_KEPT) this.samples.shift();
    }
}
const FRAME_BUCKETS = [17, 33, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000];
const FRAME_METER_IDLE_MS = 2000;
const FRAME_WORST_KEPT = 20;
export class FrameMeter {
    constructor() {
        this.buckets = new Array(FRAME_BUCKETS.length + 1).fill(0);
        this.worst = [];
        this.frames = 0;
        this.totalMs = 0;
        this.hidden = 0;
        this._last = 0;
        this._raf = null;
        this._until = 0;
    }
    poke() {
        if (this.onPoke) this.onPoke();
        this._until = perfNow() + FRAME_METER_IDLE_MS;
        if (this._raf == null) this._start();
    }
    _start() {
        if (typeof requestAnimationFrame !== "function") return;
        this._last = 0;
        const tick = () => {
            const now = perfNow();
            if (this._last) this.record(now - this._last);
            this._last = now;
            if (now >= this._until) { this._raf = null; this._last = 0; return; }
            this._raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        };
        this._raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
    record(ms) {
        if (!(ms >= 0) || !isFinite(ms)) return;
        if (typeof document !== "undefined" && document.hidden) { this.hidden++; return; }
        if (this.onFrame) this.onFrame(ms, Date.now());
        this.frames++; this.totalMs += ms;
        let i = 0;
        while (i < FRAME_BUCKETS.length && ms > FRAME_BUCKETS[i]) i++;
        this.buckets[i]++;
        if (ms > FRAME_BUCKETS[1]) {
            this.worst.push({ ms: +ms.toFixed(1), t: Date.now() });
            this.worst.sort((a, b) => b.ms - a.ms);
            if (this.worst.length > FRAME_WORST_KEPT) this.worst.length = FRAME_WORST_KEPT;
        }
    }
    stop() {
        if (this._raf != null && typeof cancelAnimationFrame === "function") cancelAnimationFrame(this._raf);
        this._raf = null;
    }
}
//// src/engine/mixin.js
export function mixin(target, ...protos) {
    for (const proto of protos) {
        const desc = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptors(proto);
        delete desc.constructor;
        for (const key of Object.keys(desc)) {
            if (key in target) {
                throw new Error(`mixin: ${key} is already defined on the target prototype`);
            }
        }
        Object.defineProperties(target, desc);
    }
    return target;
}
//// src/engine/now.js
export function perfNow() {
    return (typeof performance !== "undefined" ? performance.now() : Date.now());
}
//// src/engine/oplog.js
import { encodeEntry, decodeEntry } from "./format2";
import { encodeBelow, decodeBelow } from "./geometry/offsets";
import { nativeFromRecord, UNDO_CAP } from "./Document";
const lvl = (v) => (v == null ? null : String(v));
const EMPTY = new Float64Array(0);
export function snapshotRule(frameSeq = {}, listed = null) {
    const has = listed ? new Set([...listed].map(String)) : null;
    const at = (x) => (has && !has.has(String(x)) ? Infinity : (frameSeq[x] || 0));
    return (seq, levels) => { const L = [...levels].filter((x) => x != null); return L.length > 0 && L.every((x) => seq <= at(x)); };
}
export class OpLog {
    constructor(engine) {
        this.E = engine;
        this.doc = engine.doc;
        this.seq = 0;
        this.queue = [];
        this.queued = new Map();
        this.removed = new Map();
        this.forced = new Set();
        this.needFull = false;
        this._unsub = [
            this.doc.subscribe((ev) => this._onEvent(ev)),
            this.doc.subscribeOps((ev) => this._onOp(ev)),
        ];
    }
    detach() { for (const u of this._unsub) u(); this._unsub = []; }
    _next() { return ++this.seq; }
    _indexOf(id) {
        const cur = this.doc.getById(id);
        return cur ? this.doc.at(cur.level).indexOf(cur.obj) : null;
    }
    _onEvent(ev) {
        if (this.replaying) return;
        if (ev.kind === "reset") { if (!ev.load) this.needFull = true; return; }
        if (ev.kind === "remove" && ev.obj) {
            this.removed.set(ev.id, { obj: ev.obj, level: lvl(ev.level), index: null });
            if (ev.obj.erase && !this.doc._inUndo && !ev.rehome) {
                this.queue.push({ seq: this._next(), k: "spent", touches: [lvl(ev.level)], encoded: { op: { k: "spent", id: ev.id, level: lvl(ev.level) }, geo: EMPTY } });
            }
            return;
        }
        if (ev.kind !== "change" || ev.offsetsOnly || this.doc._inUndo) return;
        if (this.queued.has(ev.id)) return;
        const item = { seq: this._next(), k: "put", id: ev.id, index: null, touches: [] };
        this.queue.push(item); this.queued.set(ev.id, item);
    }
    _ownerSeq(owner) {
        if (!owner) return null;
        for (const stack of [this.doc._undo, this.doc._redo]) {
            for (const op of stack) if (op.op === "moveFrames" && op._seq != null && op.frames.includes(owner)) return op._seq;
        }
        if (this._replayOps) for (const r of this._replayOps.values()) if (r.op.op === "moveFrames" && r.op.frames.includes(owner)) return r.op._seq;
        return null;
    }
    _onSettle(ev) {
        const rec = ev.rec;
        const of = this._ownerSeq(ev.owner);
        const touches = [...new Set([lvl(ev.frame), ...rec.carries.map((c) => lvl(c[1]))])];
        const last = this.queue[this.queue.length - 1];
        if (last && last.k === "settle" && last.frame === lvl(ev.frame) && (last.of ?? null) === (of ?? null)) { last.rec = rec; last.touches = touches; }
        else this.queue.push({ seq: this._next(), k: "settle", frame: lvl(ev.frame), of, rec, touches });
        if (rec.carries.length) for (const L of touches) this.forced.add(L);
    }
    _onMerge(ev) {
        const rec = ev.rec;
        this.queue.push({ seq: this._next(), k: "mergeFrame", rec, of: this._ownerSeq(ev.owner), touches: [lvl(rec.id), lvl(rec.into)] });
        this.forced.add(lvl(rec.into));
    }
    _onOp(ev) {
        if (this.replaying) {
            if (ev.kind === "settle") this._replaySettles.push(ev);
            return;
        }
        if (ev.kind === "settle") { this._onSettle(ev); return; }
        if (ev.kind === "mergeFrame") { this._onMerge(ev); return; }
        if (ev.kind === "forget") {
            const frames = ev.frames.map(lvl);
            this.queue.push({ seq: this._next(), k: "forget", touches: frames, encoded: { op: { k: "forget", frames }, geo: EMPTY } });
            return;
        }
        const op = ev.op;
        if (ev.kind === "bake") {
            const st = ev.step;
            const mark = op.strokeId;
            if (st.rekey) {
                this.queue.push({ seq: this._next(), k: "rekey", touches: [], encoded: { op: { k: "rekey", mark, rekeys: st.rekey }, geo: EMPTY } });
                return;
            }
            if (st.frames) {
                const frames = st.frames.map((r) => lvl(r.frame));
                this.queue.push({ seq: this._next(), k: "bakeFrames", touches: frames,
                    encoded: encodeEntry({ k: "bakeFrames", mark, frames: st.frames.map((r) => ({ frame: lvl(r.frame), objects: r.natives })) }) });
                return;
            }
            const removed = st.removed;
            const entry = {
                k: "bake", mark, level: lvl(removed.level),
                removed: { index: removed.index, obj: removed.obj },
                pieces: st.pieces.map((p) => ({ obj: p.obj })),
                levels: st.pieces.map((p) => lvl(p.level)),
            };
            const touches = new Set([lvl(removed.level), ...entry.levels]);
            this.queue.push({ seq: this._next(), k: "bake", touches: [...touches], encoded: encodeEntry(entry) });
            return;
        }
        if (ev.kind === "undo" || ev.kind === "redo") {
            if (op._seq == null) { this.needFull = true; return; }
            const touches = this._opLevels(op);
            for (const L of this._forcedFor(op, touches)) this.forced.add(L);
            this.queue.push({ seq: this._next(), k: ev.kind, touches, encoded: { op: { k: ev.kind, of: op._seq }, geo: EMPTY } });
            return;
        }
        switch (op.op) {
            case "add": case "eraseCommit": {
                op._seq = this._next();
                const id = op.op === "add" ? op.id : op.strokeId;
                const item = { seq: op._seq, k: op.op === "add" ? "add" : "mark", id, index: this._indexOf(id), touches: [] };
                this.queue.push(item); this.queued.set(id, item);
                return;
            }
            case "move": case "moveMany": {
                op._seq = this._next();
                const moves = op.op === "move" ? [op] : op.moves;
                const touches = new Set();
                for (const m of moves) { if (m.from != null) touches.add(lvl(m.from)); if (m.to != null) touches.add(lvl(m.to)); }
                for (const L of touches) this.forced.add(L);
                this.queue.push({ seq: op._seq, k: "move", moves, many: op.op === "moveMany", touches: [...touches] });
                return;
            }
            case "moveFrames": {
                op._seq = this._next();
                const touches = new Set();
                for (const e of op.frames) {
                    touches.add(lvl(e.id));
                    if (e.from && e.from.parent != null) touches.add(lvl(e.from.parent));
                    if (e.to && e.to.parent != null) touches.add(lvl(e.to.parent));
                }
                for (const m of op.moves || []) { if (m.from != null) touches.add(lvl(m.from)); if (m.to != null) touches.add(lvl(m.to)); }
                for (const L of this._forcedFor(op, [...touches])) this.forced.add(L);
                this.queue.push({ seq: op._seq, k: "moveFrames", frames: op.frames, moves: op.moves || [], touches: [...touches] });
                return;
            }
            case "eraseMany": {
                op._seq = this._next();
                const entry = { k: "removeMany", records: op.records.map((r) => ({ level: lvl(r.level), index: r.index, obj: r.obj })) };
                this.queue.push({ seq: op._seq, k: "removeMany", touches: [...new Set(op.records.map((r) => lvl(r.level)))], encoded: encodeEntry(entry) });
                return;
            }
            case "removeFrames": case "eraseFrames": {
                op._seq = this._next();
                this.queue.push({ seq: op._seq, k: "removeFrames", records: op.records, touches: op.records.map((r) => lvl(r.frame)) });
                return;
            }
            case "deleteMany": {
                op._seq = this._next();
                this.queue.push({ seq: op._seq, k: "deleteMany", parts: op.parts, touches: this._opLevels(op) });
                return;
            }
            case "clear": this.needFull = true; return;
            default: return;
        }
    }
    _opLevels(op) {
        const out = new Set();
        const at = (id) => { const r = this.doc.getById(id); if (r) out.add(lvl(r.level)); };
        switch (op.op) {
            case "add": { at(op.id); const r = this.removed.get(op.id); if (r && r.level != null) out.add(r.level); break; }
            case "absent": if (op.level != null) out.add(lvl(op.level)); break;
            case "move": if (op.from != null) out.add(lvl(op.from)); if (op.to != null) out.add(lvl(op.to)); at(op.id); break;
            case "moveMany": for (const m of op.moves) { if (m.from != null) out.add(lvl(m.from)); if (m.to != null) out.add(lvl(m.to)); at(m.id); } break;
            case "eraseMany": case "removeMany": for (const r of op.records) out.add(lvl(r.level)); break;
            case "removeFrames": case "eraseFrames": for (const r of op.records) out.add(lvl(r.frame)); break;
            case "deleteMany": for (const p of op.parts) for (const L of this._opLevels(p)) out.add(L); break;
            case "moveFrames":
                for (const e of op.frames) { out.add(lvl(e.id)); if (e.from && e.from.parent != null) out.add(lvl(e.from.parent)); if (e.to && e.to.parent != null) out.add(lvl(e.to.parent)); }
                for (const m of op.moves || []) { if (m.from != null) out.add(lvl(m.from)); if (m.to != null) out.add(lvl(m.to)); at(m.id); }
                break;
            case "eraseCommit": case "eraseRevert":
                at(op.strokeId); if (op.strokeRec) out.add(lvl(op.strokeRec.level));
                for (const st of op.baked || []) {
                    if (st.removed) out.add(lvl(st.removed.level));
                    for (const p of st.pieces || []) out.add(lvl(p.level));
                    for (const r of st.frames || []) out.add(lvl(r.frame));
                }
                break;
            default: break;
        }
        return [...out];
    }
    _forcedFor(op, touches) {
        if (op.op !== "moveFrames") return touches;
        const out = new Set();
        for (const m of op.moves || []) { if (m.from != null) out.add(lvl(m.from)); if (m.to != null) out.add(lvl(m.to)); }
        for (const e of op.frames) {
            for (const m of e.merged || []) { out.add(lvl(m.id)); out.add(lvl(m.into)); }
            if (e.settled && e.settled.carries.length) { out.add(lvl(e.id)); for (const c of e.settled.carries) out.add(lvl(c[1])); }
        }
        return [...out];
    }
    _moveFile(m) {
        const cur = this.doc.getById(m.id);
        const out = { id: m.id, from: lvl(m.from), to: lvl(m.to), dx: m.dx, dy: m.dy,
            obj: cur ? cur.obj : null, level: cur ? lvl(cur.level) : null, index: this._indexOf(m.id) };
        if ("belowBefore" in m) { out.belowBefore = encodeBelow(m.belowBefore) || null; out.belowAfter = encodeBelow(m.belowAfter) || null; }
        if (m.base || m.after) { out.base = m.base || null; out.after = m.after || null; }
        return out;
    }
    drain() {
        const entries = [];
        const frameRecs = (records) => records.map((r) => ({ frame: lvl(r.frame), objects: r.natives }));
        for (const it of this.queue) {
            let enc = it.encoded;
            if (it.k === "add" || it.k === "mark" || it.k === "put") {
                const cur = this.doc.getById(it.id);
                const aside = !cur && !this.removed.has(it.id) ? this.doc._byId.get(it.id) : null;
                const src = cur ? { obj: cur.obj, level: lvl(cur.level) }
                    : this.removed.get(it.id) || (aside ? { obj: aside, level: lvl(aside._home) } : null);
                if (!src) continue;
                it.touches = [src.level];
                enc = encodeEntry({ k: it.k, level: src.level, index: it.index, obj: src.obj });
            } else if (it.k === "move") {
                enc = encodeEntry({ k: "move", many: it.many, moves: it.moves.map((m) => this._moveFile(m)) });
            } else if (it.k === "moveFrames") {
                enc = encodeEntry({ k: "moveFrames", frames: it.frames.map(frameFile), moves: it.moves.map((m) => this._moveFile(m)) });
            } else if (it.k === "removeFrames") {
                enc = encodeEntry({ k: "removeFrames", records: frameRecs(it.records) });
            } else if (it.k === "deleteMany") {
                const records = [], frames = [];
                for (const p of it.parts) {
                    if (p.op === "eraseMany" || p.op === "removeMany") for (const r of p.records) records.push({ level: lvl(r.level), index: r.index, obj: r.obj });
                    else if (p.op === "removeFrames" || p.op === "eraseFrames") frames.push(...frameRecs(p.records));
                }
                enc = encodeEntry({ k: "deleteMany", records, frames });
            } else if (it.k === "settle") {
                enc = { op: { k: "settle", frame: it.frame, of: it.of, ...settleFile(it.rec) }, geo: EMPTY };
            } else if (it.k === "mergeFrame") {
                enc = { op: { k: "mergeFrame", of: it.of, rec: mergeFile(it.rec) }, geo: EMPTY };
            }
            if (!enc) continue;
            entries.push({ seq: it.seq, t: Date.now(), op: enc.op, geo: enc.geo, touches: it.touches });
        }
        const out = { entries, forced: [...this.forced], full: this.needFull };
        this.queue = []; this.queued = new Map(); this.removed = new Map(); this.forced = new Set(); this.needFull = false;
        return out;
    }
    replay(entries, frameSeq = {}, listed = null) {
        const wasReplaying = this.replaying;
        this.replaying = true;
        this._replaySettles = [];
        try { return this._replay(entries, frameSeq, listed); } finally {
            this.replaying = wasReplaying;
            for (const ev of this._replaySettles) this._onSettle(ev);
            this._replaySettles = [];
            this._replayOps = null;
        }
    }
    _replay(entries, frameSeq, listed) {
        const doc = this.doc, E = this.E;
        const ops = new Map();
        this._replayOps = ops;
        const marks = new Map();
        let undo = [], redo = [];
        const stale = snapshotRule(frameSeq, listed);
        const made = new Map();
        const adopt = (dst, src) => {
            for (const k of Object.keys(dst)) if (k !== "id" && k[0] !== "_" && !(k in src)) delete dst[k];
            for (const k of Object.keys(src)) if (k !== "id") dst[k] = src[k];
            delete dst._bbox; dst._ver = (dst._ver || 0) + 1;
            return dst;
        };
        const live = (rec) => {
            const n = nativeFromRecord(rec); doc.noteId(n.id); if (n.editId != null) doc.noteId(n.editId);
            const prev = made.get(n.id);
            if (prev) return adopt(prev, n);
            made.set(n.id, n);
            return n;
        };
        const liveOrDoc = (rec) => { const cur = doc.getById(rec.id); if (cur) { made.set(rec.id, cur.obj); return cur.obj; } return live(rec); };
        const at = (index) => (index == null || index < 0 ? 1e9 : index);
        const rewound = new Map();
        const rewind = (obj, id) => {
            const r = rewound.get(id);
            if (!r || doc.getById(id)) return obj;
            if ("below" in r) { if (r.below) obj.below = r.below; else delete obj.below; }
            return obj;
        };
        const fresh = (seq, op, entry, levels) => {
            op._seq = seq; const rec = { op, entry, levels: new Set(levels.map(lvl)), spent: false }; ops.set(seq, rec);
            undo.push(op); if (undo.length > UNDO_CAP) undo.shift();
            redo = []; return rec;
        };
        const inverseFromData = (rec) => {
            const op = rec.op, e = rec.entry;
            switch (op.op) {
                case "add": {
                    const r = rewound.get(e.obj.id), out = !doc.getById(e.obj.id);
                    return { op: "absent", obj: rewind(liveOrDoc(e.obj), e.obj.id), level: r && r.level != null && out ? r.level : e.level, index: at(e.index) };
                }
                case "absent": return { op: "add", id: op.obj.id };
                case "eraseCommit":
                    op.strokeRec = rec.spent ? null : (op.strokeRec || { obj: liveOrDoc(e.obj), level: e.level, index: at(e.index) });
                    op.op = "eraseRevert"; return op;
                case "eraseRevert": op.op = "eraseCommit"; return op;
                case "move": return { op: "move", ...doc._invertMove(op) };
                case "moveMany": return { op: "moveMany", moves: op.moves.map((m) => doc._invertMove(m)) };
                case "eraseMany": return { op: "removeMany", records: op.records };
                case "removeMany": return { op: "eraseMany", records: op.records };
                case "removeFrames": return { op: "eraseFrames", records: op.records };
                case "eraseFrames": return { op: "removeFrames", records: op.records };
                case "deleteMany": return { op: "deleteMany", parts: op.parts.map((p) => inverseFromData({ op: p, entry: e })) };
                default: return op;
            }
        };
        const undoFrames = (op, seq) => {
            for (const f of op.frames) {
                if (f.merged) for (let i = f.merged.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const m = f.merged[i]; if (!stale(seq, [m.id, m.into])) doc.unmergeReplay(m); }
                if (f.settled && !stale(seq, [f.id, ...f.settled.carries.map((c) => c[1])])) doc.unsettle(f.id, f.settled);
            }
            const ml = [];
            for (const m of op.moves || []) { if (m.from != null) ml.push(m.from); if (m.to != null) ml.push(m.to); }
            if (ml.length && !stale(seq, ml)) doc._undoMove(op.moves);
            const inv = {
                op: "moveFrames",
                frames: op.frames.map((f) => ({ ...f, from: f.to, to: f.from, shiftBefore: f.shiftAfter, shiftAfter: f.shiftBefore, settled: null, merged: null })),
                moves: (op.moves || []).map((m) => doc._invertMove(m)),
            };
            for (const f of inv.frames) doc.noteFrameOwner(f.id, f);
            return inv;
        };
        const applyMoves = (fileMoves, seq) => {
            const moves = fileMoves.map((m) => {
                const out = { id: m.id, dx: m.dx, dy: m.dy, from: m.from, to: m.to };
                if ("belowBefore" in m) { out.belowBefore = decodeBelow(m.belowBefore); out.belowAfter = decodeBelow(m.belowAfter); }
                if (m.base || m.after) { out.base = geomLive(m.base); out.after = geomLive(m.after); }
                return out;
            });
            const levels = [];
            fileMoves.forEach((m, i) => {
                const mine = [m.from, m.to].filter((x) => x != null);
                levels.push(...mine);
                if (stale(seq, mine)) return;
                const cur = doc.getById(m.id);
                if (cur && m.to != null && cur.level !== lvl(m.to)) doc.rehomeById(m.id, m.to);
                if (!doc.getById(m.id)) { if (m.obj) doc.insertAt(live(m.obj), m.level || m.to, at(m.index)); }
                else {
                    if (moves[i].after) doc.setGeometryById(m.id, moves[i].after);
                    if ("belowAfter" in moves[i]) doc.setOffsetsById(m.id, moves[i].belowAfter);
                    else if (!moves[i].after && cur) doc.moveById(m.id, m.dx, m.dy);
                }
            });
            return { moves, levels };
        };
        const frameRecs = (list) => (list || []).map((r) => ({ frame: r.frame, natives: r.objects.map(liveOrDoc), index: null }));
        for (const raw of entries) {
            const e = decodeEntry(raw);
            const seq = raw.seq;
            if (seq > this.seq) this.seq = seq;
            switch (e.k) {
                case "add": case "mark": {
                    const op = e.k === "add" ? { op: "add", id: e.obj.id } : { op: "eraseCommit", strokeId: e.obj.id, strokeRec: null, baked: [] };
                    const rec = fresh(seq, op, e, [e.level]);
                    if (e.k === "mark") marks.set(e.obj.id, rec);
                    if (stale(seq, [e.level])) break;
                    if (!doc.getById(e.obj.id)) doc.insertAt(live(e.obj), e.level, at(e.index));
                    break;
                }
                case "put": {
                    if (stale(seq, [e.level])) break;
                    const cur = doc.removeById(e.obj.id);
                    if (cur) made.set(cur.obj.id, cur.obj);
                    doc.insertAt(live(e.obj), e.level, cur ? cur.index : at(e.index));
                    break;
                }
                case "spent": {
                    const rec = marks.get(e.id);
                    if (rec) rec.spent = true;
                    if (!stale(seq, [e.level])) doc.removeById(e.id);
                    break;
                }
                case "bake": {
                    const rec = marks.get(e.mark);
                    const levels = [e.level, ...(e.levels || [])];
                    if (rec) for (const L of levels) rec.levels.add(lvl(L));
                    const step = { removed: { obj: liveOrDoc(e.removed.obj), level: e.level, index: at(e.removed.index) }, pieces: [], _seq: seq };
                    if (seq > (doc._stepSeq || 0)) doc._stepSeq = seq;
                    if (!stale(seq, [e.level])) doc.removeById(e.removed.obj.id);
                    e.pieces.forEach((pr, i) => {
                        const L = (e.levels && e.levels[i]) || e.level;
                        const obj = liveOrDoc(pr);
                        if (!stale(seq, [L]) && !doc.getById(pr.id)) doc.insertAt(obj, L, 1e9);
                        step.pieces.push({ obj, level: L });
                    });
                    if (rec) rec.op.baked.push(step);
                    break;
                }
                case "bakeFrames": {
                    const rec = marks.get(e.mark);
                    const records = frameRecs(e.frames);
                    for (const r of records) { if (rec) rec.levels.add(lvl(r.frame)); if (!stale(seq, [r.frame])) doc.detachFrame(r.frame, r); }
                    if (rec) rec.op.baked.push({ frames: records, _seq: seq });
                    if (seq > (doc._stepSeq || 0)) doc._stepSeq = seq;
                    break;
                }
                case "rekey": {
                    const rec = marks.get(e.mark);
                    for (const r of e.rekeys) { const cur = doc.getById(r.id); if (cur) Object.assign(cur.obj, r.after); }
                    doc.keysChanged();
                    if (rec) rec.op.baked.push({ rekey: e.rekeys, _seq: seq });
                    if (seq > (doc._stepSeq || 0)) doc._stepSeq = seq;
                    break;
                }
                case "removeMany": {
                    const records = e.records.map((r) => ({ obj: liveOrDoc(r.obj), level: r.level, index: at(r.index) }));
                    for (const r of records) if (!stale(seq, [r.level])) doc.removeById(r.obj.id);
                    fresh(seq, { op: "eraseMany", records }, e, records.map((r) => r.level));
                    break;
                }
                case "move": {
                    const { moves, levels } = applyMoves(e.moves, seq);
                    fresh(seq, e.many ? { op: "moveMany", moves } : { op: "move", ...moves[0] }, e, levels);
                    break;
                }
                case "moveFrames": {
                    const { moves, levels } = applyMoves(e.moves || [], seq);
                    const frames = e.frames.map((f) => ({ id: f.id, depth: f.depth, from: f.from, to: f.to, shiftBefore: f.shiftBefore, shiftAfter: f.shiftAfter,
                        settled: settleLive(f.settled), merged: f.merged ? f.merged.map(mergeLive) : null }));
                    for (const f of frames) doc.noteFrameOwner(f.id, f);
                    fresh(seq, { op: "moveFrames", frames, moves }, e, [...levels, ...(raw.touches || [])]);
                    break;
                }
                case "settle": {
                    const s = settleLive(e);
                    const rec = e.of != null ? ops.get(e.of) : null;
                    if (rec && rec.op.op === "moveFrames") { const fe = rec.op.frames.find((f) => f.id === e.frame); if (fe) fe.settled = s; }
                    if (!stale(seq, raw.touches || [e.frame])) doc.applySettle(e.frame, s);
                    break;
                }
                case "mergeFrame": {
                    const m = mergeLive(e.rec);
                    const rec = e.of != null ? ops.get(e.of) : null;
                    if (rec && rec.op.op === "moveFrames") {
                        const fe = rec.op.frames.find((f) => f.id === m.id) || rec.op.frames.find((f) => f.id === m.into);
                        if (fe && !(fe.merged || []).some((r) => r.id === m.id && r.into === m.into)) (fe.merged || (fe.merged = [])).push(m);
                    }
                    if (!stale(seq, raw.touches || [m.id, m.into])) doc.mergeReplay(m);
                    break;
                }
                case "removeFrames": {
                    const records = frameRecs(e.records);
                    for (const r of records) if (!stale(seq, [r.frame])) doc.detachFrame(r.frame, r);
                    fresh(seq, { op: "removeFrames", records }, e, records.map((r) => r.frame));
                    break;
                }
                case "deleteMany": {
                    const records = (e.records || []).map((r) => ({ obj: liveOrDoc(r.obj), level: r.level, index: at(r.index) }));
                    for (const r of records) if (!stale(seq, [r.level])) doc.removeById(r.obj.id);
                    const frames = frameRecs(e.frames);
                    for (const r of frames) if (!stale(seq, [r.frame])) doc.detachFrame(r.frame, r);
                    fresh(seq, { op: "deleteMany", parts: [{ op: "eraseMany", records }, { op: "removeFrames", records: frames }] }, e,
                        [...records.map((r) => r.level), ...frames.map((r) => r.frame)]);
                    break;
                }
                case "undo": case "redo": {
                    const rec = ops.get(e.of);
                    if (!rec) break;
                    const op = rec.op;
                    const old = stale(seq, rec.levels);
                    if (old && (op.op === "move" || op.op === "moveMany")) {
                        for (const m of (op.op === "move" ? [op] : op.moves)) {
                            rewound.set(m.id, "belowBefore" in m ? { below: m.belowBefore, level: m.from } : { level: m.from });
                            const o = made.get(m.id);
                            if (o) rewind(o, m.id);
                        }
                    }
                    doc._undo = undo; doc._redo = redo;
                    const inv = op.op === "moveFrames" ? undoFrames(op, seq) : old ? inverseFromData(rec) : doc._invert(op);
                    inv._seq = op._seq; rec.op = inv;
                    if (e.k === "undo") { undo = undo.filter((x) => x !== op); redo.push(inv); }
                    else { redo = redo.filter((x) => x !== op); undo.push(inv); }
                    break;
                }
                case "attr": {
                    const cur = doc.getById(e.id);
                    if (cur && !stale(seq, [cur.level])) { Object.assign(cur.obj, e.set); doc.keysChanged(); }
                    break;
                }
                case "forget": break;
                default: break;
            }
        }
        doc._undo = undo.slice(-UNDO_CAP); doc._redo = redo;
        E._eraseCommits.clear(); E._bakeDone.clear(); E._cutInflight = null;
        for (const [strokeId, rec] of marks) {
            if (!doc.getById(strokeId) || rec.op.op !== "eraseCommit") continue;
            E._eraseCommits.set(strokeId, rec.op);
            const done = new Set();
            for (const st of rec.op.baked) { if (st.removed) done.add(st.removed.obj.id); for (const p of st.pieces || []) done.add(p.obj.id); }
            E._bakeDone.set(strokeId, done);
        }
        return { undo: doc._undo.length, redo: doc._redo.length, marks: E._eraseCommits.size };
    }
}
const settleFile = (rec) => (rec ? { dx: rec.dx, dy: rec.dy, tables: rec.tables.map(([id, t]) => [id, encodeBelow(t) || null]), carries: rec.carries.map(([id, L]) => [id, lvl(L)]) } : null);
const settleLive = (s) => (s ? { dx: s.dx, dy: s.dy, tables: s.tables.map(([id, t]) => [id, decodeBelow(t)]), carries: (s.carries || []).map(([id, L]) => [id, L]) } : null);
const mergeFile = (rec) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({ id: rec.id, into: rec.into, parent: rec.parent, i: rec.i, j: rec.j, depth: rec.depth, addrSeq: rec.addrSeq || 0,
    shift: rec.shift || null, shadows: rec.shadows || [], kids: rec.kids || [], ids: rec.ids || [] }));
const mergeLive = mergeFile;
const frameFile = (e) => ({ id: lvl(e.id), depth: e.depth, from: e.from, to: e.to, shiftBefore: e.shiftBefore || null, shiftAfter: e.shiftAfter || null,
    settled: settleFile(e.settled), merged: null });
function geomLive(g) {
    if (!g) return g;
    const n = nativeFromRecord({ type: g.loops ? "shape" : g.polys ? "fill" : "stroke", id: 0, ...g });
    const out = {};
    if (n.loops) out.loops = n.loops; if (n.polys) out.polys = n.polys; if (n.pts) out.pts = n.pts;
    if ("attachRect" in g) out.attachRect = g.attachRect;
    if ("tile" in g) out.tile = g.tile;
    if ("below" in g) out.below = n.below;
    return out;
}

    runLength, loopRuns, runPathData, loopsBounds, edgeSpans, circleLoop, insideLoops,
    clipRunToRect,
} from "./geometry/antRuns";
