const SEL_FRAME_MARK_PX = 2;
const SEL_MIN_TRACE_PX = 0.5;
const SEL_KEEP_FRACTION = 0.5;
function mergeClose(rects, gap) {
    const out = [];
    for (const r of rects) {
        let hit = null;
        for (const c of out) {
            if (r.left - gap <= c.right && r.right + gap >= c.left && r.top - gap <= c.bottom && r.bottom + gap >= c.top) { hit = c; break; }
        }
        if (!hit) { out.push({ left: r.left, top: r.top, right: r.right, bottom: r.bottom }); continue; }
        hit.left = Math.min(hit.left, r.left); hit.top = Math.min(hit.top, r.top);
        hit.right = Math.max(hit.right, r.right); hit.bottom = Math.max(hit.bottom, r.bottom);
    }
    return out;
}
const SEL_REDECIDE_DRIFT = 1.25;
const SEL_MIN_RUN_PX = 0.5;
const SEL_OBJECT_DOT_PX = 8;
const SEL_EDGE_INSET_PX = 0.05;
const SEL_CHEVRON_FRACTION = 1 / 5;
function clipRect(r) { return { rect: asRect(r), eps: rectTol(r) }; }
const asLTRB = (r) => ("x0" in r ? { left: r.x0, top: r.y0, right: r.x1, bottom: r.y1 } : r);
function mergeSpans(list, gap) {
    if (!list.length) return [];
    const sorted = list.slice().sort((x, y) => x[0] - y[0]);
    const out = [sorted[0].slice()];
    for (let i = 1; i < sorted.length; i++) {
        const cur = out[out.length - 1], nxt = sorted[i];
        if (nxt[0] <= cur[1] + gap) cur[1] = Math.max(cur[1], nxt[1]);
        else out.push(nxt.slice());
    }
    return out;
}
class Overlays {
    _selectionAnts() {
        const s = this.selection;
        if (!s || this.tool !== "select") return null;
        const d = this._dragSel;
        const kept = this._selDec;
        const held = d && kept && kept.drag === d && kept.sel === s && kept.frame === this.cam.frame;
        const table = held ? null : this._selTable(s);
        if (!held && !table.count) return null;
        const dec = held ? kept : this._selDecide(s, table);
        const sc = this.cam.inScale;
        const off = (d && dec.drag === d && d.last) ? [d.last[0] - dec.dragAt[0], d.last[1] - dec.dragAt[1]] : [0, 0];
        const edges = this._selEdges(dec, off);
        if (!dec.runs.length && !dec.marks.length && !edges.list.length) return null;
        return {
            key: dec.key,
            transform: { k: sc / dec.scale, tx: this.cam.inPanX + sc * dec.origin.x + off[0], ty: this.cam.inPanY + sc * dec.origin.y + off[1] },
            off,
            runs: dec.runs, marks: dec.marks, inkPx: dec.inkPx,
            edges: edges.list, covered: edges.covered,
        };
    }
    _selTable(s) {
        const c = this._selTableCache;
        if (c && c.sel === s && c.rev === this.doc.rev) return c.table;
        const seen = new Set();
        const byLevel = new Map();
        const ids = new Set();
        const levelOf = new Map();
        const cross = new Set();
        for (const id of s.ids) {
            const group = this.doc.editGroup(id);
            let spans = false;
            for (const m of group) if (m.level !== group[0].level) { spans = true; break; }
            for (const m of group) {
                if (m.obj.erase || seen.has(m.obj)) continue;
                seen.add(m.obj);
                ids.add(m.obj.id);
                levelOf.set(m.obj.id, m.level);
                let e = byLevel.get(m.level);
                if (!e) { e = { objs: [], boxes: new Map() }; byLevel.set(m.level, e); }
                e.objs.push(m.obj);
                if (spans) { cross.add(m.obj.id); continue; }
                const b = bboxOf(m.obj, this.store.live);
                if (!b) continue;
                const key = m.obj.below ? JSON.stringify(m.obj.below) : "";
                const bx = e.boxes.get(key);
                if (!bx) { e.boxes.set(key, { below: m.obj.below, box: { x0: b.x0, y0: b.y0, x1: b.x1, y1: b.y1 } }); continue; }
                if (b.x0 < bx.box.x0) bx.box.x0 = b.x0;
                if (b.y0 < bx.box.y0) bx.box.y0 = b.y0;
                if (b.x1 > bx.box.x1) bx.box.x1 = b.x1;
                if (b.y1 > bx.box.y1) bx.box.y1 = b.y1;
            }
        }
        const frames = new Set();
        for (const f of s.frames || []) {
            if (!this.lm.frame(f)) continue;
            frames.add(f);
            let e = byLevel.get(f);
            if (!e) { e = { objs: [], boxes: new Map() }; byLevel.set(f, e); }
            e.frame = true;
            e.boxes.set("frame:" + f, { below: null, box: { x0: -HALF_W, y0: -HALF_W, x1: HALF_W, y1: HALF_W } });
        }
        const table = { byLevel, ids, levelOf, cross, frames, count: seen.size + frames.size };
        this._selTableCache = { sel: s, rev: this.doc.rev, table };
        return table;
    }
    _selFrameRect(info, L, F) {
        let out = null;
        for (const { below, box } of info.boxes.values()) {
            const R = { left: box.x0, top: box.y0, right: box.x1, bottom: box.y1 };
            const r = below ? this.lm.mapRectObj(R, L, F, below, L) : this.lm.mapRectF(R, L, F);
            if (!r) continue;
            out = out ? { left: Math.min(out.left, r.left), top: Math.min(out.top, r.top), right: Math.max(out.right, r.right), bottom: Math.max(out.bottom, r.bottom) } : r;
        }
        return out;
    }
    _selFrameContent(f, F) {
        let out = null;
        this.lm.walk(f, (g) => {
            const ext = this.doc.frameExtent(g.id);
            if (!ext) return;
            const b = ext.box, t = g.shift || [0, 0];
            const r = this.lm.mapRectF({ left: b.x0 + t[0], top: b.y0 + t[1], right: b.x1 + t[0], bottom: b.y1 + t[1] }, g.id, F);
            if (!r) return;
            out = out ? { left: Math.min(out.left, r.left), top: Math.min(out.top, r.top), right: Math.max(out.right, r.right), bottom: Math.max(out.bottom, r.bottom) } : r;
        });
        return out;
    }
    _selDecide(s, table) {
        const list = this._lastList || [];
        const F = this.cam.frame, sc = this.cam.inScale;
        const O = this.renderer._origin();
        const vp = this.cam.frameWindow(0);
        const c = this._selDec;
        const drag = this._dragSel || null;
        if (c && drag && c.drag === drag && c.sel === s && c.frame === F) return c;
        if (c && !drag && !c.drag && c.list === list && c.sel === s && c.rev === this.doc.rev && c.frame === F && c.origin === O
            && sc / c.scale <= SEL_REDECIDE_DRIFT && c.scale / sc <= SEL_REDECIDE_DRIFT
            && vp.left >= c.win.left && vp.right <= c.win.right && vp.top >= c.win.top && vp.bottom <= c.win.bottom) return c;
        const runs = [], marks = [], pieces = [];
        let inkPx = Infinity;
        const wantPath = !this.renderer.antPainter;
        const retained = wantPath
            ? (loop, closed) => ({ d: runPathData({ pieces: loop, closed }, O.x, O.y, sc) })
            : (loop, closed) => ({ pieces: loop, closed });
        const win = this.cam.frameWindow(SEL_KEEP_FRACTION * Math.max(this.width, this.height) / sc);
        const keep = { x0: win.left, y0: win.top, x1: win.right, y1: win.bottom };
        const marked = new Set();
        for (const [L, info] of table.byLevel) {
            if (!info.boxes.size) continue;
            const r = this._selFrameRect(info, L, F);
            if (!r) { marked.add(L); continue; }
            const span = Math.max(r.right - r.left, r.bottom - r.top) * sc;
            if (span >= SEL_FRAME_MARK_PX) continue;
            marked.add(L);
            if (r.right < win.left || r.left > win.right || r.bottom < win.top || r.top > win.bottom) continue;
            const cx = (r.left + r.right) / 2, cy = (r.top + r.bottom) / 2;
            const rad = Math.max(SEL_MIN_TRACE_PX, span) / 2 / sc;
            marks.push(retained(circleLoop(cx, cy, rad), true));
        }
        const underFrame = new Map();
        const frameOf = (id) => {
            if (!table.frames.size) return null;
            let f = underFrame.get(id);
            if (f !== undefined) return f;
            const rec = this.doc.getById(id);
            f = null;
            if (rec) for (const fr of table.frames) if (this.lm.isUnder(fr, rec.level)) { f = fr; break; }
            underFrame.set(id, f);
            return f;
        };
        const seamCache = new Map();
        const traced = new Set();
        const small = [];
        const shownFrames = new Set();
        for (const piece of list) {
            const own = table.ids.has(piece.id);
            const fr = own ? null : frameOf(piece.id);
            if (!own && !fr) continue;
            if (own && marked.has(table.levelOf.get(piece.id)) && !table.cross.has(piece.id)) continue;
            if (fr && marked.has(fr)) continue;
            let loops = this._selPieceLoops(piece);
            if (!loops || !loops.length) continue;
            if (piece.res) loops = translateLoops(loops, piece.res[0], piece.res[1]);
            const bounds = loopsBounds(loops);
            pieces.push({ loops, bounds });
            let thick = piece.lwFrame || 0;
            if (!thick && piece.type !== "stroke") { try { thick = meanWidth(loops); } catch (err) { thick = 0; } }
            const thickPx = thick > 0 ? thick * sc : Infinity;
            const sizePx = bounds ? Math.min(bounds.x1 - bounds.x0, bounds.y1 - bounds.y0) * sc : Infinity;
            inkPx = Math.min(inkPx, thickPx, sizePx);
            const rects = this._selSeamRects(piece, table, F, seamCache);
            for (const loop of loops) {
                for (const seamRun of loopRuns(loop, rects)) {
                    for (const run of clipRunToRect(seamRun, keep)) {
                        const len = runLength(run.pieces) * sc;
                        if (len < SEL_MIN_RUN_PX) continue;
                        runs.push({ ...retained(run.pieces, run.closed), len });
                        traced.add(piece.id);
                        if (fr) shownFrames.add(fr);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (fr && !traced.has(piece.id) && bounds && sizePx < SEL_OBJECT_DOT_PX) { small.push({ left: bounds.x0, top: bounds.y0, right: bounds.x1, bottom: bounds.y1 }); shownFrames.add(fr); }
        }
        for (const id of table.ids) {
            if (traced.has(id) || table.cross.has(id) || marked.has(table.levelOf.get(id))) continue;
            const rec = this.doc.getById(id);
            if (!rec) continue;
            const r = this._rectInActive(rec.obj, rec.level);
            if (!r || r.right < win.left || r.left > win.right || r.bottom < win.top || r.top > win.bottom) continue;
            if (Math.max(r.right - r.left, r.bottom - r.top) * sc >= SEL_OBJECT_DOT_PX) continue;
            small.push(r);
        }
        for (const fr of table.frames) {
            if (marked.has(fr) || shownFrames.has(fr)) continue;
            const r = this._selFrameContent(fr, F);
            if (!r || r.right < win.left || r.left > win.right || r.bottom < win.top || r.top > win.bottom) continue;
            small.push(r);
        }
        for (const r of mergeClose(small, SEL_FRAME_MARK_PX / sc)) {
            const span = Math.max(r.right - r.left, r.bottom - r.top) * sc;
            const cx = (r.left + r.right) / 2, cy = (r.top + r.bottom) / 2;
            marks.push(retained(circleLoop(cx, cy, Math.max(SEL_MIN_TRACE_PX, span) / 2 / sc), true));
        }
        this._selDecSeq = (this._selDecSeq || 0) + 1;
        this._selDec = { key: this._selDecSeq, list, sel: s, rev: this.doc.rev, frame: F, origin: O, win,
            scale: sc, runs, marks, inkPx, pieces,
            drag, dragAt: drag ? (drag.listAt ? [drag.listAt[0], drag.listAt[1]] : drag.last ? [drag.last[0], drag.last[1]] : [drag.start[0], drag.start[1]]) : null };
        return this._selDec;
    }
    _selPieceLoops(piece) {
        const src = piece.type === "shape" ? piece.loops : piece.type === "fill" ? piece.polys : piece.pts;
        if (piece._antLoops !== undefined && piece._antFor === src) return piece._antLoops;
        let loops = null;
        if (piece.type === "shape") loops = piece.loops;
        else if (piece.type === "fill") loops = shapeFromRings(piece.polys);
        else if (piece.type === "stroke" && piece.pts && piece.pts.length > 1) {
            try { loops = strokeLoops(piece, this.cfg, { curved: piece.origin === "native", live: this.store.live }); } catch (err) { loops = null; }
        }
        piece._antLoops = loops || null;
        piece._antFor = src;
        return piece._antLoops;
    }
    _selSeamRects(piece, table, F, cache) {
        const key = piece.id;
        const shift = (r) => (piece.res ? { left: r.left + piece.res[0], right: r.right + piece.res[0], top: r.top + piece.res[1], bottom: r.bottom + piece.res[1] } : r);
        const own = () => clipRect(shift(asLTRB(piece.clip)));
        let rects = cache.get(key);
        if (rects) {
            if (!piece.clip) return rects;
            return rects.concat([own()]);
        }
        rects = [];
        const rec = this.doc.getById(piece.id);
        if (rec) {
            for (const m of this.doc.editGroup(rec.obj)) {
                const R = m.obj.attachRect;
                if (!R) continue;
                const Rl = { left: R.x0, top: R.y0, right: R.x1, bottom: R.y1 };
                const mapped = m.obj.below ? this.lm.mapRectObj(Rl, m.level, F, m.obj.below, m.level)
                    : (String(m.level) === String(F) ? Rl : this.lm.mapRectF(Rl, m.level, F));
                if (mapped) rects.push(clipRect(mapped));
            }
        }
        cache.set(key, rects);
        return piece.clip ? rects.concat([own()]) : rects;
    }
    _selEdges(dec, off = [0, 0]) {
        const W = this.width, H = this.height, sc = this.cam.inScale;
        const vp = this.cam.frameWindow(0);
        const rect = { x0: vp.left - off[0] / sc, y0: vp.top - off[1] / sc, x1: vp.right - off[0] / sc, y1: vp.bottom - off[1] / sc };
        const sides = { left: [], right: [], top: [], bottom: [] };
        let covered = false;
        const toY = (v) => v * sc + this.cam.inPanY + off[1], toX = (v) => v * sc + this.cam.inPanX + off[0];
        for (const p of dec.pieces) {
            const b = p.bounds;
            if (!b) continue;
            if (b.x1 < rect.x0 || b.x0 > rect.x1 || b.y1 < rect.y0 || b.y0 > rect.y1) continue;
            if (b.x0 >= rect.x0 && b.x1 <= rect.x1 && b.y0 >= rect.y0 && b.y1 <= rect.y1) continue;
            const sp = edgeSpans(p.loops, rect, (q) => insideLoops(p.loops, q), SEL_EDGE_INSET_PX / sc);
            if (sp.covered) covered = true;
            for (const [a, b2] of sp.left) sides.left.push([toY(a), toY(b2)]);
            for (const [a, b2] of sp.right) sides.right.push([toY(a), toY(b2)]);
            for (const [a, b2] of sp.top) sides.top.push([toX(a), toX(b2)]);
            for (const [a, b2] of sp.bottom) sides.bottom.push([toX(a), toX(b2)]);
        }
        const SIDE_LEN = { left: H, right: H, top: W, bottom: W };
        const list = [];
        for (const side of ["left", "right", "top", "bottom"]) {
            const merged = mergeSpans(sides[side], 1.5);
            const full = SIDE_LEN[side];
            for (const [a, b] of merged) {
                const lo = Math.max(0, a), hi = Math.min(full, b);
                if (hi - lo < 2) continue;
                list.push({ side, from: lo, to: hi, chevron: (hi - lo) >= full * SEL_CHEVRON_FRACTION });
            }
        }
        return { list, covered };
    }
}
export const overlays = Overlays.prototype;
//// src/engine/persist.js
import { validateScaleDef } from "./scaleBar";
import { inDigit, tilePhase } from "./frameLattice";
import {
    validEncodedLoops, encodedLoopsWellFormed, encodedLoopsNeedV2, repairLoops, decodeLoops,
    encodeLoops,
} from "./geometry/arcShape";
export const FORMAT = "boundless-drawing";
export const VERSION = 2;
export function encodeDrawing({ camera, crossings, natives, meta = {} }) {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const decoded = decodeMeta(meta, { lenient: true });
    const outMeta = {
        name: decoded.name,
        createdAt: decoded.createdAt,
        modifiedAt: now,
        app: "bound.less",
    };
    if (decoded.scaleDef) outMeta.scaleDef = decoded.scaleDef;
    if (decoded.scenes) outMeta.scenes = decoded.scenes;
    if (decoded.sceneIndex) outMeta.sceneIndex = decoded.sceneIndex;
    let version = 1;
    for (const l of Object.keys(natives || {})) {
        for (const o of natives[l] || []) {
            if (o && o.type === "shape" && encodedLoopsNeedV2(o.loops)) { version = VERSION; break; }
        }
        if (version === VERSION) break;
    }
    return {
        format: FORMAT,
        version,
        meta: outMeta,
        camera: {
            activeLevel: camera.activeLevel, inScale: camera.inScale,
            inPanX: camera.inPanX, inPanY: camera.inPanY,
            ...(camera.frame != null ? { frame: camera.frame } : {}),
        },
        crossings: crossings || {},
        natives: natives || {},
    };
}
export function decodeDrawing(raw) {
    if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object" || Array.isArray(raw)) {
        throw new Error("not a drawing: expected a JSON object");
    }
    if (raw.format === FORMAT) {
        if (!Number.isInteger(raw.version) || raw.version < 1) {
            throw new Error("not a drawing: missing or invalid version");
        }
        if (raw.version > VERSION) {
            throw new Error(`this drawing was saved by a newer version of bound.less (file v${raw.version}, app reads up to v${VERSION})`);
        }
        return {
            meta: decodeMeta(raw.meta),
            camera: decodeCamera(raw.camera),
            crossings: decodeCrossings(raw.crossings),
            natives: decodeNatives(raw.natives),
        };
    }
    if (raw.v === "dev-0" && raw.natives && typeof raw.natives === "object") {
        return {
            meta: decodeMeta(null),
            camera: decodeCamera(raw.camera),
            crossings: decodeCrossings(raw.crossings),
            natives: decodeNatives(raw.natives),
        };
    }
    throw new Error("not a bound.less drawing (unrecognized format)");
}
function decodeScaleDef(raw, { lenient = false } = {}) {
    if (raw == null) return null;
    const v = validateScaleDef(raw);
    if (!v) {
        if (lenient) return null;
        throw new Error("bad meta: scaleDef is malformed");
    }
    return v;
}
function decodeMeta(m, { lenient = false } = {}) {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const out = {
        name: m && typeof m.name === "string" && m.name.trim() ? m.name.trim().slice(0, 200) : "untitled",
        createdAt: m && typeof m.createdAt === "string" ? m.createdAt : now,
        modifiedAt: m && typeof m.modifiedAt === "string" ? m.modifiedAt : now,
    };
    if (m && m.scaleDef != null) {
        const sd = decodeScaleDef(m.scaleDef, { lenient });
        if (sd) out.scaleDef = sd;
    }
    if (m && Array.isArray(m.scenes)) {
        const scenes = m.scenes.filter(validScene).map(cloneScene);
        if (scenes.length) out.scenes = scenes;
    }
    if (m && Number.isInteger(m.sceneSeq) && m.sceneSeq > 0) out.sceneSeq = m.sceneSeq;
    const si = decodeSceneIndex(m && m.sceneIndex);
    if (si) out.sceneIndex = si;
    return out;
}
const MEMBERS = /^[0-9a-z.,]*$/;
const finite = (v) => typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v);
function decodeSceneIndex(si) {
    if (!si || typeof si !== "object" || si.v !== 3 || !Array.isArray(si.scenes)) return null;
    const idn = (s) => typeof s.id === "string" && s.id && s.id.length <= 40 && typeof s.name === "string" && isFrameKey(s.anchor);
    const named = (p) => p && typeof p.id === "string" && p.id && p.id.length <= 40 && (p.name == null || typeof p.name === "string");
    const nameOf = (p) => (typeof p.name === "string" ? p.name.slice(0, 120) : null);
    const scenes = si.scenes.filter((s) => s && idn(s) && typeof s.m === "string" && MEMBERS.test(s.m)).map((s) => ({
        id: s.id, seq: Number.isInteger(s.seq) ? s.seq : 0, name: s.name.slice(0, 120), named: !!s.named, anchor: s.anchor,
        ox: finite(s.ox) ? s.ox : 0, oy: finite(s.oy) ? s.oy : 0, version: Number.isInteger(s.version) ? s.version : 0,
        ...(typeof s.vtag === "string" && /^[0-9a-z]{1,12}$/.test(s.vtag) ? { vtag: s.vtag } : {}),
        Lmin: finite(s.Lmin) ? s.Lmin : 0, Lmax: finite(s.Lmax) ? s.Lmax : 0,
        ...(validRect(s.rect) ? { rect: cloneRect(s.rect) } : {}), m: s.m,
        ...(typeof s.e === "string" && s.e && MEMBERS.test(s.e) ? { e: s.e } : {}),
        ...(Array.isArray(s.parts) ? { parts: s.parts.filter((p) => named(p) && p.rect && finite(p.rect.x) && finite(p.rect.y) && finite(p.rect.w) && finite(p.rect.h))
            .slice(0, 256).map((p) => ({ id: p.id, seq: Number.isInteger(p.seq) ? p.seq : 0, name: nameOf(p), named: !!p.named, rect: { x: p.rect.x, y: p.rect.y, w: p.rect.w, h: p.rect.h } })) } : {}),
    }));
    const tomb = (Array.isArray(si.tomb) ? si.tomb : []).filter((t) => t && idn(t) && validRect(t.rect)).slice(-256).map((t) => ({
        id: t.id, seq: Number.isInteger(t.seq) ? t.seq : 0, name: t.name.slice(0, 120), named: !!t.named, anchor: t.anchor,
        rect: cloneRect(t.rect), Lmin: finite(t.Lmin) ? t.Lmin : 0, Lmax: finite(t.Lmax) ? t.Lmax : 0, t: finite(t.t) ? t.t : 0,
    }));
    const dirty = (Array.isArray(si.dirty) ? si.dirty : []).filter((id) => Number.isInteger(id));
    const pos = (v) => (Number.isInteger(v) && v > 0 ? v : 1);
    const out = { v: 3, seq: pos(si.seq), ver: pos(si.ver), pseq: pos(si.pseq), rseq: pos(si.rseq), scenes, tomb, dirty };
    if (Array.isArray(si.regions)) {
        out.regions = si.regions.filter((r) => named(r) && typeof r.parent === "string" && Array.isArray(r.kids) && r.kids.every((k) => typeof k === "string"))
            .slice(0, 4096).map((r) => ({ id: r.id, seq: Number.isInteger(r.seq) ? r.seq : 0, name: nameOf(r), named: !!r.named, parent: r.parent, kids: r.kids.slice(0, 4096) }));
    }
    if (Array.isArray(si.erase)) {
        out.erase = si.erase.filter((e) => e && Number.isInteger(e.id) && Number.isInteger(e.e) && Number.isInteger(e.host) && isFrameKey(e.home)
            && finite(e.w) && e.w > 0 && Array.isArray(e.raw) && e.raw.length && e.raw.length % 5 === 0 && e.raw.every(finite))
            .map((e) => ({ id: e.id, e: e.e, host: e.host, key: Number.isInteger(e.key) ? e.key : e.host, home: e.home, w: e.w, raw: e.raw.slice(), ...(e.off ? { off: true } : {}) }));
    }
    return out;
}
function validRect(r) {
    return r && isFiniteNum(r.x) && isFiniteNum(r.y)
        && isFiniteNum(r.w) && r.w > 0 && isFiniteNum(r.h) && r.h > 0;
}
const FRAME_ID = /^-?\d+(#\d+)?(\/-?\d+,-?\d+(#\d+)?)*$/;
function isFrameKey(v) {
    return Number.isInteger(v) || (typeof v === "string" && FRAME_ID.test(v));
}
function validScene(s) {
    return s && typeof s.id === "string" && s.id
        && typeof s.name === "string"
        && isFrameKey(s.level) && validRect(s.rect);
}
function cloneRect(r) { return { x: r.x, y: r.y, w: r.w, h: r.h }; }
function cloneScene(s) {
    return {
        id: s.id.slice(0, 40), name: s.name.slice(0, 120),
        level: s.level, rect: cloneRect(s.rect),
        pinned: !!s.pinned, auto: !!s.auto,
        ...(typeof s.hash === "string" ? { hash: s.hash.slice(0, 64) } : {}),
        ...(Number.isInteger(s.depth) && s.depth >= 0 ? { depth: s.depth } : {}),
        ...(typeof s.parent === "string" && s.parent ? { parent: s.parent.slice(0, 40) } : {}),
        ...(Number.isInteger(s.count) && s.count >= 0 ? { count: s.count } : {}),
        ...(s.kind === "part" || s.kind === "region" ? { kind: s.kind } : {}),
        ...(typeof s.region === "string" && s.region ? { region: s.region.slice(0, 40) } : {}),
    };
}
function decodeCamera(c) {
    if (c == null) return { activeLevel: 0, inScale: 1, inPanX: 0, inPanY: 0 };
    const out = {
        activeLevel: c.activeLevel == null ? 0 : c.activeLevel,
        inScale: c.inScale == null ? 1 : c.inScale,
        inPanX: c.inPanX == null ? 0 : c.inPanX,
        inPanY: c.inPanY == null ? 0 : c.inPanY,
    };
    if (c.frame != null) {
        if (typeof c.frame !== "string" || !c.frame) throw new Error("bad camera: frame must be a non-empty string");
        out.frame = c.frame;
    }
    if (!Number.isInteger(out.activeLevel)) throw new Error("bad camera: activeLevel must be an integer");
    if (!isFiniteNum(out.inScale) || out.inScale <= 0) throw new Error("bad camera: inScale must be a positive number");
    if (!isFiniteNum(out.inPanX) || !isFiniteNum(out.inPanY)) throw new Error("bad camera: pan must be finite");
    return out;
}
function decodeCrossings(cr) {
    if (cr == null) return { __lattice: 1, frames: [] };
    if (typeof cr !== "object" || Array.isArray(cr)) throw new Error("bad crossings: expected an object");
    if (!cr.__lattice) {
        if (Array.isArray(cr.__frames) || Object.keys(cr).length) {
            const e = new Error("This drawing was saved in the pre-lattice format and cannot be opened.");
            e.code = "LEGACY_FORMAT";
            throw e;
        }
        return { __lattice: 1, frames: [] };
    }
    if (!Array.isArray(cr.frames)) throw new Error("bad frames: expected a frames array");
    const ids = new Set();
    const outOfRange = [];
    for (const f of cr.frames) {
        if (!f || typeof f.id !== "string" || !f.id) throw new Error("bad frames: each frame needs a string id");
        if (ids.has(f.id)) throw new Error(`bad frames: duplicate frame id ${f.id}`);
        ids.add(f.id);
        if (!Number.isInteger(f.depth)) throw new Error(`bad frames: frame ${f.id} depth must be an integer`);
        if (f.parent != null && typeof f.parent !== "string") throw new Error(`bad frames: frame ${f.id} parent must be a string`);
        if (!Number.isInteger(f.i) || !Number.isInteger(f.j)) throw new Error(`bad frames: frame ${f.id} cell must be integers`);
        if (!inDigit(f.i) || !inDigit(f.j)) outOfRange.push(f.id);
    }
    if (outOfRange.length) cr.__outOfRangeCells = outOfRange;
    return cr;
}
function decodeNatives(n) {
    if (n == null) return { 0: [] };
    if (typeof n !== "object" || Array.isArray(n)) throw new Error("bad natives: expected an object of frames");
    const seen = new Set();
    for (const l of Object.keys(n)) {
        if (!FRAME_ID.test(l)) throw new Error(`bad natives: frame "${l}" is not a valid frame id`);
        if (!Array.isArray(n[l])) throw new Error(`bad natives: frame ${l} is not an array`);
        const survivors = [];
        for (const o of n[l]) {
            if (!o || typeof o !== "object") throw new Error(`bad object at level ${l}: not an object`);
            if (!Number.isInteger(o.id) || o.id < 1) throw new Error(`bad object at level ${l}: id must be a positive integer`);
            if (seen.has(o.id)) throw new Error(`bad natives: duplicate id ${o.id}`);
            seen.add(o.id);
            if (o.z != null && !isFiniteNum(o.z)) throw new Error(`bad object ${o.id}: z must be a number`);
            if (o.editId != null && (!Number.isInteger(o.editId) || o.editId < 1)) throw new Error(`bad object ${o.id}: editId must be a positive integer`);
            if (o.attachRect != null && !validOwnedRect(o.attachRect)) throw new Error(`bad object ${o.id}: attachRect is malformed`);
            if (o.below != null) {
                if (!Array.isArray(o.below) || !o.below.every((t) => Array.isArray(t) && t.length === 3
                    && Number.isInteger(t[0]) && t[0] >= 0 && isFiniteNum(t[1]) && isFiniteNum(t[2]))) {
                    throw new Error(`bad object ${o.id}: below (offsets under the home) is malformed`);
                }
            }
            if (o.tile != null) {
                if (!(Array.isArray(o.tile) && o.tile.length === 2
                    && isFiniteNum(o.tile[0]) && isFiniteNum(o.tile[1]))) {
                    throw new Error(`bad object ${o.id}: tile phase is malformed`);
                }
                o.tile = [tilePhase(o.tile[0]), tilePhase(o.tile[1])];
            }
            if (o.type === "stroke") {
                if (!validPts(o.pts) || o.pts.length < 1) throw new Error(`bad stroke ${o.id}: pts must be a non-empty array of finite [x,y]`);
                if (!isFiniteNum(o.lwFrame) || o.lwFrame <= 0) throw new Error(`bad stroke ${o.id}: lwFrame must be a positive number`);
            } else if (o.type === "fill") {
                if (!Array.isArray(o.polys) || !o.polys.length || !o.polys.every(validPts)) {
                    throw new Error(`bad fill ${o.id}: polys must be arrays of finite [x,y] rings`);
                }
            } else if (o.type === "shape") {
                if (!encodedLoopsWellFormed(o.loops)) {
                    throw new Error(`bad shape ${o.id}: loops must be arrays of finite numbers`);
                }
                if (!validEncodedLoops(o.loops)) {
                    const fixed = repairLoops(decodeLoops(o.loops), o.w);
                    if (!fixed.length) continue;
                    o.loops = encodeLoops(fixed);
                }
            } else {
                throw new Error(`bad object ${o.id}: unknown type "${o && o.type}"`);
            }
            survivors.push(o);
        }
        n[l] = survivors;
    }
    return n;
}
function validPts(pts) {
    return Array.isArray(pts) && pts.every((p) => Array.isArray(p) && isFiniteNum(p[0]) && isFiniteNum(p[1]));
}
function validOwnedRect(r) {
    return r && isFiniteNum(r.x0) && isFiniteNum(r.y0) && isFiniteNum(r.x1) && isFiniteNum(r.y1) &&
        r.x1 > r.x0 && r.y1 > r.y0;
}
function isFiniteNum(v) { return typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v); }
//// src/engine/raster/MovePlane.js
import { PLATE_PX, PREVIEW_QUANTA, QUANTA_PER_OCTAVE, plateKey, zqOf } from "./plate";
import { paintFamilies } from "./rasterPack";
export const MOVE_PLANE_LAYERS = 5;
export const MOVE_PLANE_PLATES = 40;
export const MOVE_PLANE_PLATES_PHONE = 24;
export const PLANE_COARSEN_MAX = 3;
export const PLANE_QUICK_OCTAVES = 2;
const PLANE_QUICK_MIN = 4;
const PLANE_SCALED_MAX = 16;
export const MOVE_HOLD_MS = 3000;
export const planeStats = {
    builds: 0, merged: 0, coarse: 0, overCap: 0, requests: 0, drags: 0, notReady: 0, lost: 0,
    quickSteps: 0, partialSteps: 0, stopgaps: 0, stopgapMsMax: 0,
    lands: 0, landTimeouts: 0, landMsMax: 0,
    composes: 0, underBlits: 0, inkBlits: 0, overBlits: 0, clipComposes: 0, maxLayers: 0,
    farListFallbacks: 0,
};
function idsHash(ids) {
    let a = 0, b = 0;
    for (const id of ids) {
        let h = Math.imul(Number(id) ^ 0x9e3779b9, 0x85ebca6b);
        h ^= h >>> 13; h = Math.imul(h, 0xc2b2ae35); h ^= h >>> 16;
        a = (a + h) | 0; b ^= h;
    }
    return (a >>> 0).toString(36) + "." + (b >>> 0).toString(36) + "." + ids.size;
}
function rangeOf(cells) {
    if (!cells.length) return null;
    let i0 = Infinity, i1 = -Infinity, j0 = Infinity, j1 = -Infinity;
    for (const [i, j] of cells) { if (i < i0) i0 = i; if (i > i1) i1 = i; if (j < j0) j0 = j; if (j > j1) j1 = j; }
    return { i0, i1, j0, j1 };
}
export default class MovePlane {
    constructor() {
        this.stats = planeStats;
        this.gen = 0;
        this._reset();
    }
    _reset() {
        this.sel = null;
        this.ids = null;
        this.list = null;
        this.frameId = null; this.q = null; this.Zq = 1;
        this.main = null;
        this.quick = null;
        this.cur = null;
        this.partial = false;
        this.stop = null;
        this.layers = [];
        this.selIds = null;
        this.max = 0;
        this.tags = [];
        this.r = null;
        this.selR = null;
        this.keys = [];
        this.state = "idle";
        this.ready = false;
        this.off = [0, 0];
        this.landUntil = 0;
        this.landAt = 0;
        this.refused = false;
        this.gen = (this.gen || 0) + 1;
    }
    get showing() { return this.state === "drag" || this.state === "land"; }
    aim(st, list, view, cfg, max, dpr = 1, live = null) {
        if (this.state === "drag" || this.state === "land") return true;
        const same = st && this.sel === st.key && this.frameId === view.frameId && this.q === view.q && this.Zq === view.Zq;
        if (!same) {
            this._reset();
            if (!st || !st.ids || !st.ids.size) return false;
            this.sel = st.key; this.frameId = view.frameId; this.q = view.q; this.Zq = view.Zq;
            planeStats.builds++;
        }
        if (this.list !== list || this.ids !== st.ids || this.max !== max) {
            this.list = list; this.ids = st.ids; this.max = max;
            this._cut(list, st.ids, view, cfg, max, dpr, live);
        }
        return !this.refused;
    }
    _cut(list, ids, view, cfg, max, dpr, live) {
        this.main = null; this.quick = null; this.cur = null; this.stop = null; this.ready = false; this.partial = false;
        this.layers = []; this.keys = []; this.tags = []; this.r = null; this.selR = null; this.selIds = null; this.refused = true;
        const s = view.Zq / PLATE_PX;
        const runs = [];
        for (const f of paintFamilies(list, view.q, view.Zq, dpr, cfg, live)) {
            if (f.all.length && f.all.every((d) => d.o.erase)) continue;
            let sel = false, on = false;
            for (const d of f.all) {
                if (ids.has(d.o.id)) sel = true;
                const b = d.box;
                if (Math.floor(b[2] * s) >= view.i0 && Math.floor(b[0] * s) <= view.i1 && Math.floor(b[3] * s) >= view.j0 && Math.floor(b[1] * s) <= view.j1) on = true;
            }
            if (!on) continue;
            let run = runs[runs.length - 1];
            if (!run || run.sel !== sel) runs.push(run = { sel, ids: new Set(), boxes: [] });
            for (const d of f.all) { run.ids.add(d.o.id); run.boxes.push(d.box); }
        }
        if (!runs.some((r) => r.sel)) { this.refused = true; return; }
        if (!runs[0].sel) runs.shift();
        const nLayers = runs.length + 1;
        if (nLayers > planeStats.maxLayers) planeStats.maxLayers = nLayers;
        while (runs.length + 1 > MOVE_PLANE_LAYERS) {
            let m = -1;
            for (let k = 1; k < runs.length - 1; k++) if (!runs[k].sel && (m < 0 || runs[k].boxes.length < runs[m].boxes.length)) m = k;
            if (m < 0) break;
            const a = runs[m - 1], b = runs[m + 1];
            for (const id of b.ids) a.ids.add(id);
            for (const x of b.boxes) a.boxes.push(x);
            runs.splice(m, 2);
            planeStats.merged++;
        }
        this.selIds = new Set();
        for (const r of runs) if (r.sel) for (const id of r.ids) this.selIds.add(id);
        const capAt = (k) => (k || view.s !== 1 ? Math.min(max, PLANE_SCALED_MAX) : max);
        let main = null;
        for (let k = 0; k <= PLANE_COARSEN_MAX && !main; k++) {
            const L = this._level(runs, view, k);
            if (L.plates <= capAt(k)) main = L;
            else if (k === PLANE_COARSEN_MAX) { main = L; planeStats.overCap++; }
        }
        if (main.k) planeStats.coarse++;
        if (main.plates > PLANE_QUICK_MIN) {
            const Q = this._level(runs, view, main.k + PLANE_QUICK_OCTAVES);
            if (Q.plates < main.plates && main.plates + Q.plates <= max && Q.plates <= PLANE_SCALED_MAX) this.quick = Q;
        }
        this.main = main;
        this.layers = main.layers;
        this.r = main.r; this.selR = main.selR;
        for (const L of [main, this.quick]) if (L) { for (const t of L.tags) this.tags.push(t); for (const key of L.keys) this.keys.push(key); }
        this.refused = false;
    }
    _level(runs, view, k) {
        let pq = view.q, pZq = view.Zq;
        if (k) {
            const q0 = typeof view.q === "number" ? view.q : Math.floor(Math.log2(view.Zq) * QUANTA_PER_OCTAVE + 1e-9);
            pq = q0 - k * QUANTA_PER_OCTAVE; pZq = zqOf(pq);
        }
        const f = pZq / view.Zq, s = pZq / PLATE_PX;
        const vi0 = Math.floor(view.i0 * f), vi1 = Math.floor((view.i1 + 1) * f - 1e-9);
        const vj0 = Math.floor(view.j0 * f), vj1 = Math.floor((view.j1 + 1) * f - 1e-9);
        const cellsOf = (boxes) => {
            const out = new Set();
            for (const b of boxes) {
                const i0 = Math.max(Math.floor(b[0] * s), vi0), i1 = Math.min(Math.floor(b[2] * s), vi1);
                const j0 = Math.max(Math.floor(b[1] * s), vj0), j1 = Math.min(Math.floor(b[3] * s), vj1);
                for (let j = j0; j <= j1; j++) for (let i = i0; i <= i1; i++) out.add(i + "," + j);
            }
            return out;
        };
        const toList = (set) => [...set].map((c) => c.split(",").map(Number));
        const below = new Set(), omit = new Set(), per = [];
        for (const r of runs) {
            const c = cellsOf(r.boxes);
            per.push(c);
            for (const x of c) below.add(x);
            for (const id of r.ids) omit.add(id);
        }
        const layers = [{ kind: "below", cells: toList(below), omit }];
        runs.forEach((r, n) => layers.push({ kind: r.sel ? "sel" : "over", cells: toList(per[n]), ids: r.ids }));
        const tags = [], keys = [];
        let plates = 0;
        layers.forEach((L, n) => {
            L.tag = "z" + n + "_" + pq + "_" + idsHash(L.kind === "below" ? L.omit : L.ids);
            tags.push(L.tag);
            plates += L.cells.length;
            for (const [i, j] of L.cells) keys.push(plateKey(this.frameId, L.tag, i, j));
        });
        const selCells = [].concat(...layers.filter((L) => L.kind === "sel").map((L) => L.cells));
        return { k, pq, pZq, layers, tags, keys, plates, r: rangeOf(layers[0].cells), selR: rangeOf(selCells), below };
    }
    farLevels() {
        return [this.quick, this.main].filter((lvl) => lvl && lvl.list === undefined && !lvl.listPending && lvl.k * QUANTA_PER_OCTAVE > PREVIEW_QUANTA);
    }
    coverOf(lvl) {
        const r = lvl.r, u = PLATE_PX / lvl.pZq;
        return r ? { left: r.i0 * u, top: r.j0 * u, right: (r.i1 + 1) * u, bottom: (r.j1 + 1) * u } : null;
    }
    requests(list) {
        if (this.refused || !this.main || this.state === "land") return null;
        const out = [];
        for (const lvl of [this.quick, this.main]) {
            if (!lvl || lvl.listPending) continue;
            for (const L of lvl.layers) {
                const base = { frameId: this.frameId, Zq: lvl.pZq, q: L.tag, list: lvl.list || list, offCam: true, prio: 2, mode: "plane", cells: L.cells };
                out.push(L.kind === "below" ? { ...base, omit: L.omit } : { ...base, only: L.ids, paper: [0, 0, 0, 0] });
            }
        }
        return out;
    }
    _whole(lvl, store, selOnly = false) {
        if (!lvl) return false;
        for (const L of lvl.layers) {
            if (selOnly && L.kind !== "sel") continue;
            for (const [i, j] of L.cells) { const e = store.get(plateKey(this.frameId, L.tag, i, j)); if (!e || e.dead) return false; }
        }
        return true;
    }
    checkReady(store) {
        if (!this.ready && this._whole(this.main, store)) this.ready = true;
        return this.ready;
    }
    pick(store) {
        this.partial = false;
        if (this.checkReady(store)) return (this.cur = this.main);
        if (this._whole(this.quick, store)) return (this.cur = this.quick);
        for (const lvl of [this.main, this.quick]) if (this._whole(lvl, store, true)) { this.partial = true; return (this.cur = lvl); }
        this.cur = null;
        return null;
    }
    dragTo(dxCss, dyCss, dpr) {
        if (this.state !== "drag") planeStats.drags++;
        this.state = "drag";
        this.off[0] = Math.round(dxCss * dpr);
        this.off[1] = Math.round(dyCss * dpr);
    }
    land(now) {
        if (this.state !== "drag") return false;
        this.state = "land";
        this.landAt = now;
        this.landUntil = now + MOVE_HOLD_MS;
        planeStats.lands++;
        return true;
    }
    landCells(v) {
        const lvl = this.cur || this.main;
        const r = lvl && lvl.r, sr = lvl && lvl.selR;
        if (!r || !sr) return null;
        const f = v.Zq / lvl.pZq;
        const ex = this.off[0] / (PLATE_PX * v.s), ey = this.off[1] / (PLATE_PX * v.s);
        const i0 = Math.min(Math.floor(r.i0 * f), Math.floor(sr.i0 * f + ex));
        const i1 = Math.max(Math.ceil((r.i1 + 1) * f) - 1, Math.ceil((sr.i1 + 1) * f + ex) - 1);
        const j0 = Math.min(Math.floor(r.j0 * f), Math.floor(sr.j0 * f + ey));
        const j1 = Math.max(Math.ceil((r.j1 + 1) * f) - 1, Math.ceil((sr.j1 + 1) * f + ey) - 1);
        return { i0: Math.max(i0, v.i0), i1: Math.min(i1, v.i1), j0: Math.max(j0, v.j0), j1: Math.min(j1, v.j1) };
    }
}
//// src/engine/raster/OverlayLayer.js
import { OverlayBuffer, paintPhase, ANT_PHASES, ANT_STEP_MS, ANT_LOOK, selAntScale } from "./antPaint";
export const SEL_CRAWL_RESUME_MS = 150;
export const OVERLAY_UNCOVERED_MS = 150;
const EDGE_STRIP_CSS = ANT_LOOK.W + 1;
const SIDES = ["left", "right", "top", "bottom"];
function snapPx(x) { return Math.round(x); }
function mkCanvas(w, h) {
    if (typeof document === "undefined" || !document.createElement) return null;
    const c = document.createElement("canvas");
    c.width = w; c.height = h;
    return c;
}
function mkImageData(data, w, h) {
    if (typeof ImageData !== "function" || !(w > 0) || !(h > 0)) return null;
    try { return new ImageData(data, w, h); } catch (e) { return null; }
}
const now = () => (typeof performance !== "undefined" && performance.now ? performance.now() : Date.now());
function prefersReducedMotion() {
    if (typeof window === "undefined" || typeof window.matchMedia !== "function") return false;
    try { return !!window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches; } catch (e) { return false; }
}
export default class OverlayLayer {
    constructor(host, opts = {}) {
        this.host = host || null;
        this._mk = opts.makeCanvas || mkCanvas;
        this._mkImg = opts.makeImageData || mkImageData;
        this._now = opts.now || now;
        this._setTimer = opts.setTimer || ((fn, ms) => setTimeout(fn, ms));
        this._clearTimer = opts.clearTimer || ((t) => clearTimeout(t));
        this.perf = opts.perf || null;
        this.dpr = opts.dpr > 0 ? opts.dpr
            : (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.devicePixelRatio > 0 ? window.devicePixelRatio : 1);
        this.cssW = opts.width > 0 ? opts.width : 0;
        this.cssH = opts.height > 0 ? opts.height : 0;
        this._reduced = opts.reducedMotion != null ? !!opts.reducedMotion : prefersReducedMotion();
        this._canvas = null; this._ctx = null;
        this.buf = null; this._img = null;
        this._strips = [null, null, null, null];
        this._dec = null;
        this._key = null; this._kt = 1;
        this._shown = false;
        this._planeDirty = true;
        this._view = { k: 1, tx: 0, ty: 0 };
        this._paintAt = { k: 1, tx: 0, ty: 0 };
        this._css = { dpr: this.dpr, ink: opts.ink || null };
        this._t = { s: 1, dx: 0, dy: 0 };
        this._q = null; this._Zq = null; this._mode = null;
        this._phase = 0;
        this._timer = null; this._resume = null;
        this._frozen = false;
        this._lastRepaintAt = -Infinity;
        this._edgeRuns = [];
        this._edgeDec = { runs: [], marks: [], inkPx: null };
        this._edgeView = { k: 1, tx: 0, ty: 0 };
        this._rep = {
            phases: 0, lastPhaseMs: 0, pixels: 0, bytes: 0, repaints: 0,
            decideMs: 0, paintMs: 0, blitMs: 0, blitPx: 0, dashes: 0, stamps: 0,
            refused: 0, nonFinite: 0,
            uncoveredPx: 0, uncoveredFrames: 0, uncoveredWorst: 0, repaintsDuringGesture: 0,
            transforms: 0, blits: 0, allocs: 0, noImageData: 0, stripBytes: 0, edgeDashes: 0,
        };
    }
    get planeW() { return snapPx(this.cssW * this.dpr); }
    get planeH() { return snapPx(this.cssH * this.dpr); }
    _style(c, cssW, cssH, z) {
        if (!c.style) return;
        c.style.position = "absolute";
        c.style.left = "0"; c.style.top = "0";
        c.style.transformOrigin = "0 0";
        c.style.pointerEvents = "none";
        c.style.zIndex = String(z);
        c.style.width = cssW + "px";
        c.style.height = cssH + "px";
    }
    _mount() {
        if (this._canvas) return this._canvas;
        const w = this.planeW, h = this.planeH;
        const c = this._mk(w, h);
        if (!c) return null;
        c.width = w; c.height = h;
        this._style(c, this.cssW, this.cssH, 2);
        if (c.style) c.style.willChange = "transform";
        if (c.setAttribute) { c.setAttribute("class", "bl-overlay"); c.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true"); }
        this._ctx = c.getContext ? c.getContext("2d") : null;
        this._canvas = c;
        return c;
    }
    _mountStrips() {
        const dpr = this.dpr, t = Math.max(2, Math.ceil(EDGE_STRIP_CSS * dpr));
        const W = this.planeW, H = this.planeH;
        let bytes = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            const side = SIDES[i];
            const w = (side === "top" || side === "bottom") ? W : t;
            const h = (side === "top" || side === "bottom") ? t : H;
            let s = this._strips[i];
            if (s && s.w === w && s.h === h && s.buf) { bytes += s.buf.bytes; continue; }
            if (!s) {
                const c = this._mk(w, h);
                if (!c) continue;
                if (c.setAttribute) { c.setAttribute("class", "bl-overlay-edge"); c.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true"); }
                s = { side, canvas: c, ctx: c.getContext ? c.getContext("2d") : null, buf: null, img: null, w: 0, h: 0 };
                this._strips[i] = s;
            }
            s.w = w; s.h = h;
            s.canvas.width = w; s.canvas.height = h;
            this._style(s.canvas, w / dpr, h / dpr, 2);
            if (s.canvas.style) {
                if (side === "right") s.canvas.style.left = (W - w) / dpr + "px";
                if (side === "bottom") s.canvas.style.top = (H - h) / dpr + "px";
            }
            if (s.buf) s.buf.resize(w, h); else s.buf = new OverlayBuffer(w, h);
            s.img = this._mkImg(s.buf.data, w, h);
            if (!s.img) this._rep.noImageData++;
            this._rep.allocs++;
            bytes += s.buf.bytes;
        }
        this._rep.stripBytes = bytes;
    }
    _ensurePlane() {
        const w = this.planeW, h = this.planeH;
        if (!this.buf) {
            this.buf = new OverlayBuffer(w, h);
            this._img = this._mkImg(this.buf.data, w, h);
            if (!this._img) this._rep.noImageData++;
            this._rep.allocs++;
            this._planeDirty = true;
        } else if (this.buf.resize(w, h)) {
            this._img = this._mkImg(this.buf.data, w, h);
            if (!this._img) this._rep.noImageData++;
            this._rep.allocs++;
            this._planeDirty = true;
        }
        this._mountStrips();
        return this.buf;
    }
    _attach() {
        if (this._shown || !this.host || !this.host.appendChild) return;
        if (this._canvas) this.host.appendChild(this._canvas);
        for (const s of this._strips) if (s && s.canvas) this.host.appendChild(s.canvas);
        this._shown = true;
    }
    _detach() {
        const els = [this._canvas].concat(this._strips.map((s) => s && s.canvas));
        for (const c of els) if (c && c.parentNode && c.parentNode.removeChild) c.parentNode.removeChild(c);
        this._shown = false;
    }
    setTransform(s, dx, dy) {
        const t = this._t;
        t.s = s; t.dx = dx; t.dy = dy;
        this._rep.transforms++;
        const c = this._canvas;
        if (c && c.style) c.style.transform = "matrix(" + s + ", 0, 0, " + s + ", " + dx + ", " + dy + ")";
    }
    _applyTransform() {
        const p = this._paintAt, v = this._view;
        const s = p.k > 0 && isFinite(p.k) ? v.k / p.k : 1;
        this.setTransform(s, (v.tx - p.tx * s) / this.dpr, (v.ty - p.ty * s) / this.dpr);
    }
    _readView(view, dec) {
        const v = this._view;
        v.k = view.k; v.tx = view.tx; v.ty = view.ty;
        const off = dec && dec.off;
        if (off && off.length === 2) {
            v.tx += Math.round(off[0] * this.dpr);
            v.ty += Math.round(off[1] * this.dpr);
        }
        return v;
    }
    _paint(phase, repaint) {
        const buf = this._ensurePlane();
        if (!buf || !this._dec) return;
        const t0 = this._now();
        const r = paintPhase(buf, this._dec, this._view, phase, this._css);
        const t1 = this._now();
        const p = this._paintAt, v = this._view;
        p.k = v.k; p.tx = v.tx; p.ty = v.ty;
        this.setTransform(1, 0, 0);
        this.blit();
        const rep = this._rep;
        rep.paintMs = t1 - t0; rep.lastPhaseMs = t1 - t0;
        rep.dashes = r.dashes; rep.stamps = r.stamps; rep.pixels = r.pixels;
        rep.refused += r.refused; rep.nonFinite += r.nonFinite;
        rep.phases++;
        this._planeDirty = false;
        this._lastRepaintAt = this._now();
        if (repaint) {
            rep.repaints++;
            if (this._frozen) rep.repaintsDuringGesture++;
        }
        rep.uncoveredPx = 0;
    }
    blit(rect) {
        const buf = this.buf, ctx = this._ctx, img = this._img;
        this._rep.blitMs = 0; this._rep.blitPx = 0;
        if (!buf || !ctx || !img) return 0;
        const r = rect || buf.dirty;
        const x0 = Math.max(0, r.x0 | 0), y0 = Math.max(0, r.y0 | 0);
        const x1 = Math.min(buf.width, r.x1 | 0), y1 = Math.min(buf.height, r.y1 | 0);
        if (x1 <= x0 || y1 <= y0) return 0;
        const t0 = this._now();
        ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0, x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0);
        this._rep.blitMs = this._now() - t0;
        this._rep.blitPx = (x1 - x0) * (y1 - y0);
        this._rep.blits++;
        return this._rep.blitPx;
    }
    _paintEdges(dec, shift) {
        const edges = (dec && dec.edges) || [];
        const dpr = this.dpr, kt = this._kt;
        const inset = (ANT_LOOK.W * kt / 2) * dpr;
        const sx = shift ? shift[0] * dpr : 0, sy = shift ? shift[1] * dpr : 0;
        this._edgeDec.inkPx = dec ? dec.inkPx : null;
        let painted = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            const s = this._strips[i];
            if (!s || !s.buf) continue;
            const side = SIDES[i];
            const runs = this._edgeDec.runs;
            runs.length = 0;
            for (let j = 0; j < edges.length; j++) {
                const e = edges[j];
                if (e.side !== side) continue;
                const run = this._edgeRun(runs.length);
                const p = run.pieces[0];
                if (side === "left" || side === "right") {
                    const x = side === "left" ? inset : s.w - inset;
                    p.A[0] = x; p.B[0] = x;
                    p.A[1] = e.from * dpr + sy; p.B[1] = e.to * dpr + sy;
                } else {
                    const y = side === "top" ? inset : s.h - inset;
                    p.A[1] = y; p.B[1] = y;
                    p.A[0] = e.from * dpr + sx; p.B[0] = e.to * dpr + sx;
                }
                runs.push(run);
            }
            const r = paintPhase(s.buf, this._edgeDec, this._edgeView, this._phase, this._css);
            painted += r.dashes;
            const d = s.buf.dirty;
            if (s.ctx && s.img && d.x1 > d.x0 && d.y1 > d.y0) {
                s.ctx.putImageData(s.img, 0, 0, d.x0, d.y0, d.x1 - d.x0, d.y1 - d.y0);
            }
        }
        this._rep.edgeDashes = painted;
    }
    _edgeRun(i) {
        let r = this._edgeRuns[i];
        if (!r) {
            r = { pieces: [{ line: true, A: [0, 0], B: [0, 0] }], closed: false, len: 0 };
            this._edgeRuns[i] = r;
            this._rep.allocs++;
        }
        return r;
    }
    _arm() {
        if (this._timer != null || !this._shown || this._reduced || !this._dec) return;
        this._timer = this._setTimer(() => { this._timer = null; this.step(); this._arm(); }, ANT_STEP_MS);
    }
    _disarm() {
        if (this._timer != null) { this._clearTimer(this._timer); this._timer = null; }
        if (this._resume != null) { this._clearTimer(this._resume); this._resume = null; }
    }
    freeze() {
        this._frozen = true;
        if (this._resume != null) { this._clearTimer(this._resume); this._resume = null; }
        this._resume = this._setTimer(() => { this._resume = null; this.resume(); }, SEL_CRAWL_RESUME_MS);
    }
    resume() { this._frozen = false; }
    step() {
        if (!this._dec || !this._shown || this._reduced) return;
        if (this._frozen) { this._maybeUncovered(); this._note(); return; }
        this._phase = (this._phase + 1) % ANT_PHASES;
        this._paint(this._phase, this._planeDirty);
        this._note();
    }
    _note() {
        if (this.perf && this.perf.noteCrawl) this.perf.noteCrawl(this.report());
    }
    _uncoveredPx() {
        const W = this.planeW, H = this.planeH;
        if (!(W > 0) || !(H > 0)) return 0;
        const t = this._t, dpr = this.dpr;
        const x0 = t.dx * dpr, y0 = t.dy * dpr;
        const x1 = x0 + W * t.s, y1 = y0 + H * t.s;
        const w = Math.min(W, x1) - Math.max(0, x0), h = Math.min(H, y1) - Math.max(0, y0);
        const cov = (w > 0 ? w : 0) * (h > 0 ? h : 0);
        const un = W * H - cov;
        return un > 0 ? Math.round(un) : 0;
    }
    _maybeUncovered() {
        const un = this._uncoveredPx();
        const rep = this._rep;
        rep.uncoveredPx = un;
        if (un <= 0) return;
        rep.uncoveredFrames++;
        const f = un / (this.planeW * this.planeH);
        if (f > rep.uncoveredWorst) rep.uncoveredWorst = f;
        if (this._now() - this._lastRepaintAt >= OVERLAY_UNCOVERED_MS) this._paint(this._phase, true);
    }
    show(dec, view, shift) {
        const runs = (dec && dec.runs) || [], marks = (dec && dec.marks) || [], edges = (dec && dec.edges) || [];
        if (!dec || !view || !(runs.length || marks.length || edges.length)) { this.hide(); return; }
        if (!this._mount()) return;
        this._ensurePlane();
        this._attach();
        this._dec = dec;
        const kt = selAntScale(dec.inkPx);
        this._readView(view, dec);
        const moved = view.q !== this._q || view.Zq !== this._Zq || view.mode !== this._mode;
        const changed = dec.key !== this._key || kt !== this._kt;
        const repaint = moved || changed || this._planeDirty;
        this._key = dec.key; this._kt = kt;
        this._q = view.q; this._Zq = view.Zq; this._mode = view.mode;
        if (repaint) this._paint(this._phase, true);
        else this._applyTransform();
        this.freeze();
        this._arm();
        this._paintEdges(dec, shift);
        if (!repaint) this._maybeUncovered();
    }
    hide() {
        if (!this._shown && !this._dec) return;
        this._disarm();
        this._detach();
        this._dec = null; this._key = null;
        this._frozen = false;
        this._rep.uncoveredPx = 0;
    }
    setSize(cssW, cssH, dpr) {
        const d = dpr > 0 ? dpr : this.dpr;
        if (cssW === this.cssW && cssH === this.cssH && d === this.dpr) return false;
        this.cssW = cssW; this.cssH = cssH; this.dpr = d; this._css.dpr = d;
        const c = this._canvas;
        if (c) {
            c.width = this.planeW; c.height = this.planeH;
            this._style(c, cssW, cssH, 2);
            if (c.style) c.style.willChange = "transform";
        }
        this._ensurePlane();
        if (this._dec && this._shown) this._paint(this._phase, true);
        return true;
    }
    onStoreRelease(reason) {
        this.buf = null; this._img = null;
        for (const s of this._strips) if (s) { s.buf = null; s.img = null; s.w = 0; s.h = 0; }
        this._rep.stripBytes = 0;
        this._planeDirty = true;
        return reason;
    }
    destroy() {
        this._disarm();
        this._detach();
        this._canvas = null; this._ctx = null;
        this.buf = null; this._img = null;
        this._strips = [null, null, null, null];
        this._dec = null; this._key = null;
        this._rep.stripBytes = 0;
        this._planeDirty = true;
    }
    setReducedMotion(v) {
        const was = this._reduced;
        this._reduced = !!v;
        if (this._reduced) { this._disarm(); this._phase = 0; if (this._dec && this._shown) this._paint(0, true); }
        else if (was) this._arm();
    }
    noteDecide(ms) { this._rep.decideMs = ms > 0 ? ms : 0; }
    report() {
        const r = this._rep;
        r.bytes = this.buf ? this.buf.bytes : 0;
        return r;
    }
}

import { PLATE_PX, QUANTA_PER_OCTAVE, QUANTUM_HYSTERESIS, PREVIEW_QUANTA, quantumFor, zqOf, plateRange, plateKey, plateOriginPx } from "./plate";
