function ensure() {
    if (F) return;
    F = new Float32Array(ROWS * STRIDE);
    I = new Int32Array(ROWS * STRIDE);
    W = new Float64Array(ROWS);
    jobs = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < JOBS_KEPT; k++) jobs.push(mkJobRec());
    drops = [];
    for (let k = 0; k < DROPS_KEPT; k++) drops.push(mkDropRec());
    stats.allocs += 5;
}
function mkJobRec() {
    return { t: 0, frameSeq: 0, jobId: 0, plates: 0, postedToArrivedMs: 0, queueWaitMs: 0, queueingMs: 0,
        workerMs: 0, serialiseMs: 0, postMs: 0, recvMs: 0, bytesIn: 0, bytesOut: 0,
        inline: false, stale: 0 };
}
function mkDropRec() {
    return { t: 0, why: "", before: false, jobId: 0, frameSeq: 0, q: "", frameId: "", epoch: 0,
        plates: 0, stale: 0 };
}
export function attach(s) {
    src = s || {};
    if (typeof src.now === "function") clock = src.now;
    if (typeof src.wall === "function") wall = src.wall;
}
export function detach() { src = {}; }
export function beginFrame(frameSeq, kind) {
    ensure();
    if (open >= 0) { stats.unclosed++; closeRow(FLAG.truncated); }
    open = head;
    const base = open * STRIDE;
    F.fill(0, base, base + STRIDE);
    I.fill(0, base, base + STRIDE);
    W[open] = wall();
    openT0 = clock();
    openQueuedAt = 0;
    I[base + C.frameSeq] = frameSeq | 0;
    I[base + C.kind] = kindCode(kind);
    I[base + C.q] = Q_UNKNOWN;
    return open;
}
export function endFrame() {
    if (open < 0) { stats.orphanEnds++; return null; }
    const base = open * STRIDE;
    const end = clock();
    const ms = end - openT0;
    F[base + T.mainMs] = ms;
    const t0 = openT0;
    const row = closeRow(0, end);
    if (src.notePerf && I[(row * STRIDE) + C.kind] === K_RENDER
        && (ms >= PERF_FLOOR_MS || traceOn())) {
        src.notePerf("rasterRender", t0, perfExtra(row));
    }
    return row;
}
export function add(slot, ms) {
    if (open < 0) { stats.orphanAdds++; return; }
    if (!(ms >= 0) || !isFinite(ms)) return;
    F[(open * STRIDE) + slot] += ms;
}
export function bump(slot, n) {
    if (open < 0) { stats.orphanAdds++; return; }
    I[(open * STRIDE) + slot] += n | 0;
}
export function noteView(view) {
    if (!view) return;
    lastView.mode = String(view.mode || "");
    lastView.q = view.q;
    lastView.Zq = +view.Zq || 0;
    lastView.s = +view.s || 0;
    lastView.dpr = +view.dpr || 0;
    lastView.rev = +view.rev || 0;
    lastView.frameId = String(view.frameId == null ? "" : view.frameId);
    if (open < 0) return;
    const base = open * STRIDE;
    I[base + C.q] = qCode(view.q);
    I[base + C.mode] = MODES.indexOf(lastView.mode) < 0 ? 0 : MODES.indexOf(lastView.mode);
    I[base + C.sMilli] = Math.round((+view.s || 0) * 1000);
    if (lastView.mode === "sync") I[base + C.flags] |= FLAG.rasOnMain;
}
function closeRow(extraFlags, endAt) {
    const row = open;
    const base = row * STRIDE;
    if (extraFlags) I[base + C.flags] |= extraFlags;
    const needEnd = extraFlags === FLAG.truncated || (openQueuedAt > 0 && !F[base + T.wallMs]);
    const end = needEnd && endAt == null ? clock() : endAt;
    if (extraFlags === FLAG.truncated) F[base + T.mainMs] = end - openT0;
    if (openQueuedAt > 0 && !F[base + T.wallMs]) F[base + T.wallMs] = end - openQueuedAt;
    const sync = (I[base + C.flags] & FLAG.rasOnMain) !== 0;
    let main = 0;
    for (const s of MAIN_PART) main += F[base + s];
    if (sync) for (const s of SYNC_PART) main += F[base + s];
    F[base + T.residualMain] = F[base + T.mainMs] - main;
    if (F[base + T.wallMs] > 0) {
        let w = 0;
        for (const s of WALL_PART) w += F[base + s];
        F[base + T.residualWall] = F[base + T.wallMs] - w;
    }
    for (let s = 0; s < TIMERS.length; s++) totalsT[s] += F[base + s];
    if (!sync) for (const s of PLATE_PART) workerT[s] += F[base + s];
    for (let s = C.platesWanted; s < COUNTS.length; s++) totalsC[s] += I[base + s];
    bucketOf(histMain, F[base + T.mainMs]);
    if (F[base + T.wallMs] > 0) bucketOf(histWall, F[base + T.wallMs]);
    kindRows[I[base + C.kind]]++;
    stats.rows++;
    if (nPending < PENDING_MAX) {
        pending[nPending * 2] = row;
        pending[nPending * 2 + 1] = I[base + C.frameSeq];
        nPending++;
        I[base + C.flags] |= FLAG.inferredPending;
    } else {
        stats.pendingLost++;
    }
    head = (head + 1) % ROWS;
    if (head === 0) wraps++;
    if (used < ROWS) used++;
    open = -1;
    return row;
}
function perfExtra(row) {
    const base = row * STRIDE;
    return { frameSeq: I[base + C.frameSeq], kind: KINDS[I[base + C.kind]],
        mainMs: ms3(F[base + T.mainMs]), residualMs: ms3(F[base + T.residualMain]) };
}
export function noteSubmit(req, nPlates, nStrips) {
    ensure();
    const seq = req && req.frameSeq != null ? req.frameSeq | 0 : 0;
    subSeq[subAt] = seq;
    subT[subAt] = clock();
    subLeft[subAt] = Math.max(1, nStrips | 0);
    subAt = (subAt + 1) % SUBMITS;
    if (nSub < SUBMITS) nSub++;
    if (open < 0) return;
    const base = open * STRIDE;
    I[base + C.jobsPosted] += nStrips | 0;
    I[base + C.misses] += nPlates | 0;
    I[base + C.platesWanted] += nPlates | 0;
}
function queuedAtFor(seq, postedAt) {
    let spent = -1;
    for (let k = 0; k < nSub; k++) {
        const at = (subAt - 1 - k + SUBMITS * 2) % SUBMITS;
        if (subSeq[at] !== seq || subT[at] > postedAt) continue;
        if (subLeft[at] > 0) { subLeft[at]--; return subT[at]; }
        if (spent < 0) spent = at;
    }
    return spent < 0 ? -1 : subT[spent];
}
export function noteJob(info, res) {
    ensure();
    stats.jobs++;
    if (open < 0) { stats.orphanAdds++; return; }
    const base = open * STRIDE;
    I[base + C.flags] |= FLAG.hasJob;
    const q = queuedAtFor(info.frameSeq | 0, info.postedAt);
    if (q < 0) stats.noQueuedAt++;
    else {
        if (info.postedAt > q) F[base + T.queueWait] += info.postedAt - q;
        if (!openQueuedAt || q < openQueuedAt) openQueuedAt = q;
    }
    F[base + T.queueing] += +info.queueingMs || 0;
    F[base + T["xfer.in"]] += +info.recvMs || 0;
    F[base + T["xfer.serialise"]] += +(res && res.serialiseMs) || 0;
    I[base + C.bytesOut] += info.bytesOut | 0;
    I[base + C.bytesIn] += info.bytesIn | 0;
    I[base + C.jobsArrived] += 1;
    let workerMs = 0;
    const nPlates = res && res.plates ? res.plates.length / 2 : 0;
    if (res && res.timings && nPlates > 0) {
        const st = res.timings.length / nPlates;
        for (let p = 0; p < nPlates; p++) {
            const o = p * st;
            F[base + T["job.recvToStart"]] += res.timings[o];
            F[base + T["job.startToFinish"]] += res.timings[o + 1];
            F[base + T["eng.clip"]] += res.timings[o + 2];
            F[base + T["eng.local"]] += res.timings[o + 3];
            F[base + T["ras.edges"]] += res.timings[o + 4];
            F[base + T["ras.union"]] += res.timings[o + 5];
            F[base + T["ras.accum"]] += res.timings[o + 6];
            workerMs += res.timings[o] + res.timings[o + 1];
            bucketOf(histPlate, res.timings[o + 1]);
        }
    }
    if (res && res.counts && nPlates > 0) {
        const sc = res.counts.length / nPlates;
        for (let p = 0; p < nPlates; p++) {
            for (let k = 0; k < sc && k < 8; k++) I[base + C.items + k] += res.counts[p * sc + k];
        }
    }
    I[base + C.platesArrived] += nPlates;
    const staleN = info.stale && info.stale.stale ? info.stale.stale.length : 0;
    takeJob(info, res, workerMs, staleN, q);
    if (src.notePerf && ((+info.wallMs || 0) >= PERF_FLOOR_MS || traceOn())) {
        src.notePerf("rasterJob", info.postedAt, {
            frameSeq: info.frameSeq, plates: nPlates, wallMs: ms3(info.wallMs),
            queueingMs: ms3(info.queueingMs), bytesIn: info.bytesIn | 0,
        });
    }
}
export function noteBitmap(ms) { add(T["br.bitmap"], ms); }
export function noteCompose(ms, plates, blits) {
    add(T["br.blit"], ms);
    if (open < 0) return;
    const base = open * STRIDE;
    I[base + C.plateBlits] += blits | 0;
    if (I[base + C.kind] !== K_ARRIVAL) {
        I[base + C.hits] += plates | 0;
        I[base + C.platesWanted] += plates | 0;
    }
}
export function noteDrop(req, d) {
    ensure();
    stats.staleDrops++;
    if (open >= 0) I[(open * STRIDE) + C.drops] += 1;
    const r = drops[dropAt];
    r.t = wall();
    r.why = String((d && d.why) || "");
    tallyDrop(r.why);
    r.before = !!(d && d.before);
    r.jobId = (d && d.jobId) || 0;
    r.frameSeq = pick(d, req, "frameSeq", 0);
    r.q = String(pick(d, req, "q", ""));
    r.frameId = String(pick(d, req, "frameId", ""));
    r.epoch = pick(d, req, "epoch", 0);
    r.plates = d && d.plates ? (d.plates.length / 2) | 0 : 0;
    r.stale = d && d.stale ? d.stale.length : 0;
    dropAt = (dropAt + 1) % DROPS_KEPT;
    if (nDrops < DROPS_KEPT) nDrops++;
    if (src.notePerf) {
        src.notePerf("rasterStale", clock(), { why: r.why, before: r.before, q: r.q,
            frameSeq: r.frameSeq, plates: r.plates });
    }
}
export function noteCrawl(rep) {
    ensure();
    if (!rep) return null;
    if (open >= 0) { stats.unclosed++; closeRow(FLAG.truncated); }
    crawlTicks++;
    open = head;
    const base = open * STRIDE;
    F.fill(0, base, base + STRIDE);
    I.fill(0, base, base + STRIDE);
    W[open] = wall();
    openT0 = clock();
    openQueuedAt = 0;
    I[base + C.frameSeq] = -crawlTicks;
    I[base + C.kind] = K_CRAWL;
    I[base + C.q] = qCode(lastView.q);
    I[base + C.mode] = Math.max(0, MODES.indexOf(lastView.mode));
    I[base + C.sMilli] = Math.round(lastView.s * 1000);
    const decide = +rep.decideMs || 0;
    const paint = rep.paintMs != null ? +rep.paintMs : (+rep.lastPhaseMs || 0);
    const blit = +rep.blitMs || 0;
    const live = +rep.liveMs || 0;
    F[base + T["ovl.decide"]] = decide;
    F[base + T["ovl.paint"]] = paint;
    F[base + T["ovl.blit"]] = blit;
    F[base + T["ovl.live"]] = live;
    F[base + T.mainMs] = rep.mainMs != null ? +rep.mainMs : decide + paint + blit + live;
    I[base + C.antDashes] = rep.dashes | 0;
    I[base + C.antStamps] = rep.stamps | 0;
    I[base + C.antPixels] = rep.pixels | 0;
    I[base + C.overlayBlitPx] = rep.blitPx | 0;
    I[base + C.overlayRepaints] = rep.repaints | 0;
    I[base + C.liveMoves] = rep.liveMoves | 0;
    I[base + C.liveDirtyPx] = rep.liveDirtyPx | 0;
    if (rep.bytes != null) stats.overlayBytes = rep.bytes | 0;
    stats.crawls = crawlTicks;
    return closeRow(0);
}
export function onFrame(deltaMs, ts) {
    if (!F || !nPending) return;
    if (!(deltaMs >= 0) || !isFinite(deltaMs)) { nPending = 0; return; }
    let sumMain = 0, n = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < nPending; k++) {
        const row = pending[k * 2];
        const base = row * STRIDE;
        if (I[base + C.frameSeq] !== pending[k * 2 + 1]) continue;
        sumMain += F[base + T.mainMs];
        n++;
    }
    const infer = deltaMs - sumMain;
    for (let k = 0; k < nPending; k++) {
        const row = pending[k * 2];
        const base = row * STRIDE;
        if (I[base + C.frameSeq] !== pending[k * 2 + 1]) { stats.pendingLost++; continue; }
        F[base + T.rafDelta] = deltaMs;
        I[base + C.flags] |= FLAG.rafKnown;
        I[base + C.flags] &= ~FLAG.inferredPending;
        if (n > 1) I[base + C.flags] |= FLAG.shared;
        if (F[base + T.mainMs] > deltaMs) I[base + C.flags] |= FLAG.spansFrames;
        if (infer < 0) I[base + C.flags] |= FLAG.clamped;
        if (k === nPending - 1) {
            F[base + T["br.inferred"]] = infer > 0 ? infer : 0;
            totalsT[T["br.inferred"]] += infer > 0 ? infer : 0;
        }
    }
    totalsT[T.rafDelta] += deltaMs;
    stats.lastTickT = ts != null ? ts : wall();
    nPending = 0;
}
function takeJob(info, res, workerMs, staleN, q) {
    const ms = +info.wallMs || 0;
    let at = -1;
    if (nJobs < JOBS_KEPT) { at = nJobs++; } else {
        let worstAt = 0;
        for (let k = 1; k < JOBS_KEPT; k++) {
            if (jobs[k].postedToArrivedMs < jobs[worstAt].postedToArrivedMs) worstAt = k;
        }
        if (ms > jobs[worstAt].postedToArrivedMs) at = worstAt;
    }
    if (at < 0) return;
    const r = jobs[at];
    r.t = wall();
    r.frameSeq = info.frameSeq | 0;
    r.jobId = info.jobId | 0;
    r.plates = res && res.plates ? res.plates.length / 2 : 0;
    r.postedToArrivedMs = ms;
    r.queueWaitMs = q >= 0 && info.postedAt > q ? info.postedAt - q : 0;
    r.queueingMs = +info.queueingMs || 0;
    r.workerMs = workerMs;
    r.serialiseMs = +(res && res.serialiseMs) || 0;
    r.postMs = +info.postMs || 0;
    r.recvMs = +info.recvMs || 0;
    r.bytesIn = info.bytesIn | 0;
    r.bytesOut = info.bytesOut | 0;
    r.inline = !!info.inline;
    r.stale = staleN;
}
function tallyDrop(why) {
    const k = dropWhy.has(why) || dropWhy.size < DROP_WHYS_KEPT ? why : "other";
    dropWhy.set(k, (dropWhy.get(k) || 0) + 1);
}
function bucketOf(hist, ms) {
    let i = 0;
    while (i < MS_BUCKETS.length && ms > MS_BUCKETS[i]) i++;
    hist[i]++;
}
function kindCode(kind) {
    const k = KINDS.indexOf(String(kind));
    return k < 0 ? 0 : k;
}
function qCode(q) {
    if (q === "s") return Q_SYNC;
    if (q === "e") return Q_SETTLE;
    const n = +q;
    return isFinite(n) && q !== "" && q != null ? Math.round(n) : Q_UNKNOWN;
}
function pick(d, req, key, dflt) {
    if (d && d[key] != null) return d[key];
    if (req && req[key] != null) return req[key];
    return dflt;
}
function traceOn() { return typeof src.trace === "function" ? !!src.trace() : false; }
function ms3(ms) { return Math.round((+ms || 0) * 1000) / 1000; }
//// src/engine/raster/rasterWorkerClient.js
import {
    wireJob, unwireResult, resultStale, jobBytes, resultBytes, BufferPool,
    GUARD_NAMES, COUNT_NAMES, GUARDS_PER_JOB, COUNTS_PER_PLATE, TIMINGS_PER_PLATE,
} from "./rasterJob";
import { runJob } from "../worker/rasterWorker";
import { PLATE_PX } from "./plate";
export const MAX_WORKERS = 4;
export const MAX_RESPAWNS = 3;
export const WATCHDOG_MS = 30000;
let workers = [];
let broken = false;
let answered = false;
let respawns = 0;
let watchdog = null;
let spawned = false;
let transport = null;
let seq = 0;
const queue = [];
const inFlight = new Map();
let heldNoSlot = 0;
const current = new Map();
const pool = new BufferPool(8 << 20);
const stats = {
    jobs: 0, plates: 0, failed: 0,
    dropsBefore: 0, dropsAfter: 0, staleOnArrival: 0,
    bytesOut: 0, bytesIn: 0,
    workerMs: 0, poolReadyMs: 0,
    postMs: 0, recvMs: 0,
    spawnedLate: 0,
    respawns: 0, silent: 0,
};
const guardTotals = new Float64Array(GUARDS_PER_JOB);
const countTotals = new Float64Array(COUNTS_PER_PLATE);
const named = (names, a) => { const o = {}; names.forEach((n, i) => { o[n] = a[i]; }); return o; };
const now = () => (typeof performance !== "undefined" ? performance.now() : Date.now());
export function rasterWorkerCount() {
    const cores = (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.hardwareConcurrency) || 1;
    return Math.min(MAX_WORKERS, Math.max(1, cores - 1));
}
function workerUrl() {
    const base = (typeof process !== "undefined" && process.env && process.env.PUBLIC_URL) || "";
    return base + "/raster-worker.js";
}
export function ensureRasterPool() { return spawnPool(false); }
function spawnPool(late) {
    if (transport || broken || spawned) return workers.length;
    spawned = true;
    if (late) stats.spawnedLate++;
    if (typeof Worker === "undefined") { broken = true; return 0; }
    const t0 = now();
    const want = rasterWorkerCount();
    for (let k = 0; k < want; k++) {
        let w;
        try {
            w = new Worker(workerUrl());
        } catch (err) {
            broken = true;
            terminateWorkers();
            return 0;
        }
        const slot = { w, jobId: null };
        w.onmessage = (e) => onMessage(slot, (e && e.data) || {});
        w.onerror = (e) => onWorkerError(e);
        workers.push(slot);
    }
    stats.poolReadyMs = now() - t0;
    return workers.length;
}
function terminateWorkers() {
    for (const s of workers) { try { s.w.terminate(); } catch (err) {  } }
    workers = [];
    spawned = false;
}
export function destroyRasterPool() {
    if (watchdog != null) { clearTimeout(watchdog); watchdog = null; }
    terminateWorkers();
    abandonInFlight("destroyed");
}
const ABANDONED = -1;
export function abandonInFlight(why) {
    const stranded = [...inFlight.values()];
    inFlight.clear();
    for (const f of stranded) {
        if (f.slot) f.slot.jobId = ABANDONED;
        else heldNoSlot++;
        stats.failed++;
        if (f.req.onDrop) f.req.onDrop({ jobId: f.jobId, plates: f.plates, why: why || "abandoned", before: false });
    }
    return stranded.length;
}
function releaseAbandoned(slot) {
    if (slot) {
        if (slot.jobId !== ABANDONED) return false;
        slot.jobId = null;
        return true;
    }
    if (heldNoSlot === 0) return false;
    heldNoSlot--;
    return true;
}
function onWorkerError(e) { failPool(e, answered); }
function failPool(e, respawn) {
    const stranded = [...inFlight.values()];
    inFlight.clear();
    terminateWorkers();
    for (const f of stranded) {
        stats.failed++;
        if (f.req.onDrop) f.req.onDrop({ jobId: f.jobId, plates: f.plates, why: "worker", before: false });
    }
    for (const f of stranded) queue.push({ req: f.req, plates: f.plates });
    if (respawn && respawns < MAX_RESPAWNS) { respawns++; stats.respawns++; spawnPool(false); }
    else broken = true;
    if (e && e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
    pump();
}
function armWatchdog() {
    if (watchdog != null || transport || !workers.length) return;
    watchdog = setTimeout(checkWatchdog, WATCHDOG_MS / 2);
}
function checkWatchdog() {
    watchdog = null;
    const t = now();
    for (const rec of inFlight.values()) {
        if (!rec.slot || t - rec.postedAt < WATCHDOG_MS) continue;
        if (!rec.suspect) { rec.suspect = t; continue; }
        stats.silent++;
        failPool(null, true);
        return;
    }
    for (const rec of inFlight.values()) if (rec.slot) { armWatchdog(); return; }
}
export const STRIPS_PER_WORKER = 2;
export function stripSizeFor(nPlates, workerCount) {
    const n = workerCount != null ? workerCount : activeCount();
    return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(nPlates / Math.max(1, n * STRIPS_PER_WORKER)));
}
function activeCount() {
    if (transport) return rasterWorkerCount();
    spawnPool(true);
    return workers.length || 1;
}
export function submitPlates(req) {
    const plates = req.plates instanceof Int32Array ? req.plates : Int32Array.from(req.plates || []);
    dropStale(req.frameSeq, req.q);
    current.set(req.q, req.frameSeq);
    const per = stripSizeFor(plates.length / 2) * 2;
    let n = 0;
    for (let at = 0; at < plates.length; at += per) {
        queue.push({ req, plates: plates.slice(at, at + per), prio: req.prio != null ? req.prio : 1 });
        n++;
    }
    pump();
    return n;
}
function dropStale(frameSeq, q) {
    for (let k = queue.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
        const e = queue[k];
        if (e.req.q !== q || e.req.frameSeq === frameSeq) continue;
        queue.splice(k, 1);
        stats.dropsBefore++;
        if (e.req.onDrop) e.req.onDrop({ jobId: null, plates: e.plates, why: "frame", before: true });
    }
    pruneCurrent();
}
function pruneCurrent() {
    const live = new Set();
    for (const e of queue) live.add(e.req.q);
    for (const f of inFlight.values()) live.add(f.req.q);
    for (const k of [...current.keys()]) if (!live.has(k)) current.delete(k);
}
export function dropQueued(why, q) {
    let n = 0;
    for (let k = queue.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
        const e = queue[k];
        if (q != null && e.req.q !== q) continue;
        queue.splice(k, 1);
        stats.dropsBefore++;
        n++;
        if (e.req.onDrop) e.req.onDrop({ jobId: null, plates: e.plates, why: why || "dropped", before: true });
    }
    pruneCurrent();
    return n;
}
function pump() {
    for (;;) {
        if (!queue.length) return;
        const slot = freeSlot();
        if (slot === undefined) return;
        const k = bestIndex();
        if (k < 0) return;
        const e = queue.splice(k, 1)[0];
        if (current.get(e.req.q) !== e.req.frameSeq
            || (e.req.stillWanted && !e.req.stillWanted(e.plates))) {
            stats.dropsBefore++;
            if (e.req.onDrop) e.req.onDrop({ jobId: null, plates: e.plates, why: "stale", before: true });
            continue;
        }
        dispatch(e, slot);
    }
}
const LOW_PRIO = 3;
function bestIndex() {
    let low = 0;
    for (const r of inFlight.values()) if ((r.req.prio != null ? r.req.prio : 1) >= LOW_PRIO) low++;
    const lowCap = Math.max(1, rasterWorkerCount() - 1);
    let best = -1, bestPrio = Infinity;
    for (let k = 0; k < queue.length; k++) {
        const p = queue[k].prio;
        if (p >= bestPrio) continue;
        if (p >= LOW_PRIO && low >= lowCap) continue;
        best = k; bestPrio = p;
        if (p === 0) break;
    }
    return best;
}
function freeSlot() {
    if (transport) return inFlight.size + heldNoSlot < rasterWorkerCount() ? null : undefined;
    if (!broken) spawnPool(true);
    if (workers.length) {
        for (const s of workers) if (s.jobId == null) return s;
        return undefined;
    }
    return inFlight.size + heldNoSlot === 0 ? null : undefined;
}
function dispatch(entry, slot) {
    const jobId = ++seq;
    let job;
    try {
        job = entry.req.pack(entry.plates, jobId, pool);
    } catch (err) {
        stats.failed++;
        if (entry.req.onDrop) entry.req.onDrop({ jobId, plates: entry.plates, why: "pack", before: true });
        return;
    }
    if (!job) {
        stats.dropsBefore++;
        if (entry.req.onDrop) entry.req.onDrop({ jobId, plates: entry.plates, why: "empty", before: true });
        return;
    }
    job.jobId = jobId;
    if (job.frameSeq == null) job.frameSeq = entry.req.frameSeq;
    const bytesOut = jobBytes(job);
    const postedAt = now();
    job.postedAt = postedAt;
    const { msg, transfer } = wireJob(job);
    const rec = { req: entry.req, plates: entry.plates, postedAt, slot, jobId, bytesOut, postMs: 0 };
    inFlight.set(jobId, rec);
    stats.jobs++;
    stats.bytesOut += bytesOut;
    if (slot) slot.jobId = jobId;
    const donePost = () => { rec.postMs = now() - postedAt; stats.postMs += rec.postMs; };
    if (transport) {
        const p = transport(msg, transfer);
        donePost();
        p.then((out) => onMessage(slot, out || {}), (err) => onFailed(jobId, err, slot));
        return;
    }
    if (slot) {
        try {
            slot.w.postMessage(msg, transfer);
            donePost();
            armWatchdog();
        } catch (err) {
            onFailed(jobId, err, slot);
        }
        return;
    }
    donePost();
    Promise.resolve().then(() => runJob(msg, { receivedAt: now() }))
        .then((out) => onMessage(null, out.msg), (err) => onFailed(jobId, err, null));
}
function onFailed(jobId, err, slot) {
    const rec = inFlight.get(jobId);
    if (!rec) {
        if (releaseAbandoned(slot || null)) pump();
        return;
    }
    inFlight.delete(jobId);
    if (rec.slot) rec.slot.jobId = null;
    stats.failed++;
    if (rec.req.onDrop) {
        rec.req.onDrop({ jobId, plates: rec.plates, why: String((err && err.message) || err || "failed"), before: false });
    }
    pump();
}
function onMessage(slot, data) {
    const arrivedAt = now();
    if (slot) answered = true;
    if (data.kind === "raster-error") {
        onFailed(data.jobId, new Error(data.err), slot);
        return;
    }
    const res = unwireResult(data);
    const rec = inFlight.get(res.jobId);
    if (!rec) {
        if (releaseAbandoned(slot)) pump();
        return;
    }
    inFlight.delete(res.jobId);
    if (rec.slot) rec.slot.jobId = null;
    for (const b of res.recycled) pool.give(b);
    res.recycled.length = 0;
    const recvMs = now() - arrivedAt;
    const nPlates = res.plates.length / 2;
    let phases = res.serialiseMs || 0;
    for (let p = 0; p < nPlates; p++) {
        phases += res.timings[p * TIMINGS_PER_PLATE] + res.timings[p * TIMINGS_PER_PLATE + 1];
    }
    const wallMs = arrivedAt - rec.postedAt;
    const info = {
        jobId: res.jobId, frameSeq: res.frameSeq, plates: rec.plates,
        postedAt: rec.postedAt, arrivedAt, wallMs,
        queueingMs: wallMs - phases,
        postMs: rec.postMs, recvMs,
        bytesOut: rec.bytesOut, bytesIn: resultBytes(res),
        stale: rec.req.epochOf ? resultStale(res, rec.req.epochOf) : null,
        inline: !slot && !transport,
    };
    stats.plates += nPlates;
    stats.bytesIn += info.bytesIn;
    stats.workerMs += phases;
    stats.recvMs += recvMs;
    if (res.guards) for (let g = 0; g < GUARDS_PER_JOB; g++) guardTotals[g] += res.guards[g];
    if (res.counts) for (let c = 0; c < res.counts.length; c++) countTotals[c % COUNTS_PER_PLATE] += res.counts[c];
    if (info.stale) {
        stats.dropsAfter++;
        stats.staleOnArrival += info.stale.stale.length;
        if (rec.req.onDrop) {
            rec.req.onDrop({
                jobId: res.jobId, plates: rec.plates, stale: info.stale.stale,
                why: info.stale.why, before: false,
            });
        }
    }
    if (rec.req.onResult) rec.req.onResult(res, info);
    pump();
}
export function plateIds(res, p) {
    const end = p + 1 < res.idOff.length ? res.idOff[p + 1] : res.idSet.length;
    return res.idSet.subarray(res.idOff[p], end);
}
export async function plateBitmap(px) {
    if (!px || typeof createImageBitmap !== "function" || typeof ImageData !== "function") return null;
    return createImageBitmap(new ImageData(px, PLATE_PX, PLATE_PX));
}
export function rasterWorkerReport() {
    let held = heldNoSlot;
    for (const s of workers) if (s.jobId === ABANDONED) held++;
    return {
        mode: transport ? "transport" : workers.length ? "workers" : "inline",
        workers: workers.length, wanted: rasterWorkerCount(), broken, respawns: stats.respawns, silent: stats.silent,
        queued: queue.length, inFlight: inFlight.size, heldSlots: held, liveRequests: current.size,
        jobs: stats.jobs, plates: stats.plates, failed: stats.failed,
        dropsBefore: stats.dropsBefore, dropsAfter: stats.dropsAfter, staleOnArrival: stats.staleOnArrival,
        bytesOut: stats.bytesOut, bytesIn: stats.bytesIn,
        workerMs: stats.workerMs, poolReadyMs: stats.poolReadyMs,
        postMs: stats.postMs, recvMs: stats.recvMs, spawnedLate: stats.spawnedLate,
        guards: named(GUARD_NAMES, guardTotals),
        counts: named(COUNT_NAMES, countTotals),
        pool: { takes: pool.takes, hits: pool.hits, allocBytes: pool.allocBytes, bytes: pool.bytes },
    };
}
//// src/engine/rectMath.js
import { asRect } from "./geometry/connect";
export function latticeStep(rect) {
    const R = asRect(rect);
    const m = Math.max(Math.abs(R.x0), Math.abs(R.y0), Math.abs(R.x1), Math.abs(R.y1), 1);
    return Math.max(1 / 1000, m / 4.0e7);
}
export const rectTol = (r) => 2 * latticeStep(r);
export const rectSpan = (r) => { const R = asRect(r); return Math.max(R.x1 - R.x0, R.y1 - R.y0, 1e-12); };
//// src/engine/report.js
let yq = null;
export function macroYield() {
    if (typeof MessageChannel !== "function") return new Promise((res) => setTimeout(res, 0));
    if (!yq) {
        const ch = new MessageChannel(), q = [];
        ch.port1.onmessage = () => { const f = q.shift(); if (f) f(); };
        if (ch.port1.unref) ch.port1.unref();
        yq = { q, post: () => ch.port2.postMessage(0) };
    }
    return new Promise((res) => { yq.q.push(res); yq.post(); });
}

function buildRungs(defs) {
    const lpIndex = defs.findIndex((d) => d.name === "ℓP");
    let meters;
    if (lpIndex >= 0) {
        let factor = 1;
        for (let i = 1; i <= lpIndex; i++) {
            factor *= defs[i].ratioFromPrev ?? 1;
        }
        meters = PLANCK_LENGTH_M / factor;
    } else {
        meters = PLANCK_LENGTH_M;
    }
    return defs.map((def, i) => {
        if (i > 0 && def.ratioFromPrev != null) {
            meters *= def.ratioFromPrev;
        }
        return { ...def, meters };
    });
}
function safeLog10Meters(meters) {
    if (!(meters > 0) || !Number.isFinite(meters)) {
        return Number.NEGATIVE_INFINITY;
    }
    return Math.log10(meters);
}
const unitRegistry = new Map();
function registerUnit(rung) {
    const existing = unitRegistry.get(rung.name);
    if (existing) {
        return existing;
    }
    const entry = {
        id: rung.name,
        name: rung.name,
        meters: rung.meters,
        log10Meters: safeLog10Meters(rung.meters),
        kind: rung.kind,
        family: rung.family || rung.kind || "other",
        siPrefixBase: rung.siPrefixBase ?? null,
        prefixShort: rung.prefixShort ?? null,
        formatKind: rung.kind === "imperial" && rung.name === "in" ? "inch" : "plain",
    };
    if (!Number.isFinite(entry.log10Meters) || entry.log10Meters === -Infinity) {
        entry.log10Meters = Math.log10(PLANCK_LENGTH_M);
    }
    unitRegistry.set(rung.name, entry);
    return entry;
}
const SM_RUNGS = buildRungs([...SHARED_SUB_UM, ...STANDARD_METRIC_TAIL]);
for (const r of SM_RUNGS) registerUnit(r);
const TM_RUNGS = buildRungs([...SHARED_SUB_UM, ...TRUE_METRIC_TAIL]);
for (const r of TM_RUNGS) {
    if (!unitRegistry.has(r.name)) registerUnit(r);
}
const SI_RUNGS = buildRungs([...SHARED_SUB_UM, ...STANDARD_IMPERIAL_TAIL]);
for (const r of SI_RUNGS) {
    if (!unitRegistry.has(r.name)) registerUnit(r);
}
function repairLogFactors() {
    const ordered = [...unitRegistry.values()].sort((a, b) => {
        if (Number.isFinite(a.meters) && Number.isFinite(b.meters)) return a.meters - b.meters;
        return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
    });
    for (const u of ordered) {
        if (Number.isFinite(u.meters) && u.meters > 0) {
            u.log10Meters = Math.log10(u.meters);
        }
    }
    const planckLog = Math.log10(PLANCK_LENGTH_M);
    const planckChain = [
        ["qℓP", -30], ["rℓP", -27], ["yℓP", -24], ["zℓP", -21], ["aℓP", -18],
        ["fℓP", -15], ["pℓP", -12], ["nℓP", -9], ["µℓP", -6], ["mℓP", -3],
        ["ℓP", 0], ["kℓP", 3],
    ];
    for (const [name, exp] of planckChain) {
        const u = unitRegistry.get(name);
        if (u) u.log10Meters = planckLog + exp;
    }
}
repairLogFactors();
export function getUnit(name) {
    return unitRegistry.get(name) || null;
}
export function unitMeters(name) {
    const u = unitRegistry.get(name);
    return u?.meters ?? null;
}
export function unitLog10Meters(name) {
    const u = unitRegistry.get(name);
    if (!u) return NaN;
    if (Number.isFinite(u.log10Meters)) return u.log10Meters;
    if (Number.isFinite(u.meters) && u.meters > 0) return Math.log10(u.meters);
    return NaN;
}
export function allCatalogUnits() {
    return [...unitRegistry.values()].sort((a, b) => a.log10Meters - b.log10Meters);
}
function prefixNameForShort(short) {
    return PREFIXES.find((p) => p.short === short)?.name ?? short;
}
function capitalizeWord(s) {
    if (!s) return s;
    return s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
}
export function unitFullName(name) {
    if (SPECIAL_NAMES[name]) return SPECIAL_NAMES[name];
    const rung = unitRegistry.get(name);
    if (!rung) return name;
    if (rung.kind === "planck-prefix") {
        const prefix = prefixNameForShort(rung.prefixShort);
        return `${capitalizeWord(prefix)}-Planck Length`;
    }
    if (rung.kind === "planck") return "Planck Length";
    if (rung.kind === "si-meter") {
        if (!rung.prefixShort) return "Meter";
        const prefix = prefixNameForShort(rung.prefixShort);
        return `${capitalizeWord(prefix)}meter`;
    }
    if (rung.kind === "astro" && name.endsWith("pc")) {
        const prefixShort = name.slice(0, -2);
        if (!prefixShort) return "Parsec";
        const prefix = prefixNameForShort(prefixShort);
        return `${capitalizeWord(prefix)}parsec`;
    }
    if (rung.kind === "imperial") return SPECIAL_NAMES[name] || capitalizeWord(name);
    if (rung.kind === "body") return SPECIAL_NAMES[name] || name;
    return name;
}
export function allUnitsTableRows() {
    return allCatalogUnits().map((u) => ({
        name: unitFullName(u.name),
        shorthand: u.name,
        meters: u.meters,
    }));
}
export function hasSiPrefix(unit) {
    const u = unitRegistry.get(unit);
    if (!u) return false;
    return u.siPrefixBase != null || (u.kind === "si-meter" && u.prefixShort != null);
}
export function isNoSiPrefix(unit) {
    return !hasSiPrefix(unit);
}
