export function computeScale(effectiveZoom, scaleDef, session, opts = {}) {
    const mpp = mppFromDef(scaleDef, effectiveZoom);
    if (!(mpp > 0) || !Number.isFinite(mpp)) {
        return { reading: null, session };
    }
    const cleared = clearUserBandIfExited(session, mpp);
    const reading = resolveReading(mpp, cleared, opts);
    return { reading, session: withReading(cleared, reading) };
}
//// src/engine/scaleBar/ladder.js
import { LADDER_IDS, LADDER_PRIORITY, BAR_PX_MIN, BAR_PX_MAX } from "./constants";
import { getUnit } from "./catalog";
import { LADDERS, RELATED_LADDERS } from "./membership";
import { bandFor, extraNiceFor } from "./preference";
import { StandardPreferenceRange } from "./preferenceRange";
import { niceValuesForUnit } from "./nice";
import { log10, safeExp10 } from "./logMath";
const REL_EPS = 1e-9;
export class Ladder {
    constructor(id) {
        this.id = id;
        this.rungs = LADDERS[id] || LADDERS[LADDER_IDS.TRUE_METRIC];
        this.priority = LADDER_PRIORITY.indexOf(id);
        this._rank = new Map(this.rungs.map((r, i) => [r.name, i]));
    }
    get relatedIds() { return RELATED_LADDERS[this.id] || []; }
    get names() { return this.rungs.map((r) => r.name); }
    has(unit) { return this._rank.has(unit); }
    rankOf(unit) { return this._rank.has(unit) ? this._rank.get(unit) : -1; }
    floorUnit() { return this.rungs[0]?.name ?? null; }
    ceilingUnit() { return this.rungs[this.rungs.length - 1]?.name ?? null; }
    neighbors(unit, up = 1, down = 1) {
        const r = this.rankOf(unit);
        if (r < 0) return [];
        const out = [];
        for (let d = 1; d <= down; d++) if (r - d >= 0) out.push(this.rungs[r - d].name);
        for (let u = 1; u <= up; u++) if (r + u < this.rungs.length) out.push(this.rungs[r + u].name);
        return out;
    }
    unitsWithinFactor(unit, factor) {
        const c = getUnit(unit);
        if (!c) return [];
        const logLo = c.log10Meters - log10(factor);
        const logHi = c.log10Meters + log10(factor);
        return this.rungs
            .filter((r) => r.log10Meters >= logLo - 1e-12 && r.log10Meters <= logHi + 1e-12)
            .map((r) => r.name);
    }
    bandFor(unit) { return bandFor(this.id, unit); }
    extraNiceFor(unit) { return extraNiceFor(this.id, unit); }
    preferenceFor(unit) {
        const b = this.bandFor(unit);
        return new StandardPreferenceRange({ ladderId: this.id, unit, lo: b.lo, hi: b.hi });
    }
    candidatesAt(mpp) {
        if (!(mpp > 0) || !Number.isFinite(mpp)) return [];
        const logMpp = log10(mpp);
        const logBarMin = log10(BAR_PX_MIN);
        const logBarMax = log10(BAR_PX_MAX);
        const stops = [];
        for (let rank = 0; rank < this.rungs.length; rank++) {
            const rung = this.rungs[rank];
            const logUnit = rung.log10Meters;
            if (!Number.isFinite(logUnit)) continue;
            const logMagLo = logBarMin + logMpp - logUnit;
            const logMagHi = logBarMax + logMpp - logUnit;
            if (logMagHi < -320 || logMagLo > 306) continue;
            const magLo = safeExp10(logMagLo);
            const magHi = safeExp10(logMagHi);
            const values = niceValuesForUnit(rung.name, {
                magLo: magLo * (1 - 1e-7),
                magHi: magHi * (1 + 1e-7),
                extraValues: this.extraNiceFor(rung.name),
            });
            for (const v of values) {
                const logLen = log10(v.value) + logUnit;
                const barPx = safeExp10(logLen - logMpp);
                if (!(barPx > 0) || !Number.isFinite(barPx)) continue;
                if (barPx < BAR_PX_MIN * (1 - REL_EPS) || barPx > BAR_PX_MAX * (1 + REL_EPS)) continue;
                stops.push({
                    ladderId: this.id,
                    unit: rung.name,
                    rank,
                    niceValue: v.value,
                    value: v.value,
                    logLen,
                    barPx: Math.min(BAR_PX_MAX, Math.max(BAR_PX_MIN, barPx)),
                    form: v.form,
                    label: v.label,
                });
            }
        }
        return stops;
    }
}
const registry = new Map();
export function ladder(id) {
    let l = registry.get(id);
    if (!l) {
        l = new Ladder(id);
        registry.set(id, l);
    }
    return l;
}
export const ALL_LADDERS = LADDER_PRIORITY.map(ladder);
//// src/engine/scaleBar/logMath.js
import { BAR_PX_TARGET } from "./constants";
import { unitLog10Meters } from "./catalog";
const LOG10_E = Math.LOG10E;
export function log10(x) {
    if (!(x > 0) || !Number.isFinite(x)) {
        if (x === 0) return -Infinity;
        return Number.isFinite(x) ? NaN : (x > 0 ? Infinity : -Infinity);
    }
    const v = Math.log10(x);
    if (Number.isFinite(v)) return v;
    const ln = Math.log(x);
    if (!Number.isFinite(ln)) {
        return x > 1 ? 308.254 : -323.306;
    }
    return ln * LOG10_E;
}
export function safeExp10(logX) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(logX)) {
        if (logX === Infinity) return Number.MAX_VALUE;
        if (logX === -Infinity) return Number.MIN_VALUE;
        return 1;
    }
    const clamped = Math.max(-323, Math.min(308, logX));
    const v = Math.pow(10, clamped);
    if (Number.isFinite(v) && v > 0) return v;
    if (clamped >= 0) return Number.MAX_VALUE;
    return Number.MIN_VALUE;
}
export function targetLogLen(mpp) {
    if (!(mpp > 0) || !Number.isFinite(mpp)) return 0;
    return log10(BAR_PX_TARGET) + log10(mpp);
}
export function logLenFromNice(niceValue, unit) {
    if (!(niceValue > 0) || !Number.isFinite(niceValue)) return NaN;
    return log10(niceValue) + unitLog10Meters(unit);
}
export function mppFromDef(scaleDef, effectiveZoom) {
    if (!scaleDef) return NaN;
    const { value, unit, barPx, zoomAt } = scaleDef;
    if (!(value > 0) || !(barPx > 0) || !(zoomAt > 0) || !(effectiveZoom > 0)) {
        return NaN;
    }
    const logUnit = unitLog10Meters(unit);
    if (!Number.isFinite(logUnit)) return NaN;
    const logMpp =
        log10(value) + logUnit - log10(barPx) + log10(zoomAt) - log10(effectiveZoom);
    return safeExp10(logMpp);
}
export function barPxFromLogLen(stopLogLen, mpp) {
    if (!(mpp > 0)) return NaN;
    return safeExp10(stopLogLen - log10(mpp));
}
//// src/engine/scaleBar/logicRule.js
import { LADDER_PRIORITY, BAR_PX_TARGET, LADDER_IDS } from "./constants";
import {
    allCatalogUnits,
    getUnit,
    unitLog10Meters,
    isNoSiPrefix,
    hasSiPrefix,
} from "./catalog";
import { ladder } from "./ladder";
import { ULTRA_STANDARD } from "./membership";
import { resolveReading } from "./resolve";
import { createSession } from "./session";
import { log10, safeExp10 } from "./logMath";
function autoShowUnit(ladderId, mpp, discard) {
    const reading = resolveReading(mpp, createSession(ladderId), {
        ladderId,
        ignoreUserBand: true,
        ignoreIncumbent: true,
        ignoreAllPrefs: discard === "all",
    });
    return reading?.unit ?? null;
}
function ladderUnitsReadingBetween(ladderId, mpp, lo, hi) {
    if (!(mpp > 0)) return [];
    const out = [];
    const logTarget = log10(BAR_PX_TARGET) + log10(mpp);
    for (const rung of ladder(ladderId).rungs) {
        const value = safeExp10(logTarget - rung.log10Meters);
        if (value >= lo && value <= hi) out.push(rung.name);
    }
    return out;
}
function unitsBetween(names, loUnit, hiUnit) {
    const lo = unitLog10Meters(loUnit);
    const hi = unitLog10Meters(hiUnit);
    if (!Number.isFinite(lo) || !Number.isFinite(hi)) return [];
    return names.filter((n) => {
        const u = getUnit(n);
        return u && u.log10Meters >= lo - 1e-9 && u.log10Meters <= hi + 1e-9;
    });
}
function allLadderUnion() {
    const seen = new Set();
    for (const ladderId of LADDER_PRIORITY) {
        for (const rung of ladder(ladderId).rungs) seen.add(rung.name);
    }
    return [...seen];
}
export class LogicRule {
    constructor(params = {}) { this.params = params; }
    evaluate(ctx) { return []; }
}
export class RelatedLadderAutoShow extends LogicRule {
    evaluate(ctx) {
        return (ladder(ctx.ladderId).relatedIds || [])
            .map((rl) => autoShowUnit(rl, ctx.mpp, "user"))
            .filter(Boolean);
    }
}
export class CurrentLadderAuto extends LogicRule {
    evaluate(ctx) {
        const u = autoShowUnit(ctx.ladderId, ctx.mpp, this.params.discard);
        return u ? [u] : [];
    }
}
export class CurrentLadderWithinFactor extends LogicRule {
    evaluate(ctx) {
        return ladder(ctx.ladderId).unitsWithinFactor(ctx.currentUnit, this.params.factor);
    }
}
export class AnyLadderAuto extends LogicRule {
    evaluate(ctx) {
        return LADDER_PRIORITY.map((l) => autoShowUnit(l, ctx.mpp, this.params.discard)).filter(Boolean);
    }
}
export class RelatedWithinFactor extends LogicRule {
    evaluate(ctx) {
        return (ladder(ctx.ladderId).relatedIds || []).flatMap((rl) =>
            ladder(rl).unitsWithinFactor(ctx.currentUnit, this.params.factor),
        );
    }
}
export class CurrentLadderReadingBand extends LogicRule {
    evaluate(ctx) {
        return ladderUnitsReadingBetween(ctx.ladderId, ctx.mpp, this.params.lo, this.params.hi);
    }
}
export class AnyLadderReadingBand extends LogicRule {
    evaluate(ctx) {
        return LADDER_PRIORITY.flatMap((l) =>
            ladderUnitsReadingBetween(l, ctx.mpp, this.params.lo, this.params.hi),
        );
    }
}
export class CurrentLadderNeighbors extends LogicRule {
    evaluate(ctx) {
        return ladder(ctx.ladderId).neighbors(ctx.currentUnit, this.params.up, this.params.down);
    }
}
export class RelatedLadderNeighbors extends LogicRule {
    evaluate(ctx) {
        return (ladder(ctx.ladderId).relatedIds || []).flatMap((rl) =>
            ladder(rl).neighbors(ctx.currentUnit, this.params.up, this.params.down),
        );
    }
}
export class AllUltraStandard extends LogicRule {
    evaluate() { return ULTRA_STANDARD.slice(); }
}
export class NamedUnits extends LogicRule {
    evaluate() { return this.params.units.slice(); }
}
export class NoSiPrefixUnits extends LogicRule {
    evaluate() {
        return allCatalogUnits().filter((u) => isNoSiPrefix(u.name)).map((u) => u.name);
    }
}
export class AllUnits extends LogicRule {
    evaluate() { return allLadderUnion(); }
}
export class UltraStandardBetween extends LogicRule {
    evaluate() { return unitsBetween(ULTRA_STANDARD, this.params.lo, this.params.hi); }
}
export class AllLaddersBetween extends LogicRule {
    evaluate() { return unitsBetween(allLadderUnion(), this.params.lo, this.params.hi); }
}
export class CurrentLadderNoSiPrefix extends LogicRule {
    evaluate(ctx) {
        if (!ctx.ladderId) return [];
        return ladder(ctx.ladderId).names.filter((n) => isNoSiPrefix(n));
    }
}
export class CurrentLadderSiPrefixedMeters extends LogicRule {
    evaluate(ctx) {
        if (ctx.ladderId !== LADDER_IDS.TRUE_METRIC) return [];
        return ladder(ctx.ladderId).names.filter((n) => {
            const u = getUnit(n);
            return u && u.siPrefixBase === "m" && hasSiPrefix(n);
        });
    }
}
//// src/engine/scaleBar/membership.js
import {
    LADDER_IDS,
    LADDER_PRIORITY,
} from "./constants";
import {
    SM_RUNGS,
    TM_RUNGS,
    SI_RUNGS,
    ULTRA_STANDARD_METRIC_NAMES,
    ULTRA_STANDARD_IMPERIAL_NAMES,
    getUnit,
} from "./catalog";
export { LADDER_IDS, LADDER_PRIORITY };
export const RELATED_LADDERS = {
    [LADDER_IDS.ULTRA_STANDARD_IMPERIAL]: [
        LADDER_IDS.ULTRA_STANDARD_METRIC,
        LADDER_IDS.STANDARD_IMPERIAL,
    ],
    [LADDER_IDS.ULTRA_STANDARD_METRIC]: [
        LADDER_IDS.ULTRA_STANDARD_IMPERIAL,
        LADDER_IDS.STANDARD_METRIC,
    ],
    [LADDER_IDS.STANDARD_METRIC]: [
        LADDER_IDS.ULTRA_STANDARD_METRIC,
        LADDER_IDS.TRUE_METRIC,
        LADDER_IDS.STANDARD_IMPERIAL,
    ],
    [LADDER_IDS.TRUE_METRIC]: [
        LADDER_IDS.ULTRA_STANDARD_METRIC,
        LADDER_IDS.STANDARD_METRIC,
        LADDER_IDS.STANDARD_IMPERIAL,
    ],
    [LADDER_IDS.STANDARD_IMPERIAL]: [
        LADDER_IDS.ULTRA_STANDARD_IMPERIAL,
        LADDER_IDS.STANDARD_METRIC,
        LADDER_IDS.TRUE_METRIC,
    ],
};
function rungsFromNames(names) {
    return names.map((name) => {
        const u = getUnit(name);
        if (!u) throw new Error(`membership: unknown unit ${name}`);
        return {
            name,
            meters: u.meters,
            log10Meters: u.log10Meters,
            kind: u.kind,
            family: u.family,
        };
    });
}
function rungsFromBuilt(built) {
    return built.map((r) => ({
        name: r.name,
        meters: r.meters,
        log10Meters: getUnit(r.name)?.log10Meters ?? Math.log10(r.meters),
        kind: r.kind,
        family: r.family || r.kind,
    }));
}
export const LADDERS = {
    [LADDER_IDS.STANDARD_METRIC]: rungsFromBuilt(SM_RUNGS),
    [LADDER_IDS.TRUE_METRIC]: rungsFromBuilt(TM_RUNGS),
    [LADDER_IDS.STANDARD_IMPERIAL]: rungsFromBuilt(SI_RUNGS),
    [LADDER_IDS.ULTRA_STANDARD_METRIC]: rungsFromNames(ULTRA_STANDARD_METRIC_NAMES),
    [LADDER_IDS.ULTRA_STANDARD_IMPERIAL]: rungsFromNames(ULTRA_STANDARD_IMPERIAL_NAMES),
};
const ownersMap = new Map();
for (const ladderId of LADDER_PRIORITY) {
    const ladder = LADDERS[ladderId];
    for (const rung of ladder) {
        let owners = ownersMap.get(rung.name);
        if (!owners) {
            owners = [];
            ownersMap.set(rung.name, owners);
        }
        if (!owners.includes(ladderId)) owners.push(ladderId);
    }
}
export function ladderForStack(ladderId) {
    return LADDERS[ladderId] || LADDERS[LADDER_IDS.TRUE_METRIC];
}
export function unitRank(name, ladderOrId) {
    const ladder = typeof ladderOrId === "string" ? ladderForStack(ladderOrId) : ladderOrId;
    const i = ladder.findIndex((u) => u.name === name);
    return i >= 0 ? i : -1;
}
export function laddersOwning(unit) {
    const owners = ownersMap.get(unit);
    if (owners?.length) return owners.slice();
    return [];
}
export function stackForUnit(unit) {
    const owners = laddersOwning(unit);
    if (owners.length) return owners[0];
    return LADDER_IDS.STANDARD_METRIC;
}
export function highestPriorityLadder(ladderIds) {
    for (const id of LADDER_PRIORITY) {
        if (ladderIds.includes(id)) return id;
    }
    return ladderIds[0] || LADDER_IDS.STANDARD_METRIC;
}
export function floorUnit(ladderId) {
    const ladder = ladderForStack(ladderId);
    return ladder[0]?.name || null;
}
export function ceilingUnit(ladderId) {
    const ladder = ladderForStack(ladderId);
    return ladder[ladder.length - 1]?.name || null;
}
export const ULTRA_STANDARD = [
    ...new Set([
        ...ULTRA_STANDARD_METRIC_NAMES,
        ...ULTRA_STANDARD_IMPERIAL_NAMES,
    ]),
];
//// src/engine/scaleBar/nice.js
import {
    NICE_MANTISSAS,
    PLAIN_MIN,
    PLAIN_MAX,
    INCH_FRACTIONS,
    BAR_PX_MIN,
    BAR_PX_MAX,
    BAR_PX_TARGET,
} from "./constants";
import { unitLog10Meters } from "./catalog";
import { log10, safeExp10 } from "./logMath";
const REL_EPS = 1e-9;
function formatSciValue(value) {
    if (value === 0) return "0";
    let exp = Math.floor(Math.log10(Math.abs(value)));
    let mantissa = value / Math.pow(10, exp);
    let m = parseFloat(mantissa.toPrecision(2));
    if (Math.abs(m) >= 10) {
        m /= 10;
        exp += 1;
    }
    if (exp === 0) return String(m);
    const superscript = String(exp)
        .replace(/-/g, "⁻")
        .replace(/0/g, "⁰")
        .replace(/1/g, "¹")
        .replace(/2/g, "²")
        .replace(/3/g, "³")
        .replace(/4/g, "⁴")
        .replace(/5/g, "⁵")
        .replace(/6/g, "⁶")
        .replace(/7/g, "⁷")
        .replace(/8/g, "⁸")
        .replace(/9/g, "⁹");
    if (m === 1) return `10${superscript}`;
    return `${m}×10${superscript}`;
}
export function formatScaleNumber(n) {
    if (n === 0) return "0";
    const abs = Math.abs(n);
    if (abs > PLAIN_MAX || abs < PLAIN_MIN) return formatSciValue(n);
    if (abs >= 100) return Math.round(n).toLocaleString();
    return parseFloat(n.toPrecision(3)).toString();
}
function formFor(value) {
    return value >= PLAIN_MIN * (1 - REL_EPS) && value <= PLAIN_MAX * (1 + REL_EPS)
        ? "plain"
        : "sci";
}
const INCH_FRACTION_REGION_LO = 0.02 * (1 + REL_EPS);
const INCH_FRACTION_REGION_HI = 1 * (1 - REL_EPS);
export function niceValuesForUnit(unit, opts = {}) {
    const {
        magLo = PLAIN_MIN,
        magHi = PLAIN_MAX,
        extraValues = [],
    } = opts;
    if (!(magLo > 0) || !(magHi > 0) || !(magLo <= magHi)) return [];
    const out = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    const inWindow = (v) => v >= magLo * (1 - REL_EPS) && v <= magHi * (1 + REL_EPS);
    const push = (value, form, label = null) => {
        if (!(value > 0) || !Number.isFinite(value)) return;
        if (seen.has(value)) return;
        seen.add(value);
        out.push({
            value,
            form,
            label: form === "sci" && label == null ? formatSciValue(value) : label,
        });
    };
    const loExp = Math.floor(log10(magLo)) - 1;
    const hiExp = Math.ceil(log10(magHi)) + 1;
    if (!Number.isFinite(loExp) || !Number.isFinite(hiExp) || hiExp - loExp > 800) {
        return [];
    }
    const isInch = unit === "in";
    for (let e = loExp; e <= hiExp; e++) {
        for (const m of NICE_MANTISSAS) {
            const v = m * Math.pow(10, e);
            if (!(v > 0) || !Number.isFinite(v)) continue;
            if (!inWindow(v)) continue;
            if (isInch && v > INCH_FRACTION_REGION_LO && v < INCH_FRACTION_REGION_HI) continue;
            push(v, formFor(v));
        }
    }
    if (isInch) {
        for (const f of INCH_FRACTIONS) {
            if (inWindow(f.value)) push(f.value, "fraction", f.label);
        }
        for (const v of [0.25, 0.5]) {
            if (inWindow(v)) push(v, "plain");
        }
    }
    for (const v of extraValues) {
        if (inWindow(v)) push(v, formFor(v));
    }
    out.sort((a, b) => a.value - b.value);
    return out;
}
export function bestInBoundsNice(
    unit,
    mpp,
    barMin = BAR_PX_MIN,
    barMax = BAR_PX_MAX,
    barTarget = BAR_PX_TARGET,
    extraValues = [],
) {
    if (!(mpp > 0) || !Number.isFinite(mpp)) return null;
    let logUnit = unitLog10Meters(unit);
    if (!Number.isFinite(logUnit)) return null;
    const logMpp = log10(mpp);
    const magLo = safeExp10(log10(barMin) + logMpp - logUnit);
    const magHi = safeExp10(log10(barMax) + logMpp - logUnit);
    const cands = niceValuesForUnit(unit, {
        magLo: magLo * (1 - 1e-6),
        magHi: magHi * (1 + 1e-6),
        extraValues,
    });
    let best = null;
    let bestScore = Infinity;
    for (const c of cands) {
        const logLen = log10(c.value) + logUnit;
        const barPx = safeExp10(logLen - logMpp);
        if (!(barPx > 0) || !Number.isFinite(barPx)) continue;
        const score = Math.abs(logLen - (log10(barTarget) + logMpp));
        if (score < bestScore) {
            bestScore = score;
            best = {
                unit,
                niceValue: c.value,
                value: c.value,
                logLen,
                form: c.form,
                label: c.label,
                barPx: Math.min(barMax, Math.max(barMin, barPx)),
                displayLabel: c.form === "fraction" ? c.label : undefined,
                sciLabel: c.form === "sci" ? c.label : undefined,
            };
        }
    }
    if (best) return best;
    const targetNiceLog = log10(barTarget) + logMpp - logUnit;
    let fallback = null;
    let fbScore = Infinity;
    for (let e = Math.floor(targetNiceLog) - 1; e <= Math.ceil(targetNiceLog) + 1; e++) {
        for (const m of NICE_MANTISSAS) {
            const vLog = log10(m) + e;
            const value = safeExp10(vLog);
            if (!(value > 0) || !Number.isFinite(value)) continue;
            const score = Math.abs(vLog - targetNiceLog);
            if (score < fbScore) {
                fbScore = score;
                const logLen = vLog + logUnit;
                const rawBar = safeExp10(logLen - logMpp);
                const form = formFor(value);
                fallback = {
                    unit,
                    niceValue: value,
                    value,
                    logLen,
                    form,
                    label: form === "sci" ? formatSciValue(value) : null,
                    barPx: Math.min(barMax, Math.max(barMin, rawBar)),
                    sciLabel: form === "sci" ? formatSciValue(value) : undefined,
                };
            }
        }
    }
    return fallback;
}
export { formatSciValue };
//// src/engine/scaleBar/pick.js
import { LADDER_PRIORITY, BAR_PX_MIN, BAR_PX_MAX, BAR_PX_TARGET } from "./constants";
import { laddersOwning, highestPriorityLadder } from "./membership";
import { extraNiceFor, bandLogInterval } from "./preference";
import { UserPreferenceRange } from "./preferenceRange";
import { resolveReading } from "./resolve";
import { bestInBoundsNice } from "./nice";
import { unitLog10Meters } from "./catalog";
import { log10, safeExp10, targetLogLen } from "./logMath";
import { createSession } from "./session";
function autoSpanForUnit(ladderId, unit) {
    const logUnit = unitLog10Meters(unit);
    if (!Number.isFinite(logUnit)) return null;
    const session = createSession(ladderId);
    const logTarget = log10(BAR_PX_TARGET);
    const step = 0.04;
    let loLog = null;
    let hiLog = null;
    for (let d = -8; d <= 8 + 1e-9; d += step) {
        const worldLog = logUnit + d;
        const mpp = safeExp10(worldLog - logTarget);
        if (!(mpp > 0)) continue;
        const auto = resolveReading(mpp, session, {
            ladderId,
            ignoreUserBand: true,
            ignoreIncumbent: true,
        });
        if (auto && auto.unit === unit) {
            if (loLog === null) loLog = worldLog;
            hiLog = worldLog;
        }
    }
    if (loLog === null) return null;
    return { loLog: loLog - step, hiLog: hiLog + step };
}
export function applyUnitPick(pickedUnit, mpp, session) {
    let s = session || createSession();
    if (s.userBand && pickedUnit !== s.userBand.unit) {
        s = { ...s, userBand: null };
    }
    const preferredLadders = [];
    for (const ladderId of LADDER_PRIORITY) {
        const probe = resolveReading(mpp, createSession(ladderId), {
            ladderId,
            ignoreUserBand: true,
            ignoreIncumbent: true,
        });
        if (probe?.unit === pickedUnit) preferredLadders.push(ladderId);
    }
    if (preferredLadders.length) {
        const dest = highestPriorityLadder(preferredLadders);
        const reading = resolveReading(mpp, {
            ladderId: dest,
            userBand: null,
            incumbentUnit: pickedUnit,
            lastReading: null,
        }, { ignoreIncumbent: true });
        const next = {
            ladderId: dest,
            userBand: null,
            incumbentUnit: pickedUnit,
            lastReading: reading,
        };
        return { session: next, reading };
    }
    const owners = laddersOwning(pickedUnit);
    const dest = owners.includes(s.ladderId)
        ? s.ladderId
        : highestPriorityLadder(owners);
    const niceStop = bestInBoundsNice(
        pickedUnit,
        mpp,
        BAR_PX_MIN,
        BAR_PX_MAX,
        BAR_PX_TARGET,
        extraNiceFor(dest, pickedUnit),
    );
    if (!niceStop) {
        const reading = resolveReading(mpp, s);
        return { session: s, reading };
    }
    const currentLog = targetLogLen(mpp);
    const span = autoSpanForUnit(dest, pickedUnit);
    let logLo;
    let logHi;
    if (span) {
        logLo = Math.min(currentLog, niceStop.logLen, span.loLog);
        logHi = Math.max(currentLog, niceStop.logLen, span.hiLog);
    } else {
        const bi = bandLogInterval(dest, pickedUnit);
        logLo = Math.min(currentLog, niceStop.logLen, Number.isFinite(bi.logLo) ? bi.logLo : currentLog);
        logHi = Math.max(currentLog, niceStop.logLen, Number.isFinite(bi.logHi) ? bi.logHi : currentLog);
    }
    const userBand = new UserPreferenceRange({ ladderId: dest, unit: pickedUnit, logLo, logHi });
    const reading = {
        value: niceStop.value,
        niceValue: niceStop.niceValue,
        unit: pickedUnit,
        barPx: niceStop.barPx,
        ladderId: dest,
        metersPerPx: mpp,
        logLen: niceStop.logLen,
        form: niceStop.form,
        reason: "user-band",
    };
    if (niceStop.displayLabel) reading.displayLabel = niceStop.displayLabel;
    if (niceStop.sciLabel) reading.sciLabel = niceStop.sciLabel;
    const next = {
        ladderId: dest,
        userBand,
        incumbentUnit: pickedUnit,
        lastReading: reading,
    };
    return { session: next, reading };
}
//// src/engine/scaleBar/preference.js
import { LADDER_IDS } from "./constants";
import { unitLog10Meters } from "./catalog";
import { log10 } from "./logMath";
const { STANDARD_METRIC, STANDARD_IMPERIAL, TRUE_METRIC, ULTRA_STANDARD_METRIC, ULTRA_STANDARD_IMPERIAL } = LADDER_IDS;
const DEFAULT_BAND = [1, 500];
const BAND_OVERRIDES = {
    [STANDARD_METRIC]: {
        "qℓP": [0.05, 500],
        mm: [1, 5],
        cm: [1, 5],
        "R☉": [1, 200],
        ld: [5, 200],
        pc: [200, 500],
        Qpc: [1, 5000],
    },
    [TRUE_METRIC]: {
        "qℓP": [0.05, 500],
        mm: [1, 5],
        cm: [1, 5],
        dm: [1, 5],
        m: [1, 5],
        dam: [1, 5],
        hm: [1, 5],
        km: [1, 5],
        Qpc: [1, 5000],
    },
    [STANDARD_IMPERIAL]: {
        "qℓP": [0.05, 500],
        mil: [1, 50],
        in: [1 / 16, 1],
        ft: [2, 500],
        yd: [200, 500],
        mi: [0.5, 1],
        "R⊕": [1, 200],
        "R☉": [1, 200],
        ld: [5, 200],
        pc: [200, 500],
        Qpc: [1, 5000],
    },
    [ULTRA_STANDARD_METRIC]: {
        mm: [1, 5],
        cm: [1, 5],
        km: [1, 5000],
        ly: [1, 5000],
        pc: [200, 5000],
    },
    [ULTRA_STANDARD_IMPERIAL]: {
        in: [1 / 16, 10],
        ft: [2, 5000],
        mi: [0.25, 1],
        ly: [1, 5000],
        pc: [200, 5000],
    },
};
const EXTRA_NICE = {
    [ULTRA_STANDARD_IMPERIAL]: { mi: [0.25] },
};
export function bandFor(ladderId, unit) {
    const o = BAND_OVERRIDES[ladderId]?.[unit];
    if (o) return { lo: o[0], hi: o[1] };
    return { lo: DEFAULT_BAND[0], hi: DEFAULT_BAND[1] };
}
export function bandLogInterval(ladderId, unit) {
    const band = bandFor(ladderId, unit);
    const logUnit = unitLog10Meters(unit);
    if (!Number.isFinite(logUnit)) {
        return { logLo: NaN, logHi: NaN };
    }
    return {
        logLo: log10(band.lo) + logUnit,
        logHi: log10(band.hi) + logUnit,
    };
}
export function extraNiceFor(ladderId, unit) {
    return EXTRA_NICE[ladderId]?.[unit] ?? [];
}
//// src/engine/scaleBar/preferenceRange.js
import { log10 } from "./logMath";
import { unitLog10Meters } from "./catalog";
const REL_EPS = 1e-9;
export const RANGE_PRIORITY = { USER: 2, STANDARD: 1, NONE: 0 };
export class PreferenceRange {
    constructor({ ladderId, unit, logLo, logHi, priority }) {
        this.ladderId = ladderId;
        this.unit = unit;
        this.logLo = logLo;
        this.logHi = logHi;
        this.priority = priority;
    }
    contains(logLen, eps = REL_EPS) {
        return (
            Number.isFinite(this.logLo) &&
            Number.isFinite(this.logHi) &&
            logLen >= this.logLo - eps &&
            logLen <= this.logHi + eps
        );
    }
    claims(stop) {
        return stop.unit === this.unit && this.contains(stop.logLen);
    }
    get kind() { return "preference"; }
}
export class StandardPreferenceRange extends PreferenceRange {
    constructor({ ladderId, unit, lo, hi }) {
        const logUnit = unitLog10Meters(unit);
        super({
            ladderId,
            unit,
            logLo: Number.isFinite(logUnit) ? log10(lo) + logUnit : NaN,
            logHi: Number.isFinite(logUnit) ? log10(hi) + logUnit : NaN,
            priority: RANGE_PRIORITY.STANDARD,
        });
        this.lo = lo;
        this.hi = hi;
    }
    claims(stop) {
        return (
            stop.unit === this.unit &&
            stop.niceValue >= this.lo * (1 - REL_EPS) &&
            stop.niceValue <= this.hi * (1 + REL_EPS)
        );
    }
    get kind() { return "standard"; }
}
export class UserPreferenceRange extends PreferenceRange {
    constructor({ ladderId, unit, logLo, logHi }) {
        super({ ladderId, unit, logLo, logHi, priority: RANGE_PRIORITY.USER });
    }
    claims(stop) {
        return stop.unit === this.unit && this.contains(stop.logLen);
    }
    shouldClear() { return false; }
    toJSON() {
        return { unit: this.unit, ladderId: this.ladderId, logLo: this.logLo, logHi: this.logHi };
    }
    get kind() { return "user"; }
}
export function toUserRange(obj) {
    if (!obj) return null;
    if (obj instanceof UserPreferenceRange) return obj;
    return new UserPreferenceRange({
        ladderId: obj.ladderId,
        unit: obj.unit,
        logLo: obj.logLo,
        logHi: obj.logHi,
    });
}
//// src/engine/scaleBar/resolve.js
import {
    BAR_PX_MIN,
    BAR_PX_MAX,
    BAR_PX_TARGET,
    LADDER_IDS,
    HYSTERESIS_ENTER_PAST_EDGE,
} from "./constants";
import { ladder } from "./ladder";
import { bandLogInterval } from "./preference";
import { toUserRange } from "./preferenceRange";
import { bestInBoundsNice } from "./nice";
import { log10, targetLogLen } from "./logMath";
const LOG_EPS = 1e-9;
export function pastIncumbentEnterEdge(ladderId, incumbentUnit, tLog) {
    if (!incumbentUnit || !Number.isFinite(tLog)) return true;
    const { logLo, logHi } = bandLogInterval(ladderId, incumbentUnit);
    if (!Number.isFinite(logLo) || !Number.isFinite(logHi)) return true;
    const marginLog = log10(1 + HYSTERESIS_ENTER_PAST_EDGE);
    return tLog > logHi + marginLog + LOG_EPS || tLog < logLo - marginLog - LOG_EPS;
}
export function candidatesOnLadder(ladderId, mpp) {
    return ladder(ladderId).candidatesAt(mpp);
}
export function extremeCandidates(ladderId, mpp) {
    const L = ladder(ladderId);
    const rungs = L.rungs;
    if (!rungs.length || !(mpp > 0)) return [];
    const tLog = targetLogLen(mpp);
    const floor = rungs[0];
    const ceiling = rungs[rungs.length - 1];
    const useFloor = tLog < (floor.log10Meters + ceiling.log10Meters) / 2;
    const rung = useFloor ? floor : ceiling;
    const stop = bestInBoundsNice(
        rung.name,
        mpp,
        BAR_PX_MIN,
        BAR_PX_MAX,
        BAR_PX_TARGET,
        L.extraNiceFor(rung.name),
    );
    if (!stop) return [];
    return [{
        ladderId,
        unit: rung.name,
        rank: useFloor ? 0 : rungs.length - 1,
        niceValue: stop.niceValue,
        value: stop.value,
        logLen: stop.logLen,
        barPx: stop.barPx,
        form: stop.form,
        label: stop.label,
    }];
}
function readingFromStop(stop, mpp, reason) {
    const out = {
        value: stop.value,
        niceValue: stop.niceValue,
        unit: stop.unit,
        barPx: stop.barPx,
        ladderId: stop.ladderId,
        metersPerPx: mpp,
        logLen: stop.logLen,
        form: stop.form,
        rank: stop.rank,
        reason,
    };
    if (stop.form === "fraction" && stop.label) out.displayLabel = stop.label;
    if (stop.form === "sci" && stop.label) out.sciLabel = stop.label;
    return out;
}
export function resolveReading(mpp, session, opts = {}) {
    if (!(mpp > 0) || !Number.isFinite(mpp)) return null;
    const ladderId =
        opts.ladderId || session?.ladderId || LADDER_IDS.STANDARD_METRIC;
    const L = ladder(ladderId);
    let pool = L.candidatesAt(mpp);
    if (!pool.length) pool = extremeCandidates(ladderId, mpp);
    if (!pool.length) return null;
    const tLog = targetLogLen(mpp);
    const ignoreAll = !!opts.ignoreAllPrefs;
    let userRange =
        !ignoreAll && !opts.ignoreUserBand && session?.userBand
            ? toUserRange(session.userBand)
            : null;
    if (userRange && userRange.shouldClear(tLog, pool, LOG_EPS)) {
        userRange = null;
    }
    const byUnit = new Map();
    for (const s of pool) {
        s.userHit = Boolean(userRange && userRange.claims(s));
        s.bandHit = ignoreAll ? false : L.preferenceFor(s.unit).claims(s);
        const cur = byUnit.get(s.unit);
        if (!cur) { byUnit.set(s.unit, s); continue; }
        if (s.userHit && !cur.userHit) { byUnit.set(s.unit, s); continue; }
        if (cur.userHit && !s.userHit) continue;
        if (Math.abs(s.logLen - tLog) < Math.abs(cur.logLen - tLog)) byUnit.set(s.unit, s);
    }
    const reps = [...byUnit.values()];
    const allSubOne = reps.every((s) => s.niceValue < 1);
    const lowNumber = (s) =>
        s.bandHit ? s.niceValue : (s.niceValue >= 1 ? s.niceValue : Infinity);
    const keyFor = (s) => [
        s.userHit ? 0 : 1,
        s.bandHit ? 0 : 1,
        lowNumber(s),
        allSubOne ? s.rank : 0,
        Math.abs(s.logLen - tLog),
        s.rank,
        s.value,
    ];
    let best = null;
    let bestKey = null;
    for (const s of reps) {
        const key = keyFor(s);
        if (!bestKey) {
            best = s;
            bestKey = key;
            continue;
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < key.length; i++) {
            if (key[i] < bestKey[i]) {
                best = s;
                bestKey = key;
                break;
            }
            if (key[i] > bestKey[i]) break;
        }
    }
    const reason = best.userHit
        ? "user-band"
        : best.bandHit
            ? "standard-band"
            : best.niceValue >= 1
                ? "prefer-ge1"
                : "bounds-fit";
    return readingFromStop(best, mpp, reason);
}
//// src/engine/scaleBar/rungs.js
import {
    POPOVER_TABLE_AT,
    SET_SCALE_TABLE_AT,
} from "./constants";
import { unitLog10Meters } from "./catalog";
import {
    RelatedLadderAutoShow,
    CurrentLadderAuto,
    CurrentLadderWithinFactor,
    AnyLadderAuto,
    RelatedWithinFactor,
    CurrentLadderReadingBand,
    AnyLadderReadingBand,
    CurrentLadderNeighbors,
    RelatedLadderNeighbors,
    AllUltraStandard,
    NamedUnits,
    NoSiPrefixUnits,
    AllUnits,
    UltraStandardBetween,
    AllLaddersBetween,
    CurrentLadderNoSiPrefix,
    CurrentLadderSiPrefixedMeters,
} from "./logicRule";
export const POPOVER_RUNGS = [
    [
        new RelatedLadderAutoShow(),
        new CurrentLadderAuto({ discard: "user" }),
        new CurrentLadderAuto({ discard: "all" }),
        new CurrentLadderWithinFactor({ factor: 50 }),
    ],
    [
        new AnyLadderAuto({ discard: "user" }),
        new AnyLadderAuto({ discard: "all" }),
        new RelatedWithinFactor({ factor: 50 }),
        new CurrentLadderReadingBand({ lo: 0.1, hi: 500 }),
    ],
    [
        new AnyLadderReadingBand({ lo: 0.1, hi: 500 }),
        new CurrentLadderNeighbors({ up: 2, down: 2 }),
        new RelatedLadderNeighbors({ up: 1, down: 1 }),
    ],
    [
        new AllUltraStandard(),
        new NamedUnits({ units: ["kpc"] }),
        new NoSiPrefixUnits(),
    ],
    [new AllUnits()],
];
export const SET_SCALE_RUNGS = [
    [new UltraStandardBetween({ lo: "mm", hi: "mi" })],
    [new AllUltraStandard()],
    [
        new AllLaddersBetween({ lo: "µm", hi: "kpc" }),
        new CurrentLadderNoSiPrefix(),
        new CurrentLadderSiPrefixedMeters(),
    ],
    [new AllUnits()],
];
function evaluateRung(rules, ctx) {
    const out = [];
    for (const rule of rules) {
        for (const u of rule.evaluate(ctx)) {
            if (u) out.push(u);
        }
    }
    return out;
}
function sortBySize(units) {
    return [...units].sort((a, b) => {
        const la = unitLog10Meters(a);
        const lb = unitLog10Meters(b);
        if (!Number.isFinite(la) && !Number.isFinite(lb)) return 0;
        if (!Number.isFinite(la)) return 1;
        if (!Number.isFinite(lb)) return -1;
        return la - lb;
    });
}
function effectiveRungs(plan, ctx, exclude) {
    const cumulative = new Set();
    const levels = [];
    for (const rules of plan) {
        for (const u of evaluateRung(rules, ctx)) {
            if (!exclude.has(u)) cumulative.add(u);
        }
        const units = sortBySize([...cumulative]);
        if (units.length === 0) continue;
        if (!levels.length || units.length > levels[levels.length - 1].length) {
            levels.push(units);
        }
    }
    if (!levels.length) levels.push([]);
    return levels;
}
export function popoverUnits(level, ctx) {
    const levels = effectiveRungs(POPOVER_RUNGS, ctx, new Set([ctx.currentUnit]));
    const idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(level, levels.length - 1));
    const units = levels[idx];
    const asTable = units.length > POPOVER_TABLE_AT;
    const isFullCatalog = idx === levels.length - 1;
    return {
        units,
        level: idx,
        hasMore: idx < levels.length - 1,
        nextMoreLevel: Math.min(idx + 1, levels.length - 1),
        nextIsTable:
            idx < levels.length - 1 && levels[idx + 1].length > POPOVER_TABLE_AT,
        asTable,
        isFullCatalog,
        mode: asTable ? "table" : "chips",
    };
}
export function setScaleUnits(level, ctx = {}) {
    const levels = effectiveRungs(SET_SCALE_RUNGS, { ...ctx, mpp: ctx.mpp ?? null }, new Set());
    const idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(level, levels.length - 1));
    const units = levels[idx];
    const asTable = units.length > SET_SCALE_TABLE_AT;
    const isFullCatalog = idx === levels.length - 1;
    return {
        units,
        level: idx,
        hasMore: idx < levels.length - 1,
        nextMoreLevel: Math.min(idx + 1, levels.length - 1),
        asTable,
        showFullTable: asTable,
        isFullCatalog,
        mode: asTable ? "table" : "chips",
    };
}
//// src/engine/scaleBar/session.js
import { LADDER_IDS } from "./constants";
import { stackForUnit } from "./membership";
import { toUserRange } from "./preferenceRange";
import { targetLogLen } from "./logMath";
import { candidatesOnLadder, extremeCandidates } from "./resolve";
export function createSession(ladderId) {
    return {
        ladderId: ladderId || LADDER_IDS.STANDARD_METRIC,
        userBand: null,
        incumbentUnit: null,
        lastReading: null,
    };
}
export function clearUserBandIfExited(session, mpp) {
    if (!session?.userBand || !(mpp > 0)) return session;
    const ladderId = session.userBand.ladderId || session.ladderId;
    let pool = candidatesOnLadder(ladderId, mpp);
    if (!pool.length) pool = extremeCandidates(ladderId, mpp);
    const range = toUserRange(session.userBand);
    if (!range.shouldClear(targetLogLen(mpp), pool)) {
        return session;
    }
    return { ...session, userBand: null };
}
export function clearDisplayPrefs(prior, scaleDef = null) {
    const ladderId = scaleDef?.unit
        ? stackForUnit(scaleDef.unit)
        : prior?.ladderId || LADDER_IDS.STANDARD_METRIC;
    return {
        ladderId,
        userBand: null,
        incumbentUnit: null,
        lastReading: null,
    };
}
export function withReading(session, reading) {
    if (!reading) return session;
    return {
        ...session,
        incumbentUnit: reading.unit,
        lastReading: reading,
    };
}
export function shouldApplyScaleSessionWriteBack(s, next, meta = {}) {
    if (!s || !next) return false;
    const { sourceSession } = meta;
    if (s.userBand && !next.userBand) {
        if (sourceSession == null || sourceSession !== s) return false;
    }
    return true;
}
//// src/engine/scaleBar/validate.js
import { unitMeters } from "./catalog";
export function validateScaleDef(raw) {
    if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") return null;
    const { value, unit, barPx, zoomAt } = raw;
    if (typeof unit !== "string" || !unitMeters(unit)) return null;
    if (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) return null;
    if (typeof barPx !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(barPx) || barPx <= 0) return null;
    if (typeof zoomAt !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(zoomAt) || zoomAt <= 0) return null;
    return { value, unit, barPx, zoomAt };
}
//// src/engine/sceneClient.js
import { SceneIndex, CHUNK, MAX_CHUNKS, REACH } from "./sceneIndex";
import { segmentTerm, loopsBBox } from "./geometry/arcShape";
import { residual } from "./geometry/offsets";
import { Loop } from "./geometry/loop";
import { openSceneWorker } from "./sceneWorkerClient";
import { rasterWorkerReport } from "./raster/rasterWorkerClient";
const SLICE_MS = 8;
const MAX_WAIT_MS = 3000;
const SCENE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000;
const SCENE_WORKER_RESPAWNS = 3;
const INLINE_AUTO_MAX = 5000;
const REC = { 0: 3, 1: 8, 2: 9, 3: 16 };
export const FOOT_MAX = 512;
export const FOOT_CHUNKS = 8192;
const ONE_LOOP = Object.freeze([0]);
const now = () => (typeof performance !== "undefined" ? performance.now() : Date.now());
function chunker(max) {
    const out = [], starts = [];
    let x0 = 0, y0 = 0, x1 = 0, y1 = 0, len = 0, open = false, px = 0, py = 0, have = false;
    return {
        out, starts,
        put(x, y, jump) {
            const dl = have && !jump ? Math.hypot(x - px, y - py) : 0;
            if (open && (jump || Math.max(x1, x) - Math.min(x0, x) > max || Math.max(y1, y) - Math.min(y0, y) > max)) {
                out.push(x0, y0, x1, y1, len);
                open = false;
                if (!jump && have) { x0 = x1 = px; y0 = y1 = py; len = 0; open = true; }
            }
            if (!open) { if (jump) starts.push(out.length / 5); x0 = x1 = x; y0 = y1 = y; len = 0; open = true; }
            if (x < x0) x0 = x; else if (x > x1) x1 = x;
            if (y < y0) y0 = y; else if (y > y1) y1 = y;
            len += dl;
            px = x; py = y; have = true;
        },
        end() { if (open) out.push(x0, y0, x1, y1, len); open = false; },
    };
}
function walkLoops(loops, max) {
    const c = chunker(max), step = max / 2;
    let area = 0, per = 0;
    for (const lp of loops) {
        const b = lp && lp.buf ? lp.buf : Loop.from(lp).buf;
        if (!b || b.length < 5) continue;
        let ax = b[0], ay = b[1];
        const sx = ax, sy = ay;
        let a = 0;
        c.put(ax, ay, true);
        for (let o = 2; o < b.length; o += REC[b[o]] || 8) {
            const code = b[o];
            let bx, by;
            if (code === 0 || code === 2) {
                bx = code === 0 ? b[o + 1] : b[o + 7]; by = code === 0 ? b[o + 2] : b[o + 8];
                const L = Math.hypot(bx - ax, by - ay);
                per += L;
                const n = Math.ceil(L / step);
                for (let s = 1; s < n; s++) c.put(ax + ((bx - ax) * s) / n, ay + ((by - ay) * s) / n, false);
            } else {
                const cx = b[o + 1], cy = b[o + 2], r = b[o + 3], a0 = b[o + 4], sw = b[o + 5];
                bx = code === 3 ? b[o + 14] : b[o + 6]; by = code === 3 ? b[o + 15] : b[o + 7];
                const L = Math.abs(r * sw);
                per += L;
                a += (r * r * segmentTerm(sw)) / 2;
                const n = Math.ceil(L / step);
                for (let s = 1; s < n; s++) { const th = a0 + (sw * s) / n; c.put(cx + r * Math.cos(th), cy + r * Math.sin(th), false); }
            }
            a += ((ax - sx) * (by - sy) - (bx - sx) * (ay - sy)) / 2;
            c.put(bx, by, false);
            ax = bx; ay = by;
        }
        area += a;
    }
    c.end();
    return { out: c.out, loops: c.starts, area: Math.abs(area), per };
}
function walkPoly(rings, max, closed) {
    const c = chunker(max), step = max / 2;
    for (const pts of rings) {
        if (!pts || !pts.length) continue;
        let [ax, ay] = pts[0];
        c.put(ax, ay, true);
        const n = pts.length + (closed ? 1 : 0);
        for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            const [bx, by] = pts[i % pts.length];
            const L = Math.hypot(bx - ax, by - ay), k = Math.ceil(L / step);
            for (let s = 1; s < k; s++) c.put(ax + ((bx - ax) * s) / k, ay + ((by - ay) * s) / k, false);
            c.put(bx, by, false);
            ax = bx; ay = by;
        }
    }
    c.end();
    return { out: c.out, loops: closed ? c.starts : null };
}
const boxSize = (out) => {
    let x0 = Infinity, y0 = Infinity, x1 = -Infinity, y1 = -Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i += 5) { x0 = Math.min(x0, out[i]); y0 = Math.min(y0, out[i + 1]); x1 = Math.max(x1, out[i + 2]); y1 = Math.max(y1, out[i + 3]); }
    return Number.isFinite(x0) ? Math.max(x1 - x0, y1 - y0) : 0;
};
export function sceneGeom(o) {
    let w, walk = null;
    for (let grow = 1; grow < 1e9; grow *= 2) {
        if (o.type === "shape" && o.loops) {
            if (w == null) {
                const first = walkLoops(o.loops, o.w > 0 ? CHUNK * o.w : Infinity);
                const mw = first.per > 0 ? (2 * first.area) / first.per : 0;
                w = o.w > 0 ? Math.max(Math.min(o.w, mw), o.w * 1e-6) : Math.max(boxSize(first.out), 1e-12) / CHUNK;
                if (o.w > 0 && (w >= o.w / 2 || first.out.length <= 5)) { walk = first; w = w || o.w; if (walk.out.length / 5 <= MAX_CHUNKS) break; }
            }
            walk = walkLoops(o.loops, CHUNK * w * grow);
        } else if (o.type === "stroke" && o.pts) {
            if (w == null) w = o.lwFrame > 0 ? o.lwFrame : 1e-9;
            walk = walkPoly([o.pts], CHUNK * w * grow, false);
        } else if (o.type === "fill" && o.polys) {
            if (w == null) w = Math.max(boxSize(walkPoly(o.polys, Infinity, true).out), 1e-12) / CHUNK;
            walk = walkPoly(o.polys, CHUNK * w * grow, true);
        } else return null;
        if (walk.out.length / 5 <= MAX_CHUNKS) break;
    }
    const out = walk && walk.out;
    if (!out || !out.length) return null;
    for (let i = 4; i < out.length; i += 5) if (!(out[i] > 0)) out[i] = w;
    const lp = walk.loops;
    return { w, raw: Float64Array.from(out), loops: !lp || !lp.length ? null : lp.length === 1 && lp[0] === 0 ? ONE_LOOP : lp.slice() };
}
const isInk = (doc, o) => !!o && !o.erase && !doc._pending.has(o) && (o.attachRect == null || orphanPatch(doc, o));
const orphanPatch = (doc, o) => {
    for (const r of doc.editGroup(o)) if (r.obj !== o && !r.obj.erase && r.obj.attachRect == null) return false;
    return true;
};
export class SceneClient {
    constructor(E, { worker = true } = {}) {
        this.E = E; this.doc = E.doc; this.lm = E.lm;
        this.useWorker = worker;
        this.dirty = new Set();
        this.attr = new Set();
        this.goneFrames = new Set();
        this.patchFam = new Set();
        this.famDirty = new Set();
        this.hints = new Map();
        this.foot = new Map();
        this.footDirty = false;
        this.footMax = FOOT_MAX; this.footChunks = FOOT_CHUNKS;
        this.renames = [];
        this.sent = new Map();
        this.recW = new Float64Array(1024); this.recTX = new Float64Array(1024); this.recTY = new Float64Array(1024);
        this.recHO = new Int32Array(1024); this.recTop = 0; this.recFree = [];
        this.homes = new Map(); this.homeOf = [];
        this.geom = new Set();
        this.fsent = new Map();
        this.markGeo = new Map();
        this.frameKeys = new Map();
        this.export = null;
        this.inflight = null;
        this.gen = 0;
        this.frameEv = 0;
        this.resync = null;
        this.pending = null;
        this.core = null; this.remote = null;
        this.timer = null; this.idleId = null; this.waitSince = 0;
        this.destroyed = false;
        this.listeners = new Set();
        this.stats = { batches: 0, items: 0, prepMs: 0, applyMs: 0, lastApplyMs: 0, lastPrepMs: 0, lastItems: 0, restores: 0 };
        this._unsub = this.doc.subscribe((ev) => this._onEvent(ev));
        this._unsubOps = this.doc.subscribeOps((ev) => this._onOp(ev));
    }
    destroy() {
        this.destroyed = true;
        this._cancel();
        if (this._unsub) this._unsub();
        if (this._unsubOps) this._unsubOps();
        if (this.remote) this.remote.terminate();
        this.remote = null; this.core = null;
    }
    onChange(fn) { this.listeners.add(fn); return () => this.listeners.delete(fn); }
    _onEvent(ev) {
        switch (ev.kind) {
            case "reset":
                this._startResync(ev.load ? "load" : "reset");
                return;
            case "add":
                if (ev.live) return;
                this.dirty.add(ev.id); this._family(ev.obj); break;
            case "finalize": case "remove":
                if (ev.kind === "remove") this.markGeo.delete(ev.id);
                this.dirty.add(ev.id); this._family(ev.obj); break;
            case "change":
                if (ev.attrOnly) { this.attr.add(ev.id); break; }
                if (!ev.offsetsOnly) { this.geom.add(ev.id); this.markGeo.delete(ev.id); }
                this.dirty.add(ev.id); break;
            case "mergeFrame": case "splitFrame":
                this.frameEv++;
                for (const id of ev.ids || []) this.dirty.add(id);
                break;
            case "removeFrame":
                this.frameEv++;
                this.goneFrames.add(ev.frame);
                break;
            case "addFrame":
                this.frameEv++;
                for (const o of this.doc.list(ev.frame)) this.dirty.add(o.id);
                break;
            case "refile": this.frameEv++; break;
            default: break;
        }
        this._schedule();
    }
    _family(o) {
        if (!o || !this.patchFam.size) return;
        const k = this.doc.editKey(o);
        if (this.patchFam.has(k)) this.famDirty.add(k);
    }
    _onOp(ev) {
        if (ev.kind === "settle") { this.frameEv++; return; }
        if (ev.kind === "op") {
            for (const fp of this.foot.values()) if (fp.off && !fp.drop) { fp.drop = true; this.footDirty = true; }
            if (this.footDirty) this._schedule();
            return;
        }
        if ((ev.kind === "undo" || ev.kind === "redo") && ev.op && ev.op.strokeId != null) {
            for (const fp of this.foot.values()) {
                if (fp.e !== ev.op.strokeId) continue;
                fp.off = ev.op.op === "eraseRevert"; this.footDirty = true;
            }
            if (this.footDirty) this._schedule();
            return;
        }
        if (ev.kind !== "bake" || !ev.step || !ev.step.removed || !ev.step.pieces) return;
        const src = ev.step.removed.obj && ev.step.removed.obj.id;
        if (src == null) return;
        for (const pc of ev.step.pieces) if (pc && pc.obj) this.hints.set(pc.obj.id, src);
        if (ev.op && ev.op.strokeId != null) this._footprint(ev.op.strokeId, ev.step);
    }
    _footprint(markId, step) {
        const mark = this.doc.getById(markId);
        const src = step.removed.obj;
        if (!mark || !src || src.erase || src.attachRect != null) return;
        const rs = this.geom.has(src.id) ? undefined : this.sent.get(src.id);
        const g = rs != null ? { w: this.recW[rs] } : sceneGeom(src);
        let eg = this.markGeo.get(markId);
        if (!eg) { eg = sceneGeom(mark.obj); if (eg) this.markGeo.set(markId, eg); }
        if (!g || !eg) return;
        const HO = String(step.removed.level);
        const f = this.lm.frameFactor(mark.level, HO);
        const pen = mark.obj.w > 0 ? mark.obj.w : mark.obj.lwFrame;
        if (f == null || !(pen > 0) || !(pen * f < g.w)) return;
        const host = step.pieces.find((pc) => pc && pc.obj && String(pc.level) === HO && !pc.obj.erase);
        if (!host) return;
        const box = src.loops ? loopsBBox(src.loops) : null;
        if (!box) return;
        const w = pen * f, reach = REACH * w;
        const boxes = [];
        const raw = eg.raw;
        for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i += 5) {
            const r = this.lm.mapRectObj({ left: raw[i], top: raw[i + 1], right: raw[i + 2], bottom: raw[i + 3] }, mark.level, HO, host.obj.below, HO, true);
            if (!r || r.left - box.x1 > reach || box.x0 - r.right > reach || r.top - box.y1 > reach || box.y0 - r.bottom > reach) continue;
            boxes.push(r.left, r.top, r.right, r.bottom, raw[i + 4] * f);
        }
        if (!boxes.length) return;
        const fr = this.lm.frame(HO);
        this.foot.set(host.obj.id, { id: host.obj.id, e: markId, host: host.obj.id, key: this.doc.editKey(host.obj), home: HO, depth: fr ? fr.depth : null, w, boxes, off: false, raw: null, t: null });
        this.footDirty = true;
        this._capFoot();
    }
    _capFoot() {
        let n = 0, c = 0;
        for (const fp of this.foot.values()) if (!fp.drop) { n++; c += fp.boxes.length / 5; }
        for (const fp of this.foot.values()) {
            if (n <= this.footMax && c <= this.footChunks) break;
            if (fp.drop) continue;
            fp.drop = true; n--; c -= fp.boxes.length / 5; this.footDirty = true;
        }
    }
    _footItems(items) {
        for (const fp of [...this.foot.values()]) {
            const id = -fp.id, s = this.fsent.get(id);
            if (fp.drop) {
                if (s) { items.push({ id, gone: true }); this.fsent.delete(id); }
                this.foot.delete(fp.id);
                continue;
            }
            let h = !fp.off && this.doc.getById(fp.host);
            if (h && String(h.level) !== fp.home) {
                const to = this.lm.frame(String(h.level));
                if (fp.depth == null) { const was = this.lm.frame(fp.home); fp.depth = was ? was.depth : null; }
                if (to && to.depth === fp.depth) fp.home = String(h.level);
            }
            if (!fp.off && (!h || String(h.level) !== fp.home)) {
                const t0 = h ? residual(h.obj.below, 0) : null;
                const heir = this.doc.editGroup(fp.key).find((r) => String(r.level) === fp.home && !r.obj.erase
                    && String(residual(r.obj.below, 0)) === String(t0 || fp.t || null));
                if (heir) { fp.host = heir.obj.id; h = heir; } else h = null;
            }
            if (!h || !fp.boxes.length) {
                if (s) { items.push({ id, gone: true }); this.fsent.delete(id); }
                if (!fp.off && !h) this.foot.delete(fp.id);
                continue;
            }
            const t = residual(h.obj.below, 0);
            fp.t = t ? [t[0], t[1]] : null;
            const tx = t ? t[0] : 0, ty = t ? t[1] : 0;
            if (!fp.raw) fp.raw = Float64Array.from(fp.boxes);
            if (s && s.raw === fp.raw && s.home === fp.home && s.tx === tx && s.ty === ty) continue;
            const rec = { id, home: fp.home, w: fp.w, t: t ? [tx, ty] : null };
            if (!s || s.raw !== fp.raw) rec.raw = fp.raw;
            items.push(rec);
            this.fsent.set(id, { raw: fp.raw, home: fp.home, tx, ty });
        }
        this.footDirty = false;
    }
    _cancel() {
        if (this.timer != null) { clearTimeout(this.timer); this.timer = null; }
        if (this.idleId != null && typeof cancelIdleCallback === "function") cancelIdleCallback(this.idleId);
        this.idleId = null;
    }
    _schedule(delay = 30) {
        if (this.destroyed || this.timer != null || this.idleId != null) return;
        if (typeof requestIdleCallback === "function") {
            this.idleId = requestIdleCallback((dl) => {
                this.idleId = null;
                const t0 = now();
                this._tick(dl);
                if (this.E && this.E._perf) this.E._perf("sceneTick", t0, false);
            }, { timeout: SCENE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS });
        } else {
            this.timer = setTimeout(() => { this.timer = null; this._tick(null); }, delay);
        }
    }
    _busy() {
        const E = this.E;
        if (E._drawing || E._dragSel || E._lasso || E._destroyed) return true;
        if (E._panLast || (E._camBusy && E._camBusy())) return true;
        if (this.waitSince && now() - this.waitSince > MAX_WAIT_MS) return false;
        if (E._cutInflight) return true;
        if (E.raster) {
            try { const r = rasterWorkerReport(); if (r.queued || r.inFlight) return true; } catch (err) {  }
        }
        return false;
    }
    _tick(deadline) {
        if (this.destroyed || this.inflight) return;
        if (this._busy()) {
            if (!this.waitSince) this.waitSince = now();
            this.timer = setTimeout(() => { this.timer = null; this._schedule(); }, 150);
            return;
        }
        this.waitSince = 0;
        const budget = deadline && deadline.timeRemaining ? Math.max(4, Math.min(SLICE_MS, deadline.timeRemaining())) : SLICE_MS;
        if (this.resync) {
            if (!this._resyncWanted()) return;
            if (!this._resyncStep(budget)) this._schedule();
            return;
        }
        if (!this.pending) {
            if (!this._hasWork()) return;
            this._takeGone();
            this.pending = { ids: [...this.dirty], i: 0, items: [], fev: this.frameEv };
            this.dirty.clear();
        }
        if (!this._prepStep(this.pending, budget)) { this._schedule(); return; }
        const p = this.pending;
        this.pending = null;
        this._sendPrepared(p);
    }
    _sendPrepared(p) {
        if (p.fev !== this.frameEv) { this._takeGone(); if (this.dirty.size) this._fold(p); }
        if (this.attr.size) {
            const has = new Set(p.items.map((r) => r.id));
            for (const id of this.attr) if (!has.has(id) && this.sent.has(id)) p.items.push({ id, attr: true });
            this.attr.clear();
        }
        if (this.foot.size) this._footItems(p.items);
        this._send({ frames: this._frameDiff(), items: p.items, renames: this.renames.splice(0) }, p.ids);
    }
    _hasWork() {
        return !!(this.dirty.size || this.attr.size || this.goneFrames.size || this.famDirty.size || this.renames.length || this.footDirty || this._framesChanged());
    }
    _takeGone() {
        if (this.goneFrames.size) {
            const gone = new Set();
            for (const f of this.goneFrames) { const h = this.homes.get(f); if (h != null) gone.add(h); }
            if (gone.size) for (const [id, rs] of this.sent) if (gone.has(this.recHO[rs])) this.dirty.add(id);
            this.goneFrames.clear();
        }
        for (const k of this.famDirty) for (const r of this.doc.editGroup(k)) if (r.obj.attachRect != null) this.dirty.add(r.obj.id);
        this.famDirty.clear();
    }
    _fold(st) {
        const f = { ids: [...this.dirty], i: 0, items: [] };
        this.dirty.clear();
        this._prepStep(f, Infinity);
        const at = new Map();
        st.items.forEach((r, i) => at.set(r.id, i));
        for (const r of f.items) {
            const i = at.get(r.id);
            if (i == null) { at.set(r.id, st.items.length); st.items.push(r); continue; }
            const was = st.items[i], m = { ...r };
            if (!r.gone && !was.gone) {
                if (!m.raw && was.raw) { m.raw = was.raw; if (was.loops) m.loops = was.loops; }
                if (m.hint == null && was.hint != null) m.hint = was.hint;
            }
            st.items[i] = m;
        }
        for (const id of f.ids) st.ids.push(id);
    }
    _resyncWanted() {
        if (this._forced) return true;
        if (this._mode() === "worker") return true;
        let n = 0;
        for (const L of this.doc.levels()) n += this.doc.count(L);
        return n <= INLINE_AUTO_MAX;
    }
    _mode() {
        if (this.remote) return "worker";
        if (this.core) return "inline";
        if (this.useWorker) { this.remote = openSceneWorker(); if (this.remote) return "worker"; }
        this.core = new SceneIndex();
        return "inline";
    }
    _prepStep(st, budget) {
        const t0 = now();
        const doc = this.doc;
        while (st.i < st.ids.length) {
            const id = st.ids[st.i++];
            const rec = doc.getById(id);
            const o = rec && rec.obj;
            const s = this.sent.get(id);
            if (o && o.attachRect != null && !o.erase) this.patchFam.add(doc.editKey(o));
            const ink = isInk(doc, o), fresh = s === undefined || this.geom.has(id);
            const g = ink && fresh ? sceneGeom(o) : null;
            this.geom.delete(id);
            if (!ink || (fresh && !g)) {
                if (s !== undefined) { st.items.push({ id, gone: true }); this.sent.delete(id); this.recFree.push(s); }
                this.hints.delete(id);
            } else {
                const t = residual(o.below, 0);
                const tx = t ? t[0] : 0, ty = t ? t[1] : 0, home = o._home, ho = this._homeIx(home);
                const w = g ? g.w : this.recW[s];
                if (fresh || this.recW[s] !== w || this.recHO[s] !== ho || this.recTX[s] !== tx || this.recTY[s] !== ty) {
                    const r = { id, home, w, t: t ? [tx, ty] : null };
                    if (fresh) { r.raw = g.raw; if (g.loops) r.loops = g.loops; }
                    const h = this.hints.get(id);
                    if (s === undefined && h != null) r.hint = h;
                    st.items.push(r);
                    const k = s !== undefined ? s : this._recSlot();
                    this.recW[k] = w; this.recTX[k] = tx; this.recTY[k] = ty; this.recHO[k] = ho;
                    if (s === undefined) this.sent.set(id, k);
                }
                this.hints.delete(id);
            }
            if ((st.i & 63) === 0 && now() - t0 > budget) break;
        }
        this.stats.prepMs += now() - t0;
        this.stats.lastPrepMs = (st.prepMs = (st.prepMs || 0) + (now() - t0));
        return st.i >= st.ids.length;
    }
    _recSlot() {
        if (this.recFree.length) return this.recFree.pop();
        const k = this.recTop++;
        if (k >= this.recW.length) {
            const n = this.recW.length * 2, grow = (A) => { const B = new A.constructor(n); B.set(A); return B; };
            this.recW = grow(this.recW); this.recTX = grow(this.recTX); this.recTY = grow(this.recTY); this.recHO = grow(this.recHO);
        }
        return k;
    }
    _homeIx(home) {
        let h = this.homes.get(home);
        if (h == null) { h = this.homeOf.length; this.homes.set(home, h); this.homeOf.push(home); }
        return h;
    }
    _frameRec(f) {
        return { id: f.id, parent: f.parent == null ? null : f.parent, depth: f.depth,
            cx: f.centre ? f.centre.x : 0, cy: f.centre ? f.centre.y : 0,
            sx: f.shift ? f.shift[0] : 0, sy: f.shift ? f.shift[1] : 0 };
    }
    _sameFrame(r, f) {
        return !!r && r.parent === (f.parent == null ? null : f.parent) && r.depth === f.depth
            && r.cx === (f.centre ? f.centre.x : 0) && r.cy === (f.centre ? f.centre.y : 0)
            && r.sx === (f.shift ? f.shift[0] : 0) && r.sy === (f.shift ? f.shift[1] : 0);
    }
    _framesChanged() {
        if (this.frameKeys.size !== this.lm.frames.size) return true;
        for (const f of this.lm.frames.values()) if (!this._sameFrame(this.frameKeys.get(f.id), f)) return true;
        return false;
    }
    _frameDiff() {
        const out = [];
        for (const f of this.lm.frames.values()) {
            if (this._sameFrame(this.frameKeys.get(f.id), f)) continue;
            const r = this._frameRec(f);
            out.push(r); this.frameKeys.set(f.id, { ...r });
        }
        for (const id of [...this.frameKeys.keys()]) if (!this.lm.frames.has(id)) { out.push({ id, gone: true }); this.frameKeys.delete(id); }
        return out;
    }
    _startResync(kind, state) {
        this._cancel();
        this.gen++;
        this.inflight = null;
        this.pending = null;
        this.dirty.clear(); this.attr.clear(); this.goneFrames.clear(); this.famDirty.clear(); this.patchFam.clear();
        this.hints.clear(); this.frameKeys.clear();
        this.sent.clear(); this.recTop = 0; this.recFree = []; this.geom.clear(); this.fsent.clear(); this.markGeo.clear();
        this.resync = { kind, ids: null, i: 0, items: [], fev: this.frameEv, state: kind === "reset" ? (state !== undefined ? state : this.export) : undefined };
        if (kind === "load") { this.export = null; this.foot = new Map(); }
        this._schedule();
    }
    _loadFoot(list) {
        this.foot = new Map();
        for (const e of Array.isArray(list) ? list : []) {
            if (!e || !Number.isInteger(e.id) || !Array.isArray(e.raw) || e.raw.length % 5 || !(e.w > 0)) continue;
            const fr = this.lm.frame(String(e.home));
            this.foot.set(e.id, { id: e.id, e: e.e, host: e.host, key: e.key, home: String(e.home), depth: fr ? fr.depth : null, w: e.w, boxes: e.raw.slice(), off: !!e.off, raw: null, t: null });
        }
        this._capFoot();
        this.footDirty = this.foot.size > 0;
    }
    _resyncStep(budget) {
        const r = this.resync;
        if (r.kind === "load" && !r.footRead) {
            r.footRead = true;
            const saved = this.E.docMeta && this.E.docMeta.sceneIndex;
            this._loadFoot(saved && saved.erase);
        }
        if (!r.ids) {
            r.ids = [];
            for (const L of this.doc.levels()) for (const o of this.doc.list(L)) r.ids.push(o.id);
            this.dirty.clear();
        }
        if (!this._prepStep(r, budget)) return false;
        if (r.fev !== this.frameEv && this.dirty.size) this._fold(r);
        this.resync = null;
        const restore = {};
        const meta = this.E.docMeta || {};
        const saved = r.kind === "load" ? meta.sceneIndex : r.state || meta.sceneIndex;
        if (saved && saved.v === 3 && Array.isArray(saved.scenes)) restore.state = saved;
        else {
            const old = (meta.scenes || []).filter((s) => !s.kind && /^s\d+$/.test(String(s.id))).map((s) => {
                const f = this.lm.frameFor(s.level);
                const seq = parseInt(String(s.id).replace(/^s/, ""), 10);
                return f && s.rect ? { id: s.id, seq: Number.isFinite(seq) ? seq : 0, name: s.name, named: !!s.pinned, anchor: f.id, rect: { ...s.rect } } : null;
            }).filter(Boolean);
            restore.legacy = old;
            restore.seq = Math.max(meta.sceneSeq || 1, ...old.map((s) => s.seq + 1), 1);
        }
        this.frameKeys.clear();
        const frames = this._frameDiff();
        if (this.foot.size) this._footItems(r.items);
        this.stats.restores++;
        this._send({ restore, frames, items: r.items, renames: this.renames.splice(0) }, r.ids);
        return true;
    }
    _send(batch, ids) {
        const mode = this._mode();
        this.stats.batches++;
        this.stats.lastItems = batch.items.length;
        this.stats.items += batch.items.length;
        if (mode === "inline") {
            let out;
            try { out = this.core.apply(batch); } catch (err) { this._failed(err, batch, ids); return; }
            this._landed(out);
            return;
        }
        const gen = this.gen;
        this.inflight = { ids, gen, restore: !!batch.restore, state: batch.restore ? batch.restore.state || null : null, t0: now() };
        this.remote.post(batch).then((out) => {
            if (this.destroyed || gen !== this.gen) return;
            this.inflight = null;
            this._landed(out);
        }, (err) => {
            if (this.destroyed || gen !== this.gen) return;
            this.inflight = null;
            try { if (this.remote) this.remote.terminate(); } catch (e) {  }
            this.remote = null;
            this.workerFails = (this.workerFails || 0) + 1;
            if (this.workerFails > SCENE_WORKER_RESPAWNS) this.useWorker = false;
            this._failed(err, batch, ids);
        });
    }
    _failed(err, batch, ids) {
        try { console.warn("scene index failed; rebuilding", err); } catch (e) {  }
        this.core = null;
        if (batch && batch.restore) { this._startResync("reset", batch.restore.state || null); return; }
        const base = this.export || (this.E.docMeta && this.E.docMeta.sceneIndex) || null;
        const again = new Set(base && base.dirty ? base.dirty : []);
        for (const id of ids || []) again.add(id);
        for (const id of this.dirty) again.add(id);
        if (this.pending) for (const id of this.pending.ids) again.add(id);
        const state = base ? { ...base, dirty: [...again].filter((id) => Number.isInteger(id) && id >= 0) } : null;
        this._startResync("reset", state);
    }
    _landed(out) {
        if (!out) return;
        this.export = out.export;
        this.stats.lastApplyMs = out.ms || 0;
        this.stats.applyMs += out.ms || 0;
        this.stats.lastStats = out.stats;
        this.E.docMeta = { ...this.E.docMeta, scenes: out.scenes };
        for (const fn of this.listeners) { try { fn(out); } catch (err) {  } }
        if (this._owed()) this._schedule();
    }
    _owed() {
        return !!(this.resync || this.pending || this._hasWork());
    }
    flushNow() {
        if (this.destroyed) return false;
        const E = this.E;
        if (E._drawing || E._dragSel || E._lasso) { this._schedule(); return false; }
        this._forced = true;
        try {
            if (this._mode() !== "inline") { this._cancel(); this._schedule(0); return false; }
            for (let guard = 0; guard < 1000; guard++) {
                if (this.resync) { this._resyncStep(Infinity); continue; }
                if (this.pending) {
                    this._prepStep(this.pending, Infinity);
                    const p = this.pending; this.pending = null;
                    this._sendPrepared(p);
                    continue;
                }
                if (this._hasWork()) {
                    this._takeGone();
                    const st = { ids: [...this.dirty], i: 0, items: [], fev: this.frameEv };
                    this.dirty.clear();
                    this._prepStep(st, Infinity);
                    this._sendPrepared(st);
                    continue;
                }
                break;
            }
            return true;
        } finally { this._forced = false; }
    }
    rename(id, name) {
        const list = this.E.docMeta.scenes || [];
        const s = list.find((x) => x.id === id);
        if (!s || typeof name !== "string" || !name.trim()) return false;
        const nm = name.trim().slice(0, 120);
        this.E.docMeta = { ...this.E.docMeta, scenes: list.map((x) => (x.id === id ? { ...x, name: nm, pinned: true, auto: false } : x)) };
        this.renames.push([id, nm]);
        this._schedule(0);
        return true;
    }
    exportForSave() {
        const base = this.export || (this.E.docMeta && this.E.docMeta.sceneIndex) || null;
        if (!base) return null;
        const dirty = new Set(base.dirty || []);
        for (const id of this.dirty) dirty.add(id);
        if (this.pending) for (const id of this.pending.ids) dirty.add(id);
        if (this.inflight && !this.inflight.restore) for (const id of this.inflight.ids || []) dirty.add(id);
        const rs = this.resync ? this.resync.state : this.inflight && this.inflight.restore ? this.inflight.state : null;
        if (rs && rs.dirty) for (const id of rs.dirty) dirty.add(id);
        let scenes = base.scenes;
        if (this.renames.length) {
            const names = new Map(this.renames);
            scenes = scenes.map((s) => (names.has(s.id) ? { ...s, name: names.get(s.id), named: true } : s));
        }
        const erase = [...this.foot.values()].filter((fp) => !fp.drop && fp.boxes.length).map((fp) => {
            const e = { id: fp.id, e: fp.e, host: fp.host, key: fp.key, home: fp.home, w: fp.w, raw: fp.boxes.slice() };
            if (fp.off) e.off = true;
            return e;
        });
        return { ...base, scenes, dirty: [...dirty].filter((id) => Number.isInteger(id) && id >= 0), erase };
    }
}

export class FrameTable {
    constructor() { this.cur = new Map(); this.prev = null; this._maps = new Map(); this._old = new Map(); }
    get(id) { return this.cur.get(id); }
    depth(id) { const f = this.cur.get(id); return f ? f.depth : null; }
    update(recs) {
        const moved = new Set(), shifted = new Set(), gone = new Set();
        this.prev = null;
        if (!recs || !recs.length) return { moved, shifted, gone };
        this.prev = new Map();
        for (const r of recs) {
            const was = this.cur.get(r.id) || null;
            if (r.gone) { if (was) { this.prev.set(r.id, was); this.cur.delete(r.id); gone.add(r.id); } continue; }
            const f = { id: r.id, parent: r.parent == null ? null : r.parent, depth: r.depth,
                cx: r.cx || 0, cy: r.cy || 0, sx: r.sx || 0, sy: r.sy || 0 };
            if (was && was.parent === f.parent && was.depth === f.depth && was.cx === f.cx && was.cy === f.cy) {
                if (was.sx !== f.sx || was.sy !== f.sy) { shifted.add(f.id); this.prev.set(f.id, was); this.cur.set(f.id, f); }
                continue;
            }
            this.prev.set(r.id, was);
            this.cur.set(r.id, f);
            if (was) moved.add(r.id);
        }
        this._maps.clear(); this._old.clear();
        return { moved, shifted, gone };
    }
    settle() { this.prev = null; this._old.clear(); }
    _rec(id, old) {
        if (old && this.prev && this.prev.has(id)) return this.prev.get(id);
        return this.cur.get(id);
    }
    parentOf(id, old = false) { const f = this._rec(id, old); return f ? f.parent : null; }
    under(id, roots) {
        if (!roots || !roots.size) return false;
        let f = this.cur.get(id);
        for (let g = 0; f && g < 4096; g++) { if (roots.has(f.id)) return true; f = f.parent != null ? this.cur.get(f.parent) : null; }
        return false;
    }
    _up(id, depth, old) {
        let f = this._rec(id, old), s = 1, ox = 0, oy = 0;
        while (f && f.depth > depth) {
            if (f.parent == null) return null;
            s /= R; ox = ox / R + f.cx; oy = oy / R + f.cy;
            f = this._rec(f.parent, old);
        }
        return f && f.depth === depth ? { f, s, ox, oy } : null;
    }
    _across(a, b, old) {
        const ca = [], cb = [];
        let fa = a, fb = b;
        for (let g = 0; fa !== fb; g++) {
            if (!fa || !fb || fa.parent == null || fb.parent == null || g > 4096) return null;
            ca.push(fa); cb.push(fb);
            fa = this._rec(fa.parent, old); fb = this._rec(fb.parent, old);
        }
        let ox = 0, oy = 0;
        for (let i = ca.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { ox = (ox + ca[i].cx - cb[i].cx) * R; oy = (oy + ca[i].cy - cb[i].cy) * R; }
        return [ox, oy];
    }
    map(from, to, old = false) {
        const useOld = !!(old && this.prev && this.prev.size);
        const cache = useOld ? this._old : this._maps;
        const key = from + "\u0001" + to;
        const hit = cache.get(key);
        if (hit !== undefined) return hit;
        let out = null;
        const a = this._rec(from, useOld), b = this._rec(to, useOld);
        if (a && b) {
            const d = Math.min(a.depth, b.depth);
            const A = this._up(from, d, useOld), B = this._up(to, d, useOld);
            const off = A && B ? this._across(A.f, B.f, useOld) : null;
            if (off) out = { s: A.s / B.s, ox: (A.ox + off[0] - B.ox) / B.s, oy: (A.oy + off[1] - B.oy) / B.s };
        }
        cache.set(key, out);
        return out;
    }
}
export function encodeIds(ids) {
    const s = [...ids].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const out = [];
    let prev = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < s.length;) {
        let j = i;
        while (j + 1 < s.length && s[j + 1] === s[j] + 1) j++;
        const gap = (s[i] - prev).toString(36);
        out.push(j > i ? gap + "." + (j - i).toString(36) : gap);
        prev = s[j];
        i = j + 1;
    }
    return out.join(",");
}
export function decodeIds(str, max = MAX_IDS) {
    const out = [];
    if (!str) return out;
    let prev = 0;
    for (const tok of String(str).split(",")) {
        const [g, e] = tok.split(".");
        const a = prev + parseInt(g, 36);
        const n = e ? parseInt(e, 36) : 0;
        if (!Number.isFinite(a) || !Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0 || out.length + n + 1 > max) return out;
        for (let k = 0; k <= n; k++) out.push(a + k);
        prev = a + n;
    }
    return out;
}
export const rectCover = (t, r) => {
    const ix = Math.max(0, Math.min(t.x + t.w, r.x + r.w) - Math.max(t.x, r.x));
    const iy = Math.max(0, Math.min(t.y + t.h, r.y + r.h) - Math.max(t.y, r.y));
    const a = t.w * t.h;
    return a > 0 ? (ix * iy) / a : 0;
};
const grow = (bb, P, o0, n) => {
    for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        const o = o0 + 4 * k;
        if (P[o] < bb[0]) bb[0] = P[o]; if (P[o + 1] < bb[1]) bb[1] = P[o + 1];
        if (P[o + 2] > bb[2]) bb[2] = P[o + 2]; if (P[o + 3] > bb[3]) bb[3] = P[o + 3];
    }
};
const EMPTY_BB = () => [Infinity, Infinity, -Infinity, -Infinity];

const fnv = (str) => { let h = 0x811c9dc5; for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) { h ^= str.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193) >>> 0; } return h.toString(36); };

class CellTab {
    constructor(cap = 8) { this.keys = new Float64Array(cap).fill(-1); this.segs = new Int32Array(cap); this.mask = cap - 1; this.n = 0; }
    _h(key) { const hi = Math.floor(key / KEYM), lo = key - hi * KEYM; return (Math.imul(hi, 0x9E3779B1) ^ Math.imul(lo, 0x85EBCA77)) & this.mask; }
    find(key) {
        const K = this.keys;
        for (let i = this._h(key); ; i = (i + 1) & this.mask) { const k = K[i]; if (k === key) return this.segs[i]; if (k < 0) return -1; }
    }
    set(key, seg) {
        if ((this.n + 1) * 2 > this.mask + 1) this._grow();
        const K = this.keys;
        let i = this._h(key);
        while (K[i] >= 0 && K[i] !== key) i = (i + 1) & this.mask;
        if (K[i] < 0) { this.n++; K[i] = key; }
        this.segs[i] = seg;
    }
    _grow() {
        const K = this.keys, V = this.segs;
        const t = new CellTab((this.mask + 1) * 2);
        for (let i = 0; i < K.length; i++) if (K[i] >= 0) t.set(K[i], V[i]);
        this.keys = t.keys; this.segs = t.segs; this.mask = t.mask; this.n = t.n;
    }
}
function segAlloc(G, cap) {
    const need = G.top + 2 + cap;
    if (need > G.P.length) { const P = new Uint32Array(Math.max(need, G.P.length * 2)); P.set(G.P.subarray(0, G.top)); G.P = P; }
    const s = G.top;
    G.P[s] = cap; G.P[s + 1] = 0; G.top = need;
    return s;
}
const roomFor = (len) => len + (len >> 2) + 1;
function gridCompact(G) {
    let need = 0;
    const tabs = [...G.all.values(), ...G.own.values()];
    for (const t of tabs) for (let i = 0; i < t.keys.length; i++) if (t.keys[i] >= 0) { const len = G.P[t.segs[i] + 1]; if (len) need += 2 + roomFor(len); }
    const P = new Uint32Array(Math.max(64, need));
    let top = 0;
    const redo = (bands) => {
        for (const [b, t] of bands) {
            let n = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < t.keys.length; i++) if (t.keys[i] >= 0 && G.P[t.segs[i] + 1]) n++;
            let cap = 8; while (cap < 2 * n) cap *= 2;
            const u = new CellTab(cap);
            for (let i = 0; i < t.keys.length; i++) {
                if (t.keys[i] < 0) continue;
                const s = t.segs[i], len = G.P[s + 1];
                if (!len) continue;
                const cap = roomFor(len);
                P[top] = cap; P[top + 1] = len;
                P.set(G.P.subarray(s + 2, s + 2 + len), top + 2);
                u.set(t.keys[i], top);
                top += 2 + cap;
            }
            if (u.n) bands.set(b, u); else bands.delete(b);
        }
    };
    const old = G.P;
    redo(G.all); redo(G.own);
    void old;
    let live = 0;
    for (const t of [...G.all.values(), ...G.own.values()]) for (let i = 0; i < t.keys.length; i++) if (t.keys[i] >= 0) live += 2 + P[t.segs[i] + 1];
    G.P = P; G.top = top; G.waste = 0; G.live = live;
}
const padInk = (r, wmin) => {
    let x = r[0], y = r[1], w = r[2] - r[0], h = r[3] - r[1];
