        try { return fn(); } finally {
            const m = this._moving;
            this._moving = null;
            if (this.selection && (m.ids.size || m.frames.size)) this._reselect([...m.ids], this._outsideSelection(m.frames));
        }
    }
    _reselect(ids, torn) {
        const s = this.selection;
        if (!s) return;
        const frames = s.frames.concat(torn);
        const add = [], back = new Set();
        for (const id of ids) {
            const rec = this.doc.getById(id);
            if (!rec) continue;
            const under = this._underFrames(rec.level, frames), listed = s.ids.includes(id);
            if (!under && !listed) add.push(id);
            else if (under && listed) back.add(id);
        }
        const inked = this._inkedFrames();
        const keep = frames.filter((f) => inked.has(f));
        if (!add.length && !back.size && keep.length === s.frames.length && keep.every((f, k) => f === s.frames[k])) return;
        this._setSelection(s.ids.filter((id) => !back.has(id)).concat(add), keep);
    }
    _rectInActive(o, level) {
        const b = bboxOf(o, this.store.live);
        const m = o.type === "fill" ? 0 : (o.lwFrame || 0) / 2;
        const rect = { left: b.x0 - m, top: b.y0 - m, right: b.x1 + m, bottom: b.y1 + m };
        if (!o.below) return this.lm.mapRectF(rect, level, this.cam.frame);
        return this.lm.mapRectObj(rect, level, this.cam.frame, o.below, level);
    }
    _objPointInActive(o, level, p) {
        const F = this.cam.frame;
        if (!o.below) return level === F ? p : this.lm.mapPointF(p, level, F);
        return this.lm.mapPointObj(p, level, F, o.below, level);
    }
    _lassoFind(poly) {
        const box = { left: Infinity, top: Infinity, right: -Infinity, bottom: -Infinity };
        for (const p of poly) {
            if (p[0] < box.left) box.left = p[0];
            if (p[0] > box.right) box.right = p[0];
            if (p[1] < box.top) box.top = p[1];
            if (p[1] > box.bottom) box.bottom = p[1];
        }
        const found = [];
        const frames = [];
        const ink = loopTester(poly);
        const takeAll = (id) => { frames.push(id); };
        const inked = this._inkedFrames();
        const noWhole = new Set();
        const visit = (id, s, tx, ty, skip) => {
            if (!inked.has(id)) return;
            const own = { left: -REACH * s + tx, top: -REACH * s + ty,
                right: REACH * s + tx, bottom: REACH * s + ty };
            if (own.right < box.left || own.left > box.right
                || own.bottom < box.top || own.top > box.bottom) return;
            if (!noWhole.has(id) && rectInsidePolygon(poly, own)) { takeAll(id); return; }
            for (const o of this.doc.queryRect(id, { left: (box.left - tx) / s, top: (box.top - ty) / s,
                right: (box.right - tx) / s, bottom: (box.bottom - ty) / s })) {
                if (o.erase) continue;
                const r = this._rectInActive(o, id);
                if (!r) continue;
                if (rectInsidePolygon(poly, r)) { found.push(o.id); continue; }
                if (r.right < box.left || r.left > box.right || r.bottom < box.top || r.top > box.bottom) continue;
                if (this._inkInsidePolygon(o, id, ink)) found.push(o.id);
            }
            for (const c of this.lm.childrenOf(id)) {
                if (c.id === skip || !c.centre) continue;
                visit(c.id, s / CROSS_RATIO, c.centre.x * s + tx, c.centre.y * s + ty, null);
            }
        };
        for (let pass = 0; pass < LASSO_PASSES; pass++) {
            found.length = 0; frames.length = 0;
            if (this._ufMemo) this._ufMemo.delete(frames);
            this._lassoWalk(visit);
            this._lassoMoved(poly, box, ink, found, frames);
            const torn = frames.length ? this._tornUnder(frames, found) : null;
            if (!torn || !torn.size) break;
            for (const f of torn) noWhole.add(f);
        }
        const set = new Set(found);
        const whole = new Map();
        const out = [];
        for (const id of set) {
            const rec = this.doc.getById(id);
            if (!rec) continue;
            if (rec.obj.editId == null) { out.push(id); continue; }
            const key = this.doc.editKey(rec.obj);
            let ok = whole.get(key);
            if (ok === undefined) {
                ok = this._familyBounded(rec.obj, set, frames);
                whole.set(key, ok);
            }
            if (ok) out.push(id);
        }
        return { ids: out, frames };
    }
    _lassoWalk(visit) {
        visit(this.cam.frame, 1, 0, 0, null);
        let child = this.lm.frame(this.cam.frame), s = 1, tx = 0, ty = 0;
        while (child && child.parent != null) {
            const c = child.centre;
            if (!c) break;
            s *= CROSS_RATIO; tx -= c.x * s; ty -= c.y * s;
            visit(child.parent, s, tx, ty, child.id);
            child = this.lm.frame(child.parent);
        }
    }
    _familyBounded(o, found, frames) {
        return this.doc.editGroup(o).every((m) => m.obj.erase || found.has(m.obj.id)
            || (frames.length > 0 && this._underFrames(m.level, frames)));
    }
    _tornUnder(frames, found) {
        const keyed = new Set();
        for (const k of this.doc.keyedFrames()) {
            for (let f = this.lm.frame(k); f && !keyed.has(f.id); f = f.parent != null ? this.lm.frame(f.parent) : null) keyed.add(f.id);
        }
        const set = new Set(found), whole = new Map(), torn = new Set();
        const check = (fid, top) => {
            for (const o of this.doc.keyedIn(fid) || []) {
                const key = this.doc.editKey(o);
                let ok = whole.get(key);
                if (ok === undefined) { ok = this._familyBounded(o, set, frames); whole.set(key, ok); }
                if (ok) continue;
                for (let f = this.lm.frame(fid); f; f = f.parent != null ? this.lm.frame(f.parent) : null) {
                    torn.add(f.id);
                    if (f.id === top) break;
                }
            }
        };
        const down = (fid, top) => {
            check(fid, top);
            for (const c of this.lm.childrenOf(fid)) if (keyed.has(c.id)) down(c.id, top);
        };
        for (const X of frames) if (keyed.has(X)) down(X, X);
        return torn;
    }
    _lassoMoved(poly, box, ink, found, frames) {
        if (this.doc.hasOffsets()) {
            const have = new Set(found);
            const F = this.cam.frame;
            for (const id of this.doc.offsetIds()) {
                if (have.has(id)) continue;
                const rec = this.doc.getById(id);
                if (!rec || rec.obj.erase || this.lm.frameFactor(rec.level, F) == null) continue;
                if (frames.length && this._underFrames(rec.level, frames)) continue;
                const r = this._rectInActive(rec.obj, rec.level);
                if (!r) continue;
                if (rectInsidePolygon(poly, r)) { found.push(id); continue; }
                if (r.right < box.left || r.left > box.right || r.bottom < box.top || r.top > box.bottom) continue;
                if (this._inkInsidePolygon(rec.obj, rec.level, ink)) found.push(id);
            }
        }
    }
    _inkInsidePolygon(o, level, ink) {
        const f = this.lm.frameFactor(level, this.cam.frame);
        if (f == null) return false;
        const pxPerUnit = this.cam.inScale * f;
        if (!(pxPerUnit > 0)) return false;
        const toActive = (p) => this._objPointInActive(o, level, p);
        const raw = o.type === "shape" ? null : o.type === "fill" ? o.polys : [o.pts];
        if (raw) {
            for (const ring of raw) for (const p of everyNth(ring, 200)) {
                const q = toActive(p);
                if (!q || !ink.inside(q)) return false;
            }
        } else if (o.loops) {
            const ends = [];
            for (const loop of o.loops) for (const piece of loop) ends.push(piece.A);
            for (const p of everyNth(ends, 400)) {
                const q = toActive(p);
                if (!q || !ink.inside(q)) return false;
            }
        }
        const tol = LASSO_INK_TOL_PX / pxPerUnit;
        let rings;
        try { rings = this._inkOutline(o, tol); } catch (err) { return false; }
        if (!rings || !rings.length) return false;
        for (const ring0 of rings) {
            if (!ring0 || ring0.length < 2) continue;
            const ring = everyNth(ring0, LASSO_INK_MAX_PTS);
            const mapped = [];
            for (const p of ring) {
                const q = toActive(p);
                if (!q) return false;
                mapped.push(q);
            }
            if (!ink.ringInside(mapped)) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    _setSelection(ids, frames = []) {
        const live = ids.filter((id) => this.doc.getById(id));
        const fr = [...new Set(frames)].filter((f) => this.lm.frame(f));
        if (!live.length && !fr.length) { this.deselect(); return null; }
        const rec = live.length ? this.doc.getById(live[0]) : null;
        this.selection = {
            ids: live, frames: fr, id: rec ? rec.obj.id : null, editId: rec ? this.doc.editKey(rec.obj) : null,
            level: rec ? rec.level : fr[0], obj: rec ? rec.obj : null,
        };
        this.renderer.syncCameraOnly(); this.renderer.update();
        this._emit();
        return this.selection;
    }
    _toggleSelected(id) {
        const frames = this.selection ? [...(this.selection.frames || [])] : [];
        const rec = this.doc.getById(id);
        if (rec && frames.length && this._underFrames(rec.level, frames)) return this.selection;
        const cur = this.selection ? [...this.selection.ids] : [];
        const i = cur.indexOf(id);
        if (i >= 0) cur.splice(i, 1); else cur.push(id);
        return this._setSelection(cur, frames);
    }
    _applyLasso(L) {
        const poly = L.pts.map(([x, y]) => this.cam.screenToFrame(x, y));
        this._settleLassoErases(poly);
        const { ids: found, frames } = this._lassoFind(poly);
        if (!L.ctrl) {
            if (found.length || frames.length) this._setSelection(found, frames); else this.deselect();
            return;
        }
        const cur = this.selection ? [...this.selection.ids] : [];
        const curFr = this.selection ? [...(this.selection.frames || [])] : [];
        if (!found.length && !frames.length) return;
        if (found.every((id) => cur.includes(id)) && frames.every((f) => curFr.includes(f))) {
            this._setSelection(cur.filter((id) => !found.includes(id)), curFr.filter((f) => !frames.includes(f)));
            return;
        }
        for (const id of found) if (!cur.includes(id)) cur.push(id);
        for (const f of frames) if (!curFr.includes(f)) curFr.push(f);
        this._setSelection(cur, curFr);
    }
    select(sx, sy) {
        for (let guard = 0; guard < 8; guard++) {
            const id = this._hitTest(sx, sy);
            if (id == null) { this.deselect(); return null; }
            if (this._flushErasesFor(id)) { this._render(); continue; }
            const rec = this.doc.getById(id);
            if (!rec) { this.deselect(); return null; }
            this._setSelection([id]);
            return id;
        }
        this.deselect();
        return null;
    }
    deselect() {
        if (!this.selection) return;
        if (this._dragSel) this._endMove("deselect");
        this.selection = null;
        this.renderer.syncCameraOnly(); this.renderer.update();
        this._emit();
    }
    _dragSelection(sx, sy) {
        const d = this._dragSel;
        d.last = [sx, sy];
        const tx = snapDisplacement((sx - d.start[0]) / this.cam.inScale);
        const ty = snapDisplacement((sy - d.start[1]) / this.cam.inScale);
        const camDepth = this.cam.activeLevel;
        let moved = false;
        const skip = (id, level, why) => { (d.skipped || (d.skipped = [])).push({ id, level, why }); };
        const seen = new Map();
        const rehomes = new Map();
        const offsets = [];
        if (!d.members) d.members = this._selectionMembers().map((m) => m.obj);
        for (const o of d.members) {
            const id = o.id;
            if (this.doc._byId.get(id) !== o || o._gone) continue;
            let st = d.moves.get(id);
            if (!st) {
                st = { from: o._home, to: o._home, dx: 0, dy: 0, baseBelow: cloneBelow(o.below) };
                st.below = st.baseBelow;
                st.key = st.from + "|" + JSON.stringify(st.baseBelow || null);
                d.moves.set(id, st);
            }
            const key = st.key;
            let put = seen.get(key);
            if (!put) { put = this._displaceMember(st.from, st.baseBelow, camDepth, tx, ty); seen.set(key, put); }
            if (put.why) { skip(id, st.from, put.why); continue; }
            if (put.frame !== st.to) {
                let ids = rehomes.get(put.frame);
                if (!ids) rehomes.set(put.frame, ids = []);
                ids.push(id); st.to = put.frame; moved = true;
            }
            if (!sameBelow(put.table, st.below)) { offsets.push([id, put.table]); st.below = put.table; moved = true; }
            st.dx = tx; st.dy = ty;
        }
        for (const [frame, ids] of rehomes) this.doc.rehomeManyById(ids, frame);
        for (const [id, table] of offsets) this.doc.setOffsetsById(id, table);
        if (this.selection.frames.length) {
            if (!d.frameStart) this._dragFramesStart(d, camDepth);
            if (d.frameStart.size && this._dragFrames(d, camDepth, tx, ty)) moved = true;
        }
        d.moved = d.moved || moved;
        if (this._holdMove && this.renderer.dragLight && this.renderer.dragLight()) {
            if (!d.listAt) d.listAt = d.start;
            this.renderer.syncCameraOnly(); this.renderer.update(); this._emit();
        } else { d.listAt = null; this._render(); }
    }
    _dragFramesStart(d, camDepth) {
        d.frameStart = new Map();
        this.doc.holdMerges = true;
        const all = this.selection.frames;
        for (const f of all) {
            if (this._underFrames(f, all.filter((x) => x !== f))) continue;
            for (const [id, e] of this.lm.subtreeStart(f, camDepth)) {
                if (id !== f && !this.lm.childrenOf(id).length && this.doc.count(id) === 0) continue;
                d.frameStart.set(id, e);
                const fr = this.lm.frame(id);
                d.frames.set(id, { id, depth: e.depth, from: { parent: e.parent, i: e.i, j: e.j }, to: null,
                    shiftBefore: fr && fr.shift ? [fr.shift[0], fr.shift[1]] : null, shiftAfter: null, settled: null, merged: null });
            }
        }
    }
    _dragFrames(d, camDepth, tx, ty) {
        const targets = this.lm.moveSubtreeTargets(null, camDepth, tx, ty, d.frameStart, (id) => { const e = d.frames.get(id); return e ? e.shiftBefore : null; });
        const apply = [];
        for (const t of targets) {
            const e = d.frames.get(t.id);
            if (t.why) { (d.skipped || (d.skipped = [])).push({ id: t.id, level: t.id, why: t.why }); continue; }
            e.shiftAfter = t.shift;
            if (e.settled && !sameShift(e.shiftAfter, [e.settled.dx, e.settled.dy])) { this.doc.unsettle(e.id, e.settled); e.settled = null; }
            apply.push(t);
        }
        const was = new Map(apply.map((t) => { const f = this.lm.frame(t.id); return [t.id, { parent: f.parent, i: f.cell.i, j: f.cell.j }]; }));
        const r = this.lm.readdressMany(apply, { empty: (id) => this.doc.count(id) === 0 });
        let moved = false;
        for (const t of apply) {
            const e = d.frames.get(t.id);
            const f = this.lm.frame(t.id);
            const to = { parent: f.parent, i: f.cell.i, j: f.cell.j };
            const w = was.get(t.id);
            const addrChanged = to.parent !== w.parent || to.i !== w.i || to.j !== w.j;
            const shiftChanged = !e.settled && !sameShift(f.shift, e.shiftAfter);
            if (addrChanged || shiftChanged) this.doc.noteRefile(t.id, w, to);
            if (shiftChanged) this.doc.setFrameShift(t.id, e.shiftAfter);
            this.doc.noteFrameOwner(t.id, e);
            e.to = to;
            if (addrChanged || shiftChanged) moved = true;
        }
        for (const c of r.shadowed) (d.frameShadowed || (d.frameShadowed = [])).push(c);
        return moved;
    }
    _restoreFrames(d) {
        for (const e of d.frames.values()) if (e.settled) { this.doc.unsettle(e.id, e.settled); e.settled = null; }
        const back = [], was = new Map();
        for (const e of d.frames.values()) {
            const f = this.lm.frame(e.id);
            if (!f) continue;
            if (f.parent === e.from.parent && f.cell.i === e.from.i && f.cell.j === e.from.j) continue;
            was.set(e.id, { parent: f.parent, i: f.cell.i, j: f.cell.j });
            back.push({ id: e.id, depth: e.depth, parent: e.from.parent, i: e.from.i, j: e.from.j });
        }
        this.lm.readdressMany(back, { empty: (id) => this.doc.count(id) === 0 });
        for (const t of back) { const f = this.lm.frame(t.id); this.doc.noteRefile(t.id, was.get(t.id), { parent: f.parent, i: f.cell.i, j: f.cell.j }); }
        for (const e of d.frames.values()) { this.doc.setFrameShift(e.id, e.shiftBefore); this.doc.noteFrameOwner(e.id, null); }
        this.doc.holdMerges = false;
    }
    _frameUnderPoint(sx, sy) {
        const s = this.selection; if (!s || !s.frames.length) return null;
        for (const f of s.frames) {
            const p = this.cam.levelPointToScreen(f, 0, 0);
            if (p && Math.hypot(p[0] - sx, p[1] - sy) <= SEL_FRAME_HIT_PX) return f;
        }
        return null;
    }
    _displaceMember(from, below, camDepth, tx, ty) {
        const depth = this.lm.depthOf(from);
        if (depth == null) return { why: "home frame has no depth" };
        let frame = from, r;
        if (depth <= camDepth) r = addOffset(below, camDepth - depth, tx, ty);
        else {
            const put = this.lm.displaceFrame(from, camDepth, tx, ty);
            if (!put) return { why: "displaceFrame refused: no frame at the camera's depth on this member's ancestry" };
            frame = put.frame.id;
            r = addOffset(below, 0, put.rest[0], put.rest[1]);
        }
        if (r.cellX || r.cellY) {
            const n = this.lm.neighbour(frame, r.cellX, r.cellY);
            if (!n) return { why: "no neighbour cell for the carry" };
            frame = n.id;
        }
        return { frame, table: r.below };
    }
    _homeShift(id) {
        const rec = this.doc.getById(id);
        if (!rec) return null;
        const b = bboxOf(rec.obj, this.store.live);
        if (!b) return null;
        const cx = (b.x0 + b.x1) / 2, cy = (b.y0 + b.y1) / 2;
        const di = Math.round(cx / FRAME_W), dj = Math.round(cy / FRAME_W);
        if (!di && !dj) return null;
        const to = this.lm.neighbour(rec.level, di, dj);
        if (!to || to.id === rec.level) return null;
        return { level: to.id, dx: -di * FRAME_W, dy: -dj * FRAME_W };
    }
    _normalizeHome(id) {
        const n = this._homeShift(id);
        if (!n) return null;
        this.doc.rehomeById(id, n.level);
        this.doc.moveById(id, n.dx, n.dy);
        return n;
    }
    _selectionMembers() {
        const s = this.selection; if (!s) return [];
        const seen = new Set(), out = [];
        for (const id of s.ids) {
            const rec = this.doc.getById(id);
            if (!rec) continue;
            for (const m of this.doc.editGroup(this.doc.editKey(rec.obj))) {
                if (seen.has(m.obj.id)) continue;
                seen.add(m.obj.id);
                if (s.frames.length && this._underFrames(m.level, s.frames)) continue;
                out.push(m);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }
    deleteSelection() {
        if (this._carriedLater) this._flushCarried();
        const dr = this._dragSel;
        if (dr && this.selection) {
            const carried = this._carried ? [...this._carried] : [];
            this._carried = null;
            this._reselect(carried, dr.frames ? this._outsideSelection(dr.frames.keys()) : []);
        }
        const s = this.selection; if (!s) return false;
        const records = [];
        const seen = new Set();
        for (const id of s.ids) {
            const hit = this.doc.getById(id);
            if (!hit) continue;
            for (const m of this.doc.editGroup(this.doc.editKey(hit.obj))) {
                if (seen.has(m.obj.id)) continue;
                seen.add(m.obj.id);
                const rec = this.doc.removeById(m.obj.id);
                if (rec) records.push(rec);
            }
        }
        const frames = s.frames || [];
        const frameRecords = [];
        for (const f of frames) {
            if (this._underFrames(f, frames.filter((x) => x !== f))) continue;
            const recs = this.doc.removeFrameSubtree(f);
            if (recs) frameRecords.push(...recs);
        }
        if (!records.length && !frameRecords.length) return false;
        if (!frameRecords.length) this.doc.pushUndo({ op: "eraseMany", records });
        else if (!records.length) this.doc.pushUndo({ op: "removeFrames", records: frameRecords });
        else this.doc.pushUndo({ op: "deleteMany", parts: [{ op: "eraseMany", records }, { op: "removeFrames", records: frameRecords }] });
        if (this._dragSel || this._holdMove) this._endMove("delete");
        this.deselect();
        this._render();
        return true;
    }
    _selectionStatus() {
        const s = this.selection; if (!s) return null;
        return {
            id: s.id, ids: [...s.ids], frames: [...s.frames],
            count: s.ids.length + s.frames.reduce((n, f) => n + (this._underFrames(f, s.frames.filter((x) => x !== f)) ? 0 : this._subtreeCount(f)), 0),
            type: s.obj ? s.obj.type : "frame", level: s.level,
        };
    }
    _subtreeCount(f) {
        let n = 0;
        this.lm.walk(f, (fr) => { n += this.doc.count(fr.id); });
        return n;
    }
    _shapeHit(loops, p, slack, o = null) {
        let inside = null;
        if (o) {
            const m = this._hitIx || (this._hitIx = new WeakMap());
            const c = m.get(o);
            if (c && c.loops === loops && c.ver === o._ver) inside = c.inside;
            else { inside = insideTester(loops); m.set(o, { loops, ver: o._ver, inside }); }
        } else inside = insideTester(loops);
        if (inside(p)) return true;
        if (!(slack > 0)) return false;
        for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
            const a = (k * Math.PI) / 4;
            if (inside([p[0] + slack * Math.cos(a), p[1] + slack * Math.sin(a)])) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    _tinyHit(b, slack) { return slack > 0 && b.x1 - b.x0 < slack && b.y1 - b.y0 < slack; }
    hitTestAt(sx, sy) { return this._hitTest(sx, sy); }
    _hitTest(sx, sy, slackPx = 6, only = null) {
        const p0 = this.cam.screenToFrame(sx, sy);
        const list = this._lastList;
        const slack = slackPx / this.cam.inScale;
        for (let i = list.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            const o = list[i];
            const p = o.res ? [p0[0] - o.res[0], p0[1] - o.res[1]] : p0;
            let hit = false;
            if (o.type === "shape") {
                const b = bboxOf(o, this.store.live);
                if (p[0] < b.x0 - slack || p[0] > b.x1 + slack
                    || p[1] < b.y0 - slack || p[1] > b.y1 + slack) continue;
                hit = this._tinyHit(b, slack) || this._shapeHit(o.loops, p, slack, o);
            }
            else if (o.type === "fill") {
                const b = bboxOf(o, this.store.live);
                if (p[0] < b.x0 - slack || p[0] > b.x1 + slack
                    || p[1] < b.y0 - slack || p[1] > b.y1 + slack) continue;
                hit = this._tinyHit(b, slack) || windingOfPoint(o.polys, p) !== 0;
                for (let k = 0; k < 8 && !hit && slack > 0; k++) {
                    const a = (k * Math.PI) / 4;
                    hit = windingOfPoint(o.polys, [p[0] + slack * Math.cos(a), p[1] + slack * Math.sin(a)]) !== 0;
                }
            }
            else {
                const pts = (o.origin === "native" && o.pts.length > 2) ? flattenCurve(o.pts, (this.cfg.arcTolerancePx * 0.5) / this.cfg.enter) : o.pts;
                hit = distToPolyline(pts, p) <= o.lwFrame / 2 + slack;
            }
            if (!hit) continue;
            const nat = this.doc.getById(o.id);
            if (nat && nat.obj.erase) continue;
            if (only && !only(o.id)) continue;
            return o.id;
        }
        return null;
    }
}
export const selection = Selection.prototype;

//// src/engine/worker/rasterWorker.js
import "../../polyfills";
import {
    unwireJob, wireResult, copyPlate,
    TIMINGS_PER_PLATE, COUNTS_PER_PLATE, GUARDS_PER_JOB, GUARD_NAMES,
} from "../raster/rasterJob";
import { renderPlate, coreStats, drawnFlags, TW, TH } from "../raster/rasterCore";
const RGBA = new Uint8ClampedArray(TW * TH * 4);
const RECYCLE = ["geom", "meta", "attr", "subs", "rgb", "ids"];
const CLOCK = typeof performance !== "undefined" ? performance : Date;
function resetGuards() {
    for (const k of GUARD_NAMES) coreStats[k] = 0;
}
function idsForPlate(job) {
    const n = job.nItems | 0;
    const drawn = drawnFlags();
    const out = [];
    for (let it = 0; it < n; it++) if (drawn[it]) out.push(job.ids[it]);
    out.sort((u, v) => u - v);
    let w = 0;
    for (let k = 0; k < out.length; k++) if (k === 0 || out[k] !== out[k - 1]) out[w++] = out[k];
    out.length = w;
    return out;
}
export async function runJob(msg, opts) {
    const o = opts || {};
    const clock = o.clock || CLOCK;
    let mark = o.receivedAt != null ? o.receivedAt : clock.now();
    resetGuards();
    const job = unwireJob(msg);
    const nPlates = job.plates.length / 2;
    const timings = new Float64Array(TIMINGS_PER_PLATE * nPlates);
    const counts = new Uint32Array(COUNTS_PER_PLATE * nPlates);
    const idOff = new Uint32Array(nPlates);
    const useBitmap = o.bitmaps != null
        ? !!o.bitmaps
        : (typeof createImageBitmap === "function" && typeof ImageData === "function");
    const bitmaps = useBitmap ? new Array(nPlates).fill(null) : null;
    const pixels = useBitmap ? null : new Array(nPlates).fill(null);
    const ids = [];
    let serialiseMs = 0;
    for (let p = 0; p < nPlates; p++) {
        const t0 = clock.now();
        timings[p * TIMINGS_PER_PLATE] = t0 - mark;
        renderPlate(job, p, RGBA,
            counts.subarray(p * COUNTS_PER_PLATE, (p + 1) * COUNTS_PER_PLATE),
            timings.subarray(p * TIMINGS_PER_PLATE, (p + 1) * TIMINGS_PER_PLATE));
        const t1 = clock.now();
        timings[p * TIMINGS_PER_PLATE + 1] = t1 - t0;
        idOff[p] = ids.length;
        const drawn = counts[p * COUNTS_PER_PLATE + 1];
        if (drawn > 0) {
            const set = idsForPlate(job);
            for (let k = 0; k < set.length; k++) ids.push(set[k]);
            if (useBitmap) bitmaps[p] = await createImageBitmap(new ImageData(RGBA, TW, TH));
            else pixels[p] = copyPlate(RGBA);
        }
        const t2 = clock.now();
        serialiseMs += t2 - t1;
        mark = t2;
    }
    const guards = new Uint32Array(GUARDS_PER_JOB);
    for (let g = 0; g < GUARD_NAMES.length; g++) guards[g] = coreStats[GUARD_NAMES[g]] | 0;
    const recycled = [];
    for (const k of RECYCLE) if (job[k] && job[k].buffer) recycled.push(job[k]);
    const out = wireResult({
        jobId: job.jobId, frameSeq: job.frameSeq,
        plates: job.plates, epochs: job.epochs,
        bitmaps, pixels,
        idOff, idSet: Int32Array.from(ids),
        timings, counts, guards,
        recycled, serialiseMs,
    });
    out.msg.serialiseMs = serialiseMs + (clock.now() - mark);
    return out;
}
if (typeof window === "undefined" && typeof self !== "undefined" && typeof self.postMessage === "function") {
    self.onmessage = (e) => {
        const msg = (e && e.data) || {};
        const receivedAt = CLOCK.now();
        Promise.resolve()
            .then(() => runJob(msg, { receivedAt }))
            .then((out) => self.postMessage(out.msg, out.transfer))
            .catch((err) => self.postMessage({
                kind: "raster-error", jobId: msg.jobId, frameSeq: msg.frameSeq,
                err: String((err && err.message) || err),
            }));
    };
}

    }
};

const now = () => (typeof performance !== "undefined" ? performance.now() : Date.now());
export const LOCAL_AUTOSAVE = true;

    off: true, quota: false, at: Date.now(),

export default function useKobinEngine({ canvasId = null, onAutosave, gated = false, onRefused = null } = {}) {
    const hostRef = useRef(null);
    const engineRef = useRef(null);
    const errsRef = useRef([]);
    const onAutosaveRef = useRef(null);
    onAutosaveRef.current = onAutosave;
    const onRefusedRef = useRef(null);
    onRefusedRef.current = onRefused;
    const persistRef = useRef(true);
    const saverRef = useRef(null);
    const writableRef = useRef(!gated);
    const writerRef = useRef(null);
    const refusedRef = useRef(false);
    const endGestureRef = useRef(null);
    const lastWriteRef = useRef(null);
    const [engineReady, setEngineReady] = useState(false);
    const [tool, setTool] = useState("pen");
    const [penType, setPenType] = useState("freehand");
    const [color, setColor] = useState("#000000");
    const [width, setWidth] = useState(12);
    const [opacity, setOpacity] = useState(1);
    const [eraserSize, setEraserSize] = useState(16);
    const [ctrlSign, setCtrlSign] = useState(null);
    const [status, setStatus] = useState(DEFAULT_STATUS);
    const [saveError, setSaveError] = useState(LOCAL_AUTOSAVE ? null : AUTOSAVE_OFF_NOTICE);
    const patchDocMeta = useCallback((patch) => {
        const E = engineRef.current;
        if (!E) return;
        E.docMeta = { ...E.docMeta, ...patch };
        if (patch.scaleDef !== undefined) E.setScaleDef(patch.scaleDef);
        saverRef.current?.markHeaderDirty();
    }, []);
    useEffect(() => {
        const host = hostRef.current;
        if (!host) return;
        const w = window.innerWidth, h = window.innerHeight;
        const th = { last: 0, timer: null, latest: null, lastZoom: null };
        const onStatus = (s) => {
            th.latest = s;
            if (s.effectiveZoom !== th.lastZoom) {
                th.lastZoom = s.effectiveZoom;
                th.last = performance.now();
                if (th.timer) { clearTimeout(th.timer); th.timer = null; }
                setStatus(s);
                return;
            }
            const now = performance.now();
            const due = 50 - (now - th.last);
            if (due <= 0) { th.last = now; setStatus(th.latest); }
            else if (!th.timer) th.timer = setTimeout(() => { th.timer = null; th.last = performance.now(); setStatus(th.latest); }, due);
        };
        const engine = new KobinEngine(host, { width: w, height: h, onStatus, raster: true });
        engineRef.current = engine;
        if (gated) engine.readOnly = true;
        if (engine.frameMeter) engine.frameMeter.onFrame = rasterPerf.onFrame;
        if (!canvasId) persistRef.current = false;
        let disposed = false;
        let restored = false;
        let hasBase = false;
        let fullDirty = false;
        let docSeq = 0;
        let savedSeq = 0;
        let firstDirtyAt = 0;
        let debounceT = null;
        let saving = false;
        let inflight = null;
        let again = false;
        let lastSavedCam = null;
        let lastSeenCam = null;
        let failCount = 0;
        let skipUntil = 0;
        let failedSeq = -1;
        let lastOkAt = 0, lastFail = null;
        let frameSeq = {};
        const logBytes = new Map(), snapBytes = new Map(), markSeq = new Map();
        let carried = [];
        let resetPending = false;
        let lastFloor = 0;
        const log = new OpLog(engine);
        const camKey = () => {
            const c = engine.cam.state();
            return `${c.frame}|${c.activeLevel}|${c.inScale}|${c.inPanX}|${c.inPanY}`;
        };
        const isQuota = (err) => !!err && (
            err.name === "QuotaExceededError"
            || err.name === "NS_ERROR_DOM_QUOTA_REACHED"
            || err.code === 22 || err.code === 1014);
        const schedule = () => {
            if (!LOCAL_AUTOSAVE || disposed) return;
            clearTimeout(debounceT);
            const waited = firstDirtyAt ? now() - firstDirtyAt : 0;
            const delay = Math.max(0, Math.min(SAVE_DEBOUNCE_MS, SAVE_MAX_WAIT_MS - waited));
            debounceT = setTimeout(() => save("timer"), delay);
        };
        const markDirty = (full) => {
            docSeq += 1;
            if (full) fullDirty = true;
            if (!firstDirtyAt) firstDirtyAt = now();
            schedule();
        };
        const unsubDirty = engine.doc.subscribe((ev) => {
            if (ev.kind === "reset") { if (!ev.load) markDirty(true); return; }
            markDirty(false);
        });
        const unsubOps = engine.doc.subscribeOps(() => markDirty(false));
        const outgrown = (L) => (logBytes.get(L) || 0) > Math.max(SNAPSHOT_MIN_BYTES, (snapBytes.get(L) || 0) / 4);
        const noteEntries = (entries, fs) => {
            for (const e of entries) {
                const bytes = (e.geo ? e.geo.byteLength : 0) + 200;
                for (const L of e.touches || []) if (e.seq > (fs[L] || 0)) logBytes.set(L, (logBytes.get(L) || 0) + bytes);
                if (e.op.k === "mark" && e.op.obj) markSeq.set(e.op.obj.id, e.seq);
                if (e.op.k === "spent") markSeq.delete(e.op.id);
            }
        };
        const save = (why, force = false, opts = {}) => {
            if (!LOCAL_AUTOSAVE || !persistRef.current || !restored || !writableRef.current) return Promise.resolve(false);
            const dirty = docSeq !== savedSeq || log.queue.length > 0 || carried.length > 0;
            const cam = camKey();
            if (!dirty && !opts.full) {
                if (!hasBase || cam === lastSavedCam) return Promise.resolve(false);
                if (!force) {
                    if (why !== "check") return Promise.resolve(false);
                    if (cam !== lastSeenCam) { lastSeenCam = cam; return Promise.resolve(false); }
                }
            } else if (!force && failedSeq === docSeq && now() < skipUntil) {
                return Promise.resolve(false);
            }
            if (saving) { again = true; return Promise.resolve(false); }
            const t0 = now();
            const d = log.drain();
            const reset = d.full || resetPending;
            resetPending = false;
            if (reset && hasBase) log.seq += 1;
            const full = fullDirty || !hasBase || reset || !!opts.full;
            const resetLog = reset || !hasBase;
            const entries = reset ? [] : carried.concat(d.entries);
            carried = [];
            const takenFull = fullDirty;
            let takenSeq = docSeq;
            fullDirty = false;
            noteEntries(entries, frameSeq);
            const forced = new Set(d.forced);
            const holding = () => Object.keys(engine.nativesByLevel);
            const want = new Set(full ? holding() : d.forced);
            for (const L of holding()) if (outgrown(L)) want.add(L);
            const snapshots = {};
            let env, frameIds;
            try {
                for (let guard = 0; guard < 5; guard++) {
                    for (const L of holding()) if (!(L in frameSeq)) want.add(L);
                    for (const L of want) if (!(L in snapshots) && engine.nativesByLevel[L]) snapshots[L] = { ...encodeObjects(engine.doc.at(L)), seq: log.seq };
                    if (!log.queue.length) break;
                    const d2 = log.drain();
                    noteEntries(d2.entries, frameSeq);
                    entries.push(...d2.entries);
                    for (const L of d2.forced) { forced.add(L); want.add(L); }
                }
                frameIds = holding();
                const listed = new Set(frameIds);
                for (const L of Object.keys(snapshots)) if (!listed.has(L)) delete snapshots[L];
                takenSeq = docSeq;
                env = engine.serializeDrawing({}, { frames: [] });
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn("kobin autosave: serialize failed", err);
                carried = entries; fullDirty = fullDirty || takenFull;
                for (const L of forced) log.forced.add(L);
                return Promise.resolve(false);
            }
            const { natives: none, ...header } = env;
            const stats = statsFromNatives(engine.nativesByLevel);
            const nextFrameSeq = {};
            for (const L of frameIds) nextFrameSeq[L] = L in snapshots ? log.seq : (frameSeq[L] || 0);
            let floor = log.seq + 1;
            for (const L of frameIds) floor = Math.min(floor, nextFrameSeq[L]);
            for (const op of engine.doc._undo) if (op._seq != null) floor = Math.min(floor, op._seq);
            for (const op of engine.doc._redo) if (op._seq != null) floor = Math.min(floor, op._seq);
            for (const sq of markSeq.values()) floor = Math.min(floor, sq);
            const tSer = now();
            const data = full || resetLog || entries.length > 0 || Object.keys(snapshots).length > 0;
            const putBack = () => { carried = entries.concat(carried); fullDirty = fullDirty || takenFull; resetPending = resetPending || reset; for (const L of forced) log.forced.add(L); };
            saving = true;
            inflight = writeCanvas2(canvasId, {
                header: { ...header, name: header.meta.name, ...stats, seq: log.seq },
                snapshots, frameIds, entries, full, resetLog, dropBelow: Math.max(0, floor), writer: writerRef.current,
            })
                .then((ok) => {
                    if (ok === null) throw new Error("no local database");
                    if (ok === "fenced" || ok === "stale") {
                        putBack(); writableRef.current = false; refusedRef.current = true;
                        engine.notePerf?.("autosaveRefused", t0, { why, refused: ok });
                        if (!disposed && onRefusedRef.current) onRefusedRef.current(ok);
                        return false;
                    }
                    if (ok === false) {
                        hasBase = false; putBack(); fullDirty = true; again = true;
                        return false;
                    }
                    hasBase = true;
                    savedSeq = takenSeq;
                    frameSeq = nextFrameSeq;
                    lastFloor = Math.max(0, floor);
                    for (const L of Object.keys(snapshots)) { snapBytes.set(L, snapshots[L].geo.byteLength); logBytes.delete(L); }
                    for (const L of [...logBytes.keys()]) if (!engine.nativesByLevel[L]) logBytes.delete(L);
                    lastSavedCam = cam; lastSeenCam = cam;
                    failCount = 0; skipUntil = 0; failedSeq = -1; lastOkAt = Date.now();
                    if (docSeq === savedSeq && !log.queue.length) firstDirtyAt = 0;
                    engine.notePerf?.("autosave", t0, {
                        ok: 1, why, full: full ? 1 : 0, frames: Object.keys(snapshots).length, entries: entries.length,
                        serMs: +(tSer - t0).toFixed(1), putMs: +(now() - tSer).toFixed(1),
                    });
                    if (!disposed) {
                        setSaveError(null);
                        onAutosaveRef.current?.({ name: header.meta.name, stats, seq: header.seq, data });
                    }
                    return true;
                })
                .catch((err) => {
                    putBack();
                    const quota = isQuota(err);
                    failedSeq = takenSeq;
                    failCount = Math.min(failCount + 1, 6);
                    skipUntil = now() + 4000 * Math.pow(2, failCount);
                    lastFail = { at: Date.now(), quota, err: String((err && (err.message || err.name)) || err).slice(0, 120) };
                    engine.notePerf?.("autosaveFail", t0, {
                        ok: 0, why, quota: quota ? 1 : 0, full: full ? 1 : 0,
                        err: String((err && err.name) || err).slice(0, 60),
                        serMs: +(tSer - t0).toFixed(1),
                        backoffS: Math.round((skipUntil - now()) / 1000),
                    });
                    errsRef.current.push({ t: Date.now(),
                        msg: "autosave failed" + (quota ? " (storage full)" : "")
                            + ": " + String((err && err.message) || err).slice(0, 120) });
                    if (errsRef.current.length > 50) errsRef.current.shift();
                    if (!disposed) {
                        setSaveError({ quota, at: Date.now(),
                            message: quota
                                ? "Storage is full - changes are not being saved."
                                : "Autosave failed - changes are not being saved." });
                    }
                    console.warn("kobin autosave failed" + (quota ? " (storage full)" : ""), err);
                    return false;
                })
                .then((r) => {
                    saving = false; inflight = null;
                    if (again || docSeq !== savedSeq || log.queue.length || carried.length) {
                        again = false;
                        if (disposed) save("dispose", true); else schedule();
                    }
                    return r;
                });
            lastWriteRef.current = inflight;
            return inflight;
        };
        const flush = () => save("flush", true);
        const onHide = () => { if (document.visibilityState === "hidden") flush(); };
        const checkTimer = LOCAL_AUTOSAVE ? setInterval(() => save("check"), SAVE_CHECK_MS) : null;
        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onHide);
        window.addEventListener("pagehide", flush);
        saverRef.current = {
            markHeaderDirty: () => markDirty(false),
            markAllDirty: () => markDirty(false),
            lastFloor: () => lastFloor,
            saveNow: async () => {
                if (inflight) await inflight.catch(() => false);
                return save("explicit", true, { full: true });
            },
            flush: async () => {
                if (!writableRef.current) return !refusedRef.current;
                for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    if (inflight) await inflight.catch(() => false);
                    if (docSeq === savedSeq && !log.queue.length && !carried.length && !fullDirty) return true;
                    await save("handover", true);
                }
                return docSeq === savedSeq && !log.queue.length && !carried.length;
            },
            hasUnsaved: () => refusedRef.current || docSeq !== savedSeq || log.queue.length > 0 || carried.length > 0 || fullDirty || resetPending,
            markReset: () => { resetPending = true; markDirty(true); },
            markKept: () => { log.drain(); carried = []; savedSeq = docSeq; fullDirty = false; resetPending = false; refusedRef.current = false; },
            knownSeq: () => log.seq,
        };
        const restoreFrom = (res, camera = null) => {
            if (res.legacy) {
                engine.loadDrawing(camera ? { ...res.legacy, camera } : res.legacy, { render: false });
                hasBase = false; fullDirty = true;
                return true;
            }
            const natives = {};
            for (const [fid, f] of Object.entries(res.frames)) natives[fid] = decodeObjects(f.objects, f.geo);
            const { store, frameIds, frameSeq: storedSeq, seq, id, name, savedAt, base, intent, pending, writer, ...envelope } = res.header;
            engine.loadDrawing({ ...envelope, ...(camera ? { camera } : {}), natives }, { render: false });
            frameSeq = { ...(storedSeq || {}) };
            log.seq = seq || 0;
            logBytes.clear(); snapBytes.clear(); markSeq.clear(); carried = [];
            for (const [fid, f] of Object.entries(res.frames)) snapBytes.set(fid, f.geo.byteLength);
            log.replaying = true;
            try { log.replay(res.entries, frameSeq, frameIds); } finally { log.replaying = false; }
            noteEntries(res.entries, frameSeq);
            for (const mid of [...markSeq.keys()]) if (!engine.doc.getById(mid)) markSeq.delete(mid);
            engine._scheduleBake();
            hasBase = true;
            return true;
        };
        const renderLoaded = async () => {
            await macroYield();
            if (!disposed) engine._render();
        };
        const settleAfterLoad = (loaded) => {
            if (loaded && hasBase) {
                fullDirty = false; savedSeq = docSeq; firstDirtyAt = 0;
                clearTimeout(debounceT);
            }
            lastSavedCam = lastSeenCam = camKey();
            if (docSeq !== savedSeq || fullDirty) schedule();
        };
        const restoreP = canvasId ? loadCanvasStore(canvasId) : Promise.resolve(null);
        restoreP.then(async (res) => {
            if (disposed || !res) return false;
            try { return restoreFrom(res); } catch (err) {
                console.warn("kobin autosave restore failed", err);
                await backupCanvasDoc(canvasId);
                return false;
            }
        }, (err) => { console.warn("kobin autosave restore failed", err); return false; })
        .then(async (loaded) => {
            if (disposed) return;
            await renderLoaded();
            if (disposed) return;
            restored = true;
            settleAfterLoad(loaded);
            if (loaded) engine.sweepFrames();
            setEngineReady(true);
        });
        saverRef.current.reload = async ({ keepCamera = false } = {}) => {
            if (inflight) await inflight.catch(() => false);
            const t0 = now();
            const res = await loadCanvasStore(canvasId);
            if (!res || disposed) return null;
            const cam = keepCamera ? engine.cam.state() : null;
            log.drain();
            try {
                restoreFrom(res, cam);
                settleAfterLoad(true);
                engine.sweepFrames();
                refusedRef.current = false; resetPending = false;
            } finally { await renderLoaded(); }
            return now() - t0;
        };
        saverRef.current.refreshMeta = async () => {
            const h = await getStoreHeader(canvasId);
            if (!h || !h.meta || disposed) return false;
            if (typeof h.meta.name === "string") engine.docMeta = { ...engine.docMeta, name: h.meta.name };
            engine.setScaleDef(h.meta.scaleDef || null);
            const mine = new Map((engine.docMeta.scenes || []).map((s) => [s.id, s]));
            for (const s of Array.isArray(h.meta.scenes) ? h.meta.scenes : []) {
                const m = s && mine.get(s.id);
                if (m && typeof s.name === "string" && s.name && s.name !== m.name) engine.renameScene(s.id, s.name);
            }
            return true;
        };
        const onErr = (e) => {
            errsRef.current.push({ t: Date.now(), msg: String((e && (e.message || e.reason)) || e) });
            if (errsRef.current.length > 50) errsRef.current.shift();
        };
        window.addEventListener("error", onErr);
        window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", onErr);
        const rel = (e) => {
            const r = host.getBoundingClientRect();
            return [e.clientX - r.left, e.clientY - r.top];
        };
        const pointers = new Map();
        let pinch = null;
        let ignoreId = null;
        let downT = 0;
        const mid = (a, b) => [(a[0] + b[0]) / 2, (a[1] + b[1]) / 2];
        const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1]);
        const PINCH_GRACE_MS = 400;
        const down = (e) => {
            if (e.pointerType === "mouse" && e.button !== 0) return;
            const p = rel(e);
            pointers.set(e.pointerId, p);
            if (pointers.size === 1) {
                ignoreId = null;
                downT = Date.now();
                engine.pointerDown(p[0], p[1], e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey);
            } else if (pointers.size === 2) {
                if (engine._drawing && Date.now() - engine._drawStartT < PINCH_GRACE_MS) engine.cancelStroke();
                else if (engine.tool === "select") engine.cancelSelectGesture(Date.now() - downT > PINCH_GRACE_MS);
                else engine.pointerUp();
                const [a, b] = [...pointers.values()];
                pinch = { mid: mid(a, b), dist: dist(a, b) };
            }
            if (e.cancelable) e.preventDefault();
        };
        const move = (e) => {
            if (!pointers.has(e.pointerId)) return;
            const p = rel(e);
            pointers.set(e.pointerId, p);
            if (pinch && pointers.size >= 2) {
                const [a, b] = [...pointers.values()];
                const m = mid(a, b), d = dist(a, b);
                const factor = pinch.dist > 0 && d > 0 ? d / pinch.dist : 1;
                engine.pinchUpdate(m[0], m[1], factor, m[0] - pinch.mid[0], m[1] - pinch.mid[1]);
                pinch = { mid: m, dist: d };
            } else if (!pinch && e.pointerId !== ignoreId) {
                engine.pointerMove(p[0], p[1]);
            }
        };
        const up = (e) => {
            if (!pointers.has(e.pointerId)) return;
            pointers.delete(e.pointerId);
            if (pinch) {
                if (pointers.size < 2) {
                    pinch = null;
                    ignoreId = pointers.size === 1 ? [...pointers.keys()][0] : null;
                }
            } else if (e.pointerId !== ignoreId) {
                engine.pointerUp();
            }
            if (pointers.size === 0) ignoreId = null;
        };
        const resetGesture = () => {
            const busy = pointers.size || engine._drawing || engine._dragSel || engine._lasso || engine._selPress || engine._panLast;
            pointers.clear(); pinch = null; ignoreId = null;
            if (!busy) return;
            if (engine.tool === "select") engine.cancelSelectGesture(true);
            else engine.pointerUp();
        };
        const onBlur = () => resetGesture();
        endGestureRef.current = resetGesture;
        const onVisReset = () => { if (document.visibilityState === "hidden") resetGesture(); };
        const wheel = (e) => { e.preventDefault(); const [x, y] = rel(e); engine.zoomAt(x, y, e.deltaY); };
        let resizeT = null;
        const onResize = () => {
            clearTimeout(resizeT);
            resizeT = setTimeout(() => engine.resize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight), 150);
        };
        const gesturePrevent = (e) => e.preventDefault();
        const onKey = (e) => {
            const t = e.target;
            if (t && (t.tagName === "INPUT" || t.tagName === "TEXTAREA" || t.isContentEditable)) return;
            if (!(e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) {
                if ((e.key === "Delete" || e.key === "Backspace") && engine.selection && !engine.readOnly) {
                    e.preventDefault(); engine.deleteSelection();
                }
                return;
            }
            const k = e.key.toLowerCase();
            if (k === "z") { e.preventDefault(); if (e.shiftKey) engine.redo(); else engine.undo(); markDirty(null, true); }
            else if (k === "y") { e.preventDefault(); engine.redo(); markDirty(null, true); }
        };
        host.addEventListener("pointerdown", down);
        window.addEventListener("pointermove", move);
        window.addEventListener("pointerup", up);
        window.addEventListener("pointercancel", up);
        host.addEventListener("wheel", wheel, { passive: false });
        host.addEventListener("gesturestart", gesturePrevent);
        host.addEventListener("gesturechange", gesturePrevent);
        window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);
        window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey);
        window.addEventListener("blur", onBlur);
        document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisReset);
        return () => {
            if (checkTimer) clearInterval(checkTimer);
            clearTimeout(debounceT);
            clearTimeout(resizeT);
            clearTimeout(th.timer);
            unsubDirty(); unsubOps(); log.detach();
            document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onHide);
            window.removeEventListener("pagehide", flush);
            if (LOCAL_AUTOSAVE) flush();
            disposed = true;
            saverRef.current = null;
            window.removeEventListener("error", onErr);
            window.removeEventListener("unhandledrejection", onErr);
            host.removeEventListener("pointerdown", down);
            window.removeEventListener("pointermove", move);
            window.removeEventListener("pointerup", up);
            window.removeEventListener("pointercancel", up);
            host.removeEventListener("wheel", wheel);
            host.removeEventListener("gesturestart", gesturePrevent);
            host.removeEventListener("gesturechange", gesturePrevent);
            window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize);
            window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey);
            window.removeEventListener("blur", onBlur);
            document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisReset);
            engine.destroy();
            setEngineReady(false);
        };
    }, [canvasId]);
    useEffect(() => { engineRef.current && engineRef.current.setTool(tool); }, [tool]);
    useEffect(() => { engineRef.current && engineRef.current.setPenType(penType); }, [penType]);
    useEffect(() => { engineRef.current && engineRef.current.setColor(color); }, [color]);
    useEffect(() => { engineRef.current && engineRef.current.setWidth(width); }, [width]);
    useEffect(() => { engineRef.current && engineRef.current.setOpacity(opacity); }, [opacity]);
    useEffect(() => { engineRef.current && engineRef.current.setEraserSize(eraserSize); }, [eraserSize]);
    const pickPen = (type) => { setPenType(type); setTool("pen"); };
    const E = () => engineRef.current;
    const saveLocal = async (name) => {
        const eng = E();
        if (!eng || !persistRef.current || !canvasId) return null;
        if (name) patchDocMeta({ name });
        try {
            const ok = saverRef.current ? await saverRef.current.saveNow() : false;
            if (!ok) return null;
            return eng.serializeDrawing();
        } catch (err) {
            return null;
        }
    };
    const saveDrawing = (name) => {
        const eng = E();
        if (!eng) return;
        const doc = eng.serializeDrawing({ name });
        const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(doc)], { type: "application/json" });
        const a = document.createElement("a");
        a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        a.download = (doc.meta.name || "untitled") + ".boundless.json";
        a.click();
        URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
    };
    const loadDrawingFile = async (file) => {
        const eng = E();
        if (!eng || !file) return;
        if (eng.readOnly) throw new Error("another tab or device has the pen");
        const raw = JSON.parse(await file.text());
        eng.loadDrawing(raw);
        if (saverRef.current && saverRef.current.markReset) saverRef.current.markReset();
        await saveLocal();
    };
    useEffect(() => {
        if (tool !== "select") { setCtrlSign(null); return undefined; }
        const host = hostRef.current;
        if (!host) return undefined;
        let pt = null;
        const signAt = () => {
            const E = engineRef.current;
            if (!E || !pt) return "+";
            const id = E.hitTestAt(pt[0], pt[1]);
            const sel = E.selection;
            return id != null && sel && sel.ids.indexOf(id) >= 0 ? "-" : "+";
        };
        const onMove = (e) => {
            const r = host.getBoundingClientRect();
            pt = [e.clientX - r.left, e.clientY - r.top];
            setCtrlSign((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) ? signAt() : null);
        };
        const onDown = (e) => { if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) setCtrlSign(signAt()); };
        const onUp = (e) => { if (!(e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) setCtrlSign(null); };
        const clear = () => setCtrlSign(null);
        window.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
        window.addEventListener("keydown", onDown);
        window.addEventListener("keyup", onUp);
        window.addEventListener("blur", clear);
        return () => {
            window.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
            window.removeEventListener("keydown", onDown);
            window.removeEventListener("keyup", onUp);
            window.removeEventListener("blur", clear);
        };
    }, [tool, hostRef, engineRef]);
    const cursor = tool === "pan" ? "grab"
        : (tool === "erase" || tool === "erasePartial") ? "cell"
        : tool === "select" ? (ctrlSign ? SIGN_CURSOR[ctrlSign] : "default")
        : "crosshair";
    return {
        hostRef,
        engineRef,
        engineReady,
        tool, setTool,
        penType, setPenType,
        color, setColor,
        width, setWidth,
        opacity, setOpacity,
        eraserSize, setEraserSize,
        status,
        saveError,
        pickPen,
        cursor,
        patchDocMeta,
        disablePersist: () => { persistRef.current = false; },
        saveLocal,
        saveDrawing,
        loadDrawingFile,
        undo: () => { E()?.undo(); saverRef.current?.markAllDirty(); },
        redo: () => { E()?.redo(); saverRef.current?.markAllDirty(); },
        clear: () => E()?.clear(),
        deleteSelection: () => { const e = E(); if (e && !e.readOnly) e.deleteSelection(); },
        deselect: () => E()?.deselect(),
        docMeta: () => E()?.docMeta ?? { name: null },
        stats: () => (E() ? statsFromNatives(E().nativesByLevel) : { strokes: 0, levels: 0 }),
        cloudPushSource: async () => {
            if (!canvasId) return null;
            const src = await cloudPushSource(canvasId, writerRef.current);
            return src ? { ...src, dropBelow: saverRef.current ? saverRef.current.lastFloor() : 0 } : null;
        },
        setReadOnly: (on) => {
            const eng = E();
            if (!eng) return;
            if (on && !eng.readOnly) { if (endGestureRef.current) endGestureRef.current(); if (eng.deselect) eng.deselect(); }
            eng.readOnly = !!on;
        },
        setSaving: (on) => { writableRef.current = !!on; },
        setWriter: (token) => { writerRef.current = token || null; },
        hasUnsaved: () => !!(saverRef.current && saverRef.current.hasUnsaved()),
        keepUnsaved: async (name) => {
            const eng = E();
            if (!eng || !canvasId) return null;
            let doc;
            const meta = eng.docMeta;
            try { doc = eng.serializeDrawing({ name }); } catch (err) { return null; } finally { eng.docMeta = meta; }
            const id = newCanvasId();
            if (!(await saveCanvasDoc(id, doc))) return null;
            const entry = { id, name, savedAt: new Date().toISOString(), ...statsFromDoc(doc) };
            upsertIndexEntry(entry);
            if (saverRef.current && saverRef.current.markKept) saverRef.current.markKept();
            return entry;
        },
        knownSeq: () => (saverRef.current && saverRef.current.knownSeq ? saverRef.current.knownSeq() : null),
        idle: async () => {
            if (saverRef.current && saverRef.current.flush) return saverRef.current.flush();
            const t0 = Date.now();
            for (let p = lastWriteRef.current; p && Date.now() - t0 < 10000; p = lastWriteRef.current) {
                await Promise.resolve(p).catch(() => null);
                if (lastWriteRef.current === p) break;
            }
            return true;
        },
        flushSave: () => (saverRef.current && saverRef.current.flush ? saverRef.current.flush() : Promise.resolve(true)),
        reloadFromStore: (opts) => (saverRef.current && saverRef.current.reload ? saverRef.current.reload(opts) : Promise.resolve(null)),
        refreshMetaFromStore: () => (saverRef.current && saverRef.current.refreshMeta ? saverRef.current.refreshMeta() : Promise.resolve(false)),
        lastWrite: () => lastWriteRef.current,
    };
}
export function fmtZoom(z) {
    if (!(z > 0) || !Number.isFinite(z)) return "1";
    if (z >= 1e9 || z < 1e-3) return formatScaleNumber(z);
    if (z >= 1e6) return (z / 1e6).toFixed(2) + "M";
    if (z >= 1e3) return (z / 1e3).toFixed(2) + "k";
    return z.toFixed(2);
}
export function zoomLabel(zoom) {
    if (zoom >= 1) return `${fmtZoom(zoom)}×`;
    return `1/${fmtZoom(1 / zoom)}×`;
}

    Object.defineProperty(Array.prototype, "at", {
        value(n) { n = Math.trunc(n) || 0; if (n < 0) n += this.length; return n < 0 || n >= this.length ? undefined : this[n]; },
        writable: true, configurable: true,
    });

//// src/storage/db.js
import LZString from "lz-string";
export const DB_NAME = "boundless";
export const DB_VERSION = 2;
let dbPromise = null;
export function idbAvailable() {
    try { return typeof indexedDB !== "undefined" && indexedDB != null; } catch (err) { return false; }
}
export function openDb() {
    if (dbPromise) return dbPromise;
    if (!idbAvailable()) { dbPromise = Promise.resolve(null); return dbPromise; }
    dbPromise = new Promise((resolve) => {
        let req;
        try { req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION); } catch (err) { resolve(null); return; }
        req.onupgradeneeded = () => {
            const db = req.result;
            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains("canvases")) db.createObjectStore("canvases", { keyPath: "id" });
            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains("frames")) {
                const s = db.createObjectStore("frames", { keyPath: ["canvasId", "frameId"] });
                s.createIndex("byCanvas", "canvasId");
            }
            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains("thumbs")) {
                const s = db.createObjectStore("thumbs", { keyPath: ["canvasId", "sceneId"] });
                s.createIndex("byCanvas", "canvasId");
                s.createIndex("byUsed", "usedAt");
            }
            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains("trash")) db.createObjectStore("trash", { keyPath: "id" });
            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains("backups")) db.createObjectStore("backups", { keyPath: "id" });
            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains("frames2")) {
                const s = db.createObjectStore("frames2", { keyPath: ["canvasId", "frameId"] });
                s.createIndex("byCanvas", "canvasId");
            }
            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains("log")) {
                const s = db.createObjectStore("log", { keyPath: ["canvasId", "seq"] });
                s.createIndex("byCanvas", "canvasId");
            }
        };
        req.onsuccess = () => {
            const db = req.result;
            db.onversionchange = () => { db.close(); dbPromise = null; };
            resolve(db);
        };
        req.onerror = () => { console.warn("bound.less: IndexedDB unavailable", req.error); resolve(null); };
    });
    return dbPromise;
}
const reqp = (r) => new Promise((res, rej) => {
    r.onsuccess = () => res(r.result);
    r.onerror = () => rej(r.error);
});
export async function tx(names, mode, fn) {
    const db = await openDb();
    if (!db) return null;
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        let t;
        try { t = db.transaction(names, mode); } catch (err) { reject(err); return; }
        let out;
        let failed = null;
        t.oncomplete = () => (failed ? reject(failed) : resolve(out));
        t.onerror = () => { failed = failed || t.error; };
        t.onabort = () => reject(failed || t.error || new Error("IndexedDB transaction aborted"));
        const stores = names.map((n) => t.objectStore(n));
        try {
            const r = fn(...stores);
            if (r && typeof r.then === "function") {
                r.then((v) => { out = v; }, (err) => { failed = err; try { t.abort(); } catch (e2) {  } });
            } else out = r;
        } catch (err) {
            failed = err;
            try { t.abort(); } catch (e2) {  }
        }
    });
}
const only = (v) => IDBKeyRange.only(v);
export function putCanvas(id, { header, frames, frameIds, full }) {
    return tx(["canvases", "frames"], "readwrite", async (canvases, store) => {
        const prev = await reqp(canvases.get(id));
        if (!prev && !full) return false;
        const now = new Set(frameIds);
        if (full) {
            const keys = await reqp(store.index("byCanvas").getAllKeys(only(id)));
            for (const k of keys) if (!now.has(k[1])) store.delete(k);
        } else {
            for (const fid of prev.frameIds || []) if (!now.has(fid)) store.delete([id, fid]);
        }
        for (const fid of Object.keys(frames || {})) {
            store.put({ canvasId: id, frameId: fid, objects: frames[fid] });
        }
        canvases.put({
            ...header,
            id,
            frameIds: [...frameIds],
            savedAt: header.savedAt || new Date().toISOString(),
        });
        return true;
    });
}
function headerToDoc(h, natives) {
    const doc = { format: h.format, version: h.version, meta: h.meta, camera: h.camera, crossings: h.crossings, natives };
    return doc;
}
export function getCanvasHeader(id) {
    return tx(["canvases"], "readonly", (canvases) => reqp(canvases.get(id)));
}
export function listCanvasHeaders() {
    return tx(["canvases"], "readonly", (canvases) => reqp(canvases.getAll())).then((l) => l || []);
}
export function patchCanvasHeader(id, fn, writer = null) {
    return tx(["canvases"], "readwrite", async (canvases) => {
        const h = await reqp(canvases.get(id));
        if (!h) return false;
        if (writer != null && h.writer && h.writer !== writer) return "fenced";
        canvases.put({ ...fn(h), id });
        return true;
    });
}
export function deleteCanvas(id) {
    return tx(["canvases", "frames", "frames2", "log"], "readwrite", async (canvases, store, frames2, log) => {
        canvases.delete(id);
        for (const s of [store, frames2, log]) {
            const keys = await reqp(s.index("byCanvas").getAllKeys(only(id)));
            for (const k of keys) s.delete(k);
        }
        return true;
    });
}
export function deleteOrphanFrames() {
    return tx(["canvases", "frames", "frames2", "log"], "readwrite", async (canvases, store, frames2, log) => {
        const ids = new Set(await reqp(canvases.getAllKeys()));
        let n = 0;
        for (const s of [store, frames2, log]) {
            const keys = await reqp(s.getAllKeys());
            for (const k of keys) if (!ids.has(k[0])) { s.delete(k); n++; }
        }
        return n;
    }).then((n) => n || 0);
}
const bufferOf = (geo) => (geo.byteOffset === 0 && geo.byteLength === geo.buffer.byteLength
    ? geo.buffer : geo.buffer.slice(geo.byteOffset, geo.byteOffset + geo.byteLength));
export const STORE_V2 = "kobin-2";
export const SYNC_FIELDS = ["base", "intent", "pending", "writer"];
export function putCanvas2(id, { header, snapshots = {}, frameIds, entries = [], full = false, resetLog = false, dropBelow = 0, writer = null, rewind = false }) {
    return tx(["canvases", "frames", "frames2", "log"], "readwrite", async (canvases, v1, frames2, log) => {
        const prev = await reqp(canvases.get(id));
        if (!prev && !full) return false;
        if (prev && writer != null && prev.writer && prev.writer !== writer) return "fenced";
        if (prev && !rewind && prev.store === STORE_V2 && (header.seq || 0) < (prev.seq || 0)) return "stale";
        const now = new Set(frameIds);
        const frameSeq = { ...((prev && prev.store === STORE_V2 && prev.frameSeq) || {}) };
        if (full) {
            for (const k of await reqp(frames2.index("byCanvas").getAllKeys(only(id)))) if (!now.has(k[1])) frames2.delete(k);
            for (const k of await reqp(v1.index("byCanvas").getAllKeys(only(id)))) v1.delete(k);
        } else if (prev.frameIds) {
            for (const fid of prev.frameIds) if (!now.has(fid)) frames2.delete([id, fid]);
        }
        for (const fid of Object.keys(frameSeq)) if (!now.has(fid)) delete frameSeq[fid];
        if (resetLog) {
            for (const k of await reqp(log.index("byCanvas").getAllKeys(only(id)))) log.delete(k);
        } else if (dropBelow > 0) {
            log.delete(IDBKeyRange.bound([id, 0], [id, dropBelow], false, true));
        }
        for (const fid of Object.keys(snapshots)) {
            const s = snapshots[fid];
            frames2.put({ canvasId: id, frameId: fid, seq: s.seq || 0, objects: s.objects, geo: bufferOf(s.geo) });
            frameSeq[fid] = s.seq || 0;
        }
        for (const e of entries) {
            log.put({ canvasId: id, seq: e.seq, t: e.t, op: e.op, geo: e.geo && e.geo.length ? bufferOf(e.geo) : null, touches: e.touches || [] });
        }
        const sync = {};
        if (prev) for (const k of SYNC_FIELDS) if (prev[k] !== undefined && !(k in header)) sync[k] = prev[k];
        if (writer != null) sync.writer = writer;
        canvases.put({
            ...sync,
            ...header,
            id,
            store: STORE_V2,
            frameIds: [...frameIds],
            frameSeq,
            seq: header.seq || 0,
            savedAt: header.savedAt || new Date().toISOString(),
        });
        return true;
    });
}
export function getCanvas2(id) {
    return tx(["canvases", "frames", "frames2", "log"], "readonly", async (canvases, v1, frames2, log) => {
        const h = await reqp(canvases.get(id));
        if (!h) return null;
        if (h.store !== STORE_V2) {
            const recs = await reqp(v1.index("byCanvas").getAll(only(id)));
            const natives = {};
            for (const r of recs) natives[r.frameId] = r.objects;
            return { legacy: headerToDoc(h, natives) };
        }
        const frames = (await reqp(frames2.index("byCanvas").getAll(only(id)))).map((r) => ({
            frameId: r.frameId, seq: r.seq || 0, objects: r.objects, geo: new Float64Array(r.geo),
        }));
        const entries = (await reqp(log.index("byCanvas").getAll(only(id))))
            .map((r) => ({ seq: r.seq, t: r.t, op: r.op, geo: r.geo ? new Float64Array(r.geo) : new Float64Array(0), touches: r.touches || [] }))
            .sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
        return { header: h, frames, entries };
    });
}
export function copyCanvas2(fromId, toId, patch = (h) => h) {
    return tx(["canvases", "frames", "frames2", "log"], "readwrite", async (canvases, v1, frames2, log) => {
        const h = await reqp(canvases.get(fromId));
        if (!h) return false;
        for (const s of [v1, frames2, log]) {
            const recs = await reqp(s.index("byCanvas").getAll(only(fromId)));
            for (const r of recs) s.put({ ...r, canvasId: toId });
        }
        canvases.put({ ...patch({ ...h }), id: toId });
        return true;
    }).then((ok) => ok === true);
}
const stamp = (h) => (h ? `${h.seq}|${h.savedAt}|${JSON.stringify(h.frameSeq || {})}|${(h.frameIds || []).join(",")}` : "");
export async function getCanvas2Chunked(id, { onChunk = null } = {}) {
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
        const h = await tx(["canvases"], "readonly", (c) => reqp(c.get(id)));
        if (!h) return null;
        if (h.store !== STORE_V2) return getCanvas2(id);
        const frames = [];
        for (const fid of h.frameIds || []) {
            const r = await tx(["frames2"], "readonly", (f) => reqp(f.get([id, fid])));
            if (r) frames.push({ frameId: r.frameId, seq: r.seq || 0, objects: r.objects, geo: new Float64Array(r.geo) });
            if (onChunk) await onChunk();
        }
        const logs = await tx(["log"], "readonly", (l) => reqp(l.index("byCanvas").getAll(only(id))));
        const h2 = await tx(["canvases"], "readonly", (c) => reqp(c.get(id)));
        if (stamp(h2) !== stamp(h)) continue;
        const entries = (logs || [])
            .map((r) => ({ seq: r.seq, t: r.t, op: r.op, geo: r.geo ? new Float64Array(r.geo) : new Float64Array(0), touches: r.touches || [] }))
            .sort((a, b) => a.seq - b.seq);
        return { header: h2, frames, entries };
    }
    return getCanvas2(id);
}
export async function copyCanvas2Chunked(fromId, toId, patch = (h) => h) {
    const h = await tx(["canvases"], "readonly", (c) => reqp(c.get(fromId)));
    if (!h) return false;
    if (h.store !== STORE_V2) return copyCanvas2(fromId, toId, patch);
    for (const fid of h.frameIds || []) {
        await tx(["frames2"], "readwrite", async (f) => {
            const r = await reqp(f.get([fromId, fid]));
            if (r) f.put({ ...r, canvasId: toId });
        });
    }
    await tx(["log"], "readwrite", async (l) => {
        for (const r of await reqp(l.index("byCanvas").getAll(only(fromId)))) l.put({ ...r, canvasId: toId });
    });
    const ok = await tx(["canvases"], "readwrite", async (c) => {
        const cur = await reqp(c.get(fromId));
        if (stamp(cur) !== stamp(h)) return false;
        c.put({ ...patch({ ...cur }), id: toId });
        return true;
    });
    if (ok === true) return true;
    await deleteCanvas(toId);
    return copyCanvas2(fromId, toId, patch);
}
